jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Site Design & Field Operations
jobs.description: Civil Engineer – Site Design \& Field Operations (PE or EI) Wages Civil LLC \| Canton, Mississippi \| Full\-time About Wages Civil The success of our clients is what drives us to perform selflessly and diligently on a daily basis. At Wages Civil, our engineers do more than design projects. They help bring them to life. Our team works on industrial site development, roadways, grading, drainage, utilities, and infrastructure projects throughout Mississippi. Our engineering leadership has contributed to major developments including Nissan North America in Canton, Toyota in Blue Springs, and the Madison County Mega Site. The Opportunity We are looking for a civil engineer who can thrive in both design and construction—someone who can develop practical solutions in Civil 3D and wants to see those plans take shape in the field. This position combines site and roadway design with hands\-on project coordination and construction\-site involvement. Responsibilities · Prepare and coordinate civil site and roadway designs, plans, and specifications using AutoCAD Civil 3D. · Visit project sites, observe construction, and work through practical field conditions. · Work directly and communicate effectively with contractors, clients, surveyors, and project managers. · Help resolve field conditions, constructability issues, and project challenges. · Contribute to site grading, drainage, roadway, water, sewer, and other infrastructure projects. · Review construction progress and coordinate project documentation. · Manage multiple assignments while maintaining schedules and quality standards. · Demonstrate leadership in a team environment and mentor less experienced personnel as appropriate. Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited university. · Professional Engineer (PE) licensed in the State of Mississippi preferred; experienced Engineer Intern / Engineer\-in\-Training (EI/EIT) candidates encouraged to apply. · Experience in civil site development, grading, roadway design, or related infrastructure projects. · Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D and ability to prepare civil design drawings. · Strong social and written communication skills, organizational skills, and problem\-solving abilities. · Must be willing to learn, accept constructive feedback, and continuously improve professional skills. · Willingness to spend meaningful time in the field and on active construction sites. · Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project locations as needed. Who We're Looking For We value integrity, dedication, initiative, and practical judgment. The right candidate is willing to learn, share knowledge with teammates, take ownership of their work, and move comfortably between design responsibilities and active construction sites. Why Wages Civil? Work alongside experienced engineering leadership on meaningful projects that shape Mississippi communities and industrial development. Build your design skills, gain direct field experience, take on responsibility, and see the real\-world results of your work. If you enjoy solving real\-world engineering challenges and want to see the results of your work beyond the computer screen, we would like to hear from you. Compensation: Competitive and based on qualifications and experience. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to maintain cloud infrastructure, support application deployments, and help keep business systems reliable and secure. You'll work with cloud resources, networking, automation, and monitoring tools to resolve technical issues and improve day\-to\-day operations. The role involves both planned infrastructure work and troubleshooting when something goes wrong. You should be comfortable investigating problems, documenting changes, and working with other technical teams to find practical solutions. We're interested in someone who understands how cloud services fit together and takes care when making changes that could affect live systems. **What You'll Be Responsible For** * Configure, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure based on application and business requirements. * Manage cloud resources such as virtual machines, storage, networking, and access permissions. * Monitor system availability, resource usage, and performance to identify potential problems. * Investigate infrastructure failures, service interruptions, and application deployment issues. * Support the deployment and maintenance of applications hosted in cloud environments. * Review cloud configurations and access controls to identify security risks and areas for improvement. * Use scripts and automation to reduce repetitive infrastructure tasks. * Assist with backup procedures, recovery planning, and routine infrastructure maintenance. * Work with developers and IT colleagues to resolve networking, configuration, and deployment problems. * Review resource consumption and identify opportunities to manage cloud costs. * Maintain accurate documentation of infrastructure configurations, operational procedures, and system changes. * Follow established change\-management procedures and communicate risks before making changes to production environments. **What You'll Bring** We are looking for someone with a practical understanding of cloud infrastructure and a methodical approach to technical problem\-solving. You should have: * Experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * An understanding of virtual machines, cloud storage, networking, and identity and access management. * Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * An understanding of system monitoring, troubleshooting, and infrastructure security. * The ability to investigate technical issues and document the steps taken to resolve them. * Good organisation and attention to detail when managing configurations and system changes. * Clear communication skills when working with technical colleagues and other stakeholders. * The ability to manage priorities and provide accurate progress updates. Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, or CI/CD tools is useful. Relevant cloud certifications are also an advantage. **What to Expect in the Role** You'll be expected to keep infrastructure documentation current, report technical problems promptly, and test changes before they affect production systems. When an issue cannot be resolved immediately, you should explain the impact, document what has been investigated, and communicate the next steps. The role also involves reviewing existing processes and recommending improvements when they can make infrastructure easier to maintain, more reliable, or more secure. **Working Schedule** **Days:** Monday to Friday **Hours:** 9:00 AM–5:00 PM **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **How to Apply** Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Include your cloud engineering experience, the platforms and tools you have used, and any relevant certifications. You can also describe a cloud infrastructure project you worked on, the technical problem you addressed, and your contribution to the result. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** **Applicants will be considered based on job\-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.** Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Montgomery, AL Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site Cloud Engineering Is About More Than Keeping Systems Online Moving applications to the cloud is one thing. Making sure they stay secure, perform well, and continue running as businesses grow is another. Cloud environments change constantly. New services are introduced, workloads increase, and unexpected issues come up. Keeping everything working takes someone who understands the technology, pays attention to the details, and knows when there's a better way to do things. At Althenis Cloud Technologies, we're looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working with infrastructure, solving technical problems, and building systems that businesses can genuinely rely on. You'll be involved in cloud deployments, infrastructure improvements, migrations, and day\-to\-day platform operations. It's a role for someone who likes hands\-on engineering and takes pride in making complicated systems work smoothly. Where You'll Make an Impact Your work will cover the practical side of building, managing, and improving cloud environments. * Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Support cloud migration projects, including planning, configuration, testing, and deployment. * Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools. * Monitor cloud environments, investigate performance issues, and improve system reliability. * Configure networking, storage, virtual machines, and cloud security controls. * Develop scripts and automation to reduce repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. * Support CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with development teams on deployments. * Troubleshoot infrastructure failures, connectivity problems, and application hosting issues. * Review cloud resource usage and recommend improvements to performance and cost efficiency. * Maintain technical documentation and contribute to infrastructure security and compliance practices. What You'll Bring We're looking for someone with solid technical foundations, good troubleshooting instincts, and the confidence to take ownership of their work. The experience we're looking for: * 2–4 years of experience in cloud engineering, systems administration, DevOps, or infrastructure support. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Good understanding of cloud networking, compute, storage, and identity management. * Experience working with Linux or Windows Server environments. * Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. * Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * Understanding of cloud security, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. * Experience troubleshooting technical issues in production environments. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently or with a team. It Would Be Great If You Also Have * AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized applications. * Familiarity with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps. * Experience with cloud monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Grafana. * Knowledge of hybrid cloud environments and cloud migration strategies. * Experience working with multiple clients or managing different cloud environments. The Kind of Engineer We're Looking For You don't have to know every cloud service inside out. Technology changes too quickly for that. What matters is that you're curious, comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems, and willing to find the right solution rather than just the quickest fix. Maybe you notice a deployment process that could be automated. Maybe you find a configuration that's costing more than it should. Or perhaps you're the person who stays calm when a system isn't behaving as expected. Those are the qualities that make a difference in this role. We value engineers who think ahead, communicate clearly, and care about the long\-term reliability of the systems they build. Benefits \& Career Development * Competitive compensation * Performance\-based bonus opportunities * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan * Paid time off and paid holidays * Cloud certification and professional training support * Opportunities to work with modern cloud technologies * Career development and progression opportunities * Collaborative and supportive engineering environment Build Something That Lasts If you enjoy working with cloud technology, solving infrastructure challenges, and improving how systems operate, we'd like to hear from you. Whether you're helping move an application to the cloud, improving an existing environment, or figuring out why something isn't working, your contribution will help make technology more dependable for the businesses using it. Join Althenis Cloud Technologies in Montgomery, Alabama, and help build cloud infrastructure that's ready for whatever comes next. *Althenis Cloud Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law.* Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Demons
jobs.description: **About TypeSafe** ================== **We’re building prod, not god.** TypeSafe is an AI lab pushing frontier model intelligence in a new direction, starting with System One Models. We combine the reasoning of LLMs with the reliability of code, for truly trustworthy AI. Our first model, Jev, launched in September 2026\. While others chase leaderboards, we’re rebuilding the LLM stack from first principles to make models smarter and also dependable enough to run in production. We’re a small, fast team backed by an $870M Series A led by a16z. Made in SF, with love. Come join the frontier. **About the role** ================== We're looking for scrappy engineers who ship data\-tooling interfaces fast. You will progress model intelligence through the interfaces, datasets, and evaluation tooling you build, combining product sense, data science, and engineering. You'll be part of the real "secret sauce" of TypeSafe: figuring out how our models can provide production\-ready reliability in the real world. Our tech stack is primarily Python. We also use TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS for frontend, with Kubernetes for orchestration. We empower developers to use any tooling they find helpful for getting their job done, including AI and agents. **What you'll do** ------------------ Check out our team video: https://vimeo.com/1231083924/22b52f6b1d * Create high\-leverage datasets, products, and user interfaces that unlock new capabilities and use cases on top of our model * Build internal data\-tooling and evaluation interfaces — fast — that make model development clearer (evaluation, debugging, data inspection) * Develop and own evaluation frameworks to measure quality, reliability, and emergent characteristics across model iterations * Run rigorous analyses and experiments to understand how data, training choices, and targeted interventions impact model behavior * Turn raw model outputs and data into clear, inspectable UIs — owning a domain end\-to\-end, with craft and judgment over simple optimization * Partner closely with product managers and customers to translate real\-world needs into concrete model and system improvements * Continuously iterate, learn, and co\-discover new techniques for building exceptional, trustworthy AI products **We are looking for people who** --------------------------------- * Are generalists with solid fundamentals, strong coding ability, and product intuition * Maintain high attention to detail and a strong bar for quality * Enjoy thinking beyond the code to how systems are used in the real world * Are scrappy and hacky, and thrive in ambiguous problem spaces — taking satisfaction in finding creative solutions * Don't trust LLMs blindly — they look at the reality of model generations * Have hands\-on experience implementing LLMs and understand their capabilities and limitations **Life at TypeSafe** ==================== We’re a small, flat, close\-knit team working to make intelligence dependable enough to become part of everyday software. We work fully in person from our San Francisco office near Embarcadero station. We love what we do and care deeply about the work. We strive for excellence and craftsmanship and won’t stop until we get there. When the team wins, we all win, and we enjoy collaborating and inspiring each other to grow—as a team and as individuals. We value emotional honesty, kindness, and bringing your whole self to work. We build machines; we don’t try to be machines. We want TypeSafe to be the place where you do the most impactful work of your career and help define our future as a company. **We provide** ============== * 100% covered health insurance * Daily lunch and dinner * Visa sponsorships * 401K plans Compensation Range: $210K \- $285K

jobs.title: Electronics Hardware Design Engineer (PCB)
jobs.description: **About Austin Sensing Company** -------------------------------- Austin Sensing Company builds radar, acoustic, and RF sensors for defense, public safety, critical infrastructure, and autonomous systems. We design and manufacture our hardware in Austin, Texas, with a focus on making high\-performance sensing reliable, affordable, and widely available. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re hiring an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer to design the circuit boards behind our sensing systems. You’ll own designs from requirements and component selection through schematic capture, PCB layout, board bring\-up, validation, and production. You’ll work closely with RF, FPGA, embedded systems, and mechanical engineers to build boards that perform reliably and can be manufactured consistently. We’re looking for someone who can make sound design decisions, debug their own hardware, and carry a board through multiple revisions into a finished product. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design digital, analog, and mixed\-signal circuits for sensor interfaces, processing, communications, and power distribution. * Own component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing documentation. * Define board stackups, placement, routing constraints, grounding, and power distribution with attention to signal integrity and noise. * Integrate microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memory, data converters, and communications interfaces. * Work with RF engineers on interfaces between RF circuitry and supporting electronics. * Bring up new boards and verify power rails, clocks, interfaces, and functionality. * Diagnose failures using measurements, schematics, and controlled tests. Identify root causes and implement fixes. * Evaluate power consumption, thermal behavior, and electrical margins across operating conditions. * Design for manufacturability and testability, including programming access, test points, and production test requirements. * Work with manufacturing and suppliers to resolve assembly issues, qualify component alternatives, and improve board yield. * Maintain design files, bills of materials, revision history, and validation results. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Experience designing PCBs from initial requirements through bring\-up and production. * Proficiency in Altium Designer or a comparable PCB design tool. * Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, power supplies, grounding, and circuit protection. * Experience designing multilayer boards and applying signal integrity and power integrity principles. * Familiarity with embedded processors, FPGAs, memory, and peripheral interfaces. * Hands\-on debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and electronic loads. * Experience preparing board fabrication and assembly files and reviewing designs with manufacturers. * The ability to explain design tradeoffs and work through issues with firmware, RF, and mechanical engineers. * Careful documentation and a willingness to take responsibility for a design through production. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Experience with radar, RF, acoustic, or other sensing hardware. * Experience with high\-speed interfaces such as DDR, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or JESD204\. * Experience with low\-noise analog circuits, ADCs, DACs, and sensor signal conditioning. * Familiarity with EMI/EMC testing and improving designs based on test results. * Experience designing for outdoor environments, temperature extremes, and electrical transients. * Experience supporting production testing and troubleshooting field failures. * A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field. **Benefits** ------------ * 401(k) * Insurance benefits * Lunch and dinner served daily

This role sits at the intersection of **engineering, product, and operations** and is “navigator\-based”: you work closely with navigators and ops, and collaborate directly with customers and Sales/AM to ensure we deliver outcomes. **What you'll do** **This role is not static.** Tools and platforms evolve month\-to\-month as we adopt vendors, build internal systems, and improve the stack. Success requires comfort learning new tools quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality, reliability, and delivery. ### **Important note: what “engineering” means here** This is **not** a backend production engineering role. * You will build **internal tools, scripts, workflow configurations, dashboards, and prototypes** (often using AI\-assisted / low\-code tooling). * You will not be asked to own production backend services ### **What You’ll Do** ### **1\) Build \& Operate Operational Workflows (System of Work / Patient Manager)** * Configure and evolve workflows that power navigator execution: routing, task creation, campaigns, automation, and program logic. * Partner with Product/Ops to ensure workflow configuration reflects real operations and reduces failure modes. * Build internal helpers/tools that make workflows easier to operate and safer to change ### **2\) Build \& Operate Agent Workflows (Agent System)** * Build and maintain agent workflows that handle operational tasks end\-to\-end: tool use, guardrails, escalation paths, and failure handling. * Shadow real workflows, identify friction, and ship improvements that reduce manual work and increase closure. * Maintain reusable components/templates so we don’t rebuild one\-offs for every customer. ### **3\) Build \& Improve Automated Communication Agents (Voice and beyond)** * Build and iterate automated agents that interact with patients/customers (voice, messaging, or other channels as needed). * Ensure behavior is operationally correct (right intent, right routing, right follow\-ups) and measurable. * Follow quality gates/playbooks for customer\-facing automation (testing/evals, rollout/rollback, post\-deploy verification). ### **4\) Customer Outcomes, Expansion, and Getting Customers to the Next Level** * Identify where outcomes break by learning the customer’s real operations and constraints. * Partner with Sales/AM and customer stakeholders to move customers to the next level clear timelines. * Convert repeated customer needs into scalable patterns (templates, components, playbooks) so we scale beyond one account. ### **5\) Rapid Viability** **Standardization (Process \+ Quality Gates)** * Push viable solutions into production quickly: small increments, clear ownership, and verifiable results. * Create/upgrade the right proof for changes: simulations, structured reviews, eval sets, regression checks, audit queries, dashboards, or other validation mechanisms. * Do the necessary research (artifacts, logs, customer workflows, tool capabilities) to choose the jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Python, React.js)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop and support cloud\-native Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you carrying user stories from refinement all the way through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build back\-end features in Python on a cloud\-native AWS stack, starting from user stories. * Build the React.js screens and components that put those features in front of users. * Automate workflows using AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and related AWS services. * Develop the application programming interfaces (APIs) and integrations that link internal systems with commercial products. * Write unit and integration tests, join code reviews, and resolve the defects you find, carrying the work all the way to production. * Help automate the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, write code that is secure and accessible, and support your services in production. * Work with AI\-assisted development tools every day, and review and test everything they produce. * Help uphold quality development practices, including test\-driven development and automated testing. You deliver and own tested, working code through production, including the defects you identify and resolve. You automate business operations that replace manual checks, validations, and spreadsheet workflows, and you build deployment pipelines so releasing services becomes routine. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience, with back\-end work in Python and front\-end work in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Familiarity with cloud development on AWS, including AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 * The ability to take a defined specification to working, tested code and own it through production, using object\-oriented design, design patterns, and data modeling * Experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, backed by sound analytical judgment * Delivery experience in an Agile framework such as Scrum or Kanban, tracking work in a tool such as Jira * Excellent communication skills, including working directly with non\-technical client stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions * Accurate estimation of your assigned tasks and work effort * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Production workloads delivered hands\-on in AWS, an AWS certification, or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Consulting experience in a client\-facing setting * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices **Who you are** You care about what you build, and you judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. You move with shifting priorities, and when you pick up a new tool or domain, you develop enough depth to make judgment calls in it rather than follow instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve an existing system. * Delivery habits to match: version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility. * Clear, plain\-language communication with the people who depend on your work, and the habit of listening for what they need. * The exactness to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

**Build vertical agents.** Own end\-to\-end agents for high\-value workflows across research, software, hardware, data, and operations—from problem definition through production use. * **Establish the agent foundation.** Build reusable primitives for models, tools, orchestration, context, memory, retrieval, permissions, human approval, and long\-running execution. * **Create the context layer.** Connect agents to trusted data through APIs, pipelines, MCP servers, and integrations with clear provenance and access control. * **Own evaluation and reliability.** Build benchmarks, regression tests, tracing, monitoring, and failure\-analysis loops across quality, latency, cost, security, and resilience. * **Advance frontier agent usage.** Evaluate new models, coding agents, SDKs, and patterns, then turn useful capabilities into maintainable systems rather than demos. * **Support strategic initiatives.** Help company leadership apply agents and analytical systems to market and customer intelligence, partnerships, fundraising, diligence, scenario analysis, and executive decisions. * **Provide technical leadership.** Set architecture and engineering standards, review designs and code, and create reusable patterns for the technical team. **Requirements** * 5\+ years in software engineering, applied AI, ML systems, or a related field, with strong zero\-to\-one technical judgment. * Experience at a frontier AI lab, leading AI company, or comparable team working at the edge of current model capabilities. * A track record shipping production agentic systems that real users depend on—not only prompts, prototypes, or demos. * Deep experience with frontier model APIs, tool use, orchestration, context engineering, retrieval, memory, and multi\-step workflows. * Experience building evaluations, regression tests, observability, and production failure\-analysis loops for AI systems. * Exceptional fluency with AI\-native development workflows using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agent SDKs, or equivalent systems, with a rigorous understanding of where agents work and fail. * Strong product judgment: able to turn an ambiguous decision or workflow into a useful, secure, measurable system. * Requires 5 days/week in\-office collaboration with the team. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with post\-training, model evaluation, inference, or research infrastructure at a frontier lab or model company. * Experience with MCP infrastructure, developer platforms, knowledge graphs, RAG, or secure enterprise integrations. * Background in robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, or another technically complex physical\-world domain. **Benefits** * Competitive stock options/equity programs. * Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan. * Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates. * Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team\-building events.

Apply today to join our diverse team of technology professionals! jobs.title: MID Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The role** Cogniify is hiring a hands\-on engineer to build secure identity and loyalty integrations for AI\-assisted commerce. You will connect AI agents, merchant applications and digital identity wallets so customers can access verified membership benefits while protecting their personal information. This role focuses on backend development, identity protocols and verifiable credentials, with Python, MCP and AI\-agent runtime integration. You will build working integrations, test fraud scenarios and create reference implementations that merchants can adopt. **What you will do** * Build UCP integrations that carry verified loyalty information from platform agents to merchants. * Use Python to integrate agent runtimes with identity and loyalty APIs, handling asynchronous calls, structured results, timeouts and failures. * Build or integrate MCP tools that let AI agents access verified loyalty functions. Enforce identity and authorization checks server\-side before merchant actions are executed. * Develop a sample merchant that verifies trust signals, checks loyalty eligibility through backend APIs, applies member pricing and stock reservations, and records pending loyalty earnings. * Implement OAuth Authorization Code with PKCE for customer account linking before loyalty points are redeemed or transferred. * Design an HTTP trust\-header contract and build a Cloudflare Worker verifier with JWKS caching, spoofed\-header removal and rate limiting. * Build Node.js/TypeScript middleware that exposes verified loyalty context to merchant application handlers. * Create a verifiable credential proof of concept covering issuance to a wallet, selective disclosure, presentation and merchant verification. * Test replay across merchants, token reuse, enumeration, account takeover and stock reservation abuse. Verify that personal information does not reach the AI agent. * Write merchant integration guides, build reference clients and servers, and demonstrate the complete flow through a sample storefront. **Required experience and skills** * 5\+ years of hands\-on TypeScript/Node.js development, with experience building backend APIs and integrations. Familiarity with Node 22 and Next.js or a similar framework. * Hands\-on Python backend integration experience, including asyncio, typed code and automated testing. * Experience integrating AI\-agent runtimes or tool\-using LLM applications with external APIs, including MCP server or client integration and structured tool results. * Strong HTTP fundamentals and the ability to build servers and reference clients that follow protocol specifications. * Production implementation of OAuth 2\.0 Authorization Code with PKCE, OpenID Connect and JWT/JWS token verification. * Experience with ES256 or EdDSA signatures, JWKS key rotation, audience validation, token expiry and replay protection using token identifiers. * Hands\-on verifiable credential experience, including W3C VC 2\.0, OID4VCI, OID4VP and SD\-JWT VC. * Familiarity with did:web, did:key and at least one identity wallet SDK, such as Credo or an equivalent. * Cloudflare Workers or equivalent edge development, including KV or Durable Objects, header verification and rate limiting. * Ability to interpret MCP, UCP, OpenID and relevant RFC specifications, including RFC 9421 and RFC 8693, and implement independently against acceptance criteria. **Good to have** * BBS\+ or zero\-knowledge proof tooling. * Google UCP or Merchant Center integrations. * Loyalty programmes, promotions systems, e\-commerce fraud prevention or bot management. * Experience with Claude or comparable LLM APIs and agent SDKs. **What you will deliver in the first 90 days** A UCP loyalty signal and platform\-agent reference implementation with Python and MCP integration; a sample merchant with loyalty tiers; an HTTP header contract, edge verifier and middleware SDK; a credential issuer, wallet and verifier proof of concept; a fraud test suite; integration guides; and a working storefront demonstration. Pay: $126,000\.00 \- $139,500\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Backend/Platform
jobs.description: **About APADCode** ------------------ APADCode is an early\-stage AI startup building the infrastructure for a more meaningful way to evaluate software engineers. Our platform conducts live, adaptive technical interviews and captures how candidates approach problems, reason about trade\-offs, write code, and respond to challenges. Behind the product is a two\-engine architecture combining real\-time AI interview orchestration with structured reasoning analysis. We've moved beyond prototypes into real hiring workflows. Now we're looking for engineers who want to help build the systems that will take us further. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Member of Technical Staff to help own the architecture and evolution of APADCode's core backend platform. At the heart of our product is a stateful AI interviewer that needs to manage multi\-stage technical conversations, coordinate live coding interactions, make context\-aware decisions, and preserve a complete record of what happened. You'll work on the engineering challenges behind making that experience reliable, responsive, secure, and scalable, while building the data infrastructure that powers our AI evaluation engine. This is a hands\-on role with significant architectural ownership and direct collaboration with the founding team. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * **Real\-time interview orchestration:** Design and evolve the stateful runtime powering our Interview Control Engine, including interview stages, transitions, time budgets, and session lifecycle management. * **AI agent coordination:** Build the orchestration layer connecting live conversation, lightweight reasoning classifiers, adaptive follow\-up decisions, and coding permissions. Handle model latency, failures, retries, and inconsistent outputs gracefully. * **Event\-driven architecture:** Develop reliable event capture for candidate responses, interviewer actions, stage transitions, code revisions, and execution results. Preserve event ordering and data integrity for downstream evaluation. * **Coding execution infrastructure:** Improve the backend supporting our interactive coding environment, including execution isolation, resource limits, timeouts, and secure handling of untrusted code. * **Asynchronous processing:** Design pipelines that move raw interview events into the Cognitive Intelligence Engine for normalization, feature extraction, and evaluation. * **Reliability and observability:** Build instrumentation around session failures, agent latency, execution errors, processing delays, and infrastructure costs. Improve recovery behavior and production visibility. * **Platform foundations:** Shape service boundaries, database architecture, APIs, deployment workflows, multi\-tenant isolation, and security practices as the platform grows. **What We Look For** -------------------- * Strong experience designing, building, and operating SaaS production backend systems. * Deep understanding of concurrency, asynchronous workflows, state management, distributed systems, and failure recovery. * Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript. * Experience with relational databases, caching, queues, and event\-driven architectures. * Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization, CI/CD, and production observability. * Ability to make sound engineering trade\-offs around latency, consistency, reliability, complexity, and cost. * Comfortable taking ambiguous technical problems from architecture through implementation and production operation. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with LLM agents, tool calling, or workflow orchestration (not in demo, but in production system of Enterprise). * Experience building WebSocket\-based or other low\-latency interactive applications. * Familiarity with sandboxed code execution, container isolation, or resource\-constrained workloads. * Experience with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, or comparable systems. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and meaningful early\-stage equity opportunities. * Significant architectural ownership and influence over technical direction. * Direct collaboration with the founders and a small engineering team. * Flexible working arrangements, paid time off, and health benefits based on location. * Equipment and professional development support. * The opportunity to build foundational AI infrastructure for hiring v3\.0 We're looking for engineers who enjoy owning complex systems, making thoughtful technical decisions, and shipping software that holds up in production. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Console (Full-Stack)

We combine the reasoning of LLMs with the reliability of code, for truly trustworthy AI. Our first model, Jev, launched in September 2026\. While others chase leaderboards, we’re rebuilding the LLM stack from first principles to make models smarter and also dependable enough to run in production. We’re a small, fast team backed by an $870M Series A led by a16z. Made in SF, with love. Come join the frontier. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a full\-stack engineer who ships customer\-facing product fast. You'll own the console and playground for our product, including enterprise features from billing to org management and more. You'll combine strong product sense, full\-stack engineering, and a bias for shipping to define our product experience in the console. Our tech stack is primarily Python. We also use TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS for frontend, with Kubernetes for orchestration. We empower developers to use any tooling they find helpful for getting their job done, including AI and agents. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own product features end\-to\-end — from design and prototype to production — with craft and judgment * Build polished, reliable user interfaces that are enterprise\-scale * Partner closely with product, design, and customers to translate real\-world needs into product improvements * Instrument, measure, and improve product quality, reliability, and performance * Contribute across the stack wherever you can add the most leverage **We are looking for people who** --------------------------------- * Are strong full\-stack engineers (\~2–7 yrs) with excellent product intuition * Have shipped customer\-facing products and care deeply about craft and detail * Are scrappy and hacky, and thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving problem spaces — taking satisfaction in finding creative solutions * Move fast without sacrificing quality * Have hands\-on experience building with LLMs and understand their capabilities and limitations * Enjoy owning problems end\-to\-end and thinking beyond the code to how products are used in the real world **Life at TypeSafe** ==================== We're a small, flat, close\-knit team dedicated to real\-world impact preparing the world for Transformative AI. Our team works fully in\-person in our San Francisco office near Embarcadero station. We love what we do and care about our work a lot. We strive for excellence and craftsmanship and won't stop until we get there. When the team wins, we all win, and we enjoy collaborating and inspiring each other to grow as a team and as individuals. We also value emotional honesty, kindness, and bringing your whole self to work. We build machines; we don't try to be machines. We want you to be able to do the most impactful work of your career at TypeSafe and help define our future as a company. **We provide** ============== * 100% covered health insurance * Daily lunch and dinner * Visa sponsorships * 401K plans Compensation Range: $210K \- $285K

jobs.title: Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Panthera Grid Partners is a portfolio company of Brookfield, one of the world’s largest owners and operators of renewable power and sustainable solutions. Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility\-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy. With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision\-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity. Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long\-term land value and strengthen regional economies. **Job Summary** Panthera Grid is seeking an experienced and motivated Performance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will have minimum 3 years of relevant experience in utility\-scale performance engineering. The Performance Engineer is responsible for maximizing the operational and financial performance of the company's utility\-scale solar and energy storage assets. This role serves as the technical lead for performance analytics, production forecasting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization initiatives across a portfolio of operating renewable energy facilities. The Performance Engineer will have extensive modeling experience with PVsyst, a strong understanding of all inputs required for generating P50 energy estimates and of PV plant construction and operation. The Performance position will report to the Reliability Engineering Manager. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in solar plant and battery storage performance assessment, energy modeling, SCADA analytics, and operational troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with Asset Management, Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M), Commercial Operations, Development, Engineering, and third\-party service providers to identify performance risks and opportunities, improve fleet availability, and ensure achievement of energy production targets. The Performance Engineer will be a subject matter expert in photovoltaic system and Battery storage behavior, plant performance metrics, and operational analytics, helping drive continuous improvement across the renewable energy portfolio. **Responsibilities** * Monitor and analyze fleet\-wide solar plant performance, availability, and energy production against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees. * Develop, maintain, and improve performance monitoring dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools. * Assist in root cause analyses of underperformance events and production losses. * Evaluate SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, and revenue meter data to identify operational issues and optimization opportunities. * Perform daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance assessments for operating assets. * Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison against performance models. * Support asset managers in assessing operational risks and revenue impacts associated with plant performance issues. * Collaborate with O\&M providers and internal resources to troubleshoot equipment failures and recurring performance losses. * Analyze inverter, tracker, module, and balance\-of\-system performance trends and degradation rates. * Lead performance guarantee evaluations, liquidated damages assessments, and contractual performance testing activities. * Review and update production forecasts, weather assumptions, and performance models as operating data becomes available. * Develop and maintain fleet degradation analyses and long\-term performance projections. * Identify and quantify opportunities for performance improvements and operational cost reductions. * Support due diligence efforts for project acquisitions, financing activities, and portfolio valuations. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders. * Stay current with evolving industry standards, technologies, and best practices related to solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics. * Develop automation tools, scripts, and analytical workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel VBA, or similar platforms. * Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet reliability and performance. * Onboard new assets in performance platforms. **Requirements*** Minimum 3 years of renewable industry experience in a performance\-related role * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (preferred), Meteorology, Statistics, Physics, or some other quantitative field * Strong knowledge of PV solar energy systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) * Proficiency in data analysis using Excel, Python, MATLAB, Fabric or other related software. * Understanding inverter operation, power conversion principles, and power electronics. * Advanced understanding of and experience with PVsyst software. * Professional verbal and written communication skills * Ability to discuss technical and advanced engineering concepts to both expert and non\-technical people. * Self\-motivated, able to work both independently with minimal oversight and in coordination with other groups and individuals. * Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, at times in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred:** * Experience with utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). * Experience supporting NERC, ISO, or utility compliance requirements. * Familiarity with SCADA platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, or similar tools. * Experience with performance guarantee testing and ASTM performance testing protocols. * Knowledge of energy markets and renewable asset commercial operations. * Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science applications in renewable energy. * Experience managing third\-party O\&M or EPC jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Python, React.js)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the design and delivery of cloud\-native Python services on Amazon Web Services (AWS), taking each one from refinement through production. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you making the design decisions that join a solution's components and carrying the result through production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design and deliver the Python services and application components that form your part of the platform. * Design the React.js front end that users work in, and set the standards other developers build it to. * Build automated workflows across AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), and Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS). * Design the application programming interfaces (APIs), integrations, and data flows that link your services to the rest of the platform. * Build and improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and automated tests your team releases through, along with how it supports production. * Run code reviews, resolve design tradeoffs, tackle difficult production issues, and mentor the developers around you. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to speed up implementation and review, while staying accountable for the code you deliver. * Take the lead on quality development practices, including test\-driven development, code reviews, and application security standards. * Produce accurate project estimates and contribute to project planning, delivery forecasting, and resource allocation. You deliver one integrated solution whose parts work together to a single quality bar. You turn spreadsheet\-bound validations and workflows into automation, and the way you work makes the developers around you better. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional hands\-on back\-end software development experience in Python * 5\+ years of hands\-on front\-end software development experience in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Strong hands\-on experience building cloud\-native applications on AWS, using AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, and Amazon RDS * Strong experience with relational databases, for example PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle * Strong experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB * Advanced knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, design patterns, object\-oriented programming, data modeling, and database design * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills * Experience leading Agile delivery under Scrum or Kanban, with work tracked in an issue tracker such as Jira * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted developer tools such as Amazon Q Developer or GitHub Copilot * A track record of leading a development team and mentoring its developers * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An AWS certification or a Python certification * Federal information technology experience * Experience leading technical delivery teams in client\-facing consulting * Experience applying DevSecOps best practices and implementing CI/CD pipelines **Who you are** You own what you build, and you put real time into making the developers around you better, through code review, through explaining your reasoning, and through the standard you set. People bring you the hard calls because you make them well, and you keep the team steady and productive when priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Deep command of modern cloud development, with the range to create something new or improve what is already in operation. * Strong delivery habits across version control, automated testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility, with the standing to set them for a team. * The judgment to weigh competing solution approaches, settle design tradeoffs across components, and own the technical direction of your assigned area. * Plain explanations of your work for the people who depend on it, and careful listening for what they need. * Precision where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Software Engineer (Early Career) – C\+\+ \& Systems **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking a **Software Engineer** to help build and maintain the real\-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux\-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on. You will work primarily in modern C\+\+ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands\-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well\-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain software components in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) for Linux\-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers * Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications * Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis * Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase * Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review * Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data * Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality * Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers * Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers * Document your work so that others on the team can build on it **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome) * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co\-ops, research, and substantial personal or open\-source projects count * Solid foundation in C\+\+, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object\-oriented and generic programming * Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis * Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C\+\+ and Python * Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics * Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git\-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce * Comfortable working hands\-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment) * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines **Nice to have:** * Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing * Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers * Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial * Contributions to open\-source projects **What You'll Learn** You will work on a real\-time sensing platform that is already running at some of the largest manufacturers in the world, on a small team where your code reaches customers quickly. * How a high\-throughput, multi\-sensor data pipeline is built end to end, from acquisition through processing and storage, and kept reliable in production * Modern C\+\+ and Linux systems engineering, with regular code review and mentorship from senior engineers * How software, firmware, and hardware teams work together to ship a physical product * How to use AI coding tools effectively and responsibly in a professional engineering workflow * A clear path to grow into a mid\-level engineer with ownership of your own components **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * Health, Dental, Vision plans provided * 401k matching provided * Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

jobs.title: Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview**Navitas Semiconductor is seeking an experienced Staff Product Engineer to lead product engineering activities for GaN power semiconductor devices, from early silicon and new product introduction (NPI) through qualification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering. This role connects device physics, electrical characterization, manufacturing processes, reliability, and power electronics. The successful candidate will take technical ownership of product readiness—including device performance, CP/FT test strategy, yield, parametric variation, datasheet validation, and qualification risk—and drive cross\-functional resolution of complex issues. **Key Responsibilities**Product Engineering – NPI, Production Ramp \& Sustaining * Own product engineering readiness from initial silicon evaluation through qualification, production release, and high\-volume manufacturing. * Drive electrical characterization, datasheet validation, test limit and guardband development, process window definition, and qualification readiness. * Analyze wafer probe (CP) and final test (FT) results, including yield trends, parametric distributions, correlations, and manufacturing variation. * Lead yield improvement and root\-cause investigations using statistical analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and cross\-functional technical reviews. * Resolve sustaining issues involving yield excursions, parametric drift, electrical failures, reliability concerns, and failure analysis; coordinate corrective actions. * Work directly with wafer fabs, OSATs, and Test Engineering on manufacturing process control, test correlation, product changes, and production ramp risks. Device Physics \& Electrical Characterization * Plan and perform electrical characterization, including breakdown voltage, leakage, threshold voltage, on\-resistance, dynamic RDS(on), and switching behavior. * Correlate device performance with device structure, process variation, trapping effects, and reliability mechanisms; translate findings into actionable recommendations. * Support development, evaluation, and manufacturing qualification of 100 V and 650 V GaN devices and integrated power technologies. * Contribute technical assessments of product margins, degradation mechanisms, and reliability data to qualification and production release decisions. Power Electronics \& Applications Interface * Support device\-level and application\-representative characterization, including double\-pulse testing, switching losses, dynamic RDS(on), and gate\-drive behavior. * Collaborate with Applications Engineering on characterization fixtures and evaluation platforms; understand effects of parasitics, ringing, dv/dt, and thermal conditions. * Correlate system\-level switching results with semiconductor device behavior and provide feedback to Device, Process, and Test Engineering. Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership * Lead complex technical investigations and present clear data\-driven recommendations, product risks, and release\-readiness assessments. * Partner with Device Engineering, Process Integration, Reliability, Quality, Test, Applications, wafer fabs, and OSAT partners to resolve product issues. * Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and support customer\-facing investigations during qualification and production ramp. **Required Qualifications*** BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Physics, Power Electronics, or a related discipline. * 8\+ years of relevant semiconductor product engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated technical expertise. * Proven experience with NPI, product qualification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering for semiconductor devices. * Strong understanding of power semiconductor device physics, electrical characterization, manufacturing variation, and reliability mechanisms. * Experience analyzing CP/FT data, parametric distributions, yield trends, and test limits using statistical and problem\-solving methods. * Hands\-on laboratory capability in electrical characterization of power devices, with demonstrated independent technical leadership and cross\-functional communication. **Preferred Qualifications*** Direct experience with GaN HEMTs, SiC MOSFETs, or comparable power semiconductor technologies. * Familiarity with dynamic RDS(on), double\-pulse testing, switching loss measurements, and gate\-drive effects. * Experience working with wafer fabrication, assembly/packaging, OSAT, and outsourced test partners. * Background in failure analysis, accelerated reliability testing, or semiconductor degradation physics. * Experience with DOE, statistical process control, and engineering data\-analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Python, or equivalent). The salary range for this role is $110,000–$160,000\. Final compensation will depend on the candidate’s experience, skills, and work location.
