jobs.description: Company: University of Missouri\-Columbia Division: College of Engineering City: Columbia State: MO County: Boone County Country: USA Email Address: umhrexecutivesearch@umsystem.edu Website URL: http://hrs.missouri.edu/find\-a\-job/academic/index Posted: 10/12/2026 Director, Quantum Innovation Center, Associate/Full Professor **Director, Quantum Innovation Center, Associate or Full Professor** The University of Missouri (MU) seeks an innovative, collaborative, and visionary leader to serve as the inaugural Director of the Quantum Innovation Center (QIC), an interdisciplinary initiative advancing research, education, workforce development, and strategic partnerships in quantum computing and quantum information science. The Director will lead a dynamic collaboration spanning the University of Missouri System, academic institutions, and industry partners nationwide, while building on MU’s existing strengths in quantum computing and related fields. The Center also provides opportunities to connect quantum research with complementary areas of innovation across the University creating pathways for interdisciplinary collaboration and emerging applications of quantum technologies in health and biomedical research. Reporting to the Dean of the College of Engineering and working collaboratively across the University, the Director will provide strategic leadership for the continued development, growth, and national visibility of the Center. The successful candidate will build and strengthen interdisciplinary collaborations, cultivate external partnerships, support faculty recruitment and development, and identify opportunities to advance MU’s role within the rapidly evolving quantum ecosystem. This is an exceptional opportunity for a nationally recognized scholar and collaborative leader to shape the future direction of a growing interdisciplinary center while contributing to the University of Missouri’s broader strengths in research, education, and innovation. The position includes a tenured faculty appointment at the rank of Professor or Associate Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Department or another appropriate academic department. **Key Responsibilities** * **Provide strategic leadership and vision** for the Quantum Innovation Center, advancing its research, education, workforce development, and innovation mission in alignment with University and national priorities. * **Build and expand a high\-impact quantum research portfolio** by identifying emerging opportunities, establishing strategic priorities, and developing interdisciplinary research initiatives across engineering, physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, and related fields. * **Recruit and engage exceptional faculty and researchers** whose scholarship advances the Center’s priorities, expands MU’s research capabilities, and creates opportunities for new interdisciplinary collaborations and externally funded research. * **Build interdisciplinary research teams and strengthen research development**, supporting competitive proposals to federal agencies, national laboratories, industry sponsors, foundations, and other funding partners. * **Advance graduate and undergraduate research and postdoctoral training**, creating opportunities for students and trainees to engage in quantum\-related research and prepare for careers in quantum science and technology. * **Lead the development and expansion of innovative education and workforce development programs**, including certificates, workshops, internships, experiential learning, and continuing education that respond to evolving workforce needs. * **Strengthen pathways from education to careers** by developing relationships with industry, government laboratories, national security organizations, graduate programs, and other employers and training partners. * **Develop and sustain strategic external partnerships** with industry, national laboratories, federal agencies, professional organizations, and other organizations to expand sponsored research, internships, workforce development, and collaborative educational opportunities. * **Serve as a visible ambassador for the Center and MU**, strengthening its national and international reputation and representing the Center at regional, national, and international forums. * **Cultivate philanthropic and other external support** in partnership with University Advancement and academic leadership, while identifying opportunities for strategic investment and industry engagement. * **Establish effective governance and operating practices** that foster interdisciplinary collaboration, support long\-term growth and sustainability, and ensure effective coordination across participating departments, colleges, and disciplines. * **Provide responsible stewardship of Center resources, programs, and activities**, developing sustainable approaches to resource allocation and operations while ensuring alignment with University poli uting, artificial intelligence, or related fields. * Experience working across academic, governmental, industrial, and community sectors. * Distinguished record of scholarship and externally funded research. * Demonstrated success leading interdisciplinary research initiatives, programs, centers, or collaborative teams. * Experience developing partnerships with industry, government agencies, national laboratories, foundations, or other external stakeholders. * Strong record of strategic planning, program development, and organizational leadership. * Outstanding communication, organizational, and leadership skills. **Visa Sponsorship Information** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The University will not sponsor applicants for this position for employment visas. **Application Materials and Process** Applications must be submitted through the University’s website. Job posting ID is \#61321 Candidates should include a cover letter outlining qualifications and a detailed curriculum vitae. A total of five references will be requested during the **final phase of the interview process.** Applications will be reviewed as they are received. The posting will remain open until filled. Specific academic home(s) of candidates will be determined throughout the hiring process. This is not a remote opportunity. To nominate a colleague or for questions about the application process or role, please contact the Marilyn Green at mnw266@missouri.edu **Handling of Application Materials** After initial review by the committee, all uploaded materials may be shared with all faculty in the prospective department. For affiliations and joint appointments materials may be shared with all faculty in all departments involved. **Community Information** Columbia, Missouri, has been consistently rated as one of the most desirable places to live and work in the U.S. This college city of 128,000\-plus residents has the best of both worlds — small\-town convenience and warmth with urban sophistication and amenities. Located halfway between St. Louis and Kansas City, Columbia boasts affordable housing, moderate cost of living, broad cultural and economic opportunities, award\-winning public schools, and a regional airport that is expanding its offerings. Popular cultural events include the annual True/False documentary film festival, the monthly First Fridays Art Walk and the spring Unbound Book Festival. As a SEC institution, college athletics plays a major role in Columbia’s social scene, with ample opportunities to attend Mizzou sporting events. Mizzou’s campus is adjacent to downtown Columbia, within walking distance of restaurants, clothing stores, ice cream shops, and music venues. Downtown’s shopping corridor is packed with designer boutiques, jewelers, florists, and bookstores. Finally, Columbia is known for having an outstanding array of year\-round outdoor activities. It boasts multiple city parks and an outstanding state park, Rock Bridge State Park. The region’s caves, forests, streams and cliffs offer endless exploration for outdoor adventurers. The popular MKT Trail takes cyclists and hikers all through Columbia and links to the 225\-mile Katy Trail, which stretches across the state. **Benefit Eligibility** This position is eligible for University benefits. As part of your total compensation, the University offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, retirement, paid time off, short\- and long\-term disability, paid parental leave, paid caregiver leave, and educational fee discounts for all four UM System campuses. For additional information on University benefits, please visit the Faculty \& Staff Benefits website at https://www.umsystem.edu/departments\-staff/human\-resources/benefits\-retirement **Equal Employment Opportunity** The University of Missouri is an Equal Opportunity Employer. To request ADA accommodations, please call the Office of Equity \& Title IX at 816\-235\-6910\.

jobs.title: ​​Technical Product Owner, Enterprise Search & AI​
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Technical Product Owner, Enterprise Search \& AI** Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. **This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career**. **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** As a Technical Product Owner for Enterprise Search \& AI, you will serve as the critical operational bridge between strategic platform roadmaps and technical sprint execution for 3M’s enterprise search ecosystem. Operating as an individual contributor within a cross\-functional pod, you will deconstruct high\-level business needs into actionable technical requirements across search infrastructure, AI\-powered retrieval, and digital experience platforms, prioritizing the day\-to\-day tactical backlog to deliver scalable, high\-performance search capabilities that power digital commerce, content discovery, and emerging AI applications. Here, you will make an impact by: * Backlog \& Requirement Engineering — Translating the Director of Product \& Portfolio Management’s long\-term search and AI platform vision into highly detailed user stories, technical specifications, and structured acceptance criteria spanning search API enhancements, ingestion pipeline improvements, index architecture changes, and AI retrieval features. * Tactical Backlog Prioritization — Owning, refining, and prioritizing the day\-to\-day pod\-level backlog to optimize sprint velocity and engineering throughput across the enterprise search stack, balancing platform reliability work against new AI\-driven capabilities such as hybrid retrieval, semantic search, and RAG\-enabled experiences. * Sprint Execution Guidance — Partnering daily with the Enterprise Search Tech Lead and vendor engineers to provide absolute clarity on execution requirements during agile ceremonies, ensuring alignment on search relevance tuning, infrastructure\-as\-code changes, and AI model integration work. * Product Quality \& Acceptance — Serving as the gatekeeper for user acceptance testing (UAT), verifying that vendor\-built and internally developed artifacts strictly adhere to defined technical benchmarks for search performance, relevance accuracy, API response times, and AI output quality before release. * Adoption \& Platform Feedback — Monitoring search platform utilization, tracking adoption metrics across consuming applications (product navigator, digital commerce, AI assistants), and funneling real\-world feedback on search relevance and AI feature effectiveness back to the Product \& Portfolio Management director. * AI \& Search Capability Evolution — Defining and prioritizing product requirements for the platform’s evolution toward hybrid retrieval approaches combining lexical and semantic/vector search, supporting RAG pipelines, LLM grounding, and agentic AI use cases that drive competitive advantage. * Multi\-Feature Capability Mapping — Mastering competing business group requirements across interconnected search, content, and AI platform modules, governing dependencies and release schedules across ingestion workflows, search APIs, and downstream digital experiences. * Shared Accountability: Release \& Deployment — Co\-owning product release schedules and deployment calendar targets alongside Program/Project Managers (PVMO), coordinating CI/CD pipeline releases and infrastructure changes. * Shared Accountability: Technical Quality — Co\-owning software quality metrics, architectural alignment, and technical debt constraints with the Enterprise Search Tech Lead (TSL), including search index health, pipeline reliability, and AI model performance. * Shared Accountability: Business Value — Co\-owning business value metrics and customer satisfaction feedback loops with the assigned Business Relationship Manager (BRM), including search relevance KPIs and AI feature adoption rates. **Key Responsibilities:** * Backlog \& Requirement Engineering — Translate the Director of Product \& Portfolio Management's long\-term search and AI platform vision into detailed user stories, technical specifications, and structured acceptance criteria covering search API enhancements, ingestion pipeline improvements, index architecture changes, and AI retrieval features. * Tactical Backlog Prioritization — Own, refine, and prioritize the day\-to\-day pod\-level backlog to optimize sprint velocity and engineering throughput, balancing platform reliability work against new AI\-driven capabilities (hybrid retrieval, semantic search, RAG\-enabled experiences). * Sprint Execution Guidance — Partner daily with the Ente of three (3\) years owning or managing search, data platform, or AI\-driven product portfolios, in a private, public, government, or military environment * **Work location:** * 3M Center, Maplewood, MN or 3M Facility, Austin, TX This role follows an on\-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at either the 3M Center in Maplewood, MN or the 3M Facility in Austin, TX. **Travel: May include up to 10% domestic or international** **Relocation: May be authorized** **Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).** **Supporting Your Well\-being** 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. **Chat with Max** For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers. Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $145,676 \- $178,049, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental \& Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.3m.com/3M/en\_US/careers\-us/working\-at\-3m/benefits/. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. **Our People:** People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. **Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform** **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area or Austin, TX (Hybrid) **About the Role** ------------------ 6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and expanding an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to. You'll work across the full path from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions, including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security. 6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B, and agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi\-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves. **What You'll Own** ------------------- ### **Agents and Orchestration** * Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Select and implement routing, orchestrator\-worker, plan\-and\-execute, reflection, and multi\-agent handoff patterns based on business needs. * Run agents headless through API\-first and MCP\-first architectures across in\-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from a shared core. * Build and maintain reusable components for state management, memory, tool\-calling, and agent\-to\-agent delegation with scoped permissions. ### **APIs, Tools, and MCP** * Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to access 6sense data and take action for both human and LLM consumers. * Optimize tool design for agent success, including naming, descriptions, schemas, response formats, error handling, and token efficiency. * Re\-design and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per\-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, graceful degradation, backward compatibility, and adoption of emerging MCP capabilities. * Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Develop integration guides and reference clients and define trust boundaries for third\-party MCP server integrations. * Strengthen platform reliability through idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, spend controls, and standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery. ### **Context and Evaluation** * Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context through MCP, APIs, and tools, enabling a unified context layer across all customer touchpoints. * Define and enforce contracts around returned data, freshness, provenance, and tenant and user\-level access controls. * Improve permission\-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints. * Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool\-selection accuracy, tool\-call accuracy, end\-to\-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements. * Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool\-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency. ### **Security, Privacy, and Trust** * Make security a first\-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change. * Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks. * Enforce tenant isolation and user\-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short\-lived, scoped credentials. * Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through outputs, traces, and logs. * Establish runtime guardrails around steps, tokens, execution time, and spend. ### **Customers and Engineering Excellence** * Investigate and resolve customer\-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems. * Participate in customer and partner technical discussions and support enablement teams through guidance, demonstrations, and documentation. * Write design documents, evaluate trade\-offs, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and partic  solutions teams. * Demonstrated success leading multi\-month, cross\-functional initiatives with minimal oversight and strong communication skills across technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building or operating MCP servers in production or contributing to MCP open\-source projects. * Experience serving context to agents from signals, entity data, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data platforms. * Experience integrating with external agent platforms, AI assistants, or agent interoperability protocols. * Familiarity with B2B go\-to\-market platforms, RevTech, CRM systems, or intent\-data platforms. * Experience with model routing, caching, cost optimization, and latency optimization. * Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, or similar data platforms. **What This Role Is Not** ------------------------- * **Not an architect role:** You influence technical direction through hands\-on engineering, working code, and thoughtful design documentation. * **Not an MCP\-only role:** MCP is one part of a broader platform strategy that includes APIs, tools, orchestration, and agent infrastructure. * **Not a greenfield build:** These systems already exist in production and support real customers today. Base Salary Range: $179,400\.00 \- $248,120\.00\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense's total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense's board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self\-care days, and paid time off (PTO). \#Li\-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy **Our Benefits:** Full\-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time\-off and holidays, quarterly self\-care days off, and stock options. We'll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well\-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG\-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com. *We are aware of recruiting impersonation* *attempts* *that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way.* *A**ll email communications from* *6sense* *will originate from* *the @6sense.com domain**.* *We will* *not initially contact you via text message and will* *never request payments**.* *If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to* *jobs@**6sense.com*

jobs.title: Data Center Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: What's on Offer * Pay: $135,200 – $156,000 per year \+ overtime pay \+ $4,000 monthly per diem ($48,000 annually, non\-taxable). * Mobilization and Demobilization Bonus: $2,400 each (tax\-free) * Contract role, full\-time on site. There is a possibility of conversion to W\-2 after a 1 to 2 month trial period * Long\-term project opportunity (18 months) with a strong possibility of extension and subsequent project engagements. * Training and professional development opportunities Why Join Our Team: * Work on a large hyperscale data center project * Gain valuable mission\-critical construction experience * Opportunity to grow into higher\-level leadership roles * Access opportunities to move to future projects across the U.S. * Contribute to a fast\-growing industry with exposure to large\-scale projects exceeding $100M Job Description * 18\-month project with high possibility of extension and subsequent projects * MV and LV electrical and mechanical commissioning supervision and coordination * Hyperscale data center construction project * Columbus Ohio area * Contract role, full\-time on\-site * Unrestricted ability to travel/relocate NOTE: This position is available to U.S. citizens or permanent residents only. INTRODUCTION: Since 1991, AB Consulting GSS has provided specialized project support and technical expertise to the manufacturing and construction industries. One of our key engagements involves supporting the construction of a major new data center in Ohio. Join our team and be part of impactful projects that shape the future of industrial innovation. JOB SUMMARY: A major client is asking us to provide a Commissioning (Cx) Engineer to oversee and coordinate Level 1 through Level 4 commissioning of facilities\-level equipment and systems on a new hyperscale data center. The Cx Engineer will work in a plant construction environment under the direction of the client’s Cx Manager on site. This role requires strong Cx expertise and excellent coordination skills with subcontractors, superintendents, quality teams, and end client engineers. CONTRACT TYPE: 1099 Independent Contractor LOCATION: Columbus Ohio area START DATE: As soon as possible, depending on availability DURATION: 18 months with likely extension or transfer to other project **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Implement and follow the Project Commissioning Plan:** Coordinate and oversee the GC’s subcontractors and the owner’s vendors to successfully complete L1\-L4 commissioning on all facilities\-level data center equipment and systems. Ensure all commissioning activities are well documented and follow project specs and industry standards. **Verify installation readiness:** Conduct site walks to confirm that systems are installed per design. Validate that equipment is accessible, labeled, torqued, and safe to energize. Identify deficiencies early and drive corrective actions. **Execute and oversee system testing:** Perform or supervise functional testing of electrical, mechanical, controls, and life\-safety systems. Support load bank testing, PQM (power quality monitoring), and integrated systems testing. Ensure test scripts are followed and results documented. **Coordinate across all stakeholders:** Run effective meetings, identify issues with the owner’s vendors, determine what’s blocking progress, effectively communicate and drive the priorities. Keep everyone aligned on schedule, readiness, and issue resolution. Manage Documentation and Reporting: Maintain commissioning logs, test reports, redlines, and deficiency lists. Ensure documentation is uploaded to the project’s commissioning platform. Track closeout requirements and ensure all systems achieve final acceptance. **Troubleshoot and Resolve Technical Issues:** Identify root causes of failures during testing. Work with subs and vendors to resolve issues quickly. Ensure fixes are retested and validated. **Support Turnover and Owner Training:** Ensure systems meet the owner’s operational requirements. Participate in training sessions for operations staff. Deliver final documentation packages and ensure a smooth handoff. QUALIFICATIONS: Education, Certifications, and Experience: o Minimum 2\-year Associate’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Construction Engineering, OR solid electrical commissioning oversight on similar industrial construction projects of at least $100M in value o Minimum of 2 years as a Commissioning Engineer using similar facility construction technology, methods, equipment, tools, and work procedures. o Useful certifications: PE (Electrical or Mechanical), CxA, BCxP, or NEBB Cx certifications, OSHA 30 (baseline expectation), NFPA 70E, factory training from OEMs (Schneider, Vertiv, Cummins, etc.) o Hyperscale data center experience is strongly preferred. Strong technical foundation in mission\-critical MEP systems: o Medium\- and low\-voltage electrical distribution o One\-line diagrams and operational sequences o UPS systems, batteries, and power electroni s o Comfort troubleshooting failures under schedule pressure Safety \& energization competency: o Deep understanding of LOTO, electrical safety, and energization protocols o Ability to coordinate safe startup of MV/LV systems o Experience working within strict energy\-control frameworks (e.g., AWS Energy Marshall model) o Understanding of aggressive turnover milestones and safe, phased energization Strong documentation \& controls discipline: o Manage commissioning logs, test scripts, deficiency lists, and turnover packages o Work in structured platforms (Procore, BIM 360, SharePoint, or owner\-specific tools) o Maintain traceability and version control across thousands of test points Cross\-functional coordination skills: o Effectively coordinate across subcontractors, OEMs, GC construction teams, owner Cx teams, and ops readiness teams Problem\-solving \& root\-cause analysis ability: o Diagnose electrical, mechanical, or controls issues quickly o Work with OEMs to resolve failures o Retest and validate fixes under tight deadlines Demonstrate effective teamwork, maintain a professional demeanor, and foster positive relationships inside and outside the team. Willingness to travel/relocate for future projects within the continental USA. Pay: $65\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * 1\. Are you an American or Canadian citizen, or a U.S. permanent resident? * 2\. Do you have an unrestricted ability to travel and relocate for future projects within the continental U.S.? * 3\. What is the highest degree you have completed, and what was your field of study (major)? * 4\. This role starts as a 1099 contract position, with potential conversion to W\-2 after a 1\-2 month trial period. Are you comfortable with this arrangement? What is your preferred employment status? * 5\. How many years of experience do you have as a Commissioning Engineer working on industrial construction projects with a total project size exceeding 250,000 square feet? * 6\. How many years of experience do you have working on data center construction projects? * What role(s) have you held on those projects? What was the approximate budget/scope (USD and sq. ft.), the end client (e.g., Google, Microsoft, Amazon). * 7\. On a scale of 1 to 5, with 5 being the highest, please rate your level of knowledge in the following areas. If you hold a certification, indicate it next to your rating (e.g., 5 / certified): * PE (Electrical or Mechanical) * CxA (Certified Commissioning Authority) * BCxP (Building Commissioning Professional) • NEBB Commissioning Certification * OSHA 30 * NFPA 70E * Factory training from OEMs (e.g., Schneider, Vertiv, Cummins, etc.) * 8\. On a scale of 1 to 5, with 5 being the highest, please rank your technical expertise with the following types of systems and equipment: * MV power distribution * LV power distribution * UPS systems * Generators * Chilled water plants BMS/EPMS controls * 9\. On a scale of 1 to 5, how would you rate your experience with: * LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) * Electrical safety * Energization procedures * 10\. How many years of experience do you have working with owner\-specific commissioning processes (e.g., Microsoft L\-levels, Google, Meta, AWS, etc.). Which commissioning stages have you personally led or supported, and what were your responsibilities at each stage? * 11\. How many years of experience do you have coordinating cross\-functional activities across subcontractors and OEMs? What role(s) have you held on those projects? What was the approximate budget and scope of those projects? * 12\. On a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 means no experience and 5 means expert\-level experience, how would you rate your experience managing the following: * Commissioning logs * Test scripts * Deficiency lists * Turnover packages * Procore * BIM 360 * SharePoint * 13\. How many years of experience do you have managing construction MEP systems? Please specify the systems and equipment you have worked with Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate Project Engineer
jobs.description: At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. **This position reports to:** Engineering Manager \_\_ In this role, you will have the opportunity to support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities, under the supervision of senior engineers. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost\-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also showcase your expertise by collecting data and supporting production of the engineering design. The work model for the role is: **On\-site {\#LI\-Onsite}** This role contributes to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Division in the US. **You will be mainly accountable for:** * Performing survey work, standard computations, analysis, and basic design tasks. * Collecting project data and supporting the development of engineering designs. * Exercising judgment on limited details of work and on application of standard methods and preparing project documentation within your scope of deliverables. * Assisting customers on technical issues and interacting with official contacts, contractors, and other staff within your scope of deliverables. * Supporting communication related to project assignments and customer meetings. * Participating in workshops related to engineering design, tools, and processes. * Supporting technical risk assessments and implementing resulting project actions. * Coordinating with project, manufacturing, testing, commissioning, and service teams to support successful project execution and maintain engineering deliverables. * Ensuring quality and timely completion of assigned work in alignment with project schedules and cost objectives **Qualifications for the role** * Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering field for 4\-year engineering degree holders * 0 to 2 years of experience in related positions. * Knowledge or experience with low complexity orders and electrical designs, as well as knowledge of electrical design principles and engineering fundamentals. * Previous experience or knowledge with AutoCAD (recent version) or equivalent computer\-aided design platform. * Previous experience with 3D design including use of Creo, SolidWorks, or equivalent design platforms. * Familiarity with MS Word, MS Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, and other applicable software. * Strong interpersonal skills: Self\-motivation with a high level of creativity, Complex problem\-solving skills, Independent thinking and decision\-making abilities, Attention to detail and accuracy * Authorization to legally work in the US. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Knowledge or experience working in a manufacturing environment, specifically with steel or copper fabrication * Knowledge or experience of electrical distribution equipment * Computer Aided Design certification or degree * Internship or co\-op experience in mechanical design or manufacturing * Knowledge of ANSI Air Insulated Switchgear * Familiarity with NEC, ANSI, IEEE standards * Knowledge of SAP or Windchill is a nice to have. understanding of server hardware, compute nodes, and storage integration within HCI environments. * Familiarity with Layer 2 networking concepts, including VLANs and basic switching. * Exposure to jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI\-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing. **The Opportunity at Altana** The Engineering team is responsible for building out the product for bringing this vision to life. We are creating a platform fundamentally driven by AI, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions. Shipping products that customers actually adopt, not just products that ship, takes a particular kind of engineering practice. It means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. It means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. It means reaching for AI as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. And it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later. As a Senior Engineer at Altana, that's the work and you'll lead others doing it. You'll embed with product and design, get on calls with users, form hypotheses about where the real pain is, and lead a small team turning those hypotheses into shipped, adopted products. You'll measure your work in customer outcomes, not commits. **You Will** * **Spend real time with customers.** Sit alongside them in their workflows, watch where they get stuck, and translate what you learn into product bets your team is willing to ship behind. * **Partner with the product team to decide** ***what*** **to build, not just** ***how***. Form hypotheses about customer value, design the smallest experiment that could prove them out, and learn fast. Push back on briefs that aren't grounded in evidence. * **Take new product surfaces from 0 to 1\.** Pitch, prototype, ship, and drive adoption with real users. You are as fluent in "did this land?" as you are in "is this maintainable?" * **Build AI‑native by default**. LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, and modern AI tooling are first‑class building blocks in your stack, not bolt‑ons. You make principled choices about where AI changes the product equation and where it doesn't. * **Own end‑to‑end outcomes**. From the first customer conversation to telemetry on the dashboard six months later — including the architecture and instrumentation choices that make that telemetry meaningful. * **Set the technical bar for your team**. Review designs and code with a high standard for quality, simplicity, and customer impact, and a low tolerance for engineering work that can't be traced back to a customer outcome. * **Mentor engineers in customer‑centric, hypothesis‑driven product development**. From the car you drive, to the AI in the cloud, Arteris connects the innovative tech that shapes tomorrow. **What You’ll Do as** **a****AI** **Software** **Staff Engineer** **at** **Arteris** Join our innovative team and help shape the future of semiconductor technology, specifically system\-on\-chip (SoC) and chiplets. In this role, you will contribute to \[insert a high\-level purpose or function of the role], collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive impact across cutting\-edge products and solutions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, AI application development, and deployment infrastructure, within a technology environment focused on EDA, security, semiconductors, and SoC design. You will collaborate with our research and development team who develop cutting edge applications of AI towards security solutions, with the objective of transforming these solutions into robust, reliable, production\-ready applications and services. This is not primarily an AI research or model\-development role. We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong understanding of AI technologies who can build the systems required to bring them into production. You will work with applications based on LLMs, chatbots, RAG systems, AI assistants, and AI agents, while addressing the technical challenges involved in their application, integration and deployment. **Key Responsibilities** * Turn AI/ML and LLM proof\-of\-concepts into production\-grade software applications and services. practices. **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong programming and software development skills. * 3\+ years experience contributing to EDA tooling or working within semiconductor engineering environments. * Strong experience with technologies such as LangGraph, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, REST/gRPC APIs, databases, monitoring, and logging. * Strong experience with Python, C\+\+, or similar programming languages. * Experience using AI/ML models as part of software applications. * Experience developing production\-quality software, APIs, backend services, or distributed applications. * Experience deploying software in cloud or on\-premises environments. * Understanding software security concepts, networking, authentication, authorization, and production deployment practices. * Good understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design. * Ability to understand and work within jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (supporting NOAA)
jobs.description: ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™ ASRC Federal is seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer with strong experience in ETL development and relational database performance for a remote, full\-time position This role will design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and the database backend supporting our applications. Primary responsibilities include implementing data ingestion and transformation workflows, developing ORM\-based data access using Java persistence frameworks, and optimizing SQL and database operations. The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust, scalable systems. They bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can troubleshoot performance across Java application code, ORM\-generated queries, and relational databases. Backend services and API development will support data integration, processing, and retrieval. Primary Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Java\-based ETL workflows that extract, transform, validate, and load data from databases, APIs, files, and other source systems. Implement data cleansing, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation to ensure accurate and consistent downstream data. Develop incremental loading, batching, retry, and recovery processes that support reliable execution and safe reprocessing without duplicate records Build and maintain ORM\-based data access layers using Java persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate, including entity mappings, relationships, and transaction management. Develop and optimize SQL queries supporting application functionality and data processing. Inspect SQL generated by JPA/Hibernate in Spring applications and analyze database execution plans to identify inefficient joins, excessive database calls, unnecessary data retrieval, and other performance bottlenecks. Improve database performance through appropriate indexing, query restructuring, batching, pagination, and relationship\-loading strategies. Design and maintain relational schemas, constraints, indexes, and versioned database migrations. Select ORM operations, parameterized SQL, or database\-native bulk operations according to workload, maintainability, and performance requirements. Implement and optimize OpenSearch or Elasticsearch queries, filters, and aggregations; troubleshoot search performance and maintain consistency between source data and search indexes. Monitor pipeline reliability, data quality, processing throughput, and query response times; troubleshoot production issues and demonstrate measurable improvements. Create automated tests for transformation logic, database interactions, data integrity, and recovery behavior Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to define requirements, document data mappings, and review database and pipeline designs. Design, develop, and maintain GraphQL APIs and resolvers to support efficient data retrieval and integration with backend services and relational databases. Develop and optimize database integrations using Amazon Aurora within Amazon RDS in AWS, including connection management, schema migrations, ETL workflows, and query performance tuning. Required Technical Qualifications Strong Java development experience building and supporting production backend applications. Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines and data integration workflows. Hands\-on experience with Java Spring ORM and persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate. Experience writing and optimizing JPQL and SQL queries, including troubleshooting ORM\-generated SQL. Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and set\-based processing. Experience analyzing database execution plans and improving query performance through indexing and query changes. Experience with relational data modeling, schema migrations, entity relationships, and transaction management. Understanding of database isolation levels, locking, and concurrency. Experience implementing data validation, incremental processing, error handling, and recoverable data workflows. Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, and software deployment practices. Ability to explain production performance improvements using measured results. Preferred Qualifications Experience with workflow orchestration, job scheduling, change data capture, and pipeline monitoring. Experience diagnosing ORM performance issues such as N\+1 queries, inefficient relationship loading, and excessive entity loading. Experience processing large datasets within defined delivery windows while managing database resource utilization. Familiarity with Apache Spark for ETL and distributed data processing. **Education:** BS/BA degree (or equivalent) plus 8\-10 years experience in related field. We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary. EEO Statement ASRC Federal and its Subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform and Automations
jobs.description: **About us** AbuvThePar runs an Amazon wholesale education program. Our students learn how to open accounts with real brands, buy inventory at wholesale, and sell it on Amazon. Behind the program are teams for purchasing, brand outreach, and student coaching, plus the software that ties all of it together. **About the role** We run the business on our own apps and automations: a platform for our students, an ops platform for our team, and scheduled jobs that move data between them and the tools we use every day. Most of it was built with AI coding tools, and it has grown past what our current team can keep up with. This role keeps all of it running, fixes what breaks, and ships what's next. If AI\-built code makes you nervous, this isn't the role. If it makes you curious, keep reading. **What's already builtAcre: the student platform** The app our students use to run their wholesale business day to day. * Find brands to work with and build lead lists * Look up the right contacts at each brand (email and phone), from our own brand database and outside data providers * Research a brand before a call: prep notes, talking points, and the brand's products on Amazon * Track every brand from first contact to closed deal, with tasks, notes, and files * Write emails that land as drafts in the student's own Gmail, and pull in the replies * Listing tools: copy checks for Amazon listings and product image generation * A background job system for long\-running work, with usage limits for each student Next up on the roadmap: more Amazon data sources, usage credits, and speed work as more students join. **Ivy: the ops platform** The internal app our team uses to run purchasing, offers, and fulfillment. It is several apps in one codebase. * **Purchasing:** upload purchase orders, check the profit on each product, approve or decline * **Student offers:** turn approved orders into offers for students, with a Google Sheet and a Gmail draft for each student * **Offer tracking:** see which offers were sent, accepted, or declined, with weekly reports * **PO flow:** follow each order from close through supplier payment, warehouse receiving, and invoicing (Xero) * **Account management:** track which products each student is approved to sell * **Brand outreach:** a database of 20,000\+ brands and their contacts, with contact lookup and call queues * **Coach workspace:** student profiles and rosters for our coaching team **Automations** * Offer texts: when an offer email goes out, the student gets a text (through GoHighLevel) and one reminder 48 hours later * Gmail sync that tracks offer emails and replies * Scheduled jobs (GitHub Actions and cron) that keep Ivy, Google Sheets, and our CRM in sync * Email sequences to students and brands (Hunter) * Brand research and contact lookup pipelines in Python and Node, using Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, and LLMs **Tech stack** * **Apps:** Next.js and React. Acre is TypeScript, Ivy is JavaScript (pnpm \+ Turborepo monorepo) * **Database:** Supabase (Postgres, row\-level security, storage) * **Hosting:** Vercel (Acre), Railway (Ivy) * **Code and CI:** GitHub, GitHub Actions * **Testing:** Vitest, Playwright * **Scripts:** Node and Python * **Outside services:** Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), GoHighLevel, Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, OpenRouter for LLM calls, Xero * **AI coding tools:** Claude Code, Codex **What you'll doEvery week** * **Fix bugs** across Acre, Ivy, and the automations. When someone says "it's broken," find which step broke, fix it, ship it, and check it on the live app. Same day when you can. * **Run deploys** on Vercel and Railway, watch the logs, and roll back fast when something goes wrong. * **Change the database safely:** write and apply migrations, keep row\-level security tight, and keep backups current. * **Keep the automations healthy:** notice when a scheduled job or sync stops, find out why, and get it running again. * **Watch usage and limits** on outside APIs (contact lookup, AI, texting) so nothing runs out without warning. **Projects** * Ship Acre roadmap features end to end * Clean up screens that confuse students or staff, in both apps * Speed up slow pages as more students and data come in * Add tests for the parts that break most often * Keep a short doc for each system, so nobody has to guess how it works The bug work matters most. Done means you saw it working live, not "it should work now." **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Get access to everything. Map how Acre, Ivy, and the automations fit together: what calls what, where the data lives, and what runs on a schedule. Fix your first live bugs. * **By day 60:** You own the bug queue and deploys for both apps. * **By day 90:** You ship Acre roadmap features end to end, from the idea to checking it live. **What you're good at** * Reading a system you didn't write and mapping it: what calls what, where the data lives, what runs in the background * Deploys and keeping apps up: GitHub, Vercel, Railway, env vars, logs, rollbacks * Postgres and Supabase: migrations, row\-level security, and never deleting what you can't get back * Next.js, React, and TypeScript, enough to fix it and ship it * A good eye for UX/UI. You can tell when a screen is confusing and make it simpler. * Working with AI coding tools and checking their work instead of trusting it * Clear written updates: what broke, what you changed, and how you checked it **Nice to have** * Experience with Amazon selling, ecommerce, or wholesale * Python for scripts and data jobs * Connecting tools through their APIs: Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, GoHighLevel, or other CRMs * Background jobs, queues, and scheduled tasks **How we work** * Find out why something broke before you fix it. * Small changes shipped often beat big risky ones. * Back up before you change data. Never delete what you can't get back. * AI writes a lot of the code. You check all of it. **This isn't for you if** * You need a full spec before you start anything * "It works on my machine" feels like done to you * You'd rather rebuild a system from scratch than learn the one that's already running **How to apply** Skip the long cover letter. When you apply, send us three things: * One thing you built or fixed, with a link if you can share it * What broke along the way, and how you found it * Your available hours and time zone A resume is fine too, but we read those three answers first. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Gen AI Engineers
jobs.description: Accellor is an AI\-native services firm purpose\-built for the post\-ChatGPT era. Free from legacy constraints, we focus on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. Our mission is to operationalize AI at scale and unlock sustained enterprise value. Our offerings span AI solutions, data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering, tailored to industry\-specific needs across healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology. By leveraging design thinking and technology\-agnostic architectures, we ensure faster time\-to\-value and seamless interoperability. With a proven track record of enabling Fortune 100 enterprises and global innovators, Accellor stands as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to harness the full potential of AI. Our vision is clear: to build intelligent, connected ecosystems that deliver measurable outcomes and redefine the future of enterprise transformation. **Role Summary****:** We are looking for a GenAI Engineer to advance how software is designed, built, tested, and delivered using frontier AI models and coding agents. You will work with models from OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and other providers, alongside AI development environments such as Cursor. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with prompt engineering and agent orchestration to improve development productivity, software quality, and cost efficiency. This role is suited to engineers who enjoy building working software, evaluating new approaches, and turning successful experiments into reliable engineering practices. Recent graduates with strong projects and demonstrable skills are encouraged to apply. **Key Responsibilities****:** **Build and Deliver Software:** * Develop features, resolve defects, refactor applications, and create automated tests using AI\-assisted development tools. * Use Cursor and other coding environments effectively for repository exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and code review. * Translate product requirements into well\-defined engineering tasks, technical approaches, and acceptance criteria. * Take ownership of code quality and delivery readiness, including changes produced by AI models or agents. * Collaborate with product, engineering, and quality teams to deliver reliable software releases. **Develop and Evaluate Prompts:** * Design and maintain effective prompts, repository instructions, context strategies, and reusable workflows for software engineering tasks. * Provide models with the relevant architecture, dependencies, coding standards, constraints, and expected outcomes. * Establish repeatable evaluations to assess correctness, consistency, requirement coverage, and the need for human intervention. * Improve prompts and workflows using evidence from test results, code reviews, and delivery outcomes. **Orchestrate Coding Agents:** * Build coordinated groups of coding agents to support planning, implementation, testing, review, and documentation. * Design reliable task delegation, handover, takeover, and recovery workflows with clear ownership and shared task state. * Manage parallel execution, task dependencies, isolated workspaces, and integration conflicts. * Define appropriate tool access, execution boundaries, and human review checkpoints. * Ensure agent\-produced changes can be traced, reviewed, tested, and integrated into the codebase **Improve Engineering Efficiency:** * Select models and tools based on task requirements, quality, latency, and cost. * Optimize context size, token consumption, model routing, retries, and agent execution overhead. * Establish baselines and measure improvements in development throughput, delivery time, review effort, and AI expenditure. * Maintain clear reporting on weekly and monthly delivery trends, including pull requests raised and merged. * Share validated practices and reusable tools that improve the effectiveness of the wider engineering team. **Requirements** **Minimum Qualifications:** * 0–4 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or applied AI development. Academic, personal, and open\-source projects will also be considered. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or C\#. * Hands\-on experience applying frontier models, including OpenAI models or Anthropic Claude, to software development. * Practical experience with Cursor or comparable AI coding environments. * Strong prompt engineering skills, including task decomposition, context preparation, structured outputs, and iterative evaluation. * Working knowledge of Git, pull requests, debugging, automated testing, APIs, and CI/CD. * Ability to understand existing codebases and independently assess the correctness of AI\-generated code. * Clear communication, collaborative working habits, and ownership of engineering outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing workflows with multiple coding agents, including delegation, handover, and integration. * Familiarity with model APIs, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience evaluating prompts and models using defined datasets, acceptance criteria, and automated checks. * Experience monitoring AI usage, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency. * Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, deployment automation, and application observability. * A portfolio of working software demonstrating effective use of AI tools, supported by tests and technical documentation. **Performance and Impact:** Success in this role is demonstrated through sustained contributions to software delivery, engineering quality, and team effectiveness. Performance expectations will reflect the scope, complexity, and level of ownership associated with the role. Delivery and execution: Expected Contribution: Deliver meaningful, well\-scoped changes with predictable execution and clear ownership. **Representative Indicators:** Weekly and monthly PR submissions and merges; task completion; time to review\-ready code; PR cycle time.

ensuring consistency with design systems and style guidelines. * Build and optimize reusable Vue components, composables, and modules to support scalable front\-end architecture. * Integrate front and back\-end applications with RESTful APIs, handling asynchronous requests and data flows using tools such as Axios or Fetch. * Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes into high\-quality, production\-ready interfaces. * Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, responsive behavior, and accessibility best practices across different devices and screen sizes. * Optimize application performance, including load times, rendering efficiency, and overall front\-end responsiveness. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve front\-end issues, including layout, styling, and API integration problems. * Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and adhere to coding standards and best practices. * Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data models, and integration patterns. * Contribute to front\-end build and deployment processes using modern tooling (e.g., module bundlers, task runners, and package managers). * Continuously stay up to date with emerging front\-end technologies, frameworks, and best practices, and apply them where appropriate. * Collaborate with product and stakeholder teams to estimate effort, plan sprints, and deliver features on schedule. * Create and maintain technical documentation for components, features, and front\-end workflows. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s cross\-device interfaces. * Solid understanding of RESTful API integration and asynchronous request handling (e.g., Axios, Fetch). * Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+) with a systems, particularly Git, and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews). * Familiarity with performance optimization techniques and tools for diagnosing front\-end bottlenecks. * Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following industry best practices. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug complex front\-end issues across environments. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional agile teams. * Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\. translate business objectives into measurable engineering outcomes. ### **Preferred** * Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or product\-led growth experiences. * Experience developing AI\-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production jobs.description: **Manager – Software Engineering** As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead and manage a team of back\-end developers that work on all server\-side aspects of smart home security. Typical projects will involve diverse technologies. You'll have the opportunity to work across various technical areas using the latest technologies while using Agile development methods. Strong multi\-tasking skills and the ability to self\-learn are must\-have attributes. You will be collaborating with stake holders across multiple offices, strong communication skills a must. This position is ideal for the candidate who seeks a small, friendly company culture where one can work closely with smart and highly productive people across a very interesting spectrum of wireless, software, and hardware/device technologies to develop outstanding consumer products. **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people**: We hire only the best. Our employees work from the office** **4 days a week****.** **COMPANY INFO** Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. jobs.title: Director of Computer Vision and Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Company Overview** *ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.* *Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter\-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost\-effective response to one of the fastest\-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.* *Following a $200 million Series B at a $2\.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast\-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real\-world impact on national security.* *ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit* *allencontrolsystems.com**.* **About The Role** We are looking for a **Director of Computer Vision/Machine Learning** to bridge executive AI strategy and day\-to\-day technical execution for Bullfrog's perception and tracking systems. You will translate the VP / Chief Engineer of AI's vision into clear priorities, roadmaps, and standards for the Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Tracking teams, while staying hands\-on: reviewing code, digging into data, and helping solve the hardest problems alongside staff engineers and leads across software, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering. You will also build direct working relationships with other VPs, Chief Engineers, and executive leadership, representing CV/ML/Tracking in technical and schedule discussions across the company. **What You'll Do** * Translate the VP / Chief Engineer of AI's vision and technical strategy into actionable plans, milestones, and priorities for the CV, ML, and Tracking teams; serve as the primary communication channel carrying direction down and status, risk, and insights up. * Manage, coach, and develop the managers of the CV/ML and Tracking teams, holding them accountable for delivery, performance, and team health; mentor engineers and technical leads and help identify and grow future leaders. * Partner with software, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering to solve problems no single discipline can solve alone, including sensor selection and placement, optics, compute and power constraints, and thermal limits. * Own on\-time delivery of CV/ML and Tracking contributions to program schedules; anticipate integration risks early and drive resolution before they threaten milestones, escalating when schedule risk cannot be resolved at the working level. * Establish and enforce standards for model development, evaluation, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and documentation; define metrics and benchmarks such as detection accuracy, tracking performance, latency, and robustness so success is measurable. * Review code and pull requests, and write code, prototypes, or analysis scripts to unblock the team or validate an approach; participate in architecture and design reviews, challenging assumptions and guiding teams toward robust, scalable solutions. **What You'll Need** * 10\-15 years of experience in computer vision and/or machine learning, with 3\+ years leading managers or multiple teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: object detection, multi\-object tracking, sensor fusion, or deep learning for perception. * Strong programming skills in Python, with familiarity in C\+\+ and common frameworks including PyTorch, TensorRT, and OpenCV; proven track record taking CV/ML systems from research through production deployment. * Demonstrated success collaborating across software, mechanical, electrical, and systems disciplines to deliver complex products on schedule; excellent communication skills engaging with staff engineers, peers, and C\-level executives; comfort operating in a flat, collaborative, low\-ego, high\-ownership organization. **You'll Stand Out** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. * 15\-20 years of experience leading managers across multiple teams, with experience scaling computer vision/ML organizations beyond a single team. * Experience with real\-time or embedded perception systems, including model optimization and edge deployment; familiarity with tracking algorithms such as Kalman filters and data association methods. * Familiarity with MLOps practices, large\-scale training pipelines, and data engineering; systems engineering experience including requirements decomposition, interface definition, and verification. * Experience in a domain such as autonomous systems, robotics, defense, surveillance, or sports analytics; publications, patents, or open\-source contributions in the field. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary * ACS Equity Package * Health, Dental, Vision Insurance * Paid Time Off *Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*
