jobs.description: **About Atlas** Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project. **Job Description** Atlas is seeking an experienced Geotechnical Project Engineer with a minimum if five years of relevant professional experience to support geotechnical engineering and construction related projects throughout South Florida. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in subsurface investigations, geotechnical analysis, report preparation, and construction phase services, with ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate field operations, and develop engineering recommendations with limited supervision. **Core Responsibilities** * Manage geotechnical projects from proposal through completion, including planning, field execution, budgets, schedules, and deliverable quality. * Plan and coordinate subsurface investigations, including SPT borings, test pits, rock core, laboratory testing, and groundwater evaluations. * Prepare geotechnical engineering reports, calculations, and recommendations (foundation, earthwork observations and site development), with QA/QC review support from senior staff. * Perform construction phase services, including site visits, field evaluations, foundation, pavement, and earthwork observations, and resolution of geotechnical issues. * Coordinate with field technicians, drilling subcontractors, contractors, and clients to ensure proper execution of field activities. * Assist with proposal preparation, cost estimates, scope development, and client communications. * Promote and maintain safe working practices during field and office operations. **You’ll thrive here if you have** * B.S. in Civil Engineering (Geotechnical emphasis) or Geotechnical Engineering. * Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in geotechnical engineering and construction\-phase services, including subsurface exploration, engineering evaluations, and geotechnical report preparation. * Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating geotechnical engineering projects, including scope, schedule, budget, field operations, and technical deliverables. * Working knowledge of geotechnical engineering principles, soil mechanics, foundation engineering, and standard industry practices. ### **Technical Knowledge \& Experience** * Plan and execute geotechnical investigations, including developing field programs, coordinating drillers and laboratories, overseeing SPT borings and test pits, documenting conditions, and troubleshooting field issues. * Demonstrated experience with construction materials testing operations, including soil compaction, earthwork observations, field inspections, technician oversight, and non\-conformance resolution. * documentation while ensuring quality and timely deliverables. * Proficiency with standard geotechnical engineering software and geotechnical logging and analysis tools. * Familiarity with South interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with clients, contractors, technicians, and project team members. * Ability to lead and direct technicians while collaborating effectively within a team environment. * Ability to satisfy specific background check requirements. * Minimum Engineer Intern (EI/EIT) certification required; Professional Engineer (P.E.) license preferred. * Strong technical writing, project coordination, and communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and assignments with limited supervision. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required. **What you can expect from us** The A\-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life: * **Health \& Wellness:** We offer medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options, including no\-cost employee\-only medical coverage. * **Time Off \& Family Support:** We offer vacation time, paid holidays, sick \& safety leave (SSL) and paid parental leave * **Retirement:** We help employees plan for the future with a 401(k) and company match. * **Insurance:** To provide protection and peace of mind, we offer Life, AD\&D (Accidental Death \& Dismemberment) and Disability insurance. * **Safety Program:** We are committed to safety as part of our ‘quality of life’ core value, and we provide approved PPE at no cost and reimbursement for prescription safety glasses and protective footwear. * **Learning \& Development:** We provide clear career paths, learning resources and development programs allowing you to see how you can grow and advance within the company. We offer internal certifications on specific skills and support external credentials through tuition reimbursement. * **Belonging:** We support Employee Communities (ECs), voluntary, employee\-led groups that create connections, belonging and shared purposes. * **Flexibility:** May vary by project demands and regional workloads, but we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to help employees manage their personal and professional responsibilities. Our people and our culture are central to our work. Our values bring us together, create a sense of belonging and give us purpose. They guide how we make decisions, how we work as a team and how we serve our clients. * **Life:** We enhance the quality of life. We value people and safety above all else. * **Heart:** As our hallmark, we act with compassion, empathy, and respect. * **Trust:** We work together as partners, doing what we say with full accountability. * **Mastery:** Always striving for the highest quality, greatness inspires our work. **About the Job** * Career Level: Professional * Employment Type: Full\-time **EEO Statement** Atlas is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants without regard to race (including hairstyles, hair texture, hair type, or hair length commonly or historically associated with race), ethnicity, creed, religion or religious creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions or requests for pregnancy disability leave and/or family care leave), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, primary language, crime victim status, criminal conviction history, uniformed service member or veteran status, marital status, age, genetic information, disability or protected medical condition, genetics, political affiliation or activities, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. **Notice to Third Party Agencies** Please note that Atlas Technical Consultants does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, Atlas will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, Atlas explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Atlas. Ready to build a career to be proud of? **Join the A\-Team today!**

You will work with extended teams to evolve solutions as business processes and requirements change. You'll own problems end\-to\-end and on an ongoing basis, you'll improve the data by adding new sources, coding business rules, and producing new metrics that support the business. Compensation: At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. jobs.title: Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description: At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world\-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state\-of\-the\-art in quantum computing. Atom Computing is seeking a Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer to improve how our physicists and engineers use AI in their daily work. You will set best practices for AI\-assisted engineering and build shared tooling that lets teams quickly adopt new AI\-driven workflows. You will also influence product architecture to broaden where LLM\-driven workflows apply, including areas where hardware, timing, or reliability requirements have typically called for conventional methods. This role’s aim is to accelerate work in experiment analysis, optics development, PCB and FPGA design, and quantum control software (C\+\+/Rust) development. Due to the need to engineer physical systems, the role will be on\-site in Boulder, CO at least 3 days per week. ### **Responsibilities** * Define, document, and maintain best practices for AI\-assisted coding, testing, code review, and research workflows. * Influence guidelines for using LLMs on performance\-critical software, including embedded C\+\+ and Rust, RTOS applications, and kernel device drivers: where AI assistance is appropriate, how generated code is reviewed and tested, and how memory safety, timing, and determinism are verified before merge. * Make forward\-looking electronics architecture improvements to our AI tooling and integrations so they keep pace with advances in models and agents and with shifts in engineers' tool preferences, and track industry benchmarks for AI\-assisted developer productivity so our practices stay current. * Build ways to measure the output of AI and LLM\-driven workflows, such as defect and revert rates of AI\-assisted changes, review findings, test coverage, performance regressions, new capabilities added, and time saved, and use the results to refine tools and guidelines. * Ensure safe and reliable operation of AI in quantum processors. ### **Experience \& Education** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Artificial Intelligence * 8\+ years of software development ### **Qualifications** * Strong software engineering skills in Python, and experience writing embedded software in C\+\+ or Rust, including manual memory management, hard real\-time constraints, and kernel device driver implementation. * Influencing an organization of \> 50 engineers using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) on a daily basis, identifying pitfalls and measuring impact. * Working knowledge of how LLMs behave in practice: context management, prompting, agentic workflows, harnesses, effective safety practices, tool use, and judging output quality. * Clear written and spoken communication with audiences ranging from physicists to new software hires. An ability to influence a multi\-discipline engineering organization. Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short\- and long\-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day! The base salary range for this position is between $170,000 \- $200,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Sr/Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Consumer Apps
jobs.description: **About Attain** **Built for consumers and companies, alike** Klover's engineering team powers one of the fastest\-growing fintech platforms in the U.S., supporting over one million active users each month. Our systems process and move more than $1\.5 billion annually, enabling real\-time access to financial tools, rewards, and services that help people improve their day\-to\-day lives. As part of this team, you'll help design, build, and scale the systems that underpin Klover's core products and platform. You'll work on high\-impact, production\-grade systems that prioritize reliability, security, and performance, and that integrate with a broad ecosystem of internal and external services. The work you do will directly shape how users interact with Klover's products, access their money, and experience transparent, low\-fee financial services. Klover engineers collaborate closely with colleagues across backend, frontend, data science, and product teams to deliver scalable, high\-quality solutions for a rapidly growing user base. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies and architectures while helping define and evolve the next generation of inclusive, data\-powered financial products—building systems and interfaces that emphasize reliability, privacy, and performance at scale. ***Attain Office Hybrid Schedule (where applicable):*** * *Chicago, IL \& New York, NY:* *4 days in\-office; 1 day remote* * *We are open to discussing a remote arrangement for the right candidate* #### **About the Role** As a Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a critical role in building out and maintaining the infrastructure that powers all of our systems, as well as all of the supporting tools to ensure that those systems are running smoothly. Automation is the core of this role. We expect you to hunt down manual toil wherever it hides and engineer it out of existence — and to do that with the best tooling available, including AI agents you direct to write, test, and ship infrastructure code. We treat fluency with modern AI as a first\-class SRE skill, along with cloud platform literacy, a strong dedication to observability, and a laser\-focus on improving developer experience. You will work closely with nearly every engineering team at Attain, helping to ensure that our systems are operating at peak efficiency, and preparing us to handle the scale of our future growth. #### **What a typical week might look like** * Use AI agents as a force multiplier for yourself and others * Create, improve, and maintain internal agentic tools and harnesses * Add automation to both existing and new systems until manual processes, and the toil that comes with them, simply go away * Write Terraform modules for deploying infrastructure resources via our GitLab pipelines * Develop Helm charts for deploying services and jobs in our Kubernetes cluster * Define metrics, network policies, and routing rules for our Istio service mesh * Monitor and maintain our GCP BigQuery, Spanner, and CloudSQL databases * Pipe metrics to our Google\-managed Prometheus instance and build out Grafana dashboards and alerts to increase visibility on our systems * Experiment with GCP offerings, 3rd party vendors, AI tooling, and open\-source projects to further automate and secure day\-to\-day operations * Pair with engineering leads to instrument and monitor critical functionality * Participate in architecture design and capacity planning discussions to ensure that our systems are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and secure * Build, maintain, and improve our CI/CD pipeline #### **You'll be a great fit for the role if** * You reach for automation before you reach for a runbook, and a manual process is something you want to delete, not document * You treat AI agents as power tools and have real opinions about how to drive them — especially when to stop trusting them * You are comfortable wearing many hats * You have a willingness to learn and teach in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment * You have a strong desire to automate things * You readily provide constructive feedback, and also proactively seek feedback to improve yourself * You like to get your hands dirty and tinker with/stress test new technologies #### **Preferred Qualifications** * 6\+ years of experience building and maintaining large\-scale cloud\-native infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) * Demonstrated fluency directing AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build, operate, and debug real infrastructure; and robust and experienced judgment on verification of their work * A track record of replacing manual operations with durable automation * Experience working with the containerization technologies Docker, Kubernetes, and Istio or a similar service mesh technology * Experience with SQL database technologies such as MySQL, Google BigQuery, and Google Spanner * Experience with stream technologies such as Kafka and Amazon Kinesis * Experience with pub sub technologies such as AWS SNS and Google Pub/Sub * Experience with serverless computing technologies such as AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Functions/Google Cloud Run * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform * Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana * Strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals * Experience with SOC2 and PCI Compliance processes and requirements ***We are excited to hear from you.*** At Attain, we are passionate about finding people to continuously help us grow our organization. We encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't match every detail on the job description. If we don't see something that immediately fits, we will keep your resume on file for future opportunities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Core Services
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. ### **Who We Are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly to make transportation safer, increasingly accessible, and more reliable and efficient than ever before. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you'll solve massively complex problems alongside other passionate, smart people, growing as an expert while broadening your field of knowledge. For Aurora’s latest news, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are excited about building the future of transportation that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient \& accessible for all. We are searching for an exceptional Backend Software Engineer to join the Aurora Services Engineering team and take on a critical role in building Aurora's suite of fleet management tools. The Aurora Services Engineering org creates full\-stack solutions including backend services, web apps, mobile apps, and real\-time onboard code that enable commercial operation of autonomous vehicle fleets at scale. Our mission is to build the software that drives the commercial side of our platform such as assigning work to autonomous vehicles, providing remote support, managing a fleet of vehicles, and receiving orders from customers. As Aurora prepares to massively scale its fleet and integrate with partners on an API level, the tools we build are critical to the efficient daily operation of our business. We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Core Services team under Aurora Services. You will help the Aurora Services Org to build the new asset management solution to scale up the autonomous vehicles fleet. ### **In this role, you will** * Design complex systems from the ground up. Partnering closely with Software, Hardware and infrastructure engineering teams. * Partner with Product Managers, Designers and Operation Stakeholders to deliver the benefit of Self Driving Vehicles quickly, safely and broadly. * Design, implement and maintain a micro\-services running in the Aurora’s AWS cloud used to monitor and manage the entire Aurora Self Driving Fleet. * Design, implement the fleet management solution and the vehicle communication system. * Establish technology and infrastructure to scale our products with high availability and reliability. * Contribute and evolve our team culture around mentorship, feedback,collaboration, and engineering excellence. ### **You will be a good fit if you have** * 2 or more years of experience in building backend services. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field. * Experience with web communication protocols, including REST, gRPC and GraphQL. * Experience with building large scale, high concurrent, high throughput and safety critical backend services. * Phenomenal communication skills. We build software with people and for people. You know how to write an effective technical spec, provide feedback to others, translate technical concepts into lay terms, and incorporate feedback into your efforts. You value and practice openness, empathy, kindness, and collaboration. * A preference for action. You will use good judgment to balance speed and quality. You will deliver products that are built in a responsible and sustainable way. You will use a self\-starter mentality to thrive in a growing environment where all hands are on deck, and consider no obstacle too big or too small. You will notice where there is a need and will hustle to fill it. * The drive to make teams stronger. You're excited to work hard and fast to the finish line on new opportunities with a collaborative and integrated team. You will be proactive in engaging conflict with openness, patience and kindness in an environment where it is safe to lean on each other and learn from failures. * Motivation to own the product lifecycle end to end. You’re happy to engage with our product and design teams and our internal customers to understand their needs and find ways to meet them. You ensure that product development stays on course all the way through release and post\-release support. ### **Desirable Experience** * Experience with autonomous vehicle development. * Experience with IoT, real time communication between devices and cloud. * Experience with application release strategies such as feature flagging, A/B testing and canary release. * Experience with observability and monitoring of safety critical systems. * Experience with fleet management solutions for Robots, Vehicles or Aerial Drones. * Experience with external customer facing software including production rollout with real customers. * Experience with safety and mission critical applications. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $139,000 \- $223,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $126,000 \- $201,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Firmware Validation Engineer I (Onsite)

Your work directly shapes product quality, customer trust, and release timelines. **Location: Scottsdale, AZ** **Reports to: Software Engineering Manager** **Direct Reports: N/A** #### **What You'll Do:** * Own execution of release regression (manual and automated), exploratory testing, as well as impacted areas for individual new features, scoping coverage to risk and release timelines. * Design reproducible evidence and customer\-impact data. * Lead release\-readiness reporting including feature quality reports, test execution status, and production\-vs\-staging escape analysis to inform go/no\-go decisions. * Identify and drive test tooling and process improvements (dashboards for regression/performance monitoring, new test\-equipment integrations, AI\-assisted test case generation) to increase coverage and efficiency. * Coordinate with Engineering, PM/TPM, and hardware/RF labs to resolve scheduling, access, and documentation gaps that block testing. * Manage multiple concurrent test cycles and releases with minimal oversight, setting priorities across competing deadlines. **What You Bring** * 3\+ years in software, firmware, or hardware quality assurance / validation engineering, ideally on complex, multi\-component products. * Experience with embedded or connected\-device products (firmware and hardware\-software integration). * Hands\-on experience with test case design, test execution, and automated testing methodologies. * Working experience within a test management and requirements\-traceability practice, using Jira, Zephyr Scale (or equivalent), and log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk). * Working knowledge of scripting/automation (Python or similar) and CI/CD\-integrated test frameworks. * Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. * Familiarity with hardware and environmental test methods: RF, GPS/GNSS, environmental chambers, and connectivity (LTE/Wi\-Fi) testing is preferred. * Experience using AI tools for test case generation, traceability, and test data analysis is highly preferred. **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Beacon Software** ------------------------- Beacon is acquiring and operating a portfolio of vertical SaaS companies. Most private equity firms scale by adding people. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple: portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and an agentic operating system can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude. We are building that system. It has two pieces. A sensing layer is a cross\-portfolio data lake on open table formats with a feature store on top that makes the data agent\-readable. An action layer runs workflows across three domains: how we run the portfolio, how we grow the portfolio, and how we acquire into it. Underneath both sits a feedback loop that captures every action and outcome with stable identifiers. Beacon has raised $550M\+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp. **About the Role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the engineers who go where the work is. You will be embedded with one or two portfolio companies at a time — sitting with the GM, the operators, and the customer success lead — figuring out where the leverage is, and shipping agentic software directly into their operation. The platforms exist. You are the person who turns them into outcomes on a specific business. This is a Palantir\-style FDE role applied to private equity operations. You will spend a meaningful fraction of your time on\-site or in the portco’s tools, and the rest of your time back at Beacon HQ pulling the patterns you learned back into the platform. The best FDEs at Beacon will not just deliver for the portcos they are deployed at — they will compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portco in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Embed deeply with portcos. Spend the first few weeks at a new portco understanding the operating model from the inside: what the GM cares about, where revenue actually comes from, where the team’s time goes, where the system is leaking. Earn the trust of the operators before you start changing things. * Find the leverage. Identify the 2–3 workflows where agentic software will meaningfully change the trajectory of the business — churn\-save, pricing experiments, lead enrichment, support deflection, AR follow\-up, bug\-fix PRs, weekly pulse, whatever the specific portco needs. Pick the wedge, not the wish list. * Ship the wedge. Build the integrations, the prompts, the evals, the workflows, and the UI surfaces required to land the first agentic loop at that portco. Use the platforms our core engineering team is building, and extend them when they fall short. * Operate the loop. Stay close to the system after it ships. Watch the outcomes. Tune the prompts. Adjust the autonomy tier as the system earns trust. Hand off cleanly to portfolio ops once the loop is stable. * Compound the learnings. Bring the patterns back to HQ. Codify what worked into playbooks that ship to every other portco in the vertical. The 11th deployment in a home\-services SaaS should be 10x faster than the 1st, and that compression is your job as much as the engineers building the platform. * Carry the GM relationship. You are the technical face of Beacon to the portco GM. Build the trust, set the expectations, and make sure the GM sees the system as their leverage — not Beacon’s audit tool. **Who You Are** --------------- * A strong generalist engineer. You can ship full\-stack TypeScript or Python on the backend, React on the frontend, SQL fluently, comfortable in someone else’s codebase within a day. You do not need to be a specialist in any one stack. You need to be the person who can land the whole thing. * Customer\-obsessed. You like being in the room with the operator, the GM, the customer success lead. You take the problem they actually have, not the problem they described. You are not interested in building platforms that no one uses. * High autonomy, low ego. You will be the only Beacon engineer on the ground at a portco most of the time. You need to make calls without a committee, defend them when challenged, and change your mind when you are wrong. * Comfortable with LLM\-native engineering. You have shipped real software using foundation models — not toy demos. You know how to write evals, when to fine\-tune, how to keep an agentic workflow from going off the rails, and where the autonomy tier should sit for any given action class. * Operator instincts. You can read a P\&L. You understand why a churn\-save matters more than a feature launch this quarter. You know that a 5\-point improvement in support deflection is worth more than a 50\-point improvement in code\-review velocity, depending on the business. * Strong written communicator. Beacon runs on writing. You will write the wedge memo, the GM update, the post\-deployment retro, the playbook that ships to every other portco. If your writing is fuzzy, the system stays fuzzy. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Prior FDE experience * PE, consulting, or M\&A diligence exposure, particularly the post\-LOI integration cadence * Comfort with Iceberg\-based data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) and event\-driven systems * Built or operated agentic systems in production, including evals, autonomy gating, and outcome tracking **Our Values at Beacon Software** * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

Reporting to the Director of AI and working with technical leadership, this position partners with business and technology teams to deliver practical tools, prepare and evaluate data and AI outputs, document solutions, support user adoption, and promote the responsible use of AI across the organization. **INTERACTION:** * Reports to the Director of AI. * Partners with Technology, Data \& Analytics, Store Operations, Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources, and other business teams to support AI use cases and implementation efforts. **SUMMARY OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES \[Essential Functions]:** * Assist with developing, testing, implementing, and supporting AI\-enabled solutions, automations, prompts, workflows, and knowledge resources. * Use version control (Git) and participate in code reviews for assigned development work. * Prepare, organize, and validate data used for assigned AI and machine learning initiatives using SQL and Python. * Evaluate AI outputs for quality, accuracy, consistency, and business relevance, and document findings. * Assist with gathering requirements and translating defined business needs into practical technical solutions. * Support pilot projects, user testing, and feedback collection for new AI\-enabled tools and processes. * Monitor assigned solutions, troubleshoot issues, track adoption and outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement. * Create and maintain technical documentation, user guides, support materials, and best practices. * Support training and enablement activities for approved AI tools. * Research emerging AI capabilities and share findings and potential business applications with technical leadership. * Follow company standards for data privacy, security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI; identify and escalate potential quality, bias, risk, or policy concerns. * Perform other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** ***Required qualifications*** * Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field; recent and upcoming graduates are encouraged to apply. * Foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence, generative AI, data analysis, automation, or related technologies gained through education, internships, projects, or relevant work experience. * Foundational understanding of prompt development and evaluation concepts. * Working knowledge of Python and SQL, demonstrated through coursework, internships, or personal projects. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and organizational skills. * Ability to collaborate, learn new technologies, and adapt to changing business needs. ***Preferred qualifications*** * Experience through an internship, capstone, academic research, project work, or employment involving AI, analytics, automation, or software development. * Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI, Power Platform, or comparable technologies. * Familiarity with APIs, cloud\-based AI services, workflow automation, Power BI, Git, Azure DevOps, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse, or similar tools. * Exposure to retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent frameworks, or AI evaluation tooling through coursework or projects. * A portfolio, GitHub repository, or capstone project demonstrating hands\-on use of generative AI tools or APIs. * Interest in applying AI within retail or consumer\-oriented business operations.

This individual will proactively research and resolve issues independently, take full ownership of projects as an individual contributor, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. **What You Will Do:** * Monitor and triage security alerts from CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, and AWS security services, escalating potential incidents as needed. * Use Datadog to review security logs, investigate unusual activity, and help improve alert quality. * Track vulnerabilities (CVEs) affecting our technology stack and follow up with engineering teams on fixes. * Support SOC 2 compliance by gathering audit evidence, maintaining documentation, and verifying security controls. * Assist with routine security maintenance such as IAM reviews, certificate renewals, and WAF rule updates. * Support the DevOps team with CI/CD pipelines, deployments, AWS administration, and automation scripting. Requirements: **What You Need to Be Successful:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field. * 1–3 years of experience in IT, DevOps, cloud, or security, including at least one year of hands\-on security experience through internships or professional roles. * Foundational knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, SSL/TLS) and core security concepts. * Basic Linux and command\-line skills, with some scripting in Python or Bash. * Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and an eagerness to learn. * Exposure to AWS, CI/CD tools, or certifications such as CompTIA Security\+ or AWS Cloud Practitioner is a plus. **Who We Are:** Since its inception in 2010, Bectran has pioneered cost\-effective credit management and accounts receivable automation solutions for all sizes of organizations. Our dedication to improving the efficiency of the order\-to\-cash cycle has helped companies cut down the time to process and approve credit by over 90% while significantly lowering the risk of default. jobs.title: Director, Embedded Engineering
jobs.description: Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single\-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT\-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development. Bevi is looking for a Director of Embedded Engineering to lead the team that builds the electronics and firmware at the heart of every Bevi machine. From the boards that drive our pumps, valves, sensors and chillers, to the firmware and embedded Linux/Android platform that keep thousands of connected machines running reliably in the field, this team makes the hardware come alive. You will own and manage the electrical and firmware engineers who design, bring up, and sustain our products, and you'll be the person who makes sure the boards, the code, and the system architecture fit together as one platform across our current fleet and our next generation of machines. This is a technical and people leadership role in equal measure. You'll set the embedded architecture and engineering standards, and you'll build and lead a team that needs both a strong technical leader and a strong people manager. This role reports to the VP of Engineering and sits on the engineering leadership team. It will operate in close partnership with Mechanical, Software, Systems, Quality, Manufacturing, and our contract manufacturing and design partners. As Bevi's product portfolio grows, there's room for this role to grow with it. ### **Your Day to Day** ### **Embedded Architecture \& Technical Direction** * Own the embedded system architecture across Bevi's products: the multi\-board electrical design, the single\-board computer and SoM platform, the microcontroller firmware, and the interfaces that tie them together. * Set the technical roadmap for embedded, including platform consolidation, next\-generation compute and control boards, and reuse across product lines so each new machine is not a clean\-sheet effort. * Make the hard tradeoff calls on reliability, cost, component availability, and speed of development, and bring a clear point of view to the engineering leadership team. * Stay hands\-on enough to review schematics, layouts, and firmware architecture, and to dig into a field failure with the team when it matters. ### **New Product Development \& Sustaining** * Lead EE and FW execution on new product programs from concept and prototype through board bring\-up, design verification, regulatory certification, and production release. * Own the health of embedded systems in the field: firmware releases, fleet diagnostics, remote management, and fast root\-cause analysis and corrective action when issues reach customers. * Drive component lifecycle management, second sourcing, and design changes that protect supply continuity and margin for products already in production. * Partner with Quality and Manufacturing on test strategy, end\-of\-line testing, and test fixtures so what we design can be built and verified at scale. ### **Team Leadership** * Manage and grow a team of Electrical Engineers and Firmware Engineers, giving each discipline what it needs to do great work while keeping both aligned to one platform. * Hire, coach, and develop engineers on technical depth and career growth, and build a team that can scale with Bevi's product roadmap. * Build clear ownership, documentation, and knowledge sharing so critical systems never depend on a single person. ### **Cross\-Functional \& Partner Leadership** * Work directly with Mechanical, Software, and Systems Engineering to define system requirements and protect design integrity from concept through production. * Manage external design partners, contract manufacturers (domestic and overseas), and component suppliers. Own design for manufacturability, NPI handoff, and production support for electronics at volume, including test coverage, yield, and corrective actions. * Represent embedded in program reviews, design reviews, and risk reviews, making sure embedded constraints shape decisions early rather than surfacing late. * Own embedded regulatory and compliance readiness (e.g., UL, FCC, CE/UKCA, EMC) in partnership with Compliance and Quality. ### **Process \& Engineering Excellence** * Establish and enforce standards for schematic and layout reviews, firmware code reviews, version control, release management, and documentation. * Build out hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, unit test frameworks, build automation, and CI/CD for firmware. * Champion the use of AI across the embedded team to accelerate design, code generation, testing, and debugging, and define how we integrate it responsibly into our workflows. ### **Requirements** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; MS is a plus. * 10\+ years of embedded hardware and firmware experience, with 5\+ years leading and growing teams that include both electrical and firmware engineers. * A track record of taking connected electromechanical products from prototype through production and sustaining them in the field at scale. * Experience taking electronics into high\-volume production with overseas contract manufacturers, including DFM/DFT, NPI transfer, PCBA yield and quality issues, and on\-site support at the CM. * Strong technical depth in board\-level electrical design (mixed\-signal, power, motor and actuator drive, sensor interfacing) and in embedded C/C\+\+ on ARM Cortex\-M microcontrollers, including bare\-metal and RTOS\-based systems. * Experience with embedded Linux or Android (AOSP) platforms on SBC or SoM\-based designs. * Hands\-on familiarity with communication interfaces and protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, USB, CAN, Ethernet, and wireless (WiFi, LTE, BLE). * Experience bringing products through regulatory certification (UL, FCC, CE/UKCA, EMC) and supporting international market entry. * Strong communicator who can hold their own with engineers in a design review and explain risk and tradeoffs clearly to executives. * Experience in food and beverage equipment, appliances, or other regulated consumer hardware is a plus. * Experience working in rapidly growing or scaling companies is a plus. * Ability to be in the office 3\+ days per week. \#LI\-CD1 \#LI\-HYBRID #### **Benefits:** * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer * 401(k) with company match * Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc * Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non\-birth parents * Fully employer paid disability and life insurances * Wellness and fitness reimbursements * Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs * Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra\-cycling, too * Happy hours, team\-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards \- and more. **A note on AI in our hiring process**: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note\-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in. Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community\-driven progress and the future of technology. *We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply!* *A member of the Bevi Talent team '**recruiting@bevi.co**' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.* #### **Accommodations:** Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

jobs.title: Data Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** Touch Lives. Improve Outcomes. BioTouch is a single\-source, international provider for all mission\-critical kitting and logistics needs. We partner with a wide range of medical facilities and healthcare providers to bring a higher level of care to healthcare delivery. Simply put, we are doing our part in the healthcare specialty logistics arena! **The Role:** We are seeking a Data Warehouse Engineer to join our IT department. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization's cloud data warehouse, with a focus on ingesting, transforming, and modeling data using Fivetran, dbt (data build tool), and Snowflake. The successful candidate will work closely with analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable, well\-documented, and high\-quality data pipelines that support reporting and decision\-making across the organization. This position will need to sit within the greater Columbus area, for our largest medical kitting sites.### **Job Responsibilities** **Your Impact:** Design, build, and maintain automated data ingestion pipelines using Fivetran to extract data from source systems into the Snowflake data warehouse. Develop, test, and maintain data transformation models using dbt, following modular and version\-controlled development practices. Administer and optimize the Snowflake environment, including performance tuning, warehouse sizing, and cost management. Write efficient, well\-documented SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Implement data quality checks, automated testing, and monitoring within dbt and the broader data pipeline. Maintain clear documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, and data lineage. Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues in a timely manner. Collaborate with business intelligence, analytics, and software engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data sets. Support data governance, security, and access\-control practices within the data warehouse environment. Participate in code reviews and contribute to the team's engineering standards and best practices.### **Required Skills and Qualifications** **What You Bring:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience. Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience writing and optimizing SQL queries. Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform. Experience with Fivetran or a similar ELT/data ingestion tool is required. Experience with dbt (data build tool) for data transformation and modeling is required. Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling, ELT/ETL design patterns, and data pipeline orchestration **What We Need:** Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform). Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD practices for data pipelines. Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt Cloud, or similar). Familiarity with data governance **What You’ll Get:** Medical, Dental, Vision after 30 days HSA and PPO plans available Company paid Life Insurance, AD\&D, and Long Term Disability 401(k) with generous company match after 90 days Supplemental Voluntary Benefits like Short Term Disability, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Employee Assistance Program $500 Referral Bonus Available!

jobs.title: Security Operations & Detection Engineer (SecOps) – AI Cloud
jobs.description: Bitdeer is a world\-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure. Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence. Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/ (https://ir.bitdeer.com/%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3E%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3E%3Cstrong%3EJob) ### **About the Role** We are seeking a hands\-on **Security Operations \& Detection Engineer** to join our AI Cloud Security team on the SecOps line. Based in Los Angeles, this role focuses on real\-time security alert monitoring, triage, incident response, and active detection engineering across AI Cloud's production estate—spanning GPU/AIDC infrastructure, our core cloud platform, and public\-facing services. This is a technical, hands\-on operations and engineering role (not a policy or management position) working regular US Pacific daytime hours, featuring tight collaboration with our global security team. ### **Responsibilities** * **Security Monitoring \& Response:** Perform on\-shift triage, containment, escalation, and post\-incident writeups for P1/P2 security incidents across our GPU/AIDC infrastructure, cloud platform, and public services. * **SLA Adherence:** Consistently meet team SLAs for critical incidents (P1 acknowledgment within $\\le$ 15 minutes, response start within $\\le$ 30 minutes). * **Detection Engineering:** Continuously tune and build alert rules within our self\-built SIEM, HIDS, and WAF telemetry to suppress false positives and keep paging high\-signal. * **Alert\-Triage Automation:** Contribute to building and refining agentic triage workflows to automate routine responses and reduce noise. * **Cross\-Site Collaboration:** Conduct daily written and live handoffs with our Singapore security team to ensure seamless global operations across shifts. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in a SOC, Incident Response (IR), or Detection Engineering role, with comfort acting as the primary on\-shift responder. * **Infrastructure Fundamentals:** Strong Linux and Kubernetes fundamentals; comfortable operating across cloud platforms and bare\-metal/GPU environments. * **Query \& Scripting:** Practical SIEM query experience (OpenSearch, Splunk DSL, or similar) and scripting skills in **Python** or **Go**. * **Host Detection \& Log Analysis:** Direct experience with host\-based detection tools (Falco, Wazuh, auditd), log analysis, and standard IR tooling. * **Schedule Flexibility:** Willingness and ability to participate in a weekend on\-call rotation. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves / Preferred Qualifications** * **Specialized Threat Experience:** Hands\-on incident response experience with crypto\-mining malware or supply\-chain security incidents. * **Runtime \& eBPF Security:** Exposure to eBPF\-based detection or runtime security tools (e.g., Tetragon, Falco internals). * **AI/GPU Infrastructure:** Familiarity with high\-performance computing environments (NVIDIA DGX/HGX, InfiniBand, or RoCE networking). * **Languages:** Professional fluency in Mandarin to facilitate day\-to\-day collaboration with our Singapore engineering site (English is required). * **Certifications:** Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, or CISSP are a plus. \- *Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.*

Using evidence\-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. **Our values:** * **People\-First**: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work. * **Collaboration and Transparency**: Valuing teamwork and open communication. * **Growth Mindset**: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement. * **Creating Lasting Impact**: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change. **About the role:** Bixal is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to build and maintain applications on a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. jobs.description: Bloomberg Media empowers global business leaders with breaking news, expert opinion and proprietary data distributed with global reach. With over 30 million unique visitors each month, our flagship website bloomberg.com is the go\-to destination for those looking to stay ahead of the curve. As one of the top 10 most visited financial and news sites on the web, we take pride in delivering top\-quality content that our audience can trust. The Media API Platform team builds and runs the API layer at the heart of Bloomberg Media's digital products. We empower Media engineers to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure APIs quickly. Our tools and standards make it easy to build, discover, and consume APIs across the org. Our internal GraphQL gateway serves backend services and is composed of more than a dozen subgraphs, spanning user and media domains in one schema. Our public GraphQL gateway serves client\-facing apps secured by pre\-approved queries. We also operate the shared building blocks all our APIs rely on: centralized authentication and authorization, rate limiting, token management and job management. We focus on reliability by building automated regression suites that run nightly and post\-deployment, daily test reports, and observability tooling—including AI\-assisted skills that track down latency regressions. jobs.description: Salary $18\.00 Hourly Location Main Campus (BG), OH Job Type Student Worker Job Number BGSU02042 Division President's Office Department Student Employment Opening Date 10/15/2026 Closing Date 10/20/2026 11:59 PM Eastern **Summary** ----------- Support an industry\-sponsored research project, funded by a Honda AI\+X Seed Grant, that develops an explainable, cost\-sensitive machine\-learning framework to predict equipment component failures within 24 hours and turn those predictions into practical maintenance recommendations. The Research Assistant will combine manufacturing and maintenance knowledge with data science skills to prepare equipment data, build and evaluate predictive models, and translate results into decisions that make sense on the plant floor. Work collaboratively with other project team members and the faculty supervisor. **Career Readiness Competencies** * Take initiative to learn new tools, systems, or procedures on the job. * Ask making a decision. * Build positive working relationships across campus departments. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Help define the project scope and the input\-output data schema for machine sensor readings (voltage, rotation, pressure, vibration), error logs, maintenance and component\-replacement records, and machine attributes. * Acquire candidate datasets (public or partner\-provided) and audit data quality, including duplicates, missing records, and timestamp alignment. * Build a reproducible Python pipeline to clean and merge the records, construct 24\-hour failure labels, and prevent temporal leakage. * Engineer tabular features (current readings, 3\-hour and 24\-hour trends, recent event counts, time since maintenance) and prepare sequence windows from the sensor data. * Implement a sensor\-threshold baseline, then train and compare a LightGBM model and a compact Temporal Convolutional Network (PyTorch) using chronological data splits. * Evaluate models using PR\-AUC, precision, recall, Brier score, and calibration plots, and apply sigmoid or isotonic probability calibration. * Develop maintenance cost ratios and inspection\-capacity assumptions, and implement the cost\-sensitive alert\-ranking policy. * Evaluate results at the event level (failure coverage, alert lead time, false alerts per machine\-month, daily inspection workload). * Generate model explanations using TreeSHAP and integrated gradients, and interpret them from a maintenance and reliability perspective. * Maintain clear, version\-controlled code and documentation (GitHub), contribute to the final technical report and presentation, and support the final project showcase. * Perform other related research duties as assigned within the scope of the position. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Currently enrolled BGSU student (undergraduate or graduate) in good academic standing. * Major in Industrial/Systems Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechanical Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * Working Python skills (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn) and coursework or project experience in data analysis or machine learning. * Basic understanding of manufacturing operations, equipment maintenance, or reliability concepts. * Strong written communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with appropriate supervision. **Additional Information** -------------------------- * Preferred Qualifications: + Coursework or experience in predictive or preventive maintenance, reliability engineering, quality control, or Lean Six Sigma. + Industry or internship experience in a manufacturing environment. + Experience with LightGBM or XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow, time\-series or sensor data, or model explainability (SHAP). + Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jupyter, and reproducible research practices. * Two openings. Total hours are capped at 120 hours for one student (manufacturing focus) and 100 hours for the other (computational focus). Work period: hire date through December 31, 2026, up to 20 hours per week, scheduled flexibly around the student’s classes. Work can be done in the lab or remotely, as arranged with the supervisor. Students are expected to attend and help present the project at the final showcase during the week of January 11, 2027\. Time is reported bi\-weekly. To apply, submit a resume and a brief statement (half a page at most) describing relevant coursework and experience. Unofficial transcripts are optional. Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures. Named a top workplace by the San Diego Union Tribune and USA today in 2025, we make life\-changing impacts through innovation, helping workers globally unlock their abilities in orchestration with intelligent machines. **Position Overview**: The Staff Software Engineer is a key technical leader within Brain Corp's Platform team, responsible for the architecture, evolution, and performance of core software systems powering our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). This includes ownership of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), telemetry systems, and core C\+\+ middleware.This role is highly hands\-on and strategic, driving the re\-architecture of foundational robotics software to improve modularity, scalability, and performance. leadership to engineers, guiding design reviews and complex debugging efforts * Contribute hands\-on code to critical components while balancing long\-term architectural improvements * Drive hardware abstraction layers (HAL) * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives or driving architectural changes in production systems **Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**: * Expert\-level proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 or later), including multithreading, memory management, and performance optimization * Strong Python skills for scripting, tooling, and system integration * Deep understanding of hardware abstraction layers and low\-level system design * Hands\-on experience integrating sensors such as LiDARs, cameras, and IMUs into production systems * Strong experience with Linux\-based development environments (e.g., Ubuntu) * Experience designing and developing middleware systems or inter\-process communication frameworks * Familiarity with communication protocols such as MQTT, or similar paradigms * Experience with build systems (e.g., CMake) and unit testing frameworks (e.g., Google Test) * Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable, and modular system architectures * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in complex robotics or embedded environments * Experience with system performance profiling and optimization (CPU, memory, latency, throughput) * Proficiency with version control systems such as Git * Excellent communication skills and ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship without direct management responsibility **Things that Make a Difference:** * Experience with Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) or similar robotic systems * Prior experience leading or contributing to large\-scale system re\-architecture or migration efforts * Experience designing or improving telemetry and observability systems * Familiarity with custom middleware architectures (non\-ROS environments) * Background in real\-time or near\-real\-time systems * Experience working at the intersection of hardware and software integration * Passion for robotics, automation, and building high\-performance, scalable systems **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Essential functions may require maintaining the physical condition necessary for sitting, walking or standing for periods of time; operating a computer and keyboard; use of hands to finger and grasp; talk and hear at normal room levels; visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures; push or pull up to 20 pounds. **Salary Range:** The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in San Diego, California is $187,182 to $233,978\. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes. We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide. Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real\-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem. This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams. Why This Role Matters You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level. We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams. You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation. You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software. This is a hands\-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization. What You’ll Do Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas * Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications. * Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture. * Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing across interconnected systems. * Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone. * Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production. Investigate Complex Problems * Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third\-party integrations. * Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes. * Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings. * Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents. * Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting. Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality * Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium. * Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate. * Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed. * Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level. * Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows. Influence Engineering and Product Decisions * Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early. * Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk. * Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions. * Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions. * Collaborate closely with Support and other customer\-facing teams when investigating reported issues. Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture * Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements. * Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics. * Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow. * Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less\-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills. * Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA. Who We’re Looking For Core Qualifications * 5\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role. * Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services. * Advanced exploratory testing and risk\-analysis skills. * Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals. * Hands\-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies. * Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases. * Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data\-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed. * Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client\-server architecture, and data flows between services. * Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring. * Experience working with defect tracking systems and test management practices. * Understanding of software security and privacy considerations, including authentication, authorization, data handling, access control, and common OWASP risks. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Experience with mapping, GPS/location systems, real\-time applications, or transportation technology is a strong plus. Technical Background Experience with some of the following technologies is useful, but expertise in every technology listed is not required. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems. * Web: React, TypeScript * APIs \& Backend: REST APIs, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase * Mobile: Android, Flutter * Automation: Playwright, Maestro, Appium * Observability \& Debugging: Datadog, Sentry, Google Cloud Platform, Proxyman * Data \& Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Platform * API tooling: Postman or similar tools * Security: OWASP, authentication/authorization concepts, privacy and data\-handling practices * Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, Agile software development practices * Mapping / Location: GPS, geospatial systems, mapping SDKs, routing, or other location\-based technologies What Makes Someone Successful in This Role* You naturally think in terms of risk, failure modes, and customer impact, not just expected behavior. * You are comfortable investigating problems across multiple layers of a system. * You can work independently when requirements are incomplete or the problem is poorly understood. * You know when deeper investigation is necessary and when additional testing provides diminishing returns. * You communicate quality concerns clearly without becoming a bottleneck for delivery. * You are comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for technical improvements. * You look for opportunities to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly testing around them. * You enjoy building tools and processes that make engineering teams more effective. * You balance attention to detail with pragmatic decision\-making.

jobs.description: Help run a global network where performance and resilience really matter.
