jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Storage
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role** The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe is seeking a **Senior Staff Software Engineer** to serve as a primary architect and visionary for our storage strategy. While a Staff Engineer leads features, a Senior Staff Engineer defines the multi\-year technical roadmap that underpins our AI\-scale infrastructure. You will be a multiplier, responsible for the architectural strategy, integrity and global scalability of our bespoke storage services. You will work at the physics of the stack, bridging the gap between high\-performance NVMe hardware and globally distributed, S3\-competitive object stores. **What You’ll Be Working On** * **Architectural Vision \& Strategy:** Define and drive the long\-term technical strategy for Crusoe’s storage engine. Identify industry trends (e.g., CXL, NVMe\-oF) and integrate them into a cohesive roadmap. * **System Programming Expertise:** Leverage proven experience in system programming with languages such as **C, C\+\+, Go, and/or Rust** to build the foundations of our V2 storage re\-architecture. * **Storage Protocols:** Architect and implement solutions utilizing industry\-standard storage protocols such as **NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe/TCP.** * **Open Source Stewardship:** Drive and maintain a track record of contributions to the open\-source community (e.g., **Ceph, GlusterFS, Lustre, Spectrum Scale, OpenEBS**). * **Technical Authority:** Serve as the final arbiter for critical architecture decisions across the Foundations organization. jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: Solutions · Full\-time · Singapore; New Delhi; Mumbai SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **About the role** We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production\-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped. We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world\-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course\-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day\-to\-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi. ### **What you’ll do** * **Sell** + Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de\-risk delivery before a line of code is written + Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time\-boxed deliverables with clear ROI + Sell the vision and the plan to C\-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it + Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six\- and seven\-figure engagements**Deliver** + Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest\-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C\-suite + Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions + Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions + Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest + Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time**Manage People** + Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects + Hire top\-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production + Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex + Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume ### **You may be a fit if** * You have 8\+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job * You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript * You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real\-world model failures * You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest\-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement * You've built and scaled IC\-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services
jobs.description: **Company Description** Opportunities arise. Competitors emerge. Demand shifts. Volumes change. Prices rise and fall. Meanwhile, the bottom line, governing the most important decisions a CEO will make, hangs in the balance, as stakeholders await word on earnings, growth, prospects, and stock price. That's where we come in! Campfire's unique, powerful, and cost\-effective solution has kindled a growing base of happy customers around the world by bringing future and current revenues and costs under a single roof, with advanced functionality to create, analyze, and modify plans, optimize portfolios, and manage long\-term profitability. Campfire's technology sparks unprecedented insight into a company's bottom line, unleashing the freedom to focus on the decisions that matter most. Join our visionary tech company and talented and passionate team as we continue to develop such valuable systems. **Job Description** We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Professional Services team, embedding directly with Campfire's enterprise and mid\-market customers to build, configure, and ship the technical solutions that get them live and successful on our platform. Reporting to \[Head of Professional Services], this is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role — you will spend as much time in a customer's data and systems as you do writing code, translating complex business requirements into working integrations and configurations under real deadlines. This is not a back\-office engineering role. You will be the technical face of Campfire in the room with customer engineering and IT teams, building solutions that hold up in production. The ideal candidate is comfortable with: * Writing production\-quality code directly in customer environments, often under tight timelines * Complex data integrations (ERP, CRM, data warehouses) * Ambiguous, evolving requirements that shift as you learn a customer's environment * Being the technical face of Campfire to customer engineering and IT teams * Balancing hands\-on building with clear technical communication to non\-technical stakeholders **Responsibilities:** Customer Implementation \& Integration * Build custom integrations, scripts, and configurations to connect Campfire with customer ERP, CRM, and other systems * Lead technical discovery with customer engineering and IT teams to scope integration requirements * Migrate and validate customer data into Campfire, ensuring accuracy and completeness * Debug and resolve technical issues that arise during implementation, in real time Solution Design \& Delivery * Translate ambiguous or evolving customer requirements into scoped, deliverable technical solutions * Partner with Technical Account Managers and Professional Services leads to define implementation plans and timelines * Build reusable tools, scripts, and accelerators that speed up future implementations * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-configure tradeoffs to hit customer go\-live dates Technical Customer Engagement * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers during implementation * Explain technical tradeoffs and solutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Build trust with customer engineering and IT teams through responsiveness and technical credibility * Represent the customer's technical environment and constraints back to Campfire's Product and Engineering teams Internal Collaboration \& Product Feedback * Act as a bridge between the field and Campfire's core Engineering and Product teams * Surface recurring integration patterns, product gaps, and technical debt to inform the roadmap * Contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and reusable implementation frameworks * Support Sales and Solution Consulting with technical scoping during the pre\-sale process, as needed **What Success Looks Like** * Customers go live on time, with integrations that work reliably in production * Customer engineering and IT teams view you as a trusted, credible technical partner * Implementation patterns and tools you build get reused across future customer engagements * Product and Engineering gain clear, actionable feedback from real customer environments * Professional Services engagements are technically sound and set customers up for long\-term success **Qualifications** **Nice\-to\-Have / Preferred Experience** * Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Engineer role * Experience with ERP or CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Salesforce) * Experience working directly with enterprise customers under live deadlines * Background in manufacturing, automotive, or supply chain software * Comfort working independently, on\-site or remote, embedded with customer teams **Technical Skills** * Strong proficiency in \[language(s) — e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL] * Experience with API\-based integrations and data pipelines * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in unfamiliar codebases and environments **Educational Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience considered **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Integrate IBM i applications with other systems through web services, JSON and XML, FTP, and the Integrated File System (IFS). * Support changes through testing, deployment, and post\-deployment, and resolve technical issues directly with client teams. * * Set coding and testing standards for IBM i work, and identify where modernizing an application pays off. * Own the technical outcome for a system area or major feature set: propose the approach, define the task breakdown, and deliver with minimal escalation. * Design APIs and data models that account for cost, scale, and failure, and build in observability (logging, tracing, and metrics) from the start. * Work with Cloud Engineers on infrastructure as code and CI/CD so what you build deploys the same way every time. * Partner with the Solutions Architect on solution design and with the Engagement Manager on delivery, and turn designs into a build plan the team can execute. * Set code\-quality standards for your area, and mentor Software Engineers I and II through pairing and reviews that teach, including how to direct AI tooling and check what it produces. * Join architecture presentations and technical deep\-dives alongside the Solutions Architect when the client needs your depth. **How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:** You own outcomes on complex work, exercise architectural judgment, and raise the bar for those around you. * **Agentic tooling.** Set the tooling approach for a codebase or engagement: which work goes to a conversion engine, which is spec\-driven build, where the human\-in\-the\-loop gates belong, and how the toolchain is wired for the problem at hand. * **Spec validation and readiness.** Own the quality of the handoff from specification to build. Make sure specs are executable and actually satisfy the requirements, and hold delivered work to a defined readiness bar. When generated code is wrong, fix the spec, not just the output. * **Validating AI output.** Be the final judgment on correctness for high\-risk changes, including in unfamiliar domains, by designing the evidence that proves behavior is preserved. * **Delivery\-system ownership.** Design and maintain the project\-specific setup of our delivery tooling (steering, agent roles, templates, quality gates, and metrics) as durable capability, not one\-off scaffolding. **Judgment over correctness:** you can tell when confident, plausible\-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * A strong grasp of architecture concepts: event\-driven and service\-based design, API design, data modeling, separation of concerns, and designing for change. * Experience owning a significant system from design through production, and mentoring the engineers who built it with you. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or agentic development workflows, where specs drive code generation, for example Kiro, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or Cursor with rules. Using AI only for autocomplete or snippets doesn't count. * A track record of catching what AI\-generated or refactored code gets quietly wrong, and of building the tests and gates that prove behavior is preserved. * Hands\-on experience programming on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries): free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, CL, and OS/400 commands. * Strong SQL skills on DB2 for i, plus working knowledge of DDS, subfiles, and older RPG (RPG III and fixed format). * Experience with IBM i Access Client Solutions or iSeries Navigator, the IFS, and JSON and XML. \| * Experience with Blue Yonder (JDA) MMS. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with AWS or application modernization, such as integrating IBM i applications with AWS services or moving IBM i workloads to modern platforms. * Experience with Java, including Java on IBM i or RPG\-to\-Java modernization. * Experience supporting IBM i in an enterprise data center. * Background in retail. **Our Culture:** Four keystones guide how we work: * **Customer obsessed, delivery focused.** We deliver what we promise. Trust \= consistency × time. * **Learning and sharing.** We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing. * **Growth and scalability.** We value cross\-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones. * **All work is strategic.** Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts. **We offer:** Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you. **No Agencies Please!**

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Perception and Controls
jobs.description: **Workplace Type:** Hybrid — Onsite 3–4 days per week across Santa Cruz and West Menlo Park, CA, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz **Reports To:** Robotics \& Controls Manager **About Capstan Medical** ------------------------- At Capstan Medical, we're building one of the most exciting and innovative companies in medtech: a first\-of\-its\-kind robotic platform for minimally invasive heart valve treatment. Our team combines surgical robotics, catheter\-based delivery, and next\-generation implants to turn complex procedures into safer, lower\-stress solutions for patients and clinicians. We're a collaborative, hands\-on team that moves fast, wears multiple hats, and believes the best ideas can come from anyone. Based in Santa Cruz, our workspace blends Bay Area innovation with a lifestyle near trails, beaches, and open space—a great place to do meaningful, career\-defining work. ### **About the Role** **Teach a heart valve robot to see where it is.** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our robotics and controls team. You'll help our robot understand where its devices are inside the patient, using intraprocedural imaging such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography. That means building perception for image\-to\-robot registration and pose estimation, and taking it from research into a clinical system. This is not a model\-in\-a\-notebook role. Your work runs on a real\-time robotic system, informs what physicians see during the procedure, and ships under FDA design controls. You'll also help shape how we collect, organize, and learn from our robot and imaging data, and use it to improve our device models and controllers. You'll have a large say in how ML is done here, from the tools and standards we adopt to which problems we tackle first, and you'll be the person the rest of the team turns to for ML judgment. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop methods to register intraprocedural imaging, such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography, to the robot. * Estimate the pose of catheters and implants from medical images. * Combine image\-based estimates with robot kinematics and other sensing, and quantify the uncertainty of each estimate. * Build data pipelines that capture, align, label, and version imaging and robot data for training and evaluation. * Use simulation and synthetic data where real clinical data is limited. * Fit and improve models of device behavior from data, and work with controls engineers to turn them into better control. * Work with clinical engineers and physicians to learn what the images show, what matters in the procedure, and what accuracy is good enough. * Read the literature, prototype what looks promising, and tell us plainly what works on our data and what doesn't. * Deploy models on the robot and meet real\-time latency budgets. * Write the validation, test datasets, and design documentation that let learned components pass FDA design controls. ### **Skills** * **Real\-World Machine Learning:** You've taken models out of notebooks and into products that run on real data, with all its noise, drift, and edge cases. * **Computer Vision:** Strong background in classical and learned computer vision, especially pose estimation, segmentation, tracking, or 2D/3D registration. * **3D Geometry:** Solid grasp of rigid transforms, rotations, camera projection models, and calibration. * **Programming:** Strong Python and PyTorch skills. Comfortable reading and writing C\+\+. * **Data Engineering:** You build pipelines, datasets, and evaluation harnesses that others can trust and reuse. * **Research and Prototyping:** You keep up with recent papers, can tell which ideas will survive contact with our data, and enjoy turning them into working prototypes. * **Problem\-Solving:** Comfortable with high ambiguity. You can take a fuzzy goal, break it into experiments, and pick a direction without a spec. * **Communication:** Excellent communicator who can explain ML clearly to controls engineers, clinical engineers, and physicians, document work effectively, and help the team decide when a model is good enough to trust. ### **Requirements** * MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. PhD is a plus. * 4\+ years of professional experience in computer vision or machine learning, classical or learned, including at least one system shipped to production on real\-world data. * Experience working with scarce, noisy, or expensive data, using synthetic data, augmentation, self\-supervision, or physics priors to make up for it. * Experience building ML on data from physical systems such as robots, cameras, medical imaging, or sensors. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and own problems end\-to\-end. * Ability to work onsite 3–4 days per week, split flexibly between our Santa Cruz, CA and West Menlo Park, CA offices, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Ultrasound or echocardiography experience, strongly preferred. Fluoroscopy or X\-ray experience is also valuable, including 2D/3D registration or digitally reconstructed radiographs. * Experience tracking catheters, needles, surgical tools, or continuum robots in images. * Sensor fusion and state estimation, such as Kalman filters or factor graphs. * System identification or learned dynamics for control, including residual models on top of physics. * Robotics software experience with ROS/ROS2 and on\-device inference under latency constraints (ONNX, TensorRT). * Data platform and MLOps experience, including practices like dataset versioning and experiment tracking. * Medical device or safety\-critical background, including validating ML under FDA design controls. * Experience as an early ML engineer on a team, setting up the tools, data practices, and evaluation that others build on. * Publications at venues such as MICCAI, IPCAI, CVPR, ICRA, or IROS. ### **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. Bring your bike or running shoes if you’d like or just be ready to enjoy a fun office outing. We enjoy time inside the office and out! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Development Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **ABOUT US** Cerapedics is a global, commercial\-stage orthopedics company that is dedicated to redefining the path to bone repair by healing bones faster and at higher rates, so all patients can get back to living their fullest lives. jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: ***Ensuring Chart’s Success…*** ------------------------------- “Cooler By Design” – Chart’s core business is centered around the design and fabrication of cryogenic equipment; so you can see where we get our tagline from, right? Well, yes and no – see, we think the products we design and build are pretty cool too. Also, we’re problem solvers. Customers don’t come to Chart with an equipment specification, they come to Chart with a challenge. That’s where you come in, because someone has to figure it out – all the way from conceptual design to installation and commissioning of equipment on\-site. Chart’s mission is to provide full solutions across the Nexus of Clean™ – clean power, clean water, clean food, and clean industrials. The diverse applications we service echo our commitment to sustainability – from providing full hydrogen solutions across the value chain, offering small and industrial scale carbon capture solutions to customers globally, creating water treatment systems responsible for treating 4\.5 billion gallons of water per day in the U.S. and delivering clean water to over a billion people worldwide, providing equipment and solutions for mission critical space launches, decarbonizing the marine industry, and electrifying the mining space. Chart even contributes to the food and beverage industry by making some of your favorite carbonated beverages possible – If nitro coffee or nitro ice cream is your thing – well, that’s Chart technology too (and it’s also cool)! We are looking to add a **Process Engineer** to our team in **Orem, UT**. We would consider candidates who are able to work out of our office across the US, including Allentown, PA, Lacrosse, WI, Orem, UT or The Woodlands, TX. The Process Engineer begins to take direct engineering responsibility for the conceptual design of Chart process technologies to meet customer requirements. This person must work well within a small team environment while preparing process information deliverables for the basic engineering design package. This position requires someone who is comfortable operating autonomously with open\-ended tasks. You will have the opportunity to interact with every part of the technology development from design of new and novel equipment and experiments to detailed large\-scale equipment design, sourcing, and operation. It is intellectually engaging work on complex, unique, and novel problems. ***What Will You Do?*** ----------------------- * Support process development for the innovative Cryogenic Carbon Capture™ technology through Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, and Aspen EDR * Simulate steady\-state and transient/dynamic processes to describe performance and generate heat and material balances * Work with clients and other engineers to develop feasibility, preFEED, and FEED studies to design Cryogenic Carbon Capture plants * Prepare process equipment data sheets and equipment lists * Prepare Process Flow Diagrams * Assist in the development of Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams * Assist in the development of wiring and loop drawings and control system architectural drawings for internal research and development work * Provide process data to mechanical engineering counterparts and key vendors for equipment sourcing * Check process engineering work performed by other Process and Process I Engineers * Assist in the preparation of Start\-up and Operating Manuals * Participate in experimental work and prototype operation * Some travel – 10% or less * Develop and implement industrial\-grade process control, including model predictive controls and human\-machine interfaces, for highly integrated prototype and commercial processes (optional, but preferred) ***Your Physical Work Environment Will Require…*** -------------------------------------------------- The ability to frequently sit for extended periods of time, stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. This position is occasionally required to sit, climb, balance, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Lifting of 50 pounds may be required. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Duties include lengthy visual requirements on computer monitors. ***Your Experience Should Be...*** ---------------------------------- * Working knowledge of ASPEN Plus/HYSYS and/or similar process simulation software, including dynamics simulation * Knowledge of chemical engineering first principles, especially thermodynamics and heat/mass transfer and ability to apply those principles to real\-world systems * Proven teamwork skills * Sound organizational skills for completing tasks as scheduled * Strong communication skills both verbal and written for the purpose of explaining challenges and solutions internally, and presenting externally * Good interpersonal skills to successfully interface other engineering disciplines and customers **We prefer candidates that also have the following:** * 2 to 5 years of process engineering experience (or educational equivalent) * Computer programming expertise in one or several of C\+\+, C\#, Java/JavaScript, or Python * Knowledge of cryogenic process technologies which can include cryogenic air separation, natural gas liquefaction, hydrogen liquefaction, helium processing and liquefaction, etc. * Knowledgeable in natural gas processing technologies * Some experience and interest in control system and human machine interface software * Understands basic applicable engineering/electrical/safety codes ***Our Benefits Package...*** ----------------------------- * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Employer contributions to an HSA account * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * Basic life insurance with the option to purchase supplemental individual, spouse and dependent child coverage * Up to two weeks of paid family leave 401k retirement savings plan including a company match * ***Competencies*** ------------------ Supporting Organizational Goals Driving Projects to Completion Acting Decisively Championing Customer Needs Thinking Globally Managing Resources Learning Quickly Critical Thinking Acting with Integrity Displaying Technical Expertise Driving Continuous Improvement Evaluating and Implementing Ideas Driving for Results

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Startups & Partnerships
jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- **About Citi:** Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **The Team:** ============= The **Startups \& Partnerships team** is the forward scout of the Citi's Head of AI Organization. Our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define Citi's next chapter with Artificial Intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. We don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. We move across every line of business at Citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe\-to\-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier AI labs in the market. We run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us. **The Opportunity:** ==================== As an **AI Engineer** on the Startups \& Partnerships team, you will be at the **tip of the spear** for Citi's AI strategy \- building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines. You'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a Tier\-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands\-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading AI labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. If you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts AI \- this is the seat. **What You'll Do Day to Day** ============================= * **Build and ship AI applications** \- architect, develop, and deploy production\-grade AI\-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across Citi's lines of business. * **Evaluate emerging AI technology** \- run structured proof\-of\-concepts and sandbox "bake\-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (LLMs, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real\-world fit. * **Prototype at speed** \- turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback. * **Integrate across the stack** \- connect LLMs and agentic systems to enterprise APIs, data pipelines, and lightweight front\-end or tooling layers to deliver end\-to\-end working solutions. * **Deliver PoCs into production pathways** \- work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment. * **Communicate impact** \- translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders. **Required Skills** =================== * A **full\-stack engineer with applied AI/LLM experience** \- this is explicitly **not** a data science or ML research role. We need builders, not modelers. * Proven experience **building and shipping AI application ot just notebooks and academic experiments. * Hands\-on proficiency with **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, prompt engineering, and **agentic frameworks and orchestration tools** (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar). * Strong software engineering fundamentals \- comfortable working across the stack, from backend services and API integrations to lightweight front\-end or internal tooling layers. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills \- you can work directly with business leaders and clients, not just other engineers. * A track record of learning and adopting new tools and platforms quickly as the AI landscape evolves. * Comfort operating in a large, regulated, global institution while bringing a startup\-speed mentality to your work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills** ========================= * Experience working directly with startups, venture teams, or technology scouting functions. * Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or knowledge graph\-based retrieval. * Experience with containerization and cloud\-native deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) for AI services. * Prior exposure to financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience presenting technical concepts to non\-technical, senior business audiences. **Education** ============= * Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience * Master’s degree preferred This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: We're looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** to build and scale the infrastructure that powers our AI\-driven warehouse intelligence platform. You'll own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of ML vision models — from training pipelines through optimized cloud deployment — ensuring our cutting\-edge computer vision and multi\-modal AI systems run reliably and efficiently in production. Your work will directly enable the real\-time perception and autonomous decision\-making capabilities at the core of our platform. This is a deeply technical role at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision and distributed systems. You'll design scalable GPU compute clusters, build robust orchestration pipelines, and optimize model serving for low\-latency inference at scale. You'll work closely with our research scientists, computer vision engineers, and product teams to bridge the gap between experimental models and production\-ready systems that operate across diverse warehouse environments. We've found tremendous value in collaborative problem\-solving, thus our team works from our SF office three days a week. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build end\-to\-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and preprocessing through model training, evaluation, and deployment — and integrate them into core product workflows. * Train, evaluate, deploy and optimize state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models in the cloud using platforms and inference optimization techniques, including VLMs and VLAs. * Establish monitoring, benchmarking, and evaluation frameworks to ensure model performance and reliability in production environments. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * B.S. / M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, or similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * 3\+ years in machine learning— developing, scaling, deploying, and optimizing large\-scale ML systems from data to model. * Track record of deploying machine learning models in production environments. * Experience with training and/or deployment of ML models in the computer vision domain. * Strong programming skills in Python. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Experience using orchestration systems (Flyte, Temporal, Airflow, or similar) for ML and data pipelines. * Proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, DeepSpeed, Ray) and model serving platforms (TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar). * Deep understanding of state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models such as auto\-regressive transformers and familiarity with inference optimization techniques (TensorRT, quantization, custom kernels). * Experience with C\+\+ or CUDA programming for GPU acceleration. * Comfortable with distributed messaging and compute systems (Kafka, gRPC, ROS2, or similar). * Prior experience working at autonomous vehicles or robotics companies. **Equal Opportunity Statement** We’re an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. All of them are defensible. They come from different systems, different assumptions about what is committed versus spent, and different ideas about how far along the work really is. The semantic layer is where that gets settled. It is the set of governed definitions that say what a Clayco number means; built once, tested, documented, and used by every report, dashboard, and AI agent downstream. A metric here is not a query someone wrote. It is a decision about meaning that somebody owns. You will build that layer. The work is SQL and modeling discipline, done carefully, on data that matters to people who will notice if you get it wrong. **The Specifics of the Role** * Build semantic models on our Snowflake platform, with tests and documentation as part of finished work rather than cleanup afterward * Translate business logic from finance, operations, and project controls into models that hold up when someone audits them * Move legacy reporting logic onto governed models and help retire what it replaces * Keep models working as source systems change, so a field change upstream does not quietly break a number people trust * Answer the definitional questions that come back from the business, and write down the answers **Requirements** * **Real SQL.** Window functions, complex joins, and the judgment to know when a query is correct rather than merely returning rows. * **You care whether a number is right.** Enough to chase down a variance of a few hundred dollars because it means something is wrong with the logic, not because anyone asked you to. * **You ask until you understand.** The willingness to tell a finance director you do not follow the calculation yet, and keep asking until you do. * **You can be the person in the middle.** Telling two groups their reports disagree, explaining why, and helping them land on one answer. * We will hire someone early in their career for this if the fundamentals and the curiosity are there — you would have senior engineers around you to learn from. Dimensional modeling experience, dbt, or construction background are all welcome, none are required. **Some Things You Should Know** * Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing. **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Network Infrastructure
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer on the Network Infrastructure team to own the networking backbone of our multi\-cloud, application, and corporate infrastructure that every other engineering team at Commure relies on. This is a horizontal team supporting multi\-product infrastructure, and the network layer is yours to design, build, and operate end\-to\-end: * Multi\-cloud network foundation and IaC * Hybrid and on\-prem connectivity * Kubernetes and service networking * Edge, load balancing, and DNS * Network security and zero\-trust access * Network observability * Network automation using GitOps The stack today runs on public cloud (GCP, AWS, and Azure), with all infrastructure defined as code (Terraform and controller\-based). Argo CD drives deployment; Helm handles application packaging; Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry power observability. Networking is an active build\-out toward cloud\-native patterns (Kubernetes\-native networking, eBPF, Gateway API, service mesh), and the shape of it is yours to define. This is a hands\-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and set the patterns other teams build on. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You'll own several of these verticals within the team's scope end\-to\-end. * Own the multi\-cloud network foundation: VPC design, routing, transit hubs, IPAM and IPv6, and multi\-region failover across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Managed as code with Terraform and Crossplane * Build hybrid and on\-prem connectivity: IPsec VPN, BGP, Cloud Interconnect / Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, and traffic engineering for data centers, regional hubs, and remote offices * Design the Kubernetes networking layer: CNI (Cilium, eBPF), ingress via Gateway API and Envoy, Istio (or equivalent) service mesh, and mTLS * Run the edge: load balancing, DNS, WAF, DDoS mitigation, and rate limiting * Secure the network by default: firewalls, segmentation, zero\-trust access, and encryption in transit. Partner with Security on policy\-as\-code that meets HIPAA and SOC 2 * Own network observability: flow logs, packet capture, and eBPF visibility (Hubble), wired into OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana * Treat the network as code: GitOps with Argo CD, pre\-merge validation, and self\-serve modules for product teams * Debug the hard problems: TCP/UDP, NAT, connection tracking, asymmetric routing, MTU, and kernel networking **What You Have** ----------------- * 6\+ years of experience in cloud native networking or infrastructure engineering * Deep expertise in network fundamentals: TCP/UDP/ICMP, BGP, IPsec, NAT, stateful firewalls, VLANs, bridges, TUN/TAP, and connection tracking * Experience with public cloud networking (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Experience with Kubernetes and cloud\-native networking (CNI, eBPF, Gateway API, Envoy, Istio) * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) * Experience designing and operating VPN and site\-to\-site connectivity at scale * Experience with BGP route filtering, multi\-path routing, and traffic engineering * Experience with network security: firewalls, WAF, DDoS mitigation, segmentation, and zero\-trust * Experience with network observability and performance troubleshooting (flow logs, packet analysis, latency, packet loss) **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with Cloud Interconnect (Dedicated Interconnect, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute) * Experience with kernel network tuning and BGP route optimization * Experience running DNS infrastructure at scale * Experience with on\-prem or hybrid environments and data center networking * Contributions to CNCF networking projects (Cilium, Envoy, Istio) * Experience with network automation and testing (GitOps, Batfish, containerlab) * Experience in regulated industries with HIPAA, SOC 2, or PCI obligations You don't need to check every box: strong network fundamentals, cloud native or Kubernetes background matter most. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI\-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next\-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on\-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross\-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently. The **CTIO** team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends. **What You’ll Do:** * Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives. * Conceptualize and develop new product features. * Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross\-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux). * Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint. * Engage in cross\-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations. **What You’ll Need:** * Deep knowledge of C/C\+\+; Swift experience required for macOS\-focused candidates; Windows OS Kernel and Driver Development experience required for Windows\-focused candidates. * Hands\-on experience operationalizing machine learning models on the endpoint, including building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on\-device inference. * Extensive, fundamental understanding of internals for your primary platform (macOS, Linux, or Windows) * Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks. * Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases. * Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team. **Bonus Points:** * Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light\-weight, and highly performing systems * In\-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems * Familiarity and experience utilizing Agile methodologies * Knowledge of security principles Experience with eBPF * \#LI\-DR1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
