jobs.description: **About Curium** Curium is the world’s largest nuclear medicine company with more than a century of industry experience. We develop, manufacture and distribute world\-class radiopharmaceutical products to help patients around the globe. Our proven heritage combined with a pioneering approach are the hallmarks to deliver innovation, excellence and unparalleled service. With manufacturing facilities across Europe and the United States, Curium delivers SPECT, PET and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical solutions for life\-threatening diseases to over 14 million patients annually. The name ‘Curium’ honors the legacy of pioneering radioactive researchers Marie and Pierre Curie, after whom the radioactive element curium was named and emphasizes our focus on nuclear medicine. The tagline ‘Life Forward’ represents our commitment to securing a brighter future for all those we serve: An enhanced quality of care for our patients. A trusted partner to our customers. A supportive employer to our valued team. **Summary of Position** ----------------------- We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data platforms, and analytical data products. The Data Engineer will collaborate with data architects, data scientists, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted data for analytics, reporting, machine learning, and operational use cases. The ideal candidate has strong experience with modern cloud data platforms, data integration, data modeling, distributed processing, data quality, and governance. Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar cloud platforms is highly desirable. **Work Schedule:** M \- F 8am \- 5pm. This is a hybrid position: 4 days onsite, 1 day remote. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Data Engineering \& Platform Development: + Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines. + Build reliable ETL/ELT processes for structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. + Integrate data from databases, APIs, SaaS applications, files, and event streams. + Develop and maintain cloud\-based data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse solutions. + Work with technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Spark, SQL, and cloud storage. + Implement reusable data engineering frameworks, patterns, and standards. + Support data platform modernization and migration initiatives. * Data Modeling \& Data Products: + Design logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases. + Develop dimensional, normalized, and lakehouse data models. + Build curated data layers supporting reporting, analytics, and machine learning. + Support domain\-oriented data products within a data mesh operating model. * Data Quality, Governance \& Security: + Implement data validation, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting. + Support data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, and data ownership. + Implement appropriate security, access controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements. + Establish monitoring and operational processes for production data pipelines. * Performance \& Cost Optimization: + Optimize data pipelines, queries, storage, and compute workloads. + Apply appropriate partitioning, clustering, caching, and workload\-management techniques. + Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, scalability, reliability, and total cost of ownership. * Collaboration \& Delivery: + Partner with architects, data scientists, analytics engineers, BI developers, application developers, and business stakeholders. + Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. + Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and Agile delivery. + Create technical documentation and operational runbooks. + Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices. + Must maintain operational compliance with US and international regulatory agencies and guidelines (i.e. FDA, DEA, EU, HC, TGA, PIC/S, ISO, USP, NRC, cGMP, etc.). **Requirements** ---------------- * Must have Experience / Skills: + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. + 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience. + Strong SQL and database development skills. + Experience developing production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines. + Proficiency in Python, Scala, Java, or similar programming language. + Experience with cloud data platforms and cloud storage. + Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehouses, data lakes, and/or lakehouses. + Experience with Git, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices. * Nice to have Experience / Skills: + Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric. + Experience with Apache Spark / PySpark and distributed data processing. + Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. + Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis. + Experience with orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or similar. + Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or other open table formats. + Experience implementing data mesh, domain\-oriented data products, or federated data architectures. + Experience with data catalog, lineage, governance, and observability platforms. + Experience supporting AI/ML data workloads. + Industry certifications or training in data engineering, cloud platforms, master data management, analytics, or project management. + Experience with pharmaceutical regulatory guidelines, including electronic records and signatures, data integrity, cGMP, FDA 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, and 211, EU Annex 11, MHRA, and GAMP 5\. + Additional languages a Plus **Working Conditions:** * This position will work in typical office conditions with extensive time using computer equipment. * Close attention to detail required. * Willingness to work in a team\-based environment. * May be required to sit or stand for long periods of 8\+ hours a day while performing duties. * Must possess good hand\-eye coordination; close attention to detail is required. * Willingness to complete safety training within allotted timeframes, and work in a team\-based environment. * The position deals with many deadlines. Must be able to work outside of regular work hours, including off shift, weekend, and holiday work as business needs require. **Disclaimer** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Curium is an equal opportunity employer and believes everyone deserves respect, dignity and equality. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title** Principal Machine Learning Engineer **Job Description Summary** We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for our business. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science \& AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. They will mentor other engineers at every level, push standards for technical excellence, and help establish the ML engineering, and architectural principles that guide our work. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves. **Job Description** **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a Principal ML Engineer to build and maintain artificial intelligence and machine learning systems for ourbusiness. This role combines deep technical execution with broad influence: tackling the most complex machine learning problems, designing and implementing data architectures/models, MLOps and LLMOps, and monitoring and optimization as key software, while raising the bar for engineering excellence across the Data Organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Science \& AI, the Principal ML Engineer is expected to move fluidly across project/product teams — embedding in projects for days or months at a time to unblock, accelerate, and uplift delivery. They will mentor other engineers at every level, push standards for technical excellence, and help establish the ML engineering, and architectural principles that guide our work. The primary platform is Databricks and the Azure cloud ecosystem, with the expectation of evaluating and adopting additional data technologies as the platform evolves. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **AI/ML Model Development** * Demonstrable experience shaping the end\-to\-end architecture, development, and deployment of AI, including machine learning, GenAI, and Agentic models that are tailored to business use cases. * Design and develop agentic AI systems — including multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-use, evaluation, and autonomous task\-execution pipelines — to automate complex enterprise workflows. * Enforce model development standards encompassing data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and documentation. * Partner with data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and high\-quality data pipelines that support model training and inference. **AI Operations (MLOps / LLMOps)** * Implement the organization's MLOps and LLMOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines for data wrangling, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. * Help define and enforce standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and model registry management. * Implement robust model monitoring frameworks to detect performance degradation, data drift, concept drift, and bias in production systems, with automated alerting and retraining triggers. **AI Governance** * Implement AI governance frameworks, including policies for model risk management, fairness, explainability, privacy, and security. * Champion sound AI principles across the global business, ensuring that human oversight and accountability are embedded in every stage of the AI development lifecycle. **Essential Skills, Knowledge \& Experience** --------------------------------------------- * **10\+ years** building software or machine learning systems, including **6\+ years** shipping and operating machine learning in production — served, monitored, and maintained after launch. * Prior experience as the senior\-most or near\-senior\-most engineer on a production ML or data platform, with responsibility for architectural decisions others had to live with. * A track record of setting technical standards that outlasted your own involvement, and of leading through influence without formal authority. * Strong hands\-on **Python** and **SQL**, and the software engineering fundamentals that keep ML systems maintainable at scale — version control, automated testing, code review, modular design — plus the discipline to enforce them across teams. * Expert hands\-on proficiency with **Databricks** (Spark, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Delta Lake, Lakebase/Postgres, Unity Catalog, Model Serving) and the Azure data ecosystem. *Deep experience on a comparable lakehouse platform will be considered, with the expectation of becoming effective on Databricks quickly.* * Experience with **MLflow** or an equivalent for experiment tracking, model registry, tracing, and reproducibility. * **At least one year building agentic systems that reached production use, or equivalent demonstrated work.** You should be able to walk us through a system you built: how it was orchestrated, how you evaluated it, what guardrails you put around it, how it failed, and what standard you set for whoever built the next one. * Proven ability to mentor engineers at every level and materially raise the technical standard of the teams you work with. * Familiarity with modern machine learning frameworks and a strong instinct for reusable, scalable engineering patterns. **Preferred Skills, Knowledge \& Experience** --------------------------------------------- * Experience establishing an ML or AI platform capability in an organisation that did not previously have one. * Experience embedding across multiple teams, geographies and time zones as a principal\-level technical contributor. * Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling for data pipelines using Azure DevOps, Databricks Declarative Automation Bundles (DABs), GitHub Actions, Terraform, or equivalent. * Good understanding of data governance, metadata management, and cataloguing in enterprise environments. * Exposure to model serving and inference at scale — containers, REST endpoints, latency and throughput targets — or to feature stores, retrieval pipelines, or LLM cost\-attribution tooling. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool\-integration standards. * Commercial real estate, professional services, or another domain where the data is messy, entities are inconsistently defined, and subject matter experts are the source of truth. Cushman \& Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements. The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications. The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role. The compensation for the position is: $ 178,500\.00 \- $210,000\.00 Cushman \& Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman \& Wakefield, please call the ADA line at **1\-888\-365\-5406** or email Accommodations@cushwake.com. Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us. INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”

jobs.title: IT Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Description: **Why work for Custom Alarm?** Bring structure, reliability, and forward thinking together at the heart of our technology operations. As **IT Systems Administrator**, you’ll play a critical role in keeping our systems, tools, and processes running smoothly, supporting the teams who rely on them every day. We’re looking for a detail\-oriented, service\-driven professional who enjoys problem\-solving and takes pride in keeping systems running smoothly. We offer a supportive, inclusive workplace where continuous improvement guides how we work. If you enjoy organized environments, supporting others through technology, and contributing to operational success, we’d love to hear from you. **A Day in the Life at Custom Alarm** The IT Systems Administrator keeps Custom Alarm’s technology reliable, secure, documented, cost\-effective, and aligned with business needs. This hands\-on role supports users, manages vendors and Microsoft 365, leads the SharePoint transition, and maintains business applications and integrations. The position models Custom Alarm’s Vision, Purpose, and Core Values through all interactions. **Reports to:** Vice President of Support Services **Hours:** 7:00am – 5:00pm (can fluctuate as a salary position) **Location:** Rochester, Minnesota (on\-site position) **Company Size:** 70 employees **Pay:** $72,000 \- $85,000 per year (starting wage is determined based on a number of considerations including education, certifications, related experience, etc.) **The Main Responsibilities** ***Technology Infrastructure \& User Support*** * Maintain and support company technology, including computers, networks, phones, printers, and communication systems. * Coordinate hardware and software installation, upgrades, maintenance, and troubleshooting with vendors. * Manage employee technology onboarding and offboarding, including equipment, licenses, and account access. ***Microsoft 365 \& SharePoint*** * Administer Microsoft 365 applications, security, permissions, and licensing. * Lead and oversee SharePoint strategy, administration, governance, content management, and continuous improvement. * Develop user training and resources for Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint. ***Business Systems \& Reporting*** * Support business systems, integrations, data transfers, and software implementations. * Maintain reporting tools and SQL\-based reports to improve operational visibility. * Manage technology budgets, vendor relationships, licenses, and hardware lifecycle planning. * Document systems, processes, and technology roadmaps to support efficiency and scalability. ***AI \& Automation*** * Administer approved AI and automation tools while ensuring secure and compliant use. * Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through AI and process automation. * Monitor and mitigate risks related to privacy, security, and data governance. ***Cybersecurity \& Vendor Management*** * Coordinate cybersecurity awareness training, phishing simulations, and compliance tracking. * Serve as the primary contact for managed IT providers and technology vendors. * Promote security best practices and escalate technology risks or incidents as needed. This description should not be construed to contain every function that may be required to be performed by an associate in this position. Duties and responsibilities may be added, deleted, or changed at any time at the discretion of management, formally or informally, either verbally or in writing. *\*\*\*Full job description provided during interview process* Requirements: **What We Look For in a Candidate** *Custom Alarm Core Values* * Do The Right Thing * Positive Attitude * Teamwork * Lifetime Learner * Customer Service *Education and Experience* * High school diploma or equivalent. * 2\-year Associate’s Degree * Three to five years’ experience in computer network maintenance. * CompTIA A\+ Technician * Microsoft 365 *Beneficial Certifications* * Network\+ * Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) * Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) *Additional Skills and Abilities* * Microsoft 365 administration. * Knowledge of SQL, reporting, cybersecurity, and automation tools. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and organizational skills. * Ability to learn new technologies and support system integrations. * Excellent communication, training, and customer service skills. * Self\-motivated with strong prioritization and confidentiality skills. *Physical Demands* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing all day. Extensive use of a computer screen and keyboard is necessary. Simultaneous movement of hands, wrists and fingers is an important element. Occasional lifting and carrying may be necessary; weights of objects rarely exceed 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. *Working Conditions* A majority of the workday is spent in a comfortable office environment with modern office equipment. Occasional after hours work may be necessary. *Other Requirements* Regular and reliable attendance is required. A person in this position must have a valid driver’s license. Due to the security nature of our business, an offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and drug test. **SUMMARY:** For the 10th consecutive year, Custom Alarm is proud to be recognized as one of the "Best Places to Work in Southeast MN," an honor we deeply value and strive to earn each year. At Custom Alarm, we know that taking care of our team is the first step in taking great care of our customers. That’s why we offer a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and recognize your hard work. In addition to a competitive salary, we provide medical, dental, and life insurance, a matching 401(k), and a range of additional perks to show our appreciation including: * Flexibility * Vacation/Sick Pay * Holiday Pay \+ 2 Floater Holidays * Volunteer Time Off (VTO) * $200 Annual Wellness Benefit * Employee Discount * Profit Sharing * Adjustable Stand\-Up Desk * Dress for Your Day/Business Casual * Company Paid Social Events **What to Expect Next** Our employees enjoy the family\-friendly, positive culture at Custom Alarm. We believe in doing the right thing, fostering a lifelong learning environment and delivering top\-notch customer service while making sure we enjoy the process along the way. Take just a quick 15 minutes to apply today and experience it for yourself! **Disability/EOE/Veteran**

Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? If we learn during the course of our recruitment process that, due to an applicant’s location, further information about the position is required, including certain salary information, this information in this posting will be supplemented accordingly.* *The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $80,000 \- $100,000 annually \+ bonus depending on factors such as job\-related knowledge, relevant experience, and location. jobs.description: **About Doss** ============== **DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.** ------------------------------------------------------------ A modern, AI\-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across: * Procurement * Inventory * Orders * Fulfillment * Finance **Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant\-heavy ERPs.** Fast time\-to\-value, adaptable as the business evolves. Through our Adaptive Resource Platform (ARP) and unified operational data model, teams deploy quickly, automate workflows, and make changes without months of re\-implementation. **We recently raised a $55M Series B**, co\-led by Madrona and Premji Invest. Participation from Intuit Ventures, Theory Ventures, General Catalyst, Contrary Capital, and Pathlight VC. DOSS is trusted by fast\-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence. About the role: Every ERP claims to be "AI\-powered." Almost none of them let an operator ask a question in plain language and get an answer grounded in their live procurement, inventory, and finance data, let alone let an agent safely take action on it. That's the goal of this job: you'll own applied AI across Doss: Dossbot (query, analyze, and automate via chat), AI\-assisted schema and workflow generation, and the agentic automations that turn back\-office busywork into background processes. You'll be the technical anchor for how foundation models meet a transactional system of record. What you’ll do: * Own the applied AI architecture end\-to\-end: model selection, orchestration, RAG over the unified operational data model, evals, guardrails, and cost/latency budgets in production. * Build Dossbot into the primary interface for operations: natural\-language search, analysis, and automation grounded in live supply\-chain, finance, and ops data. * Engineer AI\-assisted tooling that uses foundation models to propose, validate, and apply customer schemas and workflow definitions on live production tenants. * Design agentic workflows that act inside enterprise guardrails: permission\-aware, auditable, tenant\-isolated, and safe to run against a customer's system of record. * Stand up the eval and observability infrastructure to measure quality, catch regressions, and proactively detect anomalous or risky emergent behavior. * Partner with product, design, and our Forward Deployed team to deliver on their highest\-leverage AI use cases. * Mentor and shape engineering culture as the team's center of gravity for applied AI, raising the bar on how we build, evaluate, and ship LLM\-powered systems. What we’re looking for: **Experience** * Shipped LLM\-powered features or agents to production and operated them at scale, not just prototypes or demos. * Deep hands\-on work with foundation model APIs, RAG pipelines, tool use/function calling, prompt and context engineering, and fine\-tuning where it earns its keep. * Built eval harnesses and guardrails for non\-deterministic systems running against business\-critical data. * Strong backend fundamentals: Designing systems, Postgres, and cloud services for reliable, multi\-tenant web applications. * Going from 0 to 1 in ambiguous settings, and judgment for when AI is the right tool and when it isn't. **Qualities** * Team player: you bring positivity, openness, and curiosity to the team every day. * Growth mindset: everything is an opportunity to learn and improve yourself, the team, and the company. * Craftsmanship: you care about making something of quality. * Customer First: you care immensely about the customer experience journey and want to create a product full of delight. * Pragmatic: you make the right decision based on circumstance, not theory. * Low Ego: you work best in collaborative environments where everyone supports the team. Compensation Range: $230K \- $260K

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a seed\-stage AI company, backed by a top\-tier venture firm, building the ad layer for the AI era: interactive brand experiences embedded natively into apps and websites. Its ads are generated dynamically in real time and personalized to every single user, so every impression is hyper\-relevant. The recommendation stack is already live, serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users, with millions in annualized ad spend. Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads run in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor, and its ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native) is live in top App Store and Google Play apps. The team is small and based in San Francisco, with multiple prior exits and experience from leading tech and finance companies. ### **About the Role** The Applied AI Engineer owns the engine that makes real\-time, personalized ads possible: agents that generate playable mini\-games, short\-form video, and every variant in between on the fly, then learn from how they perform across millions of daily interactions and millions in annualized ad spend. This is a full\-stack applied AI role spanning model selection, agent orchestration, and production infrastructure, with direct business impact at every layer. The architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. The agents plug into a recommendation stack that is already serving ads in production, and every ad they create is served to real users and measured against real advertiser dollars. The stack runs on GCP, Redis, MongoDB, and Temporal. The role comes with ownership, equity, and a direct line to what ships. ### **What You'll Own** * **Playable generation agents:** Agents that turn an advertiser or app brief into a working, on\-brand HTML5 playable ad. * **Automated QA:** Checks that catch broken playable builds before a human does. * **Video generation pipelines:** Multimodal pipelines that produce short\-form video ads and variants across formats, hooks, and styles using frontier image and video models. * **Real\-time personalization loop:** Connect generation to the recommendation and ranking engine so each user gets creative made for them, read what wins (engagement, CTR, installs, ROAS), and feed it back so every impression gets more relevant. * **Agent infrastructure:** Orchestration, evals, and reliability so all of this runs in production at scale, not just in a demo. ### **What's Already Live** You inherit a working system with real traffic, not a blank slate: * A recommendation stack already serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users with millions of dollars in annualized ad spend * Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads running in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor * A proprietary ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native), live in top App Store and Google Play apps ### **Must\-Have** * Strong applied AI experience: has built and shipped an LLM, multimodal, or agentic system in production, beyond simple API wrappers. * Backend depth across infra, data, and serving end\-to\-end, not just the model layer (GCP, Redis, MongoDB, Temporal). * Comfort with ambiguity: the architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. * Bias toward shipping, suited to an early\-stage company that moves fast and figures things out. ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $250,000 USD per year, plus equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** Not available ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Equity * Ownership and a direct line to what ships ### **Interview Process** * Interview with the CTO * Take\-home assignment * Work trial * Offer

jobs.title: Founding RL Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a venture\-backed, seed\-stage AI data company based in San Francisco. They supply high\-quality multilingual voice data and enterprise data to leading AI labs, and use real\-world company data to build rich reinforcement learning (RL) environments rather than synthetic ones. The business already generates meaningful revenue and works with top voice and frontier AI labs. The team is small, founder\-led and hiring fast. ### **About the Role** We are looking for a Founding RL Engineer to build high\-quality RL environments and AI agents. The role spans two streams: building RL environments from the company's proprietary voice and enterprise datasets, and building and deploying AI agents for enterprise customers. This is the first hire on the engineering team. You will report to and work directly with both co\-founders, and lead the engineering function as the team grows. ### **What You'll Own** * Build high\-quality RL environments from proprietary voice and enterprise datasets * Build and deploy AI agents for enterprise customers * Partner with the co\-founders on technical direction and roadmap * Lead the engineering team as it grows * Ship fast while holding a high\-quality standard at startup pace ### **Must\-Have Requirements** * 3\-7 years of engineering experience with strong RL fundamentals * Prior experience building RL environments, either at an RL company or at a human data company with hands\-on RL exposure (e.g. Surge, Mercor, Scale\-type data companies, Proximal, or comparable) * Hands\-on experience building AI agents in production * Strong AI\-native tooling fluency, using tools such as Claude Code or Cursor daily as production aids * Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco, working fully in person 5\.5 days a week ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Prior experience at a top human data company * Full\-stack engineering background (TypeScript, AWS) * iOS, Swift, or React Native experience for mobile app development * Prior startup experience with a demonstrated shipping cadence ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary: USD $125,000 \- $200,000 * Annual profit\-share bonus: USD $100,000 \- $200,000 * Founding engineer role with a clear path to leading the engineering team ### **Key Details** * Location: San Francisco, CA (fully in person, 5\.5\-day week, Sundays off) * Employment: Full\-time * Experience: 3\-7 years * Visa sponsorship: Not available ### **Interview Process** Intro chat with a co\-founder, chat with the second co\-founder, take\-home assignment, technical chat, and a short work trial (a couple of days). The full process can be completed in about one week.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Backend & Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is one of the world's largest AI entertainment platforms, backed by a top\-tier venture firm that led its Series A. Millions of people use it every day to create characters, worlds, stories, and relationships with AI, sending tens of millions of messages a day and spending well over an hour a day on the platform on average. The company trains its own models and runs its own inference, so far more of its stack is in\-house than at most companies its size. The team is very small and works in person in San Francisco. That combination means consumer\-scale traffic on infrastructure a very small team builds and operates itself, where each engineer's work reaches millions of users. ### **About the Role** This hire leads backend and infrastructure for the platform. They work directly with the CEO, who runs the backend today, alongside one growth engineer, one mobile engineer, and a few contractors. It is a full\-stack infrastructure role: keeping the platform up, making it faster and more resilient, and building the systems behind new features. Scale defines the work. Millions of daily users generate request volume closer to a large consumer company than a B2B SaaS business, and infrastructure problems often surface as product bugs: a slow page, a delayed job, a websocket that keeps reconnecting. The role suits an engineer who can trace an issue from the user experience down to the machine, fix the cause, and own technical decisions on a small team where those decisions stick. ### **What You'll Own** * The infrastructure behind new features, including recommendation systems, model fine\-tuning, and the inference pipeline * Production reliability: monitoring through Datadog and the logging stack, responding to incidents, and shipping fixes that address root causes * Performance and resilience across APIs, database queries, caching, background jobs, and real\-time connections * Continuous hardening of the existing stack, including bot mitigation * Architecture and capacity decisions as usage grows, and how the team deploys, monitors, and recovers ### **Must\-Have** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial work on backend systems or infrastructure * Has built and operated substantial backend systems in production, not only written code for them * Strong in TypeScript/Node.js and PostgreSQL * Generalist across the stack: can follow a problem across services and layers, including unfamiliar ones * Takes an unclear problem through to a production fix with little direction, and works well on a very small, high\-ownership team ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * NestJS, Redis, and Kubernetes * Distributed systems or GPU infrastructure experience ### **Key Details** * **Title:** Member of Technical Staff – Backend \& Infrastructure * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $300,000 USD per year * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1\) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Work on an AI interactive entertainment platform with millions of users * Small team with substantial ownership over technical decisions * Room to see work through from conception to production * Impact millions of users daily through performance improvements * Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% of premiums covered * 401(k) match ### **Interview Process** * Phone screen (15–20 min) * Technical pairing (1–1\.5 hr) * On\-site technical (in person, SF office)

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a fast\-growing, Series A, AI\-native compliance software company serving financial institutions. Compliance is critical for banks, credit unions, and fintechs to get right, yet most of that work still runs manually in legacy tools or spreadsheets. The company replaces it with software that runs third\-party due diligence, screens marketing collateral, and keeps compliance teams current with a constantly changing regulatory landscape. The business has strong product\-market fit, with revenue growing more than 5x since its Series A and a customer base that includes well\-known, high\-growth fintech companies. Engineers join for the traction, the room for real agency and ownership, and a high caliber of talent on a small team. ### **About the Role** We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build the core product experiences customers use every day. Risk and compliance teams run complex, highly structured workflows involving large volumes of data, documents, approvals, and collaboration. This engineer figures out how to make those workflows fast and intuitive, then builds the frontend and backend systems behind them, including AI\-powered features that automate work that has historically been manual. Engineers here own products end\-to\-end, from understanding the customer problem through technical design, shipping, and operating in production. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the CTO, on a small engineering team. The role suits an engineer who cares about how information is structured, how users move through a workflow, and how technical design enables a great experience. ### **What You'll Own** * Building and shipping new product features end\-to\-end across the frontend and backend * Major features from technical design through launch, in close partnership with other engineers and Customer Success * Intuitive user experiences for complex, data\-dense risk and compliance workflows * AI\-powered features that automate historically manual compliance work * Performance, reliability, and architecture of the application as the company scales, informed by direct work with customers ### **Requirements** **Must\-Have** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience building production web applications * Strong experience building modern, interactive frontend applications and the backend systems that support them * Excellent product and UX judgment, particularly for complex or data\-dense applications * Strong understanding of frontend architecture, application state, APIs, data modeling, and relational databases * Ability to take a product problem from initial concept through technical design, implementation, and production * High attention to detail and a strong bar for the quality, performance, and usability of what you ship **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience building AI\-powered product features * Experience working directly with customers to shape product direction ### **Key Details** * **Location:** New York City, NY (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 3\+ years * **Salary:** $180,000 – $250,000 USD per year * **Equity:** 0\.5% – 1% * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1, OPT) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents * Lunch provided in office * Paid time off and paid company holidays * Meaningful equity (0\.5% – 1%) * Visa sponsorship for all visa types ### **Interview Process** * Intro call * Coding interview (optional) * Conversation with a Co\-Founder * Work trial * Offer

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** When a Fortune 500 C\-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real. Your counterpart is the C\-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision\-making models that make a top\-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre\-sales conversation through the life of the account. The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard\-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent. These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role. **About the Role** This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end\-to\-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs. It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest\-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross\-functional teams behind you. This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high\-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution. **In this role, you will** * Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward\-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers. * Serve as the executive partner to the C\-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion. * Design, build, and optimize enterprise\-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals. * Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap. * Direct Forward\-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome. * Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments. **Your background looks something like this** * 3\+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high\-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward\-deployed or solutions roles at high\-growth technology companies. * A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it. * Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives. * Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision\-makers at large, complex organizations. * Comfort operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it. **Even better** * A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands\-on technical experience. * An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology, is a plus. * Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level. **Compensation** $150K – $200K \+ Offers Equity **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in software development using Python and C\+\+. * Experience with machine learning (ML) hardware accelerators, ML compiler stacks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, XLA), and kernel development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 2 years of experience with full\-stack system development for hardware accelerators. * 2 years of experience with collaborative, hyper\-scalar software development and engineering best practices. * Experience scoping, planning, and executing projects towards team goals in ambiguous environments. **About the job** ----------------- We are building a next\-generation compute platform for AI inference workloads, with an emphasis on memory technologies, Hardware (HW) acceleration, and Software (SW)/HW codesign. jobs.title: Mechanical Principal Engineer-Data Center IT Rack Feasibility
jobs.description: **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Mechanical Principal Engineer\-Data Center IT Rack Feasibility** Mechanical Engineering leads and delivers the development of innovative and compliant mechanical design solutions. Our team conducts feasibility studies and preliminary testing of mechanical products, instruments, and subassemblies for new products and technologies, interlocking with cross\-functional downstream stakeholders. **What you’ll achieve:** As a **Mechanical Principal Engineer\-Data Center IT Rack Feasibility**, you will interpret technology collateral to own complex mechanical designs, conduct selective detailed analyses, and prepare test plans to validate function, reliability, and compliance. You will coordinate with downstream stakeholders to support product requirements during early feasibility investigations. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Mechanical Principal Engineer\-Data Center IT Feasibility** on our **Mechanical Engineering** team in **Round Rock, Texas** or **Hopkinton, Massachusetts**. **(relocation assistance available)** **You will:** * Partner with cross\-functional engineering teams to develop innovative, customer\-centric data center infrastructure and high\-density rack solutions * Design and develop mechanical and thermal components for air and liquid\-cooled systems, leveraging 3D Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) tools to create jobs.title: Data Protection and Management Engineer
jobs.description: Dentons US LLP is currently recruiting for a Data Protection and Management Engineer. This role will be responsible to build and operate the technical controls that keep the Firm's client and matter data confidential, correctly classified, and retained only as long as it should be. This is a hands\-on engineering role centered on data protection and management technologies. Data Protection and Management Engineer will own day\-to\-day operation of data security posture management, data loss prevention, insider risk management, and sensitivity labeling, and will support Records and Information Governance in applying retention and disposition across the same estate. You will work alongside document management system administrators on security policy management, ethical walls, and access controls, and partner with infrastructure, practice support, Risk, and the Office of General Counsel to protect confidential material without slowing the practice of law. **Responsibilities** * **Data Posture and Discovery \-** Operate the Firm's DSPM platform. Onboard and maintain data sources across Microsoft 365, the document management system, file shares, and cloud infrastructure; tune discovery and classification accuracy; and report on sensitive data location, exposure, and entitlement sprawl. * **Remediation of Data Exposure.** Partner with infrastructure, application, and practice support teams to remediate overshared repositories, excessive permissions, orphaned accounts, and unmanaged data stores identified through DSPM. Track remediation to closure and measure the reduction in data exposure over time. * **Data Loss Prevention \-** Author, test, and tune policies across email, endpoint, cloud applications, browser, and removable media; manage exception and business\-justification workflows; triage and investigate alerts; and reduce false positives while maintaining coverage of every egress channel. * **Retention and Disposition \-** Partner with Records and Information Governance to implement the Firm's retention schedule. Configure retention labels and policies, support disposition review and defensible destruction, and ensure legal holds correctly suspend retention where required. * **Data Minimization \-** Reduce redundant, obsolete, and trivial content as a protection control as much as a storage one. Identify aging and duplicate data, support decommissioning of legacy repositories, and report on volume under management and storage reclaimed. * **Document Management System Controls \-** Support DMS administrators in the operation of security policy management, ethical walls, and access management. Assist with need\-to\-know security models, matter\-level provisioning, access request workflows, periodic access reviews and recertification, and evidence for client audits and outside counsel guidelines. * **Insider Risk and Rights Management \-** Operate Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management, Information Protection, and Information Rights Management. Build and tune policies for departing timekeepers, lateral hires, and data staging and exfiltration, working within agreed privacy, escalation, and legal review protocols. * **Adoption of AI and New Technology \-** Apply data protection controls to generative AI and collaboration tools. Assess oversharing and content\-hygiene risk before rollout, define guardrails for prompt and output handling, and evaluate emerging tooling. * **Automation and Continuous Improvement.** Reduce manual effort through scripting and automation across policy deployment, label and retention operations, alert enrichment, evidence collection, and reporting. Identify opportunities to apply AI to classification, investigation, and triage workflows. * Occasional off\-hours work to support maintenance windows, participation in an on\-call rotation for data protection escalations, and limited travel to Firm offices may be required. **Experience \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 4\+ years of experience in data protection, information security, or a closely related infrastructure discipline, including at least 2 years of hands\-on work with data loss prevention, data classification, or insider risk tooling. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection and sensitivity labels, Insider Risk Management, Audit, and Communication Compliance. * Working knowledge of at least one DSPM or data access governance platform, such as Microsoft, Varonis, Cyera, BigID, or Netwrix, and familiarity with third\-party DLP and email security gateways. * Working familiarity with retention schedules, retention labeling, and defensible disposition, including how legal holds interact with retention. * Strong written communication and the ability to explain data protection risk to attorneys, business stakeholders, and firm leadership. * Experience in a law firm, professional services, or another environment with strict client confidentiality obligations. * Familiarity with legal document management systems and their security models, such as iManage Work with Security Policy Manager and Threat Manager, or NetDocuments. * Hands\-on experience with Purview Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management, or eDiscovery. * Certifications such as Microsoft SC\-401 (Information Security Administrator, formerly SC\-400\), SC\-200, CISSP, CIPT, IGP, or vendor\-specific data protection certifications. **Salary** Pursuant with states' laws, the salary range for this position is $120,000 \- $145,000, based on experience and local market. Dentons US LLP offers a competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, profit sharing, short\-term/long\-term disability, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays and discretionary bonuses. *Dentons US LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Disability/Vet. Pursuant to local ordinances, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* *If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity at Dentons US, LLP, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please call our Talent Acquisition Lead at \+1 314 259 5898 or contact us at dentonsusstaffrecruitment@dentons.com.* **About Dentons** ----------------- Redefining possibilities. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Our R\&D organization is building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences for people managing their health. You’ll combine strong software engineering with hands\-on expertise in modern AI, including foundation models, generative AI, and predictive modeling, to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, safe, and valuable product features. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production, partnering with engineers, product managers, and clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ship AI systems at scale. In doing so, you’ll help position Dexcom as an industry leader in health AI and empower millions of customers to take control of their health. **Where you come in:** * You architect end\-to\-end AI/ML product capabilities, from concept and experimental design through training, evaluation, and production deployment, writing reusable, production\-quality code. * You build and optimize AI/ML product features, whether powered by predictive models or generative AI such as large language models (LLMs), improving behavior through model selection, prompting, retrieval, feature engineering, fine\-tuning, or retraining. * You own evaluation and safety for your systems, defining metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring, identifying model and system risks, and driving mitigations and responsible\-AI practices across the team. * You lead technical strategy that balances model performance, latency, cost, safety, and regulatory requirements. * You collaborate with engineers and architects to deploy and scale AI/ML systems in production, building and improving the training, serving, and CI/CD pipelines that keep them reliable, observable, and cost\-effective. * You coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including stakeholders from R\&D, Commercial, Product, Legal, and Regulatory, to ensure development aligns with company strategy and meets the highest safety standards. jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** **This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert** We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI\-assisted features and internal tooling. You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS\-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them. * Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on\-call participation, incident root\-causing, and the follow\-through fixes. * Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter. * Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed. * Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services. * Integrate third\-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI\-backed features where they genuinely improve the product. * Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI\-generated code alike. * Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room. **What you will have** * 6\+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred). * Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Depth in a single language is not enough for this role. * Solid relational database skills on MySQL or Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior. * Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence\-led debugging in production. * Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene. * Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade\-off, or an incident to engineers and non\-engineers. **Nice to have** * Hands\-on AWS (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change Terraform. * Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod. * CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience. * Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards. * Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security). * OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi\-tenant identity providers. * C\# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home. * Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling. * Large\-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them. * Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Console Experience
jobs.description: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast\-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. DigitalOcean's console is where every customer, from a solo developer to an enterprise platform team, comes to provision, manage, and scale their infrastructure. We're looking for a designer to own that experience end to end: the navigation, the cross\-product patterns, the moments where a dozen product teams' features have to feel like one coherent product. You'll sit on a product team, and use that vantage point to build the reusable frameworks, patterns, and guidance that every team working in the console relies on, while holding the broader view of how the console works as a system. This is a role for someone who can zoom from a single dialog to the entire information architecture and back, often in the same week. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end design of the console experience, from first login through daily workflows for their users entire experience. * Treat the design system itself as the product: own the component library, patterns, and visual/interaction standards every team builds on, and plan its roadmap jointly with the engineering team. * Set the craft and quality bar for the whole product suite, plus a review process that holds it in place, so consistent, polished UI is the normal outcome rather than something each team has to fight for on its own. * Build reusable, high\-leverage patterns instead of custom screens per team, so product teams can ship well\-designed UI without needing a dedicated designer of their own. * Own the highest\-visibility shared surfaces (navigation, onboarding, app shell, landing pages) as the reference examples other teams design against. * Work closely with engineering to make sure designs land in the product as intended, and grow the design skills of the UI engineers embedded on product teams through a design guild, reviews, and pairing. * Make simplicity and strong UX a real point of differentiation again, and back up requests for more design investment with evidence of where it will pay off. * Own the creative vision for the console: bring a clear, opinionated point of view on what the experience should look and feel like, not just the systems that keep it consistent. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Staff\-level product design experience with a proven track record of building and scaling a design system across many products or teams. * A systems thinker who designs for reuse and consistency at scale rather than one\-off screens, and understands the leverage that good patterns create. * Strong, well\-rounded craft across interaction, visual, and information design, backed by a portfolio that shows both taste and measurable UX impact. * A history of driving quality and adoption through influence rather than authority, working across dozens of teams via standards, partnership, and persuasion. * Comfort being the most senior (and possibly only) designer in the room, setting direction under ambiguity. * A strong, opinionated point of view on design, and the conviction to own the creative direction of the product rather than just its consistency. * Solid collaboration with engineers, with hands\-on knowledge of front\-end constraints and how design systems actually live in code as a strong plus. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience running or scaling a design system guild or community of practice across a large engineering org. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes) or a track record of ramping up quickly on technical domains. * Experience designing for both novice and expert users within the same product. **Compensation Range:** ----------------------- * $192,800 \- $241,000 * This is a remote role JR: 2026\-8165 *\#LI\-Remote* **Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean** -------------------------------------------- * **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting\-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions. * **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high\-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences. * **We reward our employees.** The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program. * **DigitalOcean is an equal\-opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. **Application Limit:** You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180\-day period. jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash's MDX team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared foundation that ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo rely on to build and run ML\-powered products. We work across the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, serving, and monitoring. Our mission is to increase the velocity and reliability of ML\-driven business impact across the company. A central pillar of that work is agentic infrastructure. We are building systems that let agents accelerate and operate the ML workflow itself, including auto research, where agents explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and self\-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate failures in ML pipelines and production models with minimal human intervention. **About the Role** ------------------ You will join a small, high\-leverage team building the agentic layer of DoorDash's ML infrastructure. You'll design and build the systems that let agents accelerate how ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo develop, ship, and operate models. That includes auto research systems that explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and agentic developer support that helps ML engineers move through training, evaluation, deployment, and debugging faster. You'll own well\-scoped components end to end, from design through production, working across agent orchestration, tooling and integrations with our ML platform, evaluation of agent behavior, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong backend foundation who is excited to apply AI agents to real engineering workflows, learns quickly, and wants to grow into technical leadership in a fast\-moving area where model capabilities, tooling, and best practices change month to month. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Build agentic systems that increase the velocity of ML development across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, helping ML engineers get from idea to production model faster. * Design and implement infrastructure that lets agents propose, run, and evaluate modeling experiments. * Build agentic developer support for the ML lifecycle, such as agents that help engineers set up training jobs, debug failing pipelines, review model deployments, and navigate our platform. * Develop evaluation and observability for agent behavior, so we can measure whether agents are actually helping, catch regressions early, and build the trust needed to give them more autonomy. * Work with production standards in mind, including reliability, safety guardrails, cost controls, monitoring, and clear playbooks, so that agentic workflows can run against real ML systems. * Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to understand where their time goes and turn those workflows into durable, reusable platform capabilities. * Grow quickly in a fast\-moving area, with the chance to shape how agents are used to build and operate ML systems at a company of this scale. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent * 2\+ years of industry experience in software engineering * Hands\-on experience building ML infrastructure in production including feature engineering and feature stores, data pipelines for ML, training and experimentation
