jobs.title: Principal Solutions Engineer - Data Center Power
jobs.description: *Full\-time, onsite \| Houston, Texas \| Travel to customer sites, partners and our Swiss HQ* **About EH Group** ------------------ EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform that provides onsite power solutions to data centers, defense and industry, and mobile power solutions to the aviation and maritime sectors. We offer fuel\-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems running on natural gas, biogas or hydrogen, with options for integrated carbon capture and heat recovery. Following a recently announced major investment round, EHG is expanding from its founding in Switzerland into the US, fueled by a GW\-scale, late\-stage pipeline of US data center customers. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to be our technical and site design expert in front of data center customers and partners. Three things sit in the job: site planning, technical design and technical proposal writing. Near enough every data center developer we meet wants what we have. What they want from us is a proposal, a technical design their engineers can put through diligence, and proof that the project is bankable. Nobody owns producing those today. That is the seat we are creating, and you will build the system that makes it repeatable. These deals are multi\-party and deeply technical: the customer, their EPC, the gas supplier, their financing partners and sometimes the utility. Our scope has to integrate into the customer's whole site plan. You will be the person who makes that fit, on paper and in the room. This is the first hire in a function we expect to grow. You will set the templates, the design standards and the proposal library that everyone after you uses, and you will help us work out how the function should scale. The role is based in Houston, Texas, alongside our US operations hub and manufacturing site, with travel to customer sites, to partners and to our Swiss HQ. **What you will own** --------------------- **Site planning** * Work with the customer and their EPC on where our systems go: layout, footprint, clearances, electrical and gas interconnection points, hydrogen and reformer siting, and constructability. * Integrate our scope into the customer's overall site plan alongside the other parties on the project. * Surface the site\-specific constraints that change the design or the price early, before they become a late surprise in diligence. * Build reference layouts for common data center configurations so every new opportunity starts from a template. **Technical design** * Supervise and own the CAD models and technical drawings for each opportunity: system arrangement, reformer integration, balance of plant and interfaces. * Map the customer's technical specifications onto our technology and our reformers, and produce the compliance view: what we meet, what we meet differently, and what needs a deviation. * Size and configure systems against the customer's load profile, redundancy requirements and availability targets. * Own the technical interfaces: electrical tie\-in, cooling and heat recovery, controls and monitoring, and the gas and hydrogen side alongside our VP of Fuel. * Bring customer requirements and recurring design constraints back into our product roadmap with our engineering team in Switzerland. **Technical proposal writing** * Write the technical proposals. This is a named part of the job: clear, well\-structured technical writing that a customer's engineering team, their EPC and their financing partners can all read. * Own responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical questionnaires, and the technical sections of term sheets and contracts. * Carry the customer's technical due diligence: assemble the package, answer the questions, manage the follow\-ups. * Build the proposal library and content system so the second proposal is faster than the first. * Supply the technical inputs behind customer financial models: performance assumptions, capex and opex build\-up, availability and degradation. These deals are unusually finance\-heavy, and the customer's CFO is often our primary stakeholder. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- *Illustrative milestones, to be confirmed together.* * Proposal and design production has a clear owner: you. * A working system in place: templates, reference layouts, a technical content library, and a compliance matrix approach that shortens every cycle. * Named contribution to deals moving from qualified pipeline to signed order, with a measurable drop in time from customer request to delivered proposal. * You are running technical due diligence sessions with customers on your own. * A clear view on how this function scales, including your first hires. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- **Must\-have** * An engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, chemical or civil) and 8\+ years of engineering practice. This is a role for an engineer, and we are firm on it. * Strong hands\-on CAD skills. You produce drawings yourself, in current tools, and you can walk us through recent work. * Data center or industrial power design and development experience. You understand what a data center needs from its power and how a large power project gets built. * A customer\-facing track record. You have been the technical person in the room with a paying customer, rather than an internal design engineer. * Strong technical writing. You have written technical proposals, RFP responses or design basis documents for an external audience. * Comfort coordinating across multiple external parties: customer, EPC, utility or gas supplier, and financing advisors. * Comfort being the first person in a function, working from a blank page, in a lean company. * Houston\-based, or willing to relocate to Houston. * Existing authorization to work in the United States. **Strongly preferred** * EPC background. It is the single most useful thing on a CV for this role: design, constructability and multi\-party coordination in one person. * Project development experience, so a customer's development view is familiar from the inside. * Distributed generation, gas engine, turbine, fuel cell or onsite power experience. * Direct data center exposure, hyperscale or colocation, and familiarity with how these buyers run technical diligence. * Applications engineering, solutions engineering or technical sales experience in a complex, long\-cycle capital sale. * Comfort with the financial layer: you have fed technical inputs into project financial models and you understand what makes a project bankable. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation with meaningful equity. * Relocation support to Houston, Texas, if needed. * The first seat in a function that will grow. You will set the standards rather than inherit them, at the exact point where our pipeline turns into signed orders. **How to apply** ---------------- Apply with your CV and a short upload: a writing sample (a technical proposal, RFP response or design basis document you wrote for an external reader). Redact client names and commercial terms; we do not need anything confidential. Please have both ready before you start the application. Only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. *EH Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Software Design Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview: **About ERMCO** Electric Research and Manufacturing Cooperative, Inc. (ERMCO) is the leading manufacturer of distribution transformers and engineered electrical solutions, serving electric utilities, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and industrial customers across North America. Headquartered in Dyersburg, Tenn., ERMCO delivers reliable, high\-quality products that power homes, businesses, and communities across North America. With commitments to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, ERMCO is at the forefront of supporting grid modernization and energy transition. Our vertically integrated operations, customer\-focused culture, and investment in people and technology make ERMCO the Most Valued Partner for delivering resilient, sustainable power infrastructure for the future. **Job Summary** The Software Design Engineer is an early\-career role responsible for developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting software used in transformer and related component design processes. This position builds on foundational software development experience and applies it to engineering automation, design data workflows, ERP integration, and CAD\-related tools. The P2 Software Developer works with moderate supervision, contributes to defined development tasks, and collaborates with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, supply chain, and IT teams to support reliable software solutions aligned with business and design engineering needs. ***This role will be onsite in Dyersburg, TN. Relocation Assistance is available.*** Responsibilities: * Develop, update, test, troubleshoot, debug, deploy, and maintain software applications used to support transformer or component design processes. * Assist in translating engineering requirements, customer specifications, design rules, and process needs into functional software requirements. * Support basic calculations, data validation, simulations, reporting, and engineering data analysis within software tools and automation workflows. * Collaborate with design engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, supply chain, and IT teams to ensure software integrates effectively with engineering and production processes. * Maintain technical documentation, software notes, user instructions, test results, change records, and support materials under guidance from senior team members. * Participate in code reviews, design reviews, software validation, and continuous improvement activities to improve reliability, usability, and maintainability. * Support ERP and engineering system data updates related to design processes, automation workflows, and engineering deliverables. * Contribute to technology organization growth initiatives. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. * 1\-3 years of software development experience, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, automation, CAD, ERP, or technical business systems. * Working knowledge of programming concepts, database interaction, debugging practices, version control, and basic software lifecycle practices. * Ability to read and interpret drawings, customer specifications, engineering documentation, and basic design requirements. * Effective communication, organization, and teamwork skills with the ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines. * Basic understanding of engineering design processes and willingness to develop transformer or component design knowledge. * Ability to analyze complex legacy codebases and document business logic. **Preferred Qualifications*** Exposure to CAD systems, such as Autodesk Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, or similar CAD/PLM technologies, engineering automation tools, design configurators, ERP integrations, or product data workflows. * Demonstrated interest in supporting platform development, engineering data quality, and scalable tools for design decision support. * Good understanding of tools like Query Tool and MySQL used for complex data querying utilizing SQL. * Familiarity in programming languages such as VB .Net, C\#, and C\+\+ that includes embedded SQL queries, and creating, testing, and maintaining Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs). **Let’s Build the Future Together**At ERMCO, your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your impact is real. Whether you’re building on early career experience or launching your professional journey, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow in a manufacturing environment that values innovation and collaboration. **Join ERMCO and TRANSFORM your career!** Job Locations: US\-TN\-Dyersburg

jobs.title: IT Tier 3 Service Technician
jobs.description: **Tier 3 Service Technician** **About EXL Technical** EXL Technical, founded in 2010, is an MSP serving small to medium\-sized businesses in the greater Houston area. We are expanding and looking to grow our team. Position is on\-site at our Houston office and requires additional travel to local sites around town. **The Role** You are the last stop before the vendor call – the engineer who owns the problems T1 and T2 cannot close. Resolve complex server, network, security and cloud issues with the documentation discipline we expect at every tier. This is a full\-time, in\-office and on\-site, senior engineering role. **Technician Responsibilities** · Tier 1 and Tier 2 support issues/requests escalated to you to remediate requests and take control of tickets unable to be supported by Tier 1 and Tier 2 technicians. o Further troubleshoot and close tickets o You own and are responsible for remediating and closing tickets. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Econolite® is an innovator of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) solutions, products, and services. Our technology is helping save lives and making the Smart City a reality. If you want to be at the forefront of this intelligent technology revolution, we want to talk to you about being part of our team. Econolite is committed to employing the best talent that will make significant contributions to building a safer, connected world. Econolite’s ITS solutions ease traffic congestion, provide safer mobility, and improve quality of life. As the one\-stop\-shop leader for traffic management systems, sensor products, and services, Econolite is committed to the advancement of connected and autonomous vehicles, smart cities, and cybersecurity. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to join our team, specializing in Kubernetes\-based infrastructure. In this role, you will primarily deploy, operate, and support the Centracs Mobility product line in customer on\-premises environments running Kubernetes, and secondarily assist with the cloud DevOps that supports our hosted environments. You will work closely with development, support, and customer IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and repeatable deployments. Some travel to customer sites is required for installations, upgrades, and troubleshooting. **DUTIES** * Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Kubernetes clusters in customer on\-premises environments, on customer\-provided hardware and virtualization platforms. * Package and deploy Centracs Mobility services using Helm and version\-controlled, repeatable configuration. * Build and maintain the tooling, runbooks, and documentation that make on\-premises installations and upgrades consistent and repeatable, including deployments into restricted or air\-gapped networks (private container registries, offline install packages). * Provide platform services on premises without relying on cloud\-managed services: ingress and load balancing, certificate management, persistent storage, secrets management, identity (Keycloak), and messaging (Kafka). * Provide platform capabilities for SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases, including provisioning, backup/restore, high availability, and upgrades. * Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting for on\-premises deployments; diagnose and resolve issues in customer environments, remotely or on site. * Work with customer IT and network teams on site prerequisites, including networking, DNS, firewall rules, remote access, and hardware sizing. * Apply security hardening and patching to clusters, nodes, and containers; remediate CVEs; and support security practices and certifications such as SOC 2\. * Assist with cloud DevOps: build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for containerized .NET (C\#) and Angular applications, and support cloud\-hosted Kubernetes environments. * Use AI tools to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, automation, and documentation, and review their output before applying it to production or customer environments. * Work closely with the technical and support teams to deliver and manage services with maximum uptime. * Contribute to other projects as needed, such as software development. **QUALIFICATIONS** The candidate will possess keen analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent communication skills, and a mindset of continual learning. Candidates must be self\-motivated individuals who proactively seek to grow their knowledge base and progress in their careers. * 2–6 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or systems engineering. * Strong hands\-on experience running Kubernetes outside of a managed cloud service (e.g., RKE2, k3s, kubeadm, or OpenShift), including installation, upgrades, and troubleshooting. * Strong background with Docker containers and Helm. * Strong understanding of networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, TLS/certificates, firewalls, VPNs, and network segmentation. * Linux and Windows Server administration, with scripting in Bash and PowerShell. * Azure DevOps, including pipeline development, or comparable CI/CD experience; Azure or AWS cloud experience. * Working knowledge of SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration. * Experience managing security policies and practices, such as SOC 2\. * Experience supporting enterprise\-grade production software, preferably delivered into customer\-managed environments. * Programming experience with a high\-level programming language, such as C\#. * Ability to communicate effectively with customer IT staff and to travel to customer sites as needed. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or an equivalent engineering field. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATONS** * Experience with air\-gapped or disconnected deployments. * Experience operating Kafka (e.g., Strimzi), Keycloak, and cert\-manager on Kubernetes. * Infrastructure as code and configuration management (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). * Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). * Virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V). * Traffic or Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) domain experience, or experience serving public\-sector customers. **PRE\-EMPLOYMENT** All candidates who accept employment will be subject to a background investigation and drug screening. For applicable roles, candidates who accept employment will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle/Driving Record screening. **COMPENSATION** The base pay range for this full\-time exempt position is $115,000\-$140,000 per year plus benefits. Pay ranges are determined by various factors, including role, experience, and location. The pay range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base pay rates for this position. Within the range, actual individual compensation is determined by various factors, including location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **BENEFITS** This role is eligible for benefits: weekly pay, weekly PTO accrual, paid holidays. Various medical plans, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, direct deposit. Basic life, LTD, 401k discretionary match. Other voluntary benefits include: identity theft protection. ***DISCLAIMER*** *The above statements are intended to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. We strongly encourage women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and veterans to apply to all of our job openings. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, lactation, ancestry/national origin, citizenship, age, disability, arrest and court records, military \& veteran's status, Genetic Information \& Testing, Family \& Medical Leave, or any other classification protected by state or federal law.* *We prohibit Retaliation against individuals who bring forth any complaint, orally or in writing, to the employer or the government, or against any individuals who assist or participate in the investigation of any complaint or otherwise oppose discrimination.* *An Equal Opportunity Employer \- Non\-Smoking Facility*

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer - Loyalty & Customer Analytics
jobs.description: At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire\-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross\-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze. Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you. At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week. Let’s Get Loco! What’s in it for you! * STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth * Career growth opportunities * Competitive pay and bonus potential * Medical \+ Dental \+ Vision Insurance \+ HSA Savings Account * 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting * Paid Vacation \+ Sick Pay \+ 12 Paid Holidays * Employee Assistance Program * Free El Pollo Loco food \+ restaurant discounts * PerkSpot discounts program **POSITION PURPOSE:** The Senior Data Engineer owns El Pollo Loco's (EPL) loyalty and customer spend data, turning it into reliable, actionable insight for leadership. This role starts with the business problem: understanding what decision leadership needs to make, then independently designing and delivering the data solution that supports it. The engineer owns data domains end to end, from source ingestion and architecture through reporting and analysis, and ensures data integrity across internal systems and external partners. Working directly with business departments, internal technology teams, and external technology vendors, this role drives architectural improvements that directly shape how EPL leadership makes decisions. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Business Problem Framing: Partner with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions, translate them into data requirements, and recommend the right solution approach without needing detailed direction. * Independent Solution Design: Own solutions from concept to production, including evaluating options, making architectural trade\-off decisions, and delivering working outcomes with minimal supervision. * Data Domain Ownership: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, ingestion flows, and analytical models for loyalty, customer, and transaction data. * Architecture \& Governance: Define and own data architecture for the domain, ensuring alignment with business needs, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness. * Vendor \& Partner Collaboration: Work directly with external technology vendors and data providers (loyalty, POS, digital ordering, and marketing platforms) to define integrations, resolve data issues, and hold partners accountable for data quality and delivery. * Data Contracts \& Integration: Establish data contracts with internal and external sources, integrate new data sources, and develop reusable transformation patterns. * Pipeline Reliability \& Optimization: Identify limitations in existing data processes, drive improvements, and establish best practices, including automated monitoring, alerting, and self\-healing processing. * AI/ML Integration: Apply AI/ML technologies, including large language models and agentic frameworks, to expand analytics capabilities and automate insight generation. * Innovation \& Scalability: Modernize ingestion frameworks and build secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions that support EPL's growth. QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics engineering, including ownership of production data platforms. * Expert\-level SQL and strong experience with modern ETL/ELT practices and data processing. * Hands\-on experience with cloud data warehouse platforms (e.g., Snowflake or comparable). * Experience with data governance and data modeling to ensure data integrity as analytics and reports are developed across EPL. * Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous business problem and independently design, build, and deliver a solution. * Experience managing integrations and working relationships with third\-party technology vendors. * Experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks, and the ability to integrate AI into analytics workflows. * Experience with loyalty, customer, or transactional data in restaurant, retail, or consumer businesses is strongly preferred. **LEADERSHIP \& BUSINESS SKILLS:** * Technical leadership mindset with a long\-term architectural vision and a commitment to high\-quality delivery. * Comfortable operating with ambiguity and setting direction where none exists. * Strong judgment in balancing short\-term needs against long\-term business goals. * Communicates clearly in business terms with executives and non\-technical stakeholders. * Sense of urgency and strong attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment. **IMPACT:** This is a strategic role. The engineer will directly influence how EPL leadership makes decisions by ensuring customer and loyalty data is available, accurate, and actionable. **EDUCATION:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Our Company In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus\-marinated, fire\-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable. jobs.title: Software Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **We are designing the grid of the future!**ENER\-i is a cutting\-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. Backed by the collective expertise of EPE, ENER\-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud\-based, enterprise computing software. ENER\-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, GIS, network connectivity models, machine learning \& augmented intelligence. Our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry. Responsibilities: **Join us in leading the** **change!** The Software Power Systems Engineer will work as a core member of the ENER\-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. This involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. Such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi\-static time\-series (QSTS) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and DER interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of DER and non\-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and DERMS operational planning, and long\-term capacity and investment planning. The level of the role (Engineer III, Senior, Principal, or Senior Principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. Principal\-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross\-team initiatives. * The Software Power Systems Engineer will also engage with the ENER\-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as: * Distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS) * Translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications * Technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines * Validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data * Performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility\-sized models * Client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training * Perform and deliver ENER\-i based distribution planning studies when needed **How you can make an impact:** * Design and implement production\-grade Python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ENER\-i platform. * Scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full\-year time\-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., Rust, C\+\+) where it matters. * Build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (CYME, Synergi, WindMil, OpenDSS, GIS) into a common, validated representation. * Develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, DER valuation, and grid planning using optimization (LP/MILP), heuristics, and data\-driven methods. * Establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy. * Serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness. * Propose and prototype new ENER\-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management. * Mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. * Represent EPE through publications, open\-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate. * Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: **Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:** * Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a power systems focus, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience. * 3\+ years (Engineer III) or 7\+ years (Principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count. * Expert understanding of three\-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices. * Hands\-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, WindMil, or GridLAB\-D), including its APIs or automation interfaces. * Strong Python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, Git, code review, and CI/CD. OpenDSS experience is a plus. * A track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open\-source projects with real users. * Experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., Pyomo, JuMP, Gurobi, HiGHS) to power systems problems. * Experience working with large data sets (time\-series, AMI, SCADA) using tools such as pandas/Polars, SQL, or Parquet. * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters. * Proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies (e.g., Scrum). **Beneficial Experience:*** Proficiency in a compiled or high\-performance language such as Rust, C\+\+, Julia, or Java. * Contributions to open\-source power systems tools (e.g., OpenDSS/AltDSS, DiTTo, GridLAB\-D, PowerModelsDistribution, pandapower). * Experience with cloud\-native development, containers, and distributed or high\-performance computing (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience with DER integration topics such as hosting capacity, IEEE 1547, DERMS, flexible interconnection, non\-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting. * Breadth across transmission, controls, or T\&D co\-simulation. * Familiarity with GIS tools (preferably Esri) and utility network data models. * Experience leveraging machine learning and AI tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity. * Publications or participation in IEEE PES or similar industry working groups. Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy. **How we support you:*** Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you * Generous PTO and paid holidays * MyShare Employee Ownership Program * Work with industry leaders * 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1\) ***Location***: This position is open to remote for highly qualified candidates***Travel***: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less) *EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. The EEO is the Law poster, and its supplement are available using the following links:* *EEOC is the Law Poster* ***Third\-Party Recruiting Notification****EPE does not accept unsolicited resumes from* ***third\-party recruiters****. Any unsolicited third\-party resumes forwarded by recruiters to EPE via our career page or to any of our managers or employees will be considered public information, may be treated as a direct application from the person identified in the resume, and will not be eligible for placement fee payment to the agency. EPE will not pay a fee to a third\-party recruiter or agency* without a previously signed third\-party agreement *and has not coordinated their recruiting activity with the appropriate member of the Talent Acquisition team.*

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are hiring a Applied AI Engineer for a leading fintech company's AI Team to serve as the team's technical anchor in the United States. You will lead two primary streams: * AI Coding tooling and developer experience — bringing the engineering depth of Silicon Valley front\-line teams (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Replit Agent, etc.) into ByLabs. * AI application paradigm exploration and dogfooding — building small, frontier prototypes in internal scenarios that validate streaming UX, transparent agent steps, long\-context memory, and other emerging patterns, and propagating them across the team through reference code, blog posts, and workshops. **This role is about craft and taste**. You are not a platform architect, nor a BU project delivery engineer. You are the person who turns front\-line Silicon Valley product engineering experience into multiplicative leverage for the entire AI Team. **Responsibilities** * Introduce AI Coding tooling best practices — Bring the engineering depth of Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Replit Agent, and similar tools (Skills, hooks, subagents, long\-context engineering, MCP integration) into ByLabs. Produce engineer onboarding playbooks and advanced\-usage standards. * Set the bar for the Skill Marketplace — Define Skill design conventions; personally deliver 5–10 reference\-quality Skills as exemplars; raise team\-wide Skill engineering quality through PR review. * Prototype an AI\-native engineering workflow — Reimagine the spec design implementation review testing release operations lifecycle around AI tools, producing a reference workflow APAC teams can adopt. * Build internal AI application prototypes (employee\-facing scenarios) — In OpenClaw, A2UI, role\-bound AI assistants, and similar internal contexts, build small frontier prototypes that validate streaming UX, transparent agent steps, long\-context memory, multi\-agent collaboration, and other emerging patterns. * Provide reference architecture code — When APAC teams face hard architectural choices in new AI scenarios, deliver runnable "this is how Silicon Valley does it" reference implementations — not documents, but working code. * Cross\-team craft propagation — One internal tech talk per month, one in\-depth blog per quarter, and one onsite workshop in APAC per half year. Distill Silicon Valley AI application best practices into durable team assets. * Architecture review participation — As the AI Team's anchor in the U.S., participate in ByLab's AI architecture review process and provide frontier perspective and taste\-based feedback at the application layer. **Major Requirements** * Education: Top\-tier CS / EE BS or above; MS preferred. * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on LLM applications. * Senior AI application engineering experience: Has shipped AI applications from 0 1 in production (not demos). Must have at least one tour of duty as a core engineer at a top\-tier Silicon Valley AI company or a leading AI product team — examples include Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, and similar. * Deep AI Coding tooling fluency: Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, or Replit Agent (at least one) is a daily\-driver in your workflow, and you can articulate its engineering implementation. Strong understanding of the engineering tradeoffs in Skills, hooks, subagents, MCP, and long\-context engineering. * Agent application engineering depth: Solid grasp of ReAct, Plan\-Execute, Reflection, Multi\-Agent, and Orchestrator\-Worker tradeoffs. Hands\-on experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Swarm, or in\-house frameworks. * Strong full\-stack engineering: Strong backend (Go / Python / TypeScript). Mid\-level or above frontend (React / Next.js). Comfortable with end\-to\-end streaming rendering and interaction. * Strong product sense and craft: Comfortable collaborating with PMs and designers; you have considered opinions and taste on AI application UX patterns (streaming, undo, context surfacing, agent\-step progress, etc.). * Public technical influence: A track record of public output — blog, talks, OSS contributions — sufficient to represent the team's craft externally. * Self\-direction and async collaboration: Capable of independently judging value priorities and driving prototype\-to\-dogfooding loops; effective at collaborating with APAC counterparts via documents, PRs, and asynchronous communication. **Nice to have** * Open\-source contributions to LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Claude Code MCP, OpenTelemetry GenAI, or similar projects. * Track record of translating research output (papers, blog posts) into production application patterns. * SaaS B2B product 0 1 experience. * Experience productizing multilingual (English / Chinese) applications. * AI experience in the financial or crypto domain.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** **Enstall** is the world’s largest provider of rooftop solar mounting hardware. Solar installers have depended on us to secure more than 3\.5 GW of solar annually on residential, commercial and industrial roofs. Our brands in the U.S. include industry leaders **IronRidge** and **PanelClaw**. **What You'll Do** Enstall is seeking a **Senior Product Design Engineer** or a **Senior Mechanical Engineer** to join Enstall’s product development and innovation team, to design, develop and enhance its industry leading commercial and residential solar racking and mounting products. Enstall is a fast\-growing, industry leading company, developing products for the renewable energy industry for multiple solar business units. We are looking for hands on, creative, enthusiastic, and proactive people who will support our vision “A world with solar on every roof top” by developing exciting products and experiences. **In This Role, You’ll Be** * Working in an R\&D environment within a dynamic product development team, you will be responsible for leading product development projects on new and advanced products as well as improving existing solar racking and mounting products. * Working with project management, testing, application engineering, manufacturing engineering, sourcing, quality and other areas of the company. * Generating and presenting wide ranging concepts to meet customer and business needs using brainstorming, sketches, quick mockups, simple CAD, and other techniques. * Leading R\&D efforts to develop and verify the best concepts using 3D CAD, fast prototyping, and cross\-functional input. * Creating production\-level drawings * Collaborating with suppliers on design for manufacturing strategies * Applying sound processes to manage uncertainties including prototyping to verify fit, function, adherence to standards and defining test and qualification plans. * Supporting and managing projects through regular project meetings, schedules, cost, and uncertainty/risk burn down. **What You'll Bring** * BS/BA in relevant engineering field (Mechanical, Materials, Aerospace etc.) * 4\+ years relevant work experience in an R\&D environment * Proven experience designing cost\-effective, high\-volume production methods. These should include many of the following: Extrusion, casting, die\-casting, cold heading, and stamping using materials including aluminum, stainless steel, and coated steel (for 25\-year outdoor life). * Ability to meet with domestic and overseas suppliers. * Strong component design, 3D modeling, and drawing skills, with a strong preference for SolidWorks. * Hands on skills with shop tools and equipment, and measurement tools to build mockups and prototypes. * Ability to assess usability, fit, form and function, and effect on product requirements. * Strong understanding of the product development phase/gate process. * Ability to use knowledge of manufacturing methods/materials to drive down costs in cost reduction programs. * Strong strategic and critical thinking skills. This role requires travel to project sites, to other Enstall US office locations, and interaction with a wide range of personnel and site conditions. The employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, crawl, kneel, and climb for extended periods, as well as use his/her hands to lift, handle, and feel various materials, components, and assemblies. Site visits often require the employee to climb ladders, spend time on flat and pitched roofs in extreme heat or cold, and understand and adhere to safety protocols for different situations. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Bonus Points For** * Experience developing and launching products for outdoor use requiring structural and electrical performance over the designed lifetime. * Knowledge in Statics and Mechanics of Materials. Understanding and obtaining reaction loads and moments. Calculate stresses from loads applied and identify the full range of failure modes for a given product. * Experience with solar product development. * Strong track record in similar roles with a portfolio of previous work that demonstrates your abilities. * Construction and building experience. * Knowledge of UL requirements and product certification. * Ability to travel up to 10% of your time, including occasional international travel. **Where You'll Be Located** This position is based in our Phoenix, AZ office and follows a hybrid schedule, with four days per week in the office and one day working remotely. **What We’ll Offer** We offer competitive compensation determined by each individual's relevant experience, skills, education and location. We anticipate the base salary for this position to be between **$115,000** and **$130,000** annually, if located in the Phoenix market. In addition to base salary, Enstall employees are eligible for either an annual bonus or commission, depending on their position. In addition to a competitive benefit package, we offer team members perks such as paid time off (PTO), a long\-term incentive plan, 401(k) match, development opportunities, educational assistance, 12 observed company holidays, paid parental leave, and a collaborative, inclusive culture just to name a few! **Who We Hire** Enstall is a global organization and places high value on creating a diverse and inclusive workforce, providing equal opportunity for all applicants and staff. All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local laws. Enstall will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities to the extent required by applicable law.

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead (Principal Engineer)
jobs.description: **AI Technical Lead** **Location:** Cambridge, MA / Hybrid *(This role requires working in\-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)* **About us:** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** As our Technical Lead, you will design and build a new kind of product: an insurance marketplace that AI agents use to shop on a person's behalf. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from the models and how they run to the MCP server and tools that other AI platforms connect to. This is a hands\-on senior role on a small team, and the decisions you make early will shape what agentic insurance shopping looks like before the market arrives. You own the technical architecture for the agent: where the model's reasoning runs, how we tune and serve it, how we keep cost and speed under control, and how the whole system stays reliable. We intend to run and tune our own open\-weight models rather than depend only on hosted APIs, so we control cost, speed, and behavior as volume grows, and owning that is central to this role. You own the MCP server, the tools, and the data the agent works with, and you set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You are the person who decides, with testing to back it up, how this is built, and then builds it. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture: decide where the agent's reasoning runs, which models we use, how they are packaged, and how AI platforms connect to us, and back those calls with testing. * Build and tune the models: fine\-tune open\-weight models for our use, and decide when tuning, retrieval, or prompting is the right tool. * Stand up the serving and infrastructure: deploy the agent and MCP server so they are reliable, fast, and affordable to run, with versioning and a way to roll back. * Build the testing into the system: programmatic eval sets, guardrails, and monitoring for quality, drift, cost, and speed, so we catch problems before agents do. * Design the data model and tools with the AI product lead: the request and response payloads, the reasoning we expose, and the trust signals. * Set the engineering patterns and standards the team builds on, and keep the code and architecture documented. * Keep cost and speed honest: watch what inference costs, and make the trade\-offs that keep it sustainable as volume grows. * Work in the open. Help publish our code, architecture, and findings. * Mentor the engineers on the team and give leadership clear, regular visibility into technical progress and risks. **What You Bring:** * Deep, current, hands\-on experience in the AI and LLM space. You work on this every day, not from the sidelines. * Real experience with open\-weight models: you have fine\-tuned them (LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, or similar) and run them yourself, not just called a hosted API. * Experience owning an LLM system in production: you have served models reliably, pinned versions, rolled back a bad change, and explained why the bill moved. * Enterprise\-level design and architecture experience, with a track record of leading large, ambitious projects and delivering them. * Strong grasp of evaluation and guardrails: building eval sets, catching failure modes, and monitoring quality, drift, cost, and speed. * Fluency with the serving and ops stack: model serving, containers and orchestration, and monitoring, on at least one major cloud. * Strong communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to an engineer and to a non\-technical leader, and lead with data. * Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action in a space where the standards change month to month. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years in engineering, with senior or lead ownership of complex technical systems, including hands\-on work in machine learning or LLMs. * A track record of leading large, ambitious projects with a small team and delivering them. We care more about what you have shipped and the judgment you showed than the revenue the project generated. * Hands\-on fine\-tuning and deployment of open\-weight or open\-source models, with real production experience. * Enterprise design and architecture experience for complex, high\-reliability systems. * Strong Python, Rust, and fluency with the modern LLM stack (serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring). * Strong strategic thinking paired with methodical execution. You can set the technical direction and then deliver it. * Excellent communication across all levels of an organization, technical and non\-technical. * A history of teamwork and a bias for action. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job\-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full\-time hybrid role is $202,800\-$238,600\. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must have current, unrestricted work authorization in the United States. EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy\-related condition, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request. For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Hyperscale Build Infrastructure
jobs.description: Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. **THE ROLE** The Hyperscale Line of Business builds and ships products to hyperscale customers at exabyte scale, with an emphasis on speed, reliability, and operational excellence. The Build Environments and Tools team owns developer productivity infrastructure related to build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments that engineers rely on daily to build and test software. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join this team and help build fast, reliable, and reproducible build infrastructure at scale. You'll work hands\-on with build orchestration, build\-system internals, and containerized build environments — including large\-scale C/C\+\+ builds — while partnering with tech leads and engineers across the Hyperscale org to remove friction from everyday developer workflows. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, develop, and maintain build orchestration systems and tooling * Drive improvements to build speed, reliability, reproducibility, debuggability, and ease of use across local development and CI workflows * Own and evolve containerized build environments, ensuring consistent, isolated, and reproducible build images * Work on large\-scale C/C\+\+ build challenges, including dependency pruning, and static/dynamic linking tradeoffs * Diagnose and resolve build\-graph correctness issues, flaky builds, and incremental\-build regressions * Partner with tech leads and the engineering manager to shape the team's technical roadmap for build systems and developer tooling * Collaborate with teams across the Hyperscale Line of Business and broader engineering to understand pain points, prioritize fixes, and align tooling investments with product delivery needs * Establish and uphold operational excellence practices for build infrastructure: observability, incident response, change management, and continuous improvement * Use engineering metrics to track and improve build performance, reliability, and developer experience * Mentor other engineers on the team and contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and high technical standards * We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. **WHAT YOU BRING** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience in infrastructure, developer productivity, build systems, or platform engineering * Strong understanding of modern build systems and toolchains – dependency management, build\-graph correctness, incremental and reproducible builds, artifact generation, and build isolation * Hands\-on experience with build systems and toolchains such as Make, CMake, Buck/Bazel or custom/in\-house build orchestration tools * Experience with large\-scale C/C\+\+ builds, including dependency pruning, static/dynamic linking tradeoffs, and reproducible containerized builds * Hands\-on familiarity with Linux\-based development environments, Docker, and the operational concerns of maintaining consistent build images and execution environments * Experience with CI pipelines and integrating build tooling into continuous integration workflows * Experience using engineering metrics to evaluate and improve build performance, reliability, and developer experience * Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross\-functionally with adjacent platform teams \#LI\-ONSITE **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:** * **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. * **Growth**: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®! * **Team**: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information. **ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:** Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you're invited to an interview. **OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:** We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. **Join us and bring your best.** **Bring your bold.** **Pure and simple.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to Team:** Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. Lodging Connectivity is the API\- and software\-driven backbone of our supply business, simplifying connectivity across lodging products through external\-facing APIs and platforms that enable partners to acquire, optimize, and maintain lodging supply. We are an AI\-forward team: we use AI across how we design, build, test, and operate software, and we are building AI\-enabled capabilities into our services. In this role, you will deliver traveler, partner, and company value with stable architecture, high quality, and operational excellence, and you will help set the bar for how our team uses AI responsibly and effectively. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and evolve reliable backend services, including system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of your daily engineering practice (design exploration, code generation, test authoring, refactoring, code review, debugging, and incident triage), and critically validate the output for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Design and ship AI/ML\-enabled capabilities in backend services, such as LLM\-powered features, agent and tool integrations, and retrieval or automation workflows, with attention to latency, cost, quality evaluation, and failure modes. * Define and promote team practices for responsible AI adoption: prompt and context management, evaluation and guardrails, data privacy, and compliance with EG security policies. * Implement high\-quality production code with an emphasis on automated testing, observability, performance, and operational excellence. * Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to translate customer and business requirements into robust backend solutions, reusable service integrations, and well\-structured data flows. * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of services and features: development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. * Use data, metrics, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize work, validate hypotheses, and measure the impact of both product changes and AI\-driven improvements to engineering productivity. Mentor engineers on effective, safe use of AI tooling and raise the team’s overall velocity and quality. * **Minimum Qualifications** **:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional experience building and operating production backend services in a team environment. * Demonstrated ownership of services or features across design, implementation, quality, deployment, and operational support. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling, applied in production systems. * Hands\-on, demonstrable proficiency with AI\-assisted development: you can describe specific workflows where AI tools measurably improved your speed or quality, and where they failed and how you caught it. Hands\-on experience integrating AI/ML or LLM capabilities into a production system (for example, calling model APIs, building tool or agent integrations, or operating ML\-backed services). * **Preferred Qualifications** **:** * Experience designing and evolving multi\-service backend architectures with well\-structured APIs, data models, and reliable data flows. * Demonstrated success improving high\-traffic or customer\-facing systems through performance tuning, resilience hardening, and reliability engineering. * Strong operational excellence: instrumentation, logging, metrics, alerting, on\-call participation, and incident response. * Experience with experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, and analytics to guide technical and product decisions. * Experience with LLM application patterns (RAG, tool calling/MCP, agent orchestration), evaluation frameworks, and observability for AI systems (token cost, latency, quality drift). * Experience building AI guardrails: input/output validation, prompt\-injection mitigation, PII handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Experience driving AI tooling adoption across a team, including playbooks, shared prompts or agent configurations, and measuring impact.
