jobs.title: Director, Global Technology - Core
jobs.description: **Company Description** “We’re not in the shipping business; we’re in the information business” \-Peter Rose, Expeditors Founder Global supply chain management is what we do, but at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. * 18,000 trained professionals * 350\+ locations worldwide across 60\+ countries * Fortune 500 * Globally unified systems **Job Description** **Why This Role Matters** Core is the foundation the rest of Expeditors builds on: the servers, networks, databases, cloud landing zones, collaboration platforms, messaging systems, endpoints, and delivery pipelines that every other technology team and employee depends on. The governing principle is not negotiable: protect the enterprise and accelerate value delivery. As Director, Core, you will lead a global organization through its transition from administration to engineering, from centralized decisions to distributed ownership, and from technology\-shaped estates to products with named customers and measurable outcomes. Success is measured not only by keeping the lights on, but by how far you advance that transformation while maintaining operational excellence. **Team and Technology** You will lead approximately 140 people across Corporate Headquarters, Spokane, and the Global Capability Center in Chennai through Senior Managers, Technical Product Managers, and Architects. The organization spans Private and Public Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Experience, User and Endpoint Systems, and data center facilities. Core delivers hybrid multi\-cloud management, developer experience, core back\-office enablement, and workplace and endpoint experience products. You will partner closely with Cybersecurity, Geographic Global Technology, Site Reliability Engineering, Technical Product Management, Architects, procurement, vendor management, and Legal while overseeing infrastructure, cloud, licensing, and technology provider relationships. **What Success Looks Like** * Every capability can name its customers, expected outcomes, and meaningful measures. * The domain is presented through data\-driven roadmaps, commitments, and operational health. * Infrastructure as Code adoption expands while manual production work is materially reduced. * Reliability practices and Cybersecurity controls are delivered through shared metrics and engineering practices. * Leadership bench strength, technical leadership, and strategic partnerships continue to deepen globally. **Key Areas of Impact** Coaching for Growth * Coach against the career grid, run skip\-level feedback, and calibrate expectations with peer Directors so that standards are consistently applied across locations. * Develop managers, architects, and engineers while building succession plans and leadership growth across the global organization. Delivering on Commitments * Own organizational commitments, lead capacity planning, manage departmental budgets across capital and operating expenditure, and ensure investments deliver measurable value. * Prioritize freight\-impacting work, manage operational and delivery risk, and maintain accountability for roadmap execution, operational health, and sustainable delivery. Hiring and Retaining Excellence * Fill critical leadership positions, strengthen product management and engineering capability, and hire leaders who combine domain expertise with software development experience. * Build a culture grounded in respect, trust, support, succession planning, and long\-term organizational capability. Technical Depth and Delivery * Lead the transition toward Infrastructure as Code, automation, and pipeline\-based delivery while establishing standards for reproducible environments and operational excellence. * Be accountable for technical decisions across the organization and champion AI\-assisted engineering tooling, automation, testing, reliability, and security practices. Architectural Scale * Participate in design decisions involving virtualization strategy, database modernization, hybrid reference architecture, observability, and on\-premises AI. * Govern through paved roads, architecture decision records, inner\-source contribution, and enterprise\-wide architectural ownership and standards. Team Collaboration Scale * Reduce coordination overhead, strengthen cross\-location partnerships, and sustain the trust\-based operating model that enables autonomous teams and shared ownership. * Partner with Cybersecurity, Site Reliability Engineering, Geographic Global Technology, and regional teams to deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries. Influence and Advocacy * Represent the domain through roadmap, capacity, commitment, and operational\-health data while making Core’s work visible across the organization. * Model the co\-founder mindset, advocate for customer\-focused outcomes, and influence technology strategy across stakeholders  employees, technical staff, customers, and governance functions. * Establish the strategic posture for critical infrastructure providers, manage multiple cost centers, and steward cloud commitments, platform investments, and third\-party risk. * Set the strategic posture for the providers behind critical infrastructure, working with procurement, vendor management, Cybersecurity and Legal so that renewal terms, exit options and third\-party risk are settled ahead of the compelling event rather than during it. *This position is on\-site and will reside in the greater Seattle, WA. area at one of the following locations depending on availability. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate. Relocation assistance is not offered for this position.* * *Downtown Seattle* * *Federal Way* * *Lynnwood* * *Bellevue (Factoria)* **Qualifications** **Qualifications for Success** Required * Substantial experience leading a technology organization of comparable scale, managing managers and senior individual contributors across multiple disciplines. * Experience leading infrastructure or platform teams through a transition toward engineering practice, including Infrastructure as Code, automation, and pipeline\-based delivery. * Technical credibility across infrastructure and platform domains sufficient to participate in architectural decisions and establish technical standards. * Experience leading distributed teams across regions and time zones while enabling local ownership and decision\-making. * Budget accountability across capital and operating expenditure and experience managing significant technology provider relationships. * Working fluency with agile delivery at scale and the ability to evolve practices to improve outcomes. * Experience partnering with Cybersecurity as a peer and delivering controls through engineering practices. * Experience with Agentic AI development processes and practices. Preferred * Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud environments where private infrastructure and multiple public clouds operate under a single model. * Experience establishing product management discipline within infrastructure organizations, including customer definition, roadmaps, and outcome measures. * Experience with site reliability engineering practices, service management platforms, and enterprise observability. * Experience working in regulated environments and control frameworks, including financial\-reporting controls over technology. * Experience in logistics, transportation, or other operationally intensive industries where system availability has immediate business consequences. *Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not transfer or sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (such as an H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.* **Additional Information** Base Salary: $100,000 Additional Compensation: This position is eligible for quarterly bonuses based on company performance. Bonus payments are discretionary and are not guaranteed. Historically, some employees in this position have achieved average total annual compensation of $271,00 or more when bonuses are included. Benefits: Expeditors offers competitive benefits to all full\-time employees including: * Paid vacation * Holidays (10\) * Flexible Days (2\) * Paid Sick Time (accrual rate of 1 hour of sick time per 30 hours paid) * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental \& Vision Coverage * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Life and Disability Insurance * Paid Parental Leave (additional eligibility criteria) * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DC FSA) * Commuter Benefit * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Training and Personnel Development Program * Educational Assistance and Reimbursement * Position is full time (40 hours per week) Monday through Friday *All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

jobs.title: Web Development & Maintenance Provider
jobs.description: ### **Request for Proposals:** ### **Web Development \+ Maintenance Provider** Issued October 16, 2026 Proposals due Friday, October 30 5:00 PM ET Washington, DC **At a glance** **Issuer:** FAS (Federation of American Scientists) **Engagement:** Enhancements to FAS.org, heatagenda.us, cri.fas.org, essentialdata.us, followed by an optional ongoing maintenance retainer. **Term:** December 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 for the enhancement project. A maintenance retainer may follow at FAS’s option. **Budget:** Not to exceed $14,500 for initial 6\-month engagement **Proposals due:** Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET **1\.Background and Strategic Foundations** ------------------------------------------- The Federation of American Scientists (FAS) is seeking a new provider of web development and maintenance services to lead an update of our current website. FAS is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3\) that has around 60 FTEs, a network of Senior Fellows and Advisors, and is supported largely by philanthropy. We are looking for a WordPress developer with strong design judgment who will learn how FAS works and recommend improvements to our main website and growing number of sister sites. If the initial project goes well, we expect to continue with the same provider for ongoing maintenance and future enhancements. Current website environment Bidders should use the following to estimate effort. FAS will share additional details with bidders on request. * **Platform:** WordPress 7\.1\.3; Custom theme; Page builder: Standard Wordpress with some custom blocktypes, including TablePress * **Hosting:** Gravitate. Hosting costs are not in the scope of this RFP. * **Original site build**: And–Now, 2023\. Current maintenance is provided by Gravitate, who will be available for handoff. * **Content volume:** approximately \~150 pages and 5,703 posts/publications; 1,140 staff and fellow bio pages. * **Key plugins and integrations:** YoastSEO (trial), TablePress plus custom dataviz embedding with Tableau and Datawrapper, Google Analytics 4, Meta Box \+ Meta Box AIO, Relevanssi Premium, SAR Friendly SMTP, Akismet Anti\-spam, Headers Security Advanced * **Existing microsites:** heatagenda.us and cri.fas.org, and essentialdata.us, plus legacy subdomains like nuke.fas.org, sgp.fas.org. * **Brand guidelines and design source files:** PDF available here. **2\. What we are asking you to do** ------------------------------------ **Scope of work** ----------------- All work applies site\-wide to FAS.org, heatagenda.us (static site), cri.fas.org (static site), essentialdata.us unless stated otherwise. For each item, the "Done when" line describes what FAS will accept as complete. The provider may recommend changes to these items during discovery; the approved plan (see Timeline) becomes the binding scope. ### **Base scope (required)** **A. Photo, video and data visualization components.** Reusable WordPress blocks or templates for carousels, image grids, video embeds and featured data visualizations, consistent with the current design language. * *Done when:* FAS staff can add and edit these components on any page or post without developer help, and they display correctly on mobile. **B. Social media integration.** Display of FAS social content on the homepage, staff and fellow bio pages, and publication pages. Platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn, X. Bidders should state whether they propose embeds or automated feeds, and note any third\-party API or subscription costs. * *Done when:* Content from the named platforms appears on the specified page types and updates without manual work, or with a documented manual process FAS approves. **C. Microsite template and navigation.** A reusable template for program microsites \[bidder to recommend , with consistent navigation between microsites and FAS.org. * *Done when:* FAS staff can launch a new microsite from the template, and one pilot microsite (highlighting our ‘Future of Science’ work), is live. **D. Miscellaneous improvements.** Ability to update footer (currently we lack ability to add social platforms or other outward links; CMS/WordPress\-managed redirects (currently we have to ask developers to do this; visible tags on publications * *Done when:* These items are present or alternative solutions are operational on FAS.org. ### **Optional items (price each separately)** FAS will decide which of these to fund during the planning phase, based on cost and remaining budget. * **Search across microsites**: a single search that returns results from FAS.org and all microsites. * **Bulk tag editing** in the WordPress admin. * **Google Analytics 4 improvements**: pass publication date and other post metadata to GA4; an analytics dashboard for staff. * **Data visualization**: improved DataWrapper embedding or native charts and tables in WordPress. * **Footnotes for publications**: ability to include “sidenotes” or “margin\-notes” (i.e. footnotes that don’t interrupt the reading experience). ### **Requirements that appl adlines. * FAS will provide staging and admin access, brand assets and content within \[5] business days of the provider's request. Delays on FAS's side extend the schedule accordingly. * We expect the provider to recommend better approaches when they see them, including telling us when a request is a poor use of budget. **Budget and pricing** FAS's budget for the base scope is not to exceed **$14,500**, as a fixed fee. Proposals should include: * A fixed fee for the base scope, broken down by phase and by item (A through D), with estimated hours and hourly rates. * A separate fixed price for each optional item. * Proposed maintenance pricing after May 2027: monthly retainer, hours included, what is covered (for example, WordPress core and plugin updates, security monitoring, backups, small content fixes), response times, and the hourly rate for work beyond the retainer. If a bidder believes the base scope cannot be delivered within the budget, the proposal should say which items or features should be reduced and why. **Payment schedule.** 20% on FAS approval of the plan; 50% on staging approval of all base\-scope features; 30% on final acceptance. Optional items are invoiced on acceptance. **Bidder qualifications** ------------------------- * Demonstrated WordPress development experience, including custom blocks and templates. * Past work for nonprofits, think tanks or policy organizations. * Both design and development capability in\-house: the ability to design components and then build and deploy them. Bidders who plan to use subcontractors must name them. **Proposal requirements** ------------------------- Submit a single PDF (maximum 10 pages, excluding team bios and appendices) to jwilson@fas.org by Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET. Include: * **Cover letter** signed by an authorized representative, naming the proposed project lead. * **Understanding and approach.** How you would address the base scope, and how you would extend the existing design language rather than replace it. * **Workplan.** Activities, milestones and dependencies by phase, consistent with the timeline above. * **Team and capacity.** Named individuals and their roles, and the project lead's expected hours per month on this engagement. * **Work samples.** Links to 3 to 5 live websites you designed or built, preferably WordPress sites for nonprofits or policy organizations. * **Case studies and references.** Three relevant client case studies and three client references FAS may contact. * **Pricing,** as described in Budget and pricing. * **Disclosures.** Current or recent work for organizations that closely overlap with FAS's mission or audience, and any other potential conflicts of interest. **Evaluation criteria** ----------------------- **Criterion** **Weight** Understanding of FAS's needs and fit with our working style 25% Design quality, based on work samples and case studies 25% Technical approach and WordPress capability 15% Team quality and committed capacity 15% Budget realism and value, including maintenance pricing 20% FAS may invite finalists to a 60 to 90 minute interview with the Chief of Staff, Communications Associate Director, Digital and Design Senior Manager. **RFP schedule** ---------------- RFP Released October 16, 2026 Proposals Due October 30, 2026 by 5:00 pm ET Finalists Interviews November 5 \- November 20, 2026 Selection Announced November 25, 2026 Contract Executed On or before December 4, 2026 Project Kickoff Week of December 7, 2026 **Terms** --------- * FAS will own all code, designs and other work product created under this engagement, and will receive full access to source code and credentials at handoff. * FAS may reject any or all proposals, request clarifications, or negotiate scope and price with any bidder. * FAS will not reimburse costs of preparing proposals. * Proposals will be kept confidential and used only for this selection. * The selected provider will sign FAS's standard services agreement. 94ORpnHfSs

This role ensures solutions are scalable, secure, and governed while delivering measurable operational efficiency and business value. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it We're looking for passionate \& experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be proficient in frontend engineering with ability to contribute to backend when necessary. We're looking for the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others as a Senior Software Engineer working for our Sportsbook domain. You will be working with the FanDuel Sportsbook application, providing our customers with a best\-in\-class experience as a frontend proficient Software Engineer. You'll play a pivotal part in making our platform highly usable and will write clear, scalable, and high\-quality code. You will work continuously to improve architecture and processes to improve quality and efficiency. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an Engineer unfamiliar with the system can understand. You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc). * You work on project ideas with stakeholders, and peers. * You own parts of product and technology and strive to become a subject matter expert. * You write simple and extendable code following standards and best practices. You test your code thoroughly. * You utilize AI\-powered tools to maximize efficiency. * You help balance customer requirements with the team requirements. * You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric/COE reviews. * You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with FanDuel policies. * You track security risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. * You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. * You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve the team software and processes. * You work to resolve the root cause of complex problems, leaving software better and easier to maintain than when you found it. * You mentor and help new team\-mates on how your team's software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture. * You foster a constructive dialogue and seek resolutions in a professional way. * You help recruit and interview for your team. * You estimate stories/tasks accurately and deliver them in time. * On\-call rotation where required. You provide excellent customer support on behalf of Technology. * You keep yourself up to date with market standards, and open\-source frameworks. * Most importantly, you are: humble, pragmatic, self\-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied and always challenging the norm. You demonstrate responsibility for the state of the code you both inherit and produce. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent work experience. * 5 or more years of Software Development experience in creating and maintaining mobile applications with experience in React and React Native. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and core web technologies (HTML and CSS) * A fundamental understanding of data structures and algorithms with experience working with backend for frontend (BFF) architectural patterns. * Proficient with prompting AI\-powered development tools Claude or Cursor to accelerate coding workflows, improve code quality, and increasing efficiency. * Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS). * Experienced with optimization utilizing monitoring and alerting tools like DataDog or Sentry. * Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tooling, preferably Jenkins or Buildkite. * Familiarity with Git, GitLab, Atlassian suite preferred. * Experience with unit testing, testing tools, integrating testing and best\-quality practices into an SDLC. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $138,000 \- $181,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.*** ***It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*** \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Founded in 1902, we have grown to meet the expanding financial needs of the communities we serve. Recognized both regionally and nationally for our *exceptional client experience*, we are an industry leader—embracing technology and continuously adding new products to best serve our clients. **Why Work at Fidelity?** For over a decade, Fidelity Bank has been ranked among the area’s top banks by local and national publications. We've also been recognized as one of the *best places to work*. A core part of our vision is to be the best bank for the community. In 2025, our bankers contributed more than **6,200 hours** of volunteer service and helped donate over **$1\.6 million** to nonprofit organizations across our markets. We're looking to hire *top talent* to join us in serving our community partners. The Director of Infrastructure \& Operations is responsible for the planning, delivery, operation, governance, and continuous improvement of the Bank's infrastructure, network, cloud, endpoint, telecommunications, and technology operations capabilities. This role partners with business and technology leaders to ensure technology platforms and operational services are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with organizational priorities. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director provides leadership for infrastructure engineering, network engineering, cloud services, endpoint management, technology operations, and operational resilience functions, ensuring technology services effectively support business operations while meeting security, regulatory, and operational requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the engineering, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of the Bank's infrastructure, network, cloud, endpoint, telecommunications, and technology operations capabilities. * Ensure the availability, performance, security, resiliency, and scalability of the Bank's technology platforms and services. * Oversee incident management, asset management, IT service management, disaster recovery, and technology operations processes. * Develop and maintain infrastructure roadmaps, technology investment priorities, and architectural standards that improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and security. * Manage technology vendors, strategic partners, contracts, and service providers. * Establish and maintain operational standards, procedures, monitoring, reporting, and service management practices. * Ensure infrastructure and operational services meet security, business continuity, compliance, audit, regulatory, and risk management requirements. * Develop, mentor, and lead infrastructure, network, cloud, endpoint, and related technology engineers. * Collaborate with business, security, and application leaders to ensure infrastructure capabilities effectively support organizational priorities and technology initiatives. * Evaluate and pilot emerging infrastructure, cloud, security, and operational technologies to improve reliability, resiliency, efficiency, and service delivery.

jobs.title: BMS Embedded Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid In this position... The Battery Management Embedded Software Engineer owns the base software platform beneath the application layer for high\-voltage battery management controllers — the real\-time operating system, hardware abstraction, drivers, communication stacks, software update mechanism, and security foundation. Assignments may include string\-level or system\-level battery management controllers and may shift across the product architecture over the life of the program. The ideal candidate has brought up embedded hardware from first power\-on, written drivers from datasheets, integrated and hardened communication stacks, and owned a production software update path. What you'll do... * Own board bring\-up and hardware abstraction: clocks, memory, timers, interrupts, watchdog, and system basis chip integration. * Configure and maintain the real\-time operating system and scheduling architecture; own task partitioning, timing budgets, and runtime monitoring. * Develop and integrate device drivers for cell monitoring front\-end devices, voltage and current measurement, isolation monitoring interfaces, analog and digital I/O, high\-side drivers, discrete inputs and outputs, and non\-volatile storage. * Own communication stacks and services, including automotive serial networks and diagnostic services. * Own the bootloader and the software flashing, update, and rollback mechanism, including update across multiple controllers. * Implement secure boot, secure flashing, secure debug access, signed image verification, and hardware security module key handling, in partnership with cybersecurity engineering. * Own persistent data logging and event storage, including storage media management, retention, and retrieval. * Own the embedded build environment, static analysis, unit test framework, and continuous integration pipeline. * Integrate application, controls, and algorithm software onto the platform; support application engineers with debug, tracing, and runtime measurement. * Define and document the base\-software\-to\-application interface so application development can proceed independently of the platform. * Support supplier software assessment and technical transfer. * Debug at the hardware level with oscilloscopes, logic and protocol analyzers, and on\-chip debuggers. You'll have... * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 5\+ years developing embedded software in C for resource\-constrained real\-time systems. * Strong microcontroller architecture fundamentals: memory maps, interrupts, DMA, timing, and determinism. * Production experience with a real\-time operating system or equivalent scheduling framework. * Driver development from datasheets and hands\-on hardware debug experience. * Communication protocol implementation experience including CAN or CAN FD. * Bootloader, flashing, or software update implementation experience. * Version control, code review, and continuous integration discipline. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to travel occasionally Even better, you may have... * Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science. * Battery management, high\-voltage, or safety\-relevant control unit software experience. * Layered automotive base software architecture experience. * Experience interfacing to cell monitoring front\-end devices over isolated serial or CAN\-based interfaces. * Secure boot, secure flashing, hardware security module, or cryptographic library integration. * Software development under functional safety and cybersecurity process requirements. * Familiarity with industrial communication protocol stacks in addition to automotive networks. * MISRA C compliance and static analysis toolchains. * Continuous integration and hardware\-in\-the\-loop automation for embedded targets. * Technical Skills + Embedded C for real\-time systems + Real\-time operating system configuration and scheduling + Hardware abstraction and driver development + Board bring\-up and hardware debug + Communication stacks and diagnostic services + Bootloader, flashing, update, and rollback + Secure boot, secure flashing, and key handling + Non\-volatile storage and data logging + Build environment, static analysis, and continuous integration + Base software to application interface definition + Timing analysis and runtime measurement You may not check every box, jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description: In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next\-generation AI capabilities. While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E\-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies. Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility. By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure. As an Embedded Software Engineer II, you will own specific components of our embedded stack, working close to the hardware on the real\-time firmware that our safety devices depend on. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare\-metal targets, architecting safety\-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real\-time targets and richer application environments. **What You'll Do** * **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C\+\+ firmware for safety\-critical embedded devices. * **Real\-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS\-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter\-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis. * **Bare\-Metal and Drivers:** Write low\-level peripheral drivers and board support code, and bring up new silicon from reset vector through to a running application. * **Platform Integration:** Interface RTOS devices with our Embedded Linux user\-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product. * **Pipeline \& Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on\-target and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test execution. * **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint. * **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508\) while maintaining development velocity. **What You Bring** * **Experience:** 3\-5 years of hands\-on embedded software development, with a substantial portion on RTOS or bare\-metal targets. * **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in C, along with working proficiency in C\+\+. * **RTOS Knowledge:** Solid production experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar, including scheduling, synchronization primitives, and interrupt\-driven design. * **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code. * **Linux Exposure:** Familiarity with Embedded Linux user\-space development, sufficient to integrate and debug across the RTOS and Linux boundary. * **Connectivity:** Familiarity with IP networking protocols and standard interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, USB, CAN). * **Tooling:** Experience with Python for scripting/automation and familiarity with CI/CD workflows. * **Debugging:** Comfort using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and GDB to troubleshoot hard\-to\-find bugs. * **Education:** B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with Zephyr specifically, including devicetree, Kconfig, and west\-based workflows. * Experience with wireless stacks (BLE, ISM, Wi\-Fi) on constrained devices. * Background in Functional Safety (FuSa) or working in regulated industries (Medical, Automotive, Aerospace). * Low\-level Linux knowledge of Board Support Packages (BSP) and device drivers. * Familiarity with static analysis, MISRA C, or other coding standards used in safety\-critical development. Base Compensation can range from $125,000 to $150,000 based on experience \& location. FORT Robotics uses AI\-assisted tools to help our recruiting team review and organize applications. These tools do not make hiring decisions; FORT employees make all decisions. To request an accommodation or a review without these tools, contact HR@fortrobotics.com

TypeScript/React a plus; AWS (Bedrock) or Azure * College degree or equivalent experience; advanced studies preferred * Financial services or mortgage domain experience strongly preferred **Keys to Success in This Role** * Forward\-deployed instinct: comfortable embedding with business teams and staying in the code * Insists on demonstrating value of AI Systems delivered * Plans before building: treats the spec and the evaluation set as first\-class deliverables, not afterthoughts * Systems thinker who designs for the next use case, not just the current one * Clear communicator with engineers, business owners, and executives * First 12–18 months, success criteria includes: * + Agentic workflow platform in production with at least two SFA use cases (credit risk, quality control) running on shared orchestration * + Evaluation harness and release gates adopted as the standard for all SFA agent promotions * + Observability layer live—trace lineage, cost telemetry, SLO dashboards—with runbooks handed to business owners * + Shared domain graph in use by both agentic workflows and the Business Rules platform * + Measurable reduction in time\-to\-production for new agentic capabilities **Current Freddie Mac employees please apply through the internal career site.** We consider all applicants for all positions without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, physical and mental disability, pregnancy, ethnicity, genetic information or any other protected categories under applicable federal, state or local laws. Operating at the intersection of style and function, we’re passionate about upholding the ethos that quality craftsmanship and practicality aren’t mutually exclusive. From panel systems and seating to desks, storage, and more, our team is busy year\-round creating everything needed for a total office solution. With headquarters and manufacturing in San Leandro, California and a plant in Suffolk, Virginia, our 630,000 square feet of facilities are equipped with state\-of\-the\-art equipment and skilled fabric and woodworkers. We craft product that helps teams get things done while feeling good doing it, regardless of industry — because at Fríant, all work styles are welcome. **Summary/Objective** The AI Engineer designs, develops, deploys, and maintains scalable AI\-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency, business intelligence, customer engagement, and process automation across Fríant. This hands\-on role combines software engineering, machine learning, large language models, AI automation, and enterprise system integration. The position works with business stakeholders, IT, Customer Success, Operations, Sales, and Product teams to translate complex requirements into secure, production\-ready AI solutions and supports the full AI lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** **AI Solution Development** * Design, build, and deploy jobs.title: AI Operations Associate
jobs.description: **linkAbout Fuel Cycle**: Fuel Cycle empowers leading organizations with agile research solutions that deliver decision\-ready insights — fast, flexible, and fully integrated. As a market research disruptor, our AI\-powered Insights Platform is built for speed, precision, and scale. With cutting\-edge tools and seamless audience connectivity, we help brands ditch the guesswork and make smarter, customer\-led decisions at lightning speed. **Why work at Fuel Cycle?** Join a high\-growth team where curiosity is valued, ownership is encouraged, and your work drives real\-world impact. Whether you’re based at our Los Angeles HQ, New York City hub, working remotely across the U.S., or part of our global team in India, you’ll help shape the future of decision intelligence for some of the world’s most iconic brands. **The Role:** The AI Operations Associate is Fuel Cycle’s AI transformation role, with one mission: make every function in the company AI\-native. We start with IT, Services, Sales, and Marketing. You’ll begin by owning our AI for IT stack. That means deploying agentic workflows across the Service Desk, application management, and cybersecurity operations. You’ll shape the roadmap alongside our Chief AI Officer, then build and ship it. This is not an IT Operations seat with AI bolted on. You’ll own the shift from manual, hand\-offs\-between\-people workflows to AI\-driven pipelines, and you’ll measure and report the business impact of each one. * If an agent can do the work, you build it. You architect, build, and deploy the replacement. * If it can’t yet, you make it possible. You fix the underlying data and re\-engineer the process until it can. AI for IT is your starting point, and from day one you’ll work in lockstep with Services, Marketing, and Finance. As our internal playbook matures, your scope grows to HR, Legal, Customer Success, and the rest of the enterprise. **Key Responsibilities** IT Operations (Initial focus) * Own the AI\-Native Service Desk \& App Automation: Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents capable of resolving IT help desk tickets independently. You will move beyond basic ticket triage to build self\-executing agentic workflows for software provisioning, account access management, hardware procurement, and system troubleshooting. * Ship Autonomous Security \& Network Pipelines: Design and deploy end\-to\-end AI pipelines that automate core cybersecurity operations and infrastructure tasks. This includes agentifying threat detection, anomaly isolation, routine patch management, firewall adjustments, and new user network configurations. * Optimize Enterprise IT Metrics via Agent Deployment: Deploy, monitor, and continuously tune agents against strict internal SLAs. You will own the optimization loops to ensure that agentic execution directly improves core IT performance metrics—slashing time\-to\-resolution, reducing system downtime, and eliminating manual routing bottlenecks. * Build the IT Intelligence Layer (BI Dashboards): Design and maintain robust Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards that grant real\-time visibility into infrastructure health, agent performance, software utilization, and security vectors. You will transform raw operational logs into a single, trusted source of truth for leadership. * Partner with Product Management to Shape the Field: Work in lockstep with the Product and Engineering teams to dogfood internal breakthroughs. You will act as "Customer Zero," feeding your real\-world IT operational telemetry and agent design patterns back into Fuel Cycle's core AI platform development lifecycle. **Broader Internal Operations (Expanding Scope)** * Identify and prioritize AI automation opportunities across all internal functions — HR, Legal, Customer Success, IT, and others — as GTM coverage matures. * Establish and own the internal AI operations playbook: how Fuel Cycle evaluates, deploys, and measures AI\-native replacements for manual workflows company\-wide. * Champion AI fluency across internal teams — helping department leaders understand what is automatable, what isn't yet, and what the roadmap looks like. * Partner with Product \& Engineering on the underlying platform and MCP infrastructure that powers internal agent surfaces. Systems, Data \& Measurement * Own the "single source of truth" standard across all functions you support — ensuring data is clean, definitions are agreed, and escalations over numbers are rare. * Instrument every AI workflow you deploy with evaluation loops so quality, accuracy, and reliability are continuously measured. * Maintain a clear, quantified view of manual hours displaced, workflow coverage, and time\-to\-answer improvement — and report it to leadership. **Your Success Metrics** * AI\-Native Coverage — Percentage of routine workflows across supported functions executed or materially assisted by AI agents. * Manual Hours Displaced — Dollar\-equivalent time returned to IT, and other operational leaders each quarter.   Competencies \& Attributes** * Strong systems thinker — able to hold Salesforce architecture, a marketing automation platform, a finance stack, and other internal tooling in view simultaneously and see the seams between them. * Fluent in AI\-native workflow concepts: agents, MCP, prompt engineering, evaluation loops, and human\-in\-the\-loop design. * Comfortable owning the "single source of truth" burden across multiple functions with competing priorities. * Communicates clearly with both technical (engineering) and commercial (sales, marketing, finance, operations) audiences. * Bias to build and ship — will prototype the replacement rather than document the current state. **Required Experience \& Technical Skills** * Track record of building and shipping solutions with AI in a business context. * Hands\-on experience with agentic development: Claude Code, MCP, prompt engineering, evaluation loops. * Python for data analysis and automation; SQL for querying and reporting. * Familiarity with enterprise operational systems (CRM, marketing automation, ERP, BI) — enough to build against them, with willingness to become fluent across the stack. * Comfort with ambiguity and strong prioritization instincts across a broad operational scope. **Benefits \& Perks:** Fuel Cycle is committed to supporting the well\-being, flexibility, and growth of our team. We offer a competitive and inclusive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * **401(k) with Company Match**: Plan for your future with our retirement savings program * **Equity Purchase Option**: Participate in Fuel Cycle’s long\-term success * **Flexible Work Schedule**: Empowering you to balance life and work * **Generous Time Off**: + 15 vacation days and 7 sick days per year + 12 company holidays + 4 floating holidays/recharge days to rest or celebrate what matters to you * **Paid Parental Leave**: Time to bond with your growing family * **Monthly Internet \& Phone Stipend**: Support for remote work setup * **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks**: Access to tools like **Rightway (healthcare navigation), Headspace (mental wellness), Peloton (fitness)**, and more * **Team Connection Perks**: + **Weekly community lunches**, refreshments, and snacks at our LA \& NY headquarters **Compensation Overview:** The expected starting salary range for this position is **$85,000 \- $105,000\.** This range represents the typical starting compensation offered to candidates hired into this role. Final base salary will be determined based on a variety of factors, including location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education, and certifications. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Equal Opportunity:** At Fuel Cycle, we embrace the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to fostering an inclusive company culture. We believe that everyone, regardless of their background or identity, should have equal access to opportunities for growth and advancement. Our selection processes and career pathways are designed to be fair, transparent, and free from bias. We value the unique perspectives and contributions of each team member, knowing that this diverse range of experiences strengthens our team. Fuel Cycle stands firmly against discrimination based on disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law. Fuel Cycle is an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities, as needed, to enable them to perform the essential functions of their job and participate in the application and interview process. If you require accommodations during any part of the application process, please contact us at hr@fuelcycle.com to discuss your needs. \#li\-hybrid Compensation Range: $85K \- $105K

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Engineer — Evals & Model Quality
jobs.description: **About Us** At FurtherAI, we’re building the AI agents that run insurance — a trillion\-dollar industry still powered by manual work. By combining frontier agentic AI with deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how the industry’s most critical work gets done. We’ve raised more than $30M from top investors (Andreessen Horowitz, YC, Nexus, South Park Commons), grown more than XY00% in the last 12 months, and work with some of the largest names in insurance — top 10 carriers/brokers, Fortune 100 companies, and public companies. We are a deeply technical company. Both founders are engineers, and engineers have an outsized say on product direction. Now, we’re looking for an exceptional AI Engineer to own how we evaluate and continuously improve the quality of AI agents across our platform. **Why Join Us** * **Outsized ambition:** We’re out to build the definitive AI company for insurance — and we’re moving faster than anyone in the space. * **Elite team:** Founders and engineers from the best companies and schools in the world — ex\-Apple AI Research, Brex, Coinbase, and Uber; 4 YC founders and 6 ex\-founders; grads of Stanford, Berkeley, IITs, and Cornell. * **Massive market impact:** Insurance is the backbone of global commerce. Our work reshapes how the industry operates. * **Founder’s mindset:** Own big pieces of the product from day one — ideal if you want to start your own company one day. **What You’ll Do** * **Own evaluations across FurtherAI:** Build the evaluation frameworks and infrastructure that measure the accuracy, quality, and reliability of our AI agents across workflows, Assistant, document processing, and computer use. * **Build high\-quality datasets:** Develop golden datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers and domain experts to capture real\-world insurance tasks and edge cases. * **Evaluate complex agent behavior:** Design evaluations for multi\-step agent trajectories, tool use, reasoning, and end\-to\-end task completion — not just individual LLM responses. * **Build automated grading systems:** Develop LLM\-as\-judge evaluations, deterministic graders, human evaluation workflows, and rubrics that accurately reflect real\-world quality. * **Make development evaluation\-driven:** Integrate offline and online evaluations into development and release processes so engineers can measure improvements, catch regressions, and ship confidently. * **Drive model evaluation and selection:** Continuously benchmark frontier and open\-weight models across accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Use results to inform model selection, upgrades, and production releases. * **Build continuous improvement loops:** Turn production failures, customer feedback, and agent traces into new evaluation cases and measurable improvements in agent quality. **Representative Projects** * Build an end\-to\-end evaluation framework for FurtherAI agents, measuring success across multi\-step workflows, tool calls, and complex insurance tasks. * Create a library of golden datasets and benchmarks for common insurance workflows, reusable across customer implementations and out\-of\-the\-box AI skills. * Build an automated benchmarking system that evaluates new frontier and open\-weight model releases and identifies the best models for different tasks. * Develop production evaluation pipelines that detect quality regressions, identify failure patterns, and turn them into actionable improvements. **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building production AI/ML systems. * Experience building evaluation frameworks, LLM\-based applications, model benchmarking systems, or applied AI infrastructure. * Strong understanding of modern LLMs, agent architectures, evaluation methodologies, and model performance tradeoffs. * Strong Python engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, production\-grade systems. * Ability to independently own ambiguous technical problems, from research and experimentation through production. * Clear communicator — both in person and in writing. * Bonus: Experience with LLM\-as\-judge, human evaluation systems, agent trajectory evaluations, or large\-scale benchmarking. * Bonus: Experience with open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, post\-training, or model routing. * Bonus: Background in B2B SaaS and 0\-to\-1 experience. * Above all: drive, grit, and ownership. If you excel here, other requirements are secondary. At FurtherAI, we set a high bar. We’re not looking for someone who just wants a job. We’re looking for someone who wants to build something transformative. If you thrive in environments where the pace is fast, expectations are high, and the rewards are outsized, you’ll love it here. **You can look forward to the following benefits:** * Fully covered, best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision benefits * Competitive compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * Outstanding in\-office culture in the heart of San Francisco, 5x per week * Lunch and dinner onsite * Team events, such as happy hours and off\-sites * Pre\-tax commuter benefits Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K

jobs.description: **Job Description** ### **About Us** Core IT is responsible for delivering and maintaining the technology, platforms, and services that help teams across GM do their best work. For example, our design team’s brand guidelines live in Figma. Instead of maintaining static templates, we built an AI skill that reads the guidelines directly, drafts on\-brand presentations, and runs a linter that catches off\-brand choices. across multiple teams or organizations. * Hands\-on experience designing and building AI\- or LLM\-enabled applications, agents, or automations across a wide range of AI tools and models, not just one jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Systems Administrator **Job Summary:** The Kansas City Royals are committed to creating a first\-class experience for our fans, employees, players, and partners. We offer a fast\-paced, collaborative environment where every team member contributes to the success of our organization, the experiences of our fans, and the impact we make throughout our community. We are seeking a motivated Systems Administrator to join our Enterprise Technology team. This role will focus on the administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Microsoft technology environment, while also supporting Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), virtualization, networking, backup, and other core technology services. Position Accountabilities/Responsibilities Microsoft Systems Administration * Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, licensing, and related collaboration services. * Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including users, groups, permissions, authentication, MFA, Conditional Access, Group Policy, and identity lifecycle management. * Support Microsoft Intune and endpoint management, including device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, security policies, and device lifecycle management. * Support Microsoft Defender and Microsoft security services, including endpoint protection, identity security, email security, monitoring, and remediation. * Monitor, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve the Microsoft environment while supporting tenant configuration, service health, security, licensing, and adoption of new Microsoft technologies. Windows \& Infrastructure Administration * Administer and support Windows Server and virtual server environments, including VMware, Hyper\-V, and related infrastructure. * Support core infrastructure services including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file services, permissions, and authentication. * Administer and support the organization's IPTV system, including channel configuration, receivers, and content delivery. * Support and maintain infrastructure monitoring and alerting tools to monitor system health, availability, performance, and capacity. * Administer and monitor enterprise file storage and server backup/recovery systems, including backup jobs, retention, backup validation, restore testing, and data recovery. * Support Azure, AWS, and GCP cloud environments, as well as related infrastructure, connectivity, monitoring, and system integrations. Security, Compliance \& Lifecycle Management * Support system security and hardening, including vulnerability remediation, security configuration, MFA, Conditional Access, and endpoint security. * Perform server and endpoint patching, software updates, and routine maintenance. * Support technology lifecycle management, including hardware refreshes, operating system upgrades, software deployments, and system migrations. * Participate in backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities, including testing and recovery validation. Implementation \& Operations * Execute routine infrastructure and Microsoft 365 changes in accordance with established change management processes. * Assist with building, configuring, maintaining, and supporting development, test, and production environments. * Participate in technology projects involving Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Windows Server, Intune, security, cloud services, and infrastructure. * Participate in on\-call rotation and provide technical support during games, special events, and other critical organizational activities as needed. * Develop automation and administrative efficiencies using PowerShell and Microsoft management tools where appropriate. * Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Position Qualifications, Skills, and Experience Required * 2–4 years of experience in systems administration, Microsoft 365 administration, infrastructure support, cloud administration, or a related technology environment. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, and licensing. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including users, groups, authentication, MFA, permissions, Group Policy, and identity lifecycle management. * Experience with Exchange Online administration and troubleshooting, including mailboxes, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, permissions, and mail flow. * Experience with or working knowledge of Microsoft Intune and endpoint management. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft security technologies preferred. * Basic to intermediate experience administering Windows Server, including DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, Group Policy, file services, and system troubleshoo ucture and cloud environments. * Basic networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless connectivity, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with backup/recovery, endpoint management, monitoring, vulnerability management, patch management, or security tools preferred. * Experience supporting multiple locations or distributed technology environments preferred. Professional Capabilities * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues and follow them through resolution. * Ability to independently administer and troubleshoot Microsoft technologies while appropriately escalating complex issues. * Strong understanding of identity, access, security, and system administration principles. * Ability to learn new Microsoft technologies and adapt to changes in the Microsoft 365 and cloud ecosystem. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment, including during games and major events. * Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong customer service mindset and ability to collaborate across departments. * High degree of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and sound judgment. * Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on organizational and event needs. Preferred Certifications * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Microsoft 365 Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator * Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals * AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect * Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer * CompTIA Server\+, Network\+, or Security\+ * Other relevant Microsoft, cloud, or infrastructure certifications **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to lift items weighing as much as 50 pounds * Must be able to be productive utilizing a computer keyboard and telephone * Must be able to be productive in a work environment where the noise level can be high at times * Must be comfortable walking to navigate the facility to access the office, concourse, etc. * Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as required by deadlines and event scheduling The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This role is a Full\-Time, Exempt opportunity that is eligible for Company Benefits, 401K, and PTO. This role is expected to have a standard 40\-hour work week. We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, the Kansas City Royals will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, the Club also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions please inquire with Human Resources by email at humanresources@royals.com. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB INFORMATION:** **Job Title:** Senior AI Engineer **Department(s):** 5072 \- Information Technology **Location(s):** Garden City Terminal **FLSA Status:** Exempt **JOB OVERVIEW:** Under general supervision of the Director of IT – Application Development, the Senior AI Engineer designs, develops, and maintains scalable data pipelines, cloud\-based data platforms, and AI/ML solutions that support enterprise analytics and business decision\-making. The incumbent collaborates with business and technical stakeholders to define analytical objectives, develop research frameworks, and gather, integrate, and analyze complex structured and unstructured data. trains, validates, evaluates, and optimizes AI/ML and statistical models. * Deploys, monitors, and optimizes production AI/ML solutions and data pipelines to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance. * Translates complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights through written reports, dashboards, and oral presentations to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Evaluates data engineering, AI/ML, cloud, and analytics technologies, recommending improvements and selecting appropriate tools and platforms. * Conducts stakeholder interviews and data discovery activities to define analytical objectives and identify relevant data sources. * Prepares project scoping documents including feasibility assessments, data requirements, and resource estimates for management review. * Provides technical guidance and mentorship to Analysts, Operations specialists, software engineers, and other technical staff throughout the data and AI solution lifecycle. * Ensures compliance with data governance, information security, privacy requirements, and responsible AI practices in all data and modeling activities. * Performs other duties as assigned * Complies with all policies and standards **JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities** * Expertise in Python required, with experience using data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. High * Experience building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models in production environments, including familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management. High **Experience** * Minimum of five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise data engineering and AI/ML solutions, including data pipelines, cloud\-based data platforms, predictive modeling, and production AI/ML systems. Required * Experience working in cloud environments and supporting enterprise analytics and data\-driven decision\-making Required **Education** * Required Bachelor's Degree Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related quantitative field * Preferred Master's Degree master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field **Licenses \& Certifications** * TWIC \- Transportation Worker Identification Credential Required * Driver's License \- Valid state driver's license Required Note: This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, job requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. Gleason products are used by customers in e\-mobility, commercial vehicles, aerospace, agriculture, mining, sustainable energy, construction, power tools, marine and many other industries Working for Gleason, you will be connected to work that matters, putting your expertise to its best use while developing skills for the future. The result is a career defined by you, supported by Gleason and built on tangible accomplishments. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for the right people to join us on our mission. If you are interested in being part of our team, there are a few things you should know: We are energized by challenges and the effort needed to solve them. We like working with people who are positive, adaptable and growth\-minded. We care how work gets accomplished and are deeply invested in the success of our customers and colleagues. If this sounds like you, we invite you to read on and learn more. Why work at Gleason? * Excellent benefits package including a 6% Company 401(k) match * Flexible scheduling * Tuition Assistance Program * Employee Assistance Program * Formal and informal Development opportunities. Senior Software Engineer (R\&D) **Summary:** This is a senior level role in the R\&D department, and responsible for the integration of a new generation of R\&D software within an enterprise ecosystem. The R\&D department is customer driven, with decades\-long world\-class partnerships and a wide variety of exciting technologies. Maintaining these partnerships requires delivering high quality software within a timely manner and keeping up with modern industrial security requirements, and automation practices. This role requires both independent, strategic thinking, and the ability to work cross functionally to succeed. **The overall technology stack includes:** C\#, .NET 4\.8/10, .NET Core APIs, Python, Blazor, WPF, AWS and Azure services **Key responsibilities include:** * Taking leadership in a variety of high impact projects, from the design phase to delivery * Designing, implementing, testing, verifying, deploying, and maintaining engineering software and porting legacy engineering software to modern computing architectures * Troubleshooting software issues, refactoring software to improve capability and performance while working with subject matter experts * Interface with other team members and support groups across the Gleason Family of Companies * Providing mentorship to junior\-level engineers, including guidance for design, and best coding practices **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering and 5\-8 years of professional software development experience * Extensive Software development experience in C\#, .NET, Python, Go, Java or similar object\-oriented language * Experience in Desktop development for Windows (I.E WPF or WinForms) * Experience in using Source Control, Modern IDEs and DevOps tools including Agentic AI / LLM Technologies * Ability to work in an Agile Cross Functional Team environment where team members may include Customers, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Mathematicians, Gear Process Specialists and Gear Machine operators * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Desire to learn new programming languages and technologies as requirements evolve Additional Desired Experience * Experience in Cloud technologies (AWS is a huge plus) * Experience in web development in Blazor * Experience with WPF is a huge plus * Experience with CI/CD pipelines The salary range in this posting depends on qualifications and experience.
