jobs.title: Data Center Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Our Information Technology team builds, maintains, and continuously improves the infrastructure supporting our trading and business operations. We value technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and efficient service delivery. GTS is a collection of financial services companies spanning a wide array of asset classes and investment approaches, all powered by the combination of market expertise with innovative, proprietary technology. With roots as a quantitative trading firm continually building for the future, the GTS family of companies are able to leverage the latest in artificial intelligence systems and sophisticated pricing models to bring consistency, efficiency, and transparency to today’s financial markets. GTS’s electronic market maker GTS Securities accounts for 3\-5% of daily cash equities volume in the U.S. and is a leading Designated Market Maker (DMM) at the New York Stock Exchange, responsible for nearly $13 trillion of market capitalization. For more information on GTS, please visit www.gtsx.com. GTS is seeking a hands\-on Data Center Engineer to support the deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational reliability of our physical technology infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings strong server hardware, cabling, networking, and data center operations experience, along with the ability to respond effectively to time\-sensitive issues in a high\-availability environment. This role requires flexibility to work a nontraditional schedule, as much of our infrastructure maintenance and deployment activity takes place after the financial markets close. Typical working hours begin around 12:00 p.m. and extend until approximately 8:00–9:00 p.m., with daily variations based on operational needs. Occasional weekend work is also required. Responsibilities: * Serve as a primary technical contact for data center infrastructure issues, responding to incidents, service tickets, and hardware failures with urgency and precision. * Install, rack, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and replace servers, network equipment, components, and associated hardware. * Deploy, test, label, troubleshoot, and maintain copper, twinax, AOC, and fiber\-optic cabling, ensuring clean and organized installations. * Manage rack\-level power distribution, load balancing, and redundancy in accordance with operational best practices. * Diagnose hardware, connectivity, and basic Linux/networking issues, collaborating with engineering and IT teams to resolve complex problems. * Maintain accurate asset inventories, coordinate equipment shipping and receiving, and oversee hardware installations, replacements, and decommissioning. * Coordinate with vendors, colocation providers, and remote smart\-hands teams to support infrastructure operations. * Maintain organized, secure, and operationally ready data center environments, including racks, cabling, equipment, and work areas. * Follow, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, technical documentation, ticketing workflows, and incident\-resolution processes. * Support infrastructure projects and operational activities across NY/NJ data center locations. Qualifications: * 5 \+ years of Data Center Experience, financial services or telecommunications preferred. * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. * Experience installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise servers and network hardware. * Server management (iDRAC, iLO, IPMI) and component swaps (drives, memory, PSUs, NICs). * Proficiency with copper, twinax, AOC, and fiber\-optic cabling, including termination, testing, labeling, and troubleshooting. Single\-mode and multi\-mode fiber, LC/MPO connectors, SFP/QSFP optics, fiber cleaning and inspection. * Working knowledge of rack\-level power distribution, redundancy, and equipment installation best practices. * Foundational networking knowledge and familiarity with common network troubleshooting commands and cable\-testing tools. (TCP/IP, VLANs, link troubleshooting, ping/traceroute/ethtool, Dark Fiber). * Working knowledge of Linux systems and basic command\-line operations. (logs, interfaces, hardware status). * Ability to diagnose issues involving both hardware and software and work effectively with specialized engineering teams. * Experience with ticketing systems, inventory management, technical documentation, and vendor coordination. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, communication, and ability to remain effective under pressure. * Valid driver's license, access to a vehicle, and willingness to travel throughout the NY/NJ tri\-state area. * Ability to safely lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Flexibility to work a later\-day schedule (typically 12:00 p.m.–8:00/9:00 p.m.), with varying hours and occasional weekend work based on operational requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data center infrastructure within financial services, electronic trading, broker\-dealers, or other capital markets environments. *In accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $165,000\. Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits.* **Benefits:** Core Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage with generous employer contribution for employees and dependents. 401k match. Perks: Daily Meal Allowance, Equinox Corporate Membership Rate, Snacks, Office Game Room, Casual Dress. Hybrid Work Policy: 4 Days a Week in office, Fridays can be worked from home. *Please note: The use of AI tools during interviews is strictly prohibited, unless explicitly agreed upon.* All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Unsolicited resumes: We do not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with GTS.

jobs.title: Front End JavaScript / TypeScript Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ ### **About the Company** GoGoGrandparent’s (GoGo’s) mission is to help older adults live independently in their home for as long as possible. We do that by tailoring existing on demand apps to the needs of people living with mobility, visual, cognitive and dexterity impairments and letting older adults use them by making a phone call. After ordering, our service becomes a virtual caregiver that monitors the instrumental activities of daily living (mobility, meals, groceries, medication delivery \& home management) for tens of thousands of older adults around the United States. We’re profitable, have been around since 2016 \& haven’t raised any venture capital financing to date. The company was inspired by the cofounder’s grandmother, who still uses us to this day (she’s turning 95 in March)! Our engineering team is fully remote, tight\-knit, and moves fast. You’ll work closely with founders, ship meaningful features weekly, and have real ownership over architecture, reliability, and product direction. * **This is a fully remote position** **\*** **Must be able to work US timezones or 4\+ hours overlap with mainland US** ### **Job Summary** We have a Webflow designer who owns layout and CMS. He does not write JavaScript. You will own everything that makes our Webflow pages work: registration, payments, service checks, analytics, cookies, and talking to our APIs. You will also take the code from concatenated ES5/jQuery to TypeScript with a real build pipeline, without breaking production landing pages. You are not a backend hire. You are expected to read our Node/TypeScript/GraphQL/REST API well enough to decide which endpoint to call, what to send, what comes back, and what happens when it fails. We do not have complete, trustworthy API documentation for this. The source, and its tests, is the documentation. You need to be comfortable communicating and working directly with our marketing team and other company stakeholders. ### **What you will actually do** Product / integration * Wire Webflow forms and pages to existing REST and GraphQL endpoints: callers, loved ones, membership, Stripe payment, service\-area checks, grocery/home\-services leads, error logging. * Own multi\-step registration: validation, session persistence, step navigation, auth tokens, 401 handling, partner vs consumer flows. * Keep Stripe Elements, phone inputs, cookies, and tracking working across many landing\-page variants. * Coordinate with the Webflow person on DOM IDs, *required* attributes, and page structure. Our form reader is DOM\-driven; a wrong ID on a Webflow page is a production bug. * Take responsibility for our Playwright test coverage and add more tests as needed. Reading the backend (required, not optional) * Open the relevant route/controller in our backend (TypeScript, Express\-style routes, controllers, some GraphQL) and extract: HTTP method, path, auth, request body/query, success payload, error codes and shapes. * Use existing route tests as a second source of truth when the handler is messy. * Choose the right endpoint for the page (create vs patch, REST vs GraphQL, payment intent vs caller update). Calling the wrong one, or omitting a field the controller actually requires, is a failed task. * When the API cannot do what the page needs, write a clear request for backend (expected input/output, current behavior, what's missing). You will not be expected to own large backend changes. Engineering * Over time, migrate the codebase from JS IIFE modules to TypeScript. * Replace concat \+ Terser with a real bundler (esbuild/Vite/Rollup). * Untangle globals, jQuery, and implicit script order without a rewrite that takes the site down. ### **What the systems look like** Client * We use Webflow: a visual web design and development platform that lets you create, build, and host custom websites without writing manual production code, while also supporting custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for advanced functionality and customization. * Vanilla JS \+ jQuery, IIFEs, concatenated in a fixed file order. * Playwright tests already use TypeScript. App code does not. API * Large TypeScript Node service. Registration and billing are not a tiny CRUD layer; controllers have real business rules. * Auth is typically bearer tokens; some flows differ (partner vs consumer). * Error responses are not always uniform. You have to read the handler. ### **You Should Be Strong At** * JavaScript and TypeScript in the browser (DOM, events, fetch/XHR, cookies, localStorage, CORS). * Reading other people's TypeScript: routes, controllers, types, tests. You do not need to write production backend, but you cannot treat the API as a black box or wait for a spec. * Mapping a form to a real endpoint: required vs optional fields, nested payloads, auth headers, 4xx handling. Incremental migration: JS TS, globals* modules, without freezing feature work. * Build tooling: bundlers, source maps, minify, watch, CI. * Working with a designer who does not write JS: explicit contracts (element IDs, data attributes). * Playwright or similar for user flows. * Nice to Have: Stripe.js, Webflow custom code, analytics pixels, GraphQL, having changed a small backend endpoint yourself. ### **Seniority** Mid to Senior level. You should be able to: * Take a new landing flow, find the right backend endpoints, wire the page, test it, ship it — without someone translating the API for you. * Propose a TS \+ bundler plan and execute it in slices. * Push back when Webflow structure will break the JS, or when the API cannot support the page as designed. ### **How We Will Measure Success (first 6–12 months)** * You own our Webflow flows end\-to\-end: page contract, JS, correct API usage (from reading backend code), Playwright, ship. * You can explain, from the backend source, why a given page calls the endpoints it calls. * App source is being migrated to TypeScript (or a clear majority, with a path for the rest). * Build is a real pipeline: typed, module\-aware, minified, source maps, documented deploy. ### **Benefits** * Fully remote position * $80k – $120k (based on location, experience and seniority) * Paid holidays * Personal Time\-off of 15 days at start * Engineering team retreat * US Employees + Healthcare Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision) + 401k Plan **About the interview** ----------------------- 2\-stage interview process Show more

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. **This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.** **The Opportunity:** -------------------- We build **Tempo**, the open\-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack. 2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI\-driven assistants). Over the next year, you will help us: * Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes. * Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction. * Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher\-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM\-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on. * Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30\-day query ranges to match competitors. * Prepare Tempo for an agent\-driven world: larger, burstier, higher\-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI\-powered workflows, such as assistant\-driven triage and “why is this slow?”\- style investigations. **What You’ll Be Doing:** ------------------------- As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team. * **Deliver significant technical projects.** Take well\-scoped, multi\-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross\-team direction. * **Own major components of Tempo.** Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade\-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team. * **Build APIs for humans and agents.** Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM\-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably. * **Contribute to operational excellence.** Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts. * **Collaborate with Product and sibling teams.** Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them. * **Mentor and support engineers.** Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid\-level engineers. * **Participate in on\-call** for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post\-incident learning. * **Contribute to open source.** Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the o pose\-built on\-disk formats for analytical workloads. * Experience operating multi\-tenant, multi\-cell SaaS infrastructure at scale on Kubernetes. * Experience building for AI/LLM consumers: structured APIs, metadata/discovery endpoints, deterministic outputs, evaluation harnesses. * Open\-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open. * Experience as an on\-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab). * Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team. **How we work** --------------- We are a remote\-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our senior engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product. In US, the OTE (On\-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $154,445 \- $185\.334\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **About GridPoint** GridPoint is a private equity backed technology leader with a mission to accelerate the world's transition to a sustainable future by creating an intelligent energy network of grid\-interactive buildings. Our technology platform harnesses the power and potential within a building to deliver energy, operational, and resiliency benefits — spanning Fortune 500 enterprises, utilities, government organizations, and small businesses. **About the Role** GridPoint is hiring a Software Engineer II for the Application Firmware team. You will work in Elixir on the firmware running our in\-building energy controllers, the layer between our bare\-metal firmware and the GridPoint cloud. The work varies. A device\-side control feature one month, a telemetry pipeline the next, a field failure after that. The target does not vary: constrained hardware installed incustomer buildings, where memory, CPU, and network are all finite. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain features in our Elixir application firmware, from story to release * Structure application services as OTP supervision trees with isolated, restartableprocesses * Define and implement device control logic, scheduling, local data collection, andconfiguration * Develop solutions that function within the memory, CPU, and storage limits of thetarget hardware * Debug on real hardware: bench units, serial consoles, and logs from the field * Maintain the interfaces to the GridPoint cloud for telemetry, control, and config sync * Verify your own work on hardware before calling it ready to ship * Work with stakeholders to define test plans and develop them alongside the solution * Work with the Bare\-Metal Firmware and Hardware teams on drivers, bring\-up, andpower behavior **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, orequivalent experience * 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience * Elixir, or strong functional programming experience and a record of picking up newlanguages * Understanding of concurrent, fault\-tolerant design: processes, message passing,supervision * Enough embedded or systems background to design within hardware limits * Comfortable debugging on physical devices, not only locally * Git\-based development and code review Preferred * Production Elixir and OTP; Nerves or similar * Enough C/C\+\+ to read embedded firmware and work with the bare\-metal team * Device telemetry, OTA update, or fleet management * MQTT, Wi\-Fi, cellular, or LoRaWAN * Control protocols such as Modbus and BACnet, over both serial and TCP * Energy management, building automation, HVAC controls, or commercial IoT * Working alongside hardware and QA through bring\-up and validation **What Success Looks Like** Level II is where an engineer delivers a feature end to end without close supervision. The first year should look roughly like this. **Milestone** **What we expec**t 3 months Shipping scoped features through normal review; at home in the codebase and on bench hardware 6 momths Owning a feature area from design through field validation; taking part in release validation and triage 12 months Turning vague requests into designs the team agrees on; mentoring newer engineers; trusted to judge release risk Annual Salary Range: $135,000 to $175,000

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Grove Street Games is seeking a full\-time systems engineer to join our team in Gainesville. Here you will focus on creating and improving systems across all of our projects and platforms. Work with top game franchises and current generation consoles and have your work impact millions of players! You will work closely with design and QA to implement, debug, and iterate on core game systems that serve as the backbone of the games we create. The successful candidate needs to be able to develop an expert level understanding of Unreal Engine and also has strong knowledge of how to optimize game code and systems. When you join Grove Street Games, you come into a work environment that allows our employees to thrive, not just on their career paths but also on their personal journeys. We take a lot of pride in creating a foundation our employees can utilize to not only get ahead in their dreams but also create lasting games that millions of players will be able to enjoy. **Some projects our Systems Engineers have worked on in the past include:** * Developed a top of the line modding integration for ARK: Survival Ascended, allowing creators to develop mods that are distributed to PC and console players alike. Mods for ARK have now been downloaded hundreds of millions of times. * Constructed a custom total destructible world system for BeastLink, providing support for fully destructible, networked environments at a city\-wide scale. This involved a combination of clever game logic and heavy modifications to Unreal’s Nanite technology. * Designed and implemented a secure account system using a combination of trusted end\-points in our hosted servers and Epic Online Services to provide a sustainable progression system for our players. **Responsibilities** * Project and source code ownership * Architect and implement game systems that are inherently adaptive to new technology * Meet and exceed your commitments on a regular basis * Provide effective solutions to the difficult systems engineering problems * Participate and contribute creatively in team discussions, critiques, and game development ideas * Maintain the production pipeline while meeting deadlines * Long\-term thinking with respect to major design and technology choices **Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or work experience in a relatable field * Absolute fluency in C\+\+ and ability to easily pick up other languages * Strong debugging skills * Self motivated, with the ability to work both independently and on a team * Excellent communication skills, both written \& verbal * Work on\-site in Gainesville. This job is not remote. **Good to have** * Unreal Engine expertise * Previous experience working in multiple game engines * Passion and knowledge of video games **Benefits** * Flexible bank for time off (vacation, sick, personal) * Comprehensive health package * Flexible work day built around our core hours of 10:30am \- 4:30pm * Moving assistance * Royalties (with tenure) * Yearly bonuses * Career development assistance If all of this sounds like something you want to be a part of, joining a cohesive team that likes to have fun while being professionals, then let us know. Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bioinformatics
jobs.description: **Company Description** Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real\-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early\-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook . **Position Summary:** We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Bioinformatics to design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions supporting bioinformatics, life sciences, and clinical diagnostic applications. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who combines strong full\-stack development skills with an interest in applying modern software engineering and AI\-assisted development practices to complex scientific and clinical workflows. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with geographically distributed and cross\-functional teams, and building high\-quality software where reliability, traceability, and maintainability are essential. Key Responsibilities: * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust software applications and services supporting bioinformatics and clinical workflows. * Build scalable backend services and APIs using Python and modern web frameworks such as Django and FastAPI. * Develop responsive and maintainable user interfaces using modern frontend technologies such as React. * Design and optimize relational data models and database solutions using PostgreSQL. * Architect, deploy, and operate applications and services in AWS environments. * Apply sound software engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, security, and infrastructure automation. * Partner with bioinformatics scientists, computational biologists, product managers, quality teams, and other stakeholders to translate scientific and business requirements into reliable software solutions. * Develop software capable of supporting complex scientific datasets, analytical workflows, and computational pipelines. * Use modern AI\-assisted software development tools to improve engineering productivity, including code generation, code review, testing, debugging, technical documentation, and developer workflows. * Evaluate emerging AI development tools and establish effective practices for their responsible use within the software development lifecycle. * Produce clear technical documentation, architecture specifications, design documents, and operational procedures. * Contribute to architectural decisions and help establish software development standards and engineering best practices. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root\-cause analysis and long\-term corrective solutions. * Work effectively across multiple time zones and with geographically distributed engineering, scientific, and business teams. * Mentor other engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the broader engineering organization. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands\-on development experience using Python. * Strong experience developing production applications using Python web frameworks such as Django, FastAPI, or similar technologies. * Experience developing modern web applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Strong experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, queries, performance optimization, and data integrity. * Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and supporting applications in AWS. * Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, distributed systems, service\-oriented architectures, and modern application design principles. * Experience with automated testing, source control, code review, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. * Demonstrated experience using AI\-enabled software engineering tools for activities such as coding, testing, debugging, code review, and documentation. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work on complex technical problems with limited supervision. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment and effectively manage multiple priorities. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate successfully with geographically distributed and cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications with data privacy, security, and compliance considerations associated with clinical or healthcare data. **What Success Looks Like:** In this role, you will combine strong software engineering fundamentals and professional attitude. * You pitch in as necessary to meet the demands of the work and you appropriately ask for help from your team members. #### **Communication** * You are effective in company goals. * You willingly accept assignments and take the timely and necessary actions to accomplish them. #### **Standards of excellence** * You set high standards of excellence for yourself and you strive to meet those standards. * Your work is accurate, complete and demonstrates a level of professionalism that you and your teammates are proud of and reflects positively of the company. #### **Ambition to learn** * You consistently establish and pursue training objectives that support your career goals and the company’s goals. #### **Need for supervision** * Your work habits and results (Versions must be currently recognized by Microsoft) * Possess a working knowledge of networking, Active Directory hierarchy and structure. * Be able to list the key functions of a firewall, router, switch and a hub and explain the differences between them. * Be able to manually configure a workstation’s IP address, mask and gateway, and troubleshoot connectivity to the LAN and Internet. * Have a working knowledge of viruses, Trojans, adware and spyware, and be able to explain the differences. * Be able to configure various mail clients (Outlook, Outlook Express, etc.), read and understand a header. * Be able to use built in tools to monitor and troubleshoot the performance of a PC. * Identify local user accounts and set permissions. #### **Physical requirements** * Position requires the following physical activity: Sitting, standing, walking, typing, lifting and/or carrying up to 50 lbs, crouching, bending, kneeling, reaching, stretching. #### **Environment** * Work environment will usually be standard office settings. jobs.description: **Key Responsibilities** * Define and execute the technology and development strategy for the LocalGov business unit. * Provide leadership and oversight for all software development activities across eight product lines and approximately 40\+ development professionals. * Advance LocalGov's development teams along the Harris AI\-SDLC maturity model \- from AI\-assisted work, to AI\-directed work, to agentic delivery in which AI agents own bounded work end to end while engineers set goals, define guardrails, and review outcomes. * Lead modernization efforts across IBM i, RPG, and modern technology platforms while preserving customer stability and business continuity. * Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, and governance processes to improve quality, predictability, and delivery performance. * Partner with Product Management, Client Services, Professional Services, Sales, and Business Unit leadership to align development priorities with customer and business needs. * Develop and maintain multi\-year product and technology roadmaps across the LocalGov portfolio. * Build, develop, and mentor engineering leaders and technical teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. * Oversee development capacity planning, resource allocation, and prioritization across competing initiatives and product lines. * Use AI development tools personally and daily, and champion their use across the organization \- including GitHub Copilot, Project Bob, large language models, and agentic coding tools \- holding a current, practical command of what they can and cannot do rather than relying on secondhand reporting. * Establish and monitor KPIs that measure outcomes rather than activity \- cycle time, development throughput, escaped defect and escalation rates, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and development cost as a percentage of revenue \- and report AI delivery maturity and the business outcomes it produces on a recurring executive cadence. * Own the LocalGov AI delivery\-maturity roadmap across all eight product lines, applied stage by stage across the software lifecycle rather than as a single business\-unit rating, and deliver against the maturity targets agreed with executive leadership. * Stand up the governance that makes delegated agent work safe, including review gates, validation, and security review of AI\-generated code, with quality standards applied equally to human\-written and AI\-generated code. * Make the LocalGov codebase and delivery pipeline accessible to AI agents through documentation, test coverage, CI/CD, and structured context. * Apply AI directly to the IBM i and RPG estate \- legacy code comprehension, documentation generation, and modernization analysis \- as a primary mechanism for preserving knowledge held by an aging and retiring RPG skillset. * Build the tooling and training program that moves engineers from AI\-assisted work, to AI\-directed work, to supervised agent execution, and give them the access and time to get there. * Lead strategic modernization and transformation initiatives including cloud adoption, customer\-facing AI solutions, and automation efforts. * Ensure appropriate architecture, security, compliance, and technical governance practices are maintained across all products. * Serve as the executive escalation point for critical development issues and strategic customer initiatives. * Develop succession planning and knowledge preservation strategies for aging legacy technology skillsets. * Manage OpEx Financial Forecast for R\&D department to include monthly forecast updates, reporting on Monthly Business Unit Review Calls, \& attendance/participation Annual Businesss Strategy Meeting. Attendance to key customer events in markets where large\-scale development motions are occurring * **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of progressive software development leadership experience. * 5\+ years of experience leading managers, technical leaders, and software development teams within a multi\-product software organization. * Demonstrated experience leading software modernization initiatives involving both legacy and modern technology platforms. * Experience managing geographically distributed development teams and cross\-functional technical organizations. * Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices. * Experience with enterprise software delivery, product strategy, and technical roadmap development. * Proven ability to align technology investments and development priorities with business objectives and customer needs. * Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and technology transformation initiatives. * Experience implementing or leading AI\-assisted development practices, automation initiatives, or engineering productivity improvements. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of AI development tools in daily work, with a clear point of view on where they help, where they fail, and how quickly that is changing. * Experience raising an engineering organization's way of working from individual AI assistance toward agentic, human\-on\-the\-loop delivery, including the governance and validation that makes it safe. Exceptional communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and executive leadership skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with IBM i, AS400, RPG, COBOL, or legacy platform modernization initiatives. * Experience with local government, public sector, ERP, tax, financial, records management, or government technology solutions. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Project Bob, LLMs, or similar technologies. * Experience establishing engineering KPIs, delivery metrics, and AI adoption measurement programs. * Experience leading engineering organizations through large\-scale modernization or digital transformation efforts. * Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, automation frameworks, and modern application architectures. * Experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams across multiple product lines. * Experience integrating AI into engineering workflows, customer solutions, or business operations. * Experience with Jira, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software delivery methodologies. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Senior Data Engineer** **Location: Philadelphia, PA (Center City)** Health Union powers the first and largest community\-based activation and data platform, transforming healthcare by providing unparalleled support, information, and validation for millions navigating complex health conditions and their care teams. With over 125\+ condition\-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help build and evolve the data pipelines and platform capabilities that power our enterprise data environment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Enterprise Data Platforms and working closely with our data engineering pod leads and team members, you will design and build robust data pipelines, implement data models, and ensure the reliability, quality, and compliance of the data we deliver. You will be a hands\-on senior engineer who executes against the technical direction and roadmap set by our data leadership. Strong hands\-on expertise with Snowflake and core AWS data services is essential. Experience with dbt, Python, and advanced SQL is highly valued, along with solid performance\-tuning, optimization, and data\-validation skills. **What You Do:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using AWS, Snowflake, Python, and dbt, from ingestion through transformation and delivery. * Translate functional requirements into clear technical designs and well\-structured, high\-quality code, complete with unit testing and documentation. * Implement and evolve data models and transformation layers (dbt on Snowflake), following the standards and technical direction set by data leadership. * Optimize data workflows for performance, scalability, cost, and reliability. * Safeguard the accuracy and integrity of our data through meticulous analysis, rigorous testing, data profiling, and problem resolution. * Support data security, governance, and privacy practices to ensure appropriate use of data and compliance with company policies. * Partner with analytics, software engineering, product, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver sound, maintainable solutions. * Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with peers to help maintain a high bar for engineering quality. * Contribute to quarterly and sprint planning for Data Engineering activities, and communicate progress and trade\-offs clearly across project teams. * Automate and improve aspects of our data platform to enhance efficiency and output. * Stay current with technologies and best practices in the data engineering space, and bring ideas back to the team. **What You Bring:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience, with strong, recent production experience on Snowflake and core AWS data services as the primary platform, for example S3, Lambda, MWAA/Apache Airflow for orchestration, and streaming/ingestion services such as Kinesis or Snowpipe. Familiarity with a solid subset is what matters; depth over breadth. * Working knowledge of dbt for data modeling and transformation, Python, and advanced SQL (stored procedures, analytic functions), or the demonstrated ability to ramp quickly. * Strong command of modern data engineering and data warehousing concepts, including relational and non\-relational databases, data streams, and file stores, and of performance tuning, query optimization, data profiling, and validation. * Experience building and maintaining reliable, well\-tested data pipelines, with sound QA, testing, requirements\-gathering, and documentation practices. * Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data pipelines is a plus. * Understanding of data security, governance, and compliance principles as they apply to data platforms. * Openness to learning and adopting AI\-driven data platform practices and agentic workflows as this becomes a growing team focus; willingness to lean in matters more than extensive prior expertise. * Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, analytics, product, and business partners. * A self\-motivated, proactive mindset, strong logical reasoning, and a love for learning, with an eagerness to keep growing your skills and take on more as opportunities arise. * Experience in healthcare, ad tech, programmatic audiences, or related industries is a plus. Familiarity with clean\-room environments/integrations and adtech partners (SSPs, DSPs) would be a plus. * AWS and/or Snowflake certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate, SnowPro) are an advantage. You will also be granted time off for designated company\-paid holidays, summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. **HEALTH UNION REALLY IS THE BEST PLACE TO WORK** As a dynamic organization that offers flexible work options, we foster a workplace that encourages an authentic, respectful culture of teaching and learning. We work hard and save space to form close\-knit relationships that are meaningful to us individually. Health Union also offers top\-tier benefits and other perks to full\-time employees, starting day one. We cultivate a dynamic, collaborative work environment that values **inclusion, community, excellence, and transparency**. But don’t just take our word for it: The Philadelphia Inquirer, Philadelphia Business Journal, Inc., and Forbes have all named Health Union a “best place to work”\-and we take pride in living up to that hype every day. **Commitment to Inclusion** At Health Union, we believe that individually we make a statement, but collectively we make an impact. Diversity and inclusion power that impact. We strive to create a sense of belonging by embracing our differences. We are an organization where everyone is valued, heard, and appreciated. Health Union encourages applicants from historically marginalized populations to consider our team as your next opportunity for change. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and advancement regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or gender expression, Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. To comply with federal law, Health Union participates in E\-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E\-Verify process after hire. The position offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of two in\-office days per week. Our office is located in Center City, Philadelphia. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the U.S for any employer. * *Candidates only. No direct calls or emails. No recruiters/agencies, please.*

jobs.description: Hendrick Autoguard \- HIC Location: 6030 East Independence Blvd, Charlotte, North Carolina 28212 **Position Summary** The Data Engineer is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for the systems and structures that make Hendrick Autoguard's data reliable, accessible, and useful. This role owns the design and operation of the ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, and data models that serve both business intelligence and AI initiatives. This is not a role that waits for requirements to arrive fully formed. The Data Engineer is expected to develop a working understanding of how the business operates and to apply that knowledge when making technical decisions. A pipeline that runs on time but models the business incorrectly has not done its job. That distinction sits at the center of this role. The role works alongside the analysts and BI developers who build reporting on the data platform, the data science and AI teams who use curated data for model development, and the team that administers the underlying cloud infrastructure. The Data Engineer makes sure the data layer serves each of these groups well, so that none of them has to rebuild it for their own use. **What This Role Does** The Data Engineer owns the movement of data from source systems into the Snowflake data platform. In practice that means designing, building, and maintaining ingestion pipelines; orchestrating workflows in Dagster so they are observable, reliable, and operationally sound; and monitoring pipeline health and data availability. When a load fails or data arrives late, the Data Engineer investigates, fixes the underlying cause, and puts alerting in place so the same problem surfaces early next time rather than in a stakeholder's report. Once data lands, the Data Engineer develops and maintains the dbt transformation models that turn raw source data into clean, tested, and well\-documented datasets. That includes designing dimensional models and data marts that support both reporting and machine learning use cases, and implementing data quality checks and testing standards throughout the transformation layer. Downstream consumers should be able to trust a dataset without re\-verifying it themselves. The Data Engineer also prepares data for AI. That work includes structuring feature datasets and training data pipelines, and collaborating with data science and AI teams to make sure the data meets their requirements for quality, freshness, and structure. The Data Engineer contributes to the semantic layer that gives AI and analytics consumers consistent, well\-defined access to business metrics and entities, and keeps data lineage and governance in view, since AI applications raise the stakes on knowing where data came from and how it may be used. The Data Engineer is also expected to advise on the strategic direction of the data engineering toolset, weighing in on platform and feature updates and evaluating new capabilities as they become available. Staying current with best practices and industry advancements in data engineering, AI data preparation, and orchestration is part of the job, not a side interest, and that knowledge should inform how the team's tools and standards evolve over time. Across all of this work, the Data Engineer builds working knowledge of the Autoguard business processes it supports, including vehicle service contract and protection product sales through dealership partners, claims administration, and cancellations, along with the workflows and decisions that depend on data from those areas. The Data Engineer engages directly with business stakeholders to understand their data needs, translates those needs into sound technical designs, and applies business context when weighing modeling decisions, pipeline priorities, and data quality standards. That knowledge makes each new request faster to scope. It also makes the Data Engineer a useful partner when a team is still working out which question it needs to answer. **Adjacent Competencies** Dashboard and report preparation are not a routine part of this role, and primary ownership of that work belongs to analysts and BI developers. The Data Engineer may occasionally need to support that function, though, whether by building or troubleshooting a report in a pinch or by helping an analyst work through a modeling issue at the source. The Data Engineer's core job is to deliver the modeled, tested data those teams build on, and to work with them when a reporting need exposes a gap in the data layer. **Experience And Qualifications** A candidate for this role has 3–7 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline. They are proficient in SQL and have hands\-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, a data transformation and modeling framework, and a workflow orchestration tool. Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and Dagster is strongly preferred, as is familiarity with AWS, including storage, IAM, and basic networking concepts. Preferred experience includes Python for pipeline development or data scripting; exposure to data quality frameworks, data contracts, or observability tooling; supporting ML pipelines or AI data preparation workflows; familiarity with medallion architecture or similar layered data design patterns; and involvement in data governance or data catalog efforts. The current technology environment includes Snowflake, Dagster, dbt, AWS (S3, EC2, and IAM), Python, and GitHub. Candidates must be able to engage with non\-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into technical requirements. Clear written and verbal communication is not optional in this role. The Data Engineer produces model documentation, dataset descriptions, and design notes that analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders rely on. That documentation needs to be accurate, specific, and usable without a follow\-up conversation. **Working Conditions** The Data Engineer works on site at Hendrick Automotive Group headquarters in a standard office environment, collaborating in person with technology teams and the business stakeholders this role supports. Travel is minimal, and may be by car or plane. Position is not remote due to essential functions of the job. Position is required to sit for prolonged periods of time, extensive use of computer and related functions like typing and other office equipment used in regular performance of essential functions like phone, printer. Hendrick is an Equal Opportunity employer. Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
