jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **How you move is why we’re here. ®** **Now more than ever.** Get back to what you need and love to do. The possibilities are endless... Now more than ever, our guiding principles are helping us in our search for exceptional talent \- candidates who align with our unique workplace culture and who want to maximize the abundant opportunities for growth and success. If this describes you then let’s talk! HSS is consistently among the top\-ranked hospitals for orthopedics and rheumatology by U.S. News \& World Report. As a recipient of the Magnet Award for Nursing Excellence, HSS was the first hospital in New York City to receive the distinguished designation. Whether you are early in your career or an expert in your field, you will find HSS an innovative, supportive and inclusive environment. Working with colleagues who love what they do and are deeply committed to our Mission, you too can be part of our transformation across the enterprise. **Emp Status** Regular Full time **Work Shift** **Compensation Range** The base pay scale for this position is $101,500\.00 \- $154,750\.00\. In addition, this position will be eligible for additional benefits consistent with the role. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be determined based on various factors, including but not limited to: scope of role, level of experience, education, accomplishments, internal equity, budget, and subject to Fair Market Value evaluation. The hiring range listed is a good faith determination of potential compensation at the time of this job advertisement and may be modified in the future. **What you will be doing** ========================== HSS’s Transformation Office (Atlas), was created to answer a hard question: How do we harden and optimize how HSS delivers care today — more efficient, more resilient, more scalable — and use those capabilities as the foundation for new business built on what HSS knows better than anyone? At HSS, we are transforming musculoskeletal healthcare through intelligent, scalable data and technology solutions. Our Enterprise Data \& Analytics teams empower everyone across HSS – including clinicians, researchers, financial and operational teams – with timely, trusted insights, intelligent technology, and data\-enabled workflows that enhance patient care and organizational performance. We operate in cross\-functional Product\-Oriented Delivery (POD) teams, leveraging modern platforms to turn data, AI, and technology into action. Alongside the data and AI products that power HSS internally, we turn HSS's clinical expertise and intellectual property into commercial products for health systems, partners, and patients — B2B and B2C offerings competing in a market that AI is reshaping in real time. We are seeking a Product Manager to build in that environment. In this role, you will own data and AI products end to end, prototype with AI as a first instinct rather than an afterthought, and lead a matrixed team of engineers, designers, business analysts, and domain experts from problem to shipped outcome. You will help define not just what HSS builds, but how product gets built in an AI\-native organization. **Who Will Love This Work** * **A product thinker and AI\-native builder** who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by turning complex business problems into practical data, AI, and technology solutions. You think beyond a single feature or application and look for opportunities to create capabilities that can scale across HSS. You don't wait for a spec or a sprint to see if an idea works; you build a working version with AI and put it in front of users. * **An insight\-to\-action thinker** who understands that the value of data is not simply producing an answer. You are focused on how products generate insights, how insights change decisions, improve workflows, and create measurable value for the organization. * **A product\-led adopter** who thinks about the full experience of a product – from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. You build onboarding, guidance, feedback loops, and other mechanisms into products so that new capabilities become part of how people work. * **A curious technologist** who stays close to what is emerging in AI, data, analytics, and technology, technically fluent enough to understand what is possible, challenge assumptions, and help translate new capabilities into practical solutions. * **A bias\-toward\-action operator** who moves from question to evidence quickly. You would rather ship a prototype on Thursday than debate a slide deck for a month, and you treat every release as a chance to learn. * **A market\-aware strategist** who tracks how AI is transforming product strategy across healthcare and technology. You understand customers, competitors, and the shifting definition of what a product can do. * **A technical partner** who is fluent in git, the software development lifecycle, and modern data and AI architectures — credib ctly where it speeds the team up. * Treat data as a product: partner with data engineers on data models, data quality, lineage, and semantic and metric layers so the products built on top of them are accurate and trusted. * Shape B2B and B2C products built on HSS intellectual property — conduct customer and market discovery, analyze the competitive landscape, and contribute to go\-to\-market, pricing, and packaging recommendations. * Track emerging capabilities in generative AI, agentic AI, and data platforms, and translate them into concrete product opportunities and changes to how the team works. * Build systems that scale your impact — reusable agent workflows, prompt libraries, product templates, and automated reporting — and teach teammates to use them. * Apply responsible AI and data governance practices — evaluation, guardrails and HIPAA\-aligned handling of PHI — in every product you ship. * Communicate decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to stakeholders and leaders, telling the story behind the data, not just the data itself. **What Success Looks Like** * You own at least one product area within a POD and are the clear point of accountability for its outcomes. * You take an idea to a working prototype in front of real users within days, not weeks. * You ship 1–2 validated major releases per quarter, each with defined adoption or impact metrics. * You build at least one reusable AI workflow or system that your team adopts. * Your teammates are measurably faster and more AI\-fluent because of what you build and share. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience in product management, data, AI, technology, digital transformation, or a related field, with experience delivering solutions across multiple technologies and business functions. * Hands\-on daily use of AI tools to build and work — including AI coding agents to produce working prototypes — with a portfolio of things you have built. * Working knowledge of git and GitHub (branches, pull requests, code review) and the software development lifecycle. * Strong SQL skills and a working understanding of data modeling concepts — table grain, dimensional models, medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture, data quality, and lineage. * Strong understanding of modern data and AI capabilities, including generative AI, LLM\-based tools, agentic workflows, data products, and analytics. * Demonstrated bias toward action — evidence of shipping quickly, learning from users, and iterating rather than over\-planning. * Ability to lead and influence a cross\-functional, matrixed team without direct authority. * Awareness of responsible AI practices and of privacy and governance requirements for healthcare data (e.g., HIPAA, PHI). * Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for audiences ranging from engineers to senior leaders. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities evolve and progress depends on learning and iteration. **Preferred** * Experience with Databricks and AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. * Experience with Python APIs. * Experience building or launching B2B SaaS or consumer products. Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments. * **Non\-Discrimination Policy** Hospital for Special Surgery is committed to providing high quality care and skilled, compassionate, reliable service to our community in a safe and healing environment. Consistent with this commitment, Hospital for Special Surgery provides care, admits, and treats patients and provides all services without regard to age, race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, national origin, culture, language, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic status, veteran or military status, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law or by accreditation standards.

jobs.title: Senior Associate Engineer, Quality
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- The Senior Associate Quality Engineer provides Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, and Supplier Quality support for manufacturing locations. The Senior Associate Quality Engineer conducts internal quality controls to ensure established quality procedures and standards are followed. This role conducts routine quality analysis and tests/inspections of a quality control program, where duties and tasks are standardized. This role also monitors and records inconsistencies with quality procedures and standards. This individual prepares standard quality analyses and recommends necessary quality procedure changes. This role supervises the quality activities of the Business Unit, ensuring the maintenance of certifications objectives and procedural requirements of Canadian Standards Association (CSA), product certification of Underwriters Laboratories (UL), and compliance with the established Quality System as required by the International Standardization Organization (ISO) 9001\-2015 / ISO 17025\. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by: * Monitoring, auditing, and evaluating production processes. * Creating and maintaining Quality Assurance programs throughout the production operations. * Working on ISO Documentation and Revisions. * Managing Calibration Systems, Tooling, and Instrumentation. * Leading and participating in problem solving and troubleshooting activity for electro\-mechanical and mechanical devices. * Leading and participating in the internal audit program. * Supporting new product development activity including PFMEA, DFMEA, Quality Planning, Measurement Systems design and deployment. * Identifying and addressing issues regarding control of material or supplier nonconformances. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- Bachelor’s Degree in Quality, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (required) 3\-5 years of Quality Engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (required) Ability to perform Capability and Measurement Systems Analysis Proven skills in problem solving and product investigation Familiarity with statistical analysis and data analysis tools Experience writing and revising procedures, work instructions, forms, visual aids, etc. Experience working within an ISO 9001\-2015 / ISO 17025 registered, or equivalently certified QMS (required) Fluent in written and verbal English and Spanish languages. **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Electrical Solutions** Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. HES provides the critical components that allow operators of buildings, factories and other industrial infrastructure to connect, protect, wire and manage power. Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class. The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

jobs.title: Manager, Full Stack Engineering
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= Humana is seeking a Manager, Full Stack Engineering for our Wisconsin Medicaid Market who is equally passionate about leading people and building technology. This is a hands\-on working manager role where you'll spend most of your time designing, coding, reviewing, and delivering solutions alongside a small team of engineers, while also coaching and developing team members. We're looking for a technical leader who leads by example and remains deeply involved in engineering execution. In this role, you'll oversee full\-stack development across two health plan technology environments, including Microsoft\-based applications, Azure cloud services, Dynamics 365, and modern DevOps platforms. You'll drive modernization efforts, improve reliability and security, reduce technical debt, and help prepare systems for future enterprise migration. Success in this role requires a builder's mindset, strong ownership, and a commitment to leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and elevate team performance.**Key Responsibilities** * Lead and develop a team of software engineers through coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development. * Design, build, enhance, and modernize applications, APIs, integrations, and services across multiple technology platforms. * Remain highly engaged in hands\-on software engineering activities, including coding, architecture, debugging, testing, and code reviews. * Establish engineering best practices and maintain high standards for software quality, security, and performance. * Drive modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, technical debt reduction, and platform optimization efforts. * Partner with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and peer engineering leaders to define technical solutions and delivery priorities. * Implement and promote DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, monitoring, and operational excellence practices. * Champion responsible and effective use of AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. * Support technology strategies that prepare legacy systems for future migration to enterprise platforms. * Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience building and supporting enterprise applications and distributed systems. * Experience leading, mentoring, or managing software engineers in a technical environment. * Hands\-on expertise with Microsoft technologies, including: + .NET / C\# + SQL Server + RESTful APIs and integrations + Modern software design and architecture practices * Experience developing and deploying solutions in Microsoft Azure. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and DevOps practices. * Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy applications and improve operational reliability. * Experience performing code reviews and establishing engineering best practices. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to operate effectively in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional environment. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS). * Experience leading cloud transformation or modernization initiatives. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools and code\-generation technologies. * Familiarity with healthcare, payer, managed care, Medicaid, or regulated industry environments. * Experience implementing DevSecOps and security\-first engineering practices. * Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling requirements, and healthcare compliance standards. * Experience supporting complex enterprise integrations and third\-party platforms. * Azure certifications and/or Microsoft technology certifications. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $117,600 \- $161,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer** It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Robotics Simulation & Control Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially\-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 \- our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments \- and we’re growing the team to take it even further. **About The Role** ================== We design robots **in simulation before building them in hardware**. As a **Robotics Simulation \& RL Engineer**, you will help design and validate **future generations of our robotic platforms** \- including **bipedal and wheeled systems** \- using physics simulation and reinforcement learning. You will develop tools to determine whether a robot design can perform real\-world tasks **before committing to hardware**. Your work will directly inform **robot architecture, actuator selection, sensor placement, and control strategies**. A key responsibility of this role is **owning and validating the canonical robot models (URDF and simulation assets)** used across simulation and control stacks. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Design and evaluate **new robot platforms** using physics simulation; * Analyze robot capabilities including **workspace, manipulability, dynamic balance, and torque limits;** * Use **reinforcement learning to stress\-test robot designs** and explore capability limits; * Own and maintain **URDF models** of current and future robot platforms; * Maintain the **CAD URDF simulation pipeline;** * Develop tools and benchmarks to evaluate **locomotion, manipulation, and platform robustness;** * Provide **quantitative feedback to hardware teams** on actuator sizing, joint placement, mass distribution, and sensor layout; * Collaborate with **mechanical, control, and perception teams** to guide platform design decisions. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * M.Sc. or Ph.D. in **Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Control,** or a related field; * Strong foundation in **robot kinematics and dynamics;** * Experience with **robot simulation environments** (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or similar); * Experience with **reinforcement learning in robotics or physics\-based simulation;** * Experience working with URDF or similar robot description formats; * Strong programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+; * Experience training RL locomotion or manipulation policies. *Nice to have:* * Experience with **legged, humanoid, or wheeled robots;** * Experience with **whole\-body control or torque\-controlled robots;** * Experience with **simulation\-driven hardware design;** * Experience building **large\-scale RL training pipelines.** **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale. * 30\+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown). * Private healthcare, including virtual and in\-person care. * Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. * Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in\-office. * Work at the frontier \- collaborate daily with world\-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. * Real ownership \- direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

jobs.title: Director AI/ML Platforms and Shared Services
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **The Opportunity** Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director to join our Data and Analytics department. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Machine Learning and AI team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. **Who We Are** At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest\-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. **Why Now?** This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. **How We Care for Our People** What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious *100 Best Companies to Work For®* list since 2013\. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong. We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: * Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally * Flexible work schedule * Work\-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on\-site fitness center * A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption * Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match **Who You Are** As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** The Director of AI Platforms and Shared Services leads the strategy, system architecture, and hands\-on delivery of internal products that enable AI product engineering teams to build and operate AI applications and agents for business stakeholders. This leader treats internal engineering teams as customers, translating shared needs into reliable, reusable, self\-service capabilities that simplify development and accelerate the path to production. The role owns the technical vision and delivery roadmap for agent platforms, including agent runtimes and orchestration, tool and enterprise system integration, memory and context management, and agent evaluation and observability. Supporting shared services include inference, model deployment pipelines, feature stores, and enterprise embedding services backed by vector databases. Together, these capabilities support the lifecycle of agents and models, including versioning, validation, deployment, monitoring, and model registration and explainability. System design is central to the position: defining service boundaries, APIs, data flows, permissions, and deployment patterns while making practical tradeoffs across scalability, latency, reliability, security, and cost. The director brings experience owning and evolving end\-to\-end systems and uses that perspective to address product team needs while partnering closely with Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet enterprise requirements. This is a player\-coach role that combines team leadership with direct technical contribution. The director leads from the front, remaining actively involved in architecture, prototyping, Python development, design and code reviews, and solving difficult production problems across AWS and GCP. They build and develop a strong engineering team, establish sound engineering practices, and stay accountable for shared services from initial design through production operations and ongoing evolution. Success is measured by the usefulness and reliability of the internal products, reduced duplication across teams, and how easily engineers can move AI applications, agents, and models from experimentation into production. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience spanning AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or cloud platform engineering, including significant ownership of production systems. * 3\+ years leading engineering teams, with continued hands\-on involvement in architecture, development, and technical problem solving. * Demonstrated experience designing, delivering, operating, and evolving end\-to\-end platforms or shared services used by multiple engineering teams. * Experience building production agent or AI systems, including evaluation, deployment, observability, and integration with enterprise systems. * Experience partnering with Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and product engineering teams to balance product needs with enterprise requirements. * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong system design skills, including distributed systems, service boundaries, application programming interfaces, design patterns, and tradeoffs across reliability, performance, security, and cost. * Strong Python development skills and experience building reusable libraries, services, and developer tools. * Experience with agent runtimes and orchestration, tool integration, memory and context management, retrieval, evaluation, and observability. * Experience with shared AI infrastructure, including inference services, embedding services, vector databases, and model deployment pipelines. * Understanding of AI and machine learning fundamentals and lifecycle capabilities, including registration, versioning, validation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability. * Experience with AWS and GCP, including deep production expertise in at least one. * Experience with Docker, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous delivery. * Experience with agent interoperability protocols, feature stores, experimentation platforms, recommender systems, or forecasting systems preferred. The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better. The salary range for this position is $176,300 \- $235,000 The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate. *We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.*

jobs.description: **About Innovative Labs** We are a leading maker of liquid dietary supplements, known for our innovation, strong R\&D, and focus on quality. With our in\-house team, we create custom liquid products for top wellness, nutraceutical, and food brands. At Innovative Labs, we believe in teamwork and creativity. For over 15 years, we’ve helped brands bring new ideas to life with high\-quality liquids, gels, purees, pastes, oils, and emulsions. Our modern facilities and dedicated team work together to make products that matter. Here, you’ll grow, learn, and be part of a team that’s always improving and moving forward. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Your Work Matters:** Support the Brands People Use Every Day * **Collaborate \& Create:** Join a team that values fresh ideas, open communication, and teamwork * **Grow Your Career:** We encourage curiosity, learning, and stepping up to new challenges * **Supportive Culture:** Thrive in a workplace that values your contributions and well\-being **About the Job** We are looking for a senior engineer to own the technology behind our manufacturing business. You will manage our enterprise infrastructure across cloud, on\-premises and hosted environments, administer our ERP and the SaaS applications our teams rely on every day (lab, quality, production and project management), keep them all connected, and work with leaders across the company to put AI and automation to work for the business. You will be trusted to make decisions and see them through, with a direct effect on how the business runs. **What You’ll Do** ***Infrastructure and Systems Administration*** * Own our Microsoft Azure environment: Azure SQL, virtual machines, networking, storage, Azure Data Factory, identity and cost management * Administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID / Active Directory: accounts, groups, access control, conditional access and SSO * Administer the VMware virtual environment and maintain the on\-premises and cloud servers (Windows and Linux) behind our internal applications, including patching, backups, monitoring and disaster recovery * Apply security best practices: least\-privilege access, secrets management, MFA, logging, and regular access reviews ***AI and Automation*** * Lead AI for the company: own our AI platform and tools, and drive how AI is adopted and used across every department * Use AI as an everyday working tool: build, troubleshoot, document and support systems faster with AI assistants and agents (for example, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or Azure OpenAI) * Bring systems engineering and AI together: use AI to improve how our systems and integrations work, and give the AI tools you put in place the same testing, security and monitoring as any other system * Find and deliver ways to automate manual work across operations and the back office * Stay current as AI changes: follow new models, tools and practices * Keep learning, and help others learn: grow your own AI skills and help colleagues across the company use AI well * Use AI responsibly: help set and follow practical rules for how the company uses AI, with the right controls around company data ***ERP and Business Systems Administration*** * Act as the main technical administrator of our ERP: configuration, user security, upgrades, database health, and the reporting replica * Administer our SaaS and specialized platforms, including Monday.com, LIMS, QMS, MES and production\-performance (OEE) systems, and others as we add them * Be the escalation point for system issues. Diagnose problems across systems, work with vendors to fix them, and keep vendor relationships and contracts in good order * Evaluate new software, lead implementations and upgrades, and retire systems we no longer need ***Integrations and Development*** * Design, build and support integrations between our satellite systems and the ERP, using REST APIs, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL and scripting * Own the data pipelines that keep production, inventory, quality and financial data in sync, with monitoring and alerts so failures are caught before users notice * Write and maintain SQL, Python and PHP code for integrations, reports and internal web tools * Keep clear documentation for integrations and development ***Partnership and Governance*** * Partner with department leaders and teams to understand their business needs, then deliver the solution: configure an existing system, build an integration, or design a new tool on our internal web platform * Support validation, change control and audit needs for systems that hold quality and compliance data * Keep system documentation, runbooks and the system and integration inventory current **What Makes You a Great Fit** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 10\+ years in IT systems engineering, enterprise systems administration or a similar role, with at least 5 of those years hands\-on with cloud infrastructure * Strong Microsoft Azure experience: Azure SQL, VMs, networking, identity (Entra ID), and Azure Data Factory or a comparable integration and data pipeline tool * Experience administering an ERP system, ideally in a manufacturing or distribution business * A track record of building and supporting system integrations using REST APIs, SQL and at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell or similar) * Strong SQL skills, including writing queries, tuning performance and troubleshooting databases (Microsoft SQL Server / Azure SQL preferred) * Working knowledge of VMware, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Linux administration * Sound security habits: access control, secrets handling, backups and incident response * Clear communication with non\-technical users and leaders, and the ability to explain trade\-offs in plain language * The judgment to work independently and own outcomes, as a senior member of a small team * Curiosity and adaptability: a habit of learning new technology quickly, and a real interest in using AI to change how work gets done **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in an FDA\-regulated or cGMP manufacturing environment, including computer system validation and audit support * Hands\-on experience with LIMS, QMS, MES or OEE platforms (such as Redzone) * Experience with Databricks, Snowflake or other modern data platforms * Web development experience (PHP, JavaScript) for internal tools and dashboards * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants, AI agents or large language model APIs * Experience with Git and CI/CD **The Perks of Joining Our Team** * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage—plus a few weeks of paid parental leave when it matters most * Paid time off and holidays to help you unwind and recharge * Real opportunities to grow your skills and make an impact as we evolve * A collaborative team that’s adaptable, supportive, and driven to succeed together * A 401(k) retirement plan with company contributions to help you build your future **Ready to innovate with us?** Apply now and let’s build the future together!

jobs.title: AI Principal Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The AI CoE Principal Software Engineer will report to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role is the most senior individual contributor on the team and the technical owner of the enterprise AI engineering foundation, including the semantic router, model and harness hosting, the enterprise AI gateway, and the AI operations layer used across the business. The role is responsible for setting AI engineering architecture and standards and then building them, carrying a multi\-year capability roadmap from discovery through prototype, validation, and production scale. Primary duties include designing and building the shared AI platform and semantic routing layer; product inference and personalization, partnering with AI\-Ops on monitoring, evaluation, and governance guardrails; building secure, compliant AI integration patterns for a regulated financial services and health and benefits environments; leading agentic pipeline and multi\-agent orchestration work; delivering production AI services for CoE\-enabled business functions; developing reusable reference architectures for other engineering teams; managing AI unit economics; prototyping emerging AI capabilities; mentoring senior and lead engineers; and partnering with security, risk, compliance, and data governance. This role does not have direct reports. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and operate the shared enterprise AI platform, including core semantic data, model, harness, and hosting capability used across developer and in\-product personalization use cases. * Design and maintain intelligent request routing using semantic analysis and deterministic logic to direct requests to the best\-fit LLM, internal tool, or agentic pool, using cost, latency, and privacy as routing criteria. * Partner with AI\-Ops to enable metric\-based reporting, quality, performance, and drift monitoring across live systems, build model evaluation harnesses, and establish governance guardrails for safe AI use at scale. * Design and implement secure, compliant AI integration patterns appropriate for a regulated financial services environment. * Build and scale agentic pipelines and multi\-agent orchestration across the software development lifecycle, from pilot through measured engineering capacity across product teams. * Deliver production AI services supporting document intelligence and claims adjudication, conversational and voice self\-service, call intelligence, fraud and anomaly detection, and regulatory monitoring. * Develop reusable reference architectures and standard patterns so other engineering teams and embedded consultants can build AI solutions without rebuilding the foundation. * Evaluate unit economics for AI workloads, including cost per transaction, token and inference spend, latency budgets, and build\-versus\-buy and self\-host\-versus\-vendor decisions. * Identify and prototype emerging AI capabilities relevant to the business and technology roadmap, including fast, focused feasibility spikes with clear recommendations. * Lead hands\-on training sessions and pair directly with engineering teams on new development methods and prototype or pattern adoption. * Monitor the AI landscape and translate findings into roadmap recommendations on what to pilot, what to watch, and what to decline. * Set technical direction and standards for embedded AI consultants and the coaching network to scale AI delivery capacity beyond the CoE. * Mentor senior and lead engineers across business units, review AI designs, and serve as the escalation point for complex agentic and integration issues. * Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to support safe and compliant AI delivery. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. * AI Practitioner Certifications are a plus * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including 4\+ years delivering production AI/ML systems and 2\+ years of LLM or agentic systems in production, with a track record as the most senior technical owner of an enterprise\-scale platform. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Architecting and operating production agentic workflows as state machines, including branching logic, retry and recovery paths, and precise control over multi\-step process flow. * Deep fluency with AI\-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ONA, with a track record of driving adoption and measured impact across engineering teams. * Semantic routing and model orchestration, including embedding\-based intent analysis, deterministic fallback logic, and policy\-based model selection across multiple providers on cost, latency, and privacy criteria. * Observability and AI Ops for non\-deterministic systems, including distributed tracing, behavioral analysis, usage and quality metrics, drift detection,  and staff engineers, and communicating trade\-offs to executive stakeholders. * Ability to own a multi\-year capability roadmap, moving work from discovery through prototype, production validation, and scale against defined business metrics. * Ability to move fluidly between abstract system thinking and tactical, incremental delivery while managing stakeholders and delivering against a critical path. * Financial services, healthcare benefits, or other regulated industry experience preferred, with HSA/FSA, claims, custody, or payments domain exposure especially valuable. * Knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks preferred, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management, SOC 2, or HIPAA control environments. * Experience with rapid prototyping and feasibility assessment in an R\&D or innovation capacity preferred. * Experience facilitating technical learning sessions or pairing with engineers at varying skill levels preferred. * Multi\-agent system design experience preferred, including role assignment and coordination, agent\-to\-agent conversation patterns, and code execution loops for iterative problem solving. * API and integration experience across REST, event\-driven, and MCP patterns preferred, including integrating AI into systems of record and workflow platforms. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. appropriate. * Provide consultations as needed with internal and external stakeholders by providing technical expertise and knowledge of client environments. * Provide consultations with the Systems jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Enterprise AI Workflow Enablement
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit’s AI Transformation Org is changing how 18,000\+ employees do their most important work. We bring AI agents into the everyday workflows of Finance, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and People \& Places. The people doing the work spend less time on coordination and more time on the decisions that need their expertise. We need a Principal who can scale this across the company without taking it over. This role is the engine that gets AI\-redesigned workflows into production and keeps them there. You partner with AI Champions inside each non\-engineering function. You apply approved enterprise blueprints to high\-friction, repeatable workflows. You set measurable baselines before redesign. You make adoption stick after the central team steps back. Your success is measured by what the function can do after you leave, not by what you personally redesigned. You partner closely with the People \& Places AI Workforce Transformation team, the Enterprise Solution Architect, the Telemetry and Insights Lead, and senior operating leaders across Intuit’s most consequential non\-engineering functions. **Responsibilities** * Drive blueprint\-led redesign with AI Champions across non\-engineering functions. Apply approved blueprint patterns to the workflows we prioritize. Coach Champions through configuration, integration, evaluation, and rollout in their real work, not in training settings. * **Build and validate before you scale. Personally prototype agentic workflow configurations,** working closely with engineering partners and directly with LLM APIs or agent tooling to test feasibility. Validate the design meets quality and reliability standards before a function adopts it. * Hold the line on blueprint standards. Every redesign uses approved workflow logic, agent configuration standards, integration patterns, governance guardrails, and measurement contracts. Push back on bespoke designs that fragment the enterprise architecture. * Design redesigns to stick. Set baselines before launch. Instrument the pre\-state with the Telemetry and Insights Lead. Align role expectations and habits with HR Craft Leaders. Validate the post\-state. Treat behavioral adoption as a design constraint from day one, not a retrofit. * Drive blueprint adoption, not workflow possession. The redesigned workflow is the default execution model in production. The function owns it after you step back. The hand\-off is the deliverable, not the redesign itself. * Surface friction back to platform and architecture. Identify where blueprint patterns break down, where the platform is missing capability, and where governance creates drag. Feed signal to the Enterprise Solution Architect and the platform engineering team. The platform should compound with every redesign. * Connect workflow redesign to workforce evolution. Every redesign changes what the people doing the work need to know, do, and decide. Partner with HR Craft Leaders and the People \& Places AI Workforce Transformation team. Role expectations, AI proficiency, hiring criteria, and learning pathways evolve with the workflow, not after it. * Maintain the redesign portfolio view. Make redesigns in flight, baselines committed, value captured, and risk visible at any moment. Keep prioritization honest. Resist pressure to take on work that does not meet the bar. **Qualifications** **Qualifications** * 12\+ years of progressive experience designing, building, or operating production AI/ML systems, agentic workflows, or enterprise workflow platforms. * **Engineering or technical background required: you have written production code, built technical prototypes, or held a hands\-on technical role** (e.g., software engineer, ML engineer, forward\-deployed engineer) at some point in your career. * **Currently and personally building agentic workflow prototypes** in your day\-to\-day work (e.g., working directly with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, MCP tooling). * At least 3 years driving change inside other people’s organizations. This could be embedded with a business function, a forward\-deployed engineering team, or a transformation function. * Demonstrated track record of taking AI\-powered workflows from prototype into in\-production adoption at enterprise scale. * Experience influencing and aligning VP\-level and above stakeholders on workflow strategy and investment decisions. * Bachelor’s degree required. Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred. **Preferred** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Background in enterprise HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing, or Customer Success technology. These are the functions where this role will spend most of its time. * Experience designing or implementing responsible AI frameworks, evaluation pipelines, or AI governance programs. * Prior experience as a forward\-deployed engineer or AI solutions architect inside a customer’s organization. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $243,000 \- $328,500 San Diego, CA $230,000\- $311,000

with customers. * **Ticket Management:** Respond to tickets in accordance with SLAs, setting the correct priority on submission. * **Case Triage \& Classification:** Triage, classify and enrich incoming tickets to ensure they are followed up in a timely and effective manner. * **AI Solution Validation:** Validate and review AI\-generated solution proposals before sharing them with the customer. * **Customer Communication:** Provide positive and informative communication in writing and verbally (email, phone and video). * **Cloud Administration:** Implement configuration changes for cloud customers, providing information on Jedox Cloud settings and creating customer portal accounts. * **Escalation Management:** Check support responsibility for new tickets and escalate to the senior expert pool when needed. * **Case Ownership:** Take ownership of escalations, follow up on them and resolve them satisfactorily, and manage your queue proactively. * **Knowledge Sharing \& Process Improvement:** Contribute to the knowledge base and the continuous improvement of support processes. * **FP\&A Process Knowledge:** Establish a practical understanding of how customers use planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and performance management tools, in order to assess technical issues in their business context. #### **Your Profile** * Over three years' experience of working in SaaS/technical support in a fast\-paced environment. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or commensurate experience in software. * Interest in EPM, FP\&A, or finance processes such as planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. * Experience with EPM/CPM, business intelligence, planning software, financial systems, or supporting finance users is a strong plus. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, combined with excellent interpersonal, organisational and customer skills * Solid technical expertise in Windows and Linux systems, web servers, cloud services, databases and Excel, ideally complemented by experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, ITIL, SRE practices and Salesforce Service Cloud. * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. * Availability to work primarily during Pacific Time business hours to support customers and teams across the Americas (no shift work required) **Not sure if you meet every requirement?** If you bring strong technical skills and customer\-facing experience, we'd still love to hear from you. Knowledge of EPM, FP\&A, or finance processes is a plus and can be developed through onboarding and training.#### **Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence** As a tech\-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions. #### **About us** Jedox is a leading software solution that enables business planning, budgeting, and forecasting for finance, sales, and other business functions with leading\-edge technology to drive Digital Transformation and provide tangible customer value. Constant innovation has made us a leader in the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) sector. **Our Values** At Jedox, we pride ourselves on our core corporate values, which drive our success as a team. Our growth mindset encourages us to constantly learn, evolve and innovate, pushing ourselves to new heights. We work together as \#OneTeam OneJedox, with a shared passion for achieving excellence in everything we do. We execute with precision and hold ourselves to the highest standards of excellence, ensuring that we deliver impactful results that exceed our customers' expectations. Our focus on people centricity ensures that our employees are at the heart of everything we do, enabling us to attract and retain top talent. We believe that effective communication and engagement are key to building strong relationships, both internally and with our customers, partners and stakeholders. **Why should you join our team?** At Jedox, we want our customers to achieve \#Superplännen. It is that exhilarating feeling when an organization performs how it envisioned it. When you plan for the future and achieve your goals, we call it Superplännen, and we want you to achieve the same. This is why at Jedox our culture is shaped by our global collaboration, passion for people and development, diversity, and commitment to innovation. We refer to it as our \#OneTeam mantra, which is ingrained in everything we do. We believe in lifelong learning and encourage team members to pursue personal and professional development, including internal \& external training and certifications. We also enjoy meeting regularly (online or in persona) with each other all across the world for work, team events, to spend quality time together \& have fun, or even do sports together. The same effort and attention are being given to ensure employee satisfaction in an out of the office. Some of those perks include: * **Flexible work:** we love to work together in the offices as \#Oneteam, but we also enjoy the possibility of working from everywhere and owning working hours. * **Take time to care for yourself:** We offer generous vacation time and comprehensive health benefits plans, including Pension plans. * **Plan for your future:** Planning means something different to everyone. Work with your Line Manager to implement a career growth plan that suits your path. * **Reduce your footprint:** All offices are centrally located and can be easily reached via public transportation. Most Jedox offices offer public transit reimbursement or other perks like bike leasing. * **High\-impact working environment:** we enjoy flat hierarchies and short decision\-making processes. * **Get corporate discounts across many brands and products.** Jedox is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and does not discriminate based on color, religion or belief, nationality, social or ethnic origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by the laws and regulations in the geographic locations in which we operate.

Johnson Controls International (JCI) is looking for an AI Platform Engineer to join the AI Engineering \& Platforms team. This role focuses on building, automating, securing, and operating the enterprise landing zones and shared services that enable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agent\-based solutions across JCI. You will work across cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, DevOps, networking, security, observability, and service operations. The role is platform\-first: creating reusable capabilities, governed deployment patterns, and reliable self\-service experiences for AI engineering, data science, product, and business teams. **How you will do it** **Enterprise AI Landing Zones \& Cloud Platform Engineering** * Build and operate secure, scalable AI landing zones and shared platform services, primarily on Azure and increasingly across AWS. * Develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns using Terraform and Terragrunt, with consistent configuration across development, test, and production environments. * Provision and support Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Container Apps, App Services, Function Apps, Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, Storage, Cosmos DB, Redis, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and supporting services. * Contribute to AWS AI/ML platform capabilities using services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, API Gateway, Lambda, S3, IAM, and associated networking and security services. * Design platform services so new capabilities can be onboarded through repeatable modules, documented standards, and approved deployment patterns. **AI Gateways, Model Access \& Runtime Services** * Build and operate governed access to foundation models and AI services through Azure API Management and equivalent cloud gateway patterns. * Implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, quotas, routing, retries, circuit breakers, usage tracking, and cost controls for model and API consumption. * Support pay\-as\-you\-go and provisioned\-throughput model deployments, model upgrades, endpoint lifecycle management, capacity planning, and controlled access for consuming teams. * Enable secure hosting patterns for APIs, agents, containerized workloads, scheduled jobs, and event\-driven services using managed cloud platforms. **Automation, CI/CD \& Developer Enablement** * Create and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, policy checks, application hosting, and controlled releases. * Build automated testing for Terraform modules, platform services, networking, security controls, and deployment smoke tests. * Create sample projects, templates, reference implementations, runbooks, and onboarding documentation that help teams adopt the platform safely and quickly. * Work with consuming teams to troubleshoot platform access, networking, identity, certificates, private endpoints, deployment, and runtime issues. **Security, Governance, Reliability \& Operations** * Implement private networking, managed identities, Entra ID integration, RBAC, least\-privilege access, secrets management, logging, auditability, and secure\-by\-default configurations. * Partner with Cybersecurity, Cloud Engineering, Networking, Enterprise Architecture, AI Governance, and service owners to move solutions from development into supported production environments. * Build dashboards, alerts, health checks, monitoring, and operational metrics for platform availability, model usage, cost, capacity, and service quality. * Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, problem management, platform maintenance, change management, and continuous improvement. * Support platform request, approval, provisioning, documentation, and handover processes, ensuring solutions remain supportable and compliant. **Collaboration \& Engineering Standards** * Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, solution architects, product teams, and cloud specialists to translate use cases into reusable platform capabilities. * Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design decisions, backlog refinement, sprint delivery, code reviews, and platform roadmap planning. * Promote engineering practices focused on automation, reliability, security, maintainability, cost awareness, and clear technical documentation. **Qualifications \& Skills** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in cloud, DevOps, platform, SRE, infrastructure, or MLOps engineering roles. * Hands\-on experience building production Azure solutions using Terraform and Azure DevOps. * Strong knowledge of cloud networking, private endpoints, DNS, identity, RBAC, managed identities, secrets, and secure service\-to\-service connectivity. * Experience with containerized and managed application platforms such as Azure Container Apps, App Services, Functions, Docker, or Kubernetes. * Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues. * Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, or similar managed AI services. * Experience designing or operating API gateways using Azure API Management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules and working with Terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns. * Experience with enterprise landing zones, hub\-and\-spoke networking, private cloud services, policy enforcement, and multi\-subscription or multi\-account environments. * Experience operating AI or ML platforms, including model endpoints, capacity, quotas, evaluation services, vector search, RAG infrastructure, or agent runtimes. * Working knowledge of cloud cost management, service reliability, incident management, and platform product thinking. **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS platform engineering, including Bedrock, SageMaker, API Gateway, IAM, Lambda, S3, VPC networking, Terraform, or Terragrunt. * Experience with multi\-cloud AI gateway, model\-routing, or centralized model\-access patterns. * Knowledge of LLMOps, agent orchestration, MCP, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, model evaluation, safety, or observability patterns. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, SIEM integration, dashboards, load testing, resilience testing, or performance engineering. * Exposure to ServiceNow\-based request and fulfilment processes, CMDB, application onboarding, or enterprise architecture approval processes. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, or Terraform Associate. * Experience supporting global teams and services across multiple regions, time zones, and regulatory environments. **Mindset** * Platform\-first engineer who looks for reusable solutions rather than one\-off deployments. * Security\-conscious and comfortable balancing delivery speed with enterprise controls. * Operationally minded, with a focus on reliability, supportability, automation, and continuous improvement. * Pragmatic problem solver who can work through ambiguity and evolving cloud and AI technologies.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (High Performance/Distributed Computing)
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e\-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high\-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e\-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield\-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. **Company Overview** KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. **Group/Division** With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process. Come join a highly motivated Software team building Semiconductor Inspection/Review tools by solving high\-end Physics problems using software expertise. You will drive innovation of the next generation of CPUs, GPUs, and DL engines like Bionic Chips. Here is a quick overview of our product from our website ( eSL10 e\-Beam Defect Inspection \| Chip Manufacturing \| KLA (kla\-tencor.com ) **Responsibilities:** * Writing elegant, clean, code with automated tests to cover it * Designing distributed applications * Taking full advantage of system resources to deliver high performance computing (HPC) solutions. * Defining data classes for efficient processing. **Qualifications:** * Proficiency with C\+\+ programming is crucial * Working on Linux OS * Used Object\-Oriented principles for software design * HPC experience or coursework * Understanding of network stacks **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to workload management software * Containers and Docker to package software services * Passion for Physics **Minimum Qualifications** Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $0\.00 \- $0\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. **Equal Opportunity Statement** KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.description: **Location:** 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio**Job Summary** We are seeking a Lead Data Engineer to support the design, implementation, maintenance, and lifecycle of enterprise data products starting with our DevOps Data Product transforming technology, operational, and business data into trusted, governed, and reusable insights. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex data and platform problems, improving data quality and reliability, reducing friction in the data delivery and pipeline lifecycle, and building standardized solutions that encourage broad adoption. The role offers the opportunity to influence data engineering standards, strengthen platform capabilities, and help shape a delivery ecosystem built for speed, quality, governance, and resilience. **Essential Functions** * Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and support production batch and incremental pipelines using Python, SQL, and Cloud Composer to collect and process data and telemetry from enterprise tools and source systems. * BigQuery Engineering \& Optimization: Implement and maintain BigQuery datasets, tables, views, and transformation workloads. Optimize partitioning, clustering, query performance, access, storage, and compute costs. * Data Transformation \& Testing: Write and deploy automated transformation workflows and data quality checks using Dataform. * CI/CD \& Infrastructure as Code: Create and maintain repeatable Terraform configurations and GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, credential handling, and environment deployments across development, test, and production. * System Integration \& Security: Build secure integrations with enterprise APIs and source systems using appropriate authentication and credential management, incorporating retry, error handling, and rate\-limiting patterns. * Data Quality \& Reliability: Configure pipeline monitoring, alerting, schema validation, and reconciliation jobs. * Data Product Delivery: Partner with the Data Product Owner, data modelers, architects, and platform teams to translate product requirements, metric definitions, data\-quality expectations, and governance requirements into reliable technical solutions. * Documentation \& Governance: Maintain technical documentation, lineage, data contracts, implementation guides, and evidence needed to
