jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** LakeFusion is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to build and scale our real\-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault\-tolerant, high\-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high\-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms.A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer\-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Scale the real\-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high\-throughput, low\-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes. * Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C\#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores. * Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes. * Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments. * Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low\-latency queries. * Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers. * Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real\-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers. * Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer\-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks. * Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of backend engineering experience building production\-grade services and microservices. * 4\+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands\-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6\+ (C\#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components. * 4\+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo). * Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns. * Resilience and fault\-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns. * Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers. * Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside. * Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams. ‍ **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge). * Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer\-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints). * Experience with dual\-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases. **About LakeFusion** -------------------- LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R&D Lead
jobs.description: About Leading Edge Skills Leading Edge Skills LLC (LES) is an established California\-based organization and federal contractor delivering **leadership development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology training, and consulting** to defense agencies, civilian government organizations, and commercial clients. Our federal portfolio includes multi\-year programs with the **U.S. Navy's NAVSEA/NSWCDD, NAVSUP/Navy Supply Corps School, Naval Surface Warfare Center Port Hueneme Division, and the U.S. Army**. These engagements encompass leadership and advanced management development, AI and emerging technology applications, mission\- and capability\-based test and evaluation, digital engineering, modeling and simulation, cybersecurity education, and professional workforce development. LES has delivered **60\+ leadership development cohorts** under an ongoing Navy program. Our defense program footprint extends across **Dahlgren, Virginia Beach, Newport, Port Hueneme, and the San Diego region**, supporting scientists, engineers, military personnel, technical professionals, and senior leaders. Our broader experience includes cybersecurity workforce development for the California Department of Rehabilitation. **Our next strategic direction is technology research and development.** Building on our established defense contracting experience, LES is developing capabilities in applied AI, autonomous systems, cybersecurity innovation, intelligent decision\-support, and advanced simulation. We intend to pursue long\-term R\&D, SBIR/STTR, prototype development, and technology commercialization opportunities with DoD agencies and other federal organizations. We seek technically accomplished innovators who can bring original ideas, demonstrated engineering expertise, and a commitment to developing practical technologies that address defense mission challenges. Position Overview LES is seeking an accomplished **Senior Agentic AI Engineer / AI R\&D Lead** to help conceptualize, architect, develop, and validate innovative AI technologies for defense and government applications. We are particularly interested in engineers, researchers, and technical innovators who have personally designed and built functional AI systems, including agentic AI platforms, multi\-agent applications, intelligent decision\-support tools, autonomous workflows, and advanced analytical solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to emerging technology research, technical feasibility assessments, software architecture, prototype development, and selected federal R\&D pursuits. This is a hands\-on technical position for someone capable of **personally engineering and demonstrating technology**, not simply advising on AI adoption or delivering instructional programs. We value candidates with an entrepreneurial mindset who can recognize emerging technological opportunities and help transform promising ideas into defensible research concepts and commercially viable products. Key ResponsibilitiesAI Engineering and Prototype Development * Design, develop, and validate sophisticated agentic AI systems and LLM\-powered applications. * Engineer autonomous and human\-supervised AI agents that perform complex analytical tasks and support operational decision\-making. * Build multi\-agent workflows involving planning, reasoning, orchestration, information retrieval, and external tool integration. * Develop functional software prototypes using Python, AI frameworks, APIs, and contemporary development practices. * Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured data pipelines, knowledge representations, and vector databases where appropriate. * Integrate AI components with secure backend systems, databases, cloud environments, and enterprise applications. * Develop systems incorporating explainability, audit trails, human oversight, and reliable outputs. * Personally test, troubleshoot, optimize, and demonstrate engineered solutions. Applied AI Research and Innovation * Identify innovative technical approaches to complex defense and government challenges. * Evaluate existing technologies and determine opportunities for meaningful technical advancement. * Formulate research hypotheses, feasibility experiments, and measurable technical objectives. * Investigate emerging capabilities involving agentic AI, multimodal systems, advanced reasoning, optimization, and AI evaluation. * Develop methods for assessing accuracy, reliability, robustness, scalability, transparency, and uncertainty. * Produce technical research findings, experimental evidence, feasibility reports, and documented demonstrations. * Contribute original ideas capable of supporting future technology development and intellectual property. Defense R\&D and SBIR/STTR Initiatives * Evaluate DoD technology requirements and determine whether innovative AI solutions are technically feasible. * Collaborate with LES leadership, systems engineers, defense SMEs, and other t nd technical documentation. * Ability to develop a proof of concept independently or lead a small technical development team. * Strong analytical thinking, independent problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Master's degree or PhD in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related discipline. * Hands\-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks. * Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, vector databases, and advanced data architectures. * Experience with intelligent decision\-support, autonomous systems, simulation, optimization, or AI evaluation platforms. * Understanding of explainable AI, human\-in\-the\-loop decision\-making, responsible AI, and secure AI architectures. * Experience developing AI applications for government, defense, aerospace, or mission\-critical environments. * Previous involvement in SBIR/STTR, DARPA, DoD research programs, or technology commercialization. * Published research, patents, public code repositories, commercial AI products, or demonstrable technical inventions. * Experience as a startup founder, principal engineer, or technical R\&D lead. Initial Areas of Technical Interest Depending on specific opportunities, the selected professional may contribute to: * Agentic AI for defense decision management and acquisition analysis. * AI\-enabled operational decision\-support systems. * Explainable and auditable AI recommendations. * Human\-AI collaboration and intelligent analytical workflows. * AI model evaluation and performance benchmarking. * Mission\-oriented data analysis and predictive decision intelligence. * Intelligent simulation and scenario evaluation. * Secure autonomous software architectures. These are areas of strategic interest, not a guarantee that every area will be included in the initial assignment. Initial Engagement and Expected Deliverables Initial projects may include: * Assessing a specific defense R\&D opportunity and its technical requirements. * Proposing an innovative solution and explaining its technical differentiation. * Developing a system architecture and feasibility research plan. * Identifying prototype requirements, development resources, and research risks. * Producing a functional proof of concept when included in an authorized paid scope. * Establishing measurable testing and validation criteria. * Contributing technical material to research proposals and development roadmaps. jobs.description: **Position:** Product Engineer, AI \& Automation **Department:** Digital Experience **Role Overview:** The Operational Efficiency team works with departments across the organization to reduce manual effort in daily operations. This role is the team's primary builder. You will take processes that are currently slow, repetitive, or error\-prone and turn them into working automations, applying AI capabilities where they fit the problem. Most of your time will be spent building: writing code, connecting systems, designing and testing agents, and maintaining what you have already shipped. Requirements will reach you as problems rather than finished specifications, so you will work directly with the teams whose processes you are automating to understand how the work is performed before deciding what to build. We are looking for someone with five or more years of experience who has delivered automations that people depend on daily and who has supported them over time. **What you’ll get to do:** *Build* * Design and build automations across operational workflows, including data movement, document handling, reporting, intake and routing, and notifications. * Connect existing systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and integration platforms, working within the organization's current technology stack wherever possible. * Build components that use large language models where they are the right tool for the problem, including extraction from unstructured documents, classification, routing, summarization, and drafting. Design the prompts, test them against representative data, and define the accuracy required before launching. * Determine where human review is required, set confidence thresholds that route uncertain cases to staff, and define what happens when the model produces incorrect output. * Handle supporting work with the same care as the build itself, including data validation, idempotency, credential management, environment separation, and documentation sufficient for another engineer to take over. *Define and scope* * Work with department leads to document current\-state processes and identify automation candidates, quantifying the time and cost each process consumes today. * Assess feasibility and recommend alternatives when a process change or a configuration change in an existing system would solve the problem more effectively than a new automation. * Translate operational needs into technical requirements and divide work into phases that deliver value early. * Set clear expectations with stakeholders on accuracy, exception handling, and scope. This matters especially for AI\-assisted steps, where acceptable error rates should be agreed in advance. *Own and maintain* * Own each automation through its full lifecycle, including monitoring, response when upstream systems change, iteration as processes evolve, and retirement once it is no longer needed. * Build in monitoring and alerting so that failures surface quickly instead of going unnoticed. * Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support does not depend on a single person. * Track and report impact, including hours returned, error rates, cycle time, and usage. *Support and enable others* * Train and support staff who want to build simple automations on their own, extending the reach of the team. * Contribute to the team's standards and patterns, including guidelines on what organizational data may be sent to external AI services. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of professional experience building automations, integrations, or internal tools. * Strong Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript skills, with experience writing code that other engineers have maintained. * Substantial experience with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, and of SQL and experience with inconsistent or incomplete operational data. * Proven ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders, including gathering requirements, managing expectations, and supporting adoption. * Good judgment about which processes are appropriate for candidates for automation, and which are not. *Preferred* * Experience with integration or workflow platforms such as Workato, Make, n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, or Temporal. * Experience with document processing, OCR, or extraction from unstructured sources. * Experience in a comparable operational environment where automations touch finance, HR, or customer\-facing workflows. * Familiarity with data governance and access controls in environments that handle sensitive records. **What is Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts?** Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc. (LCPA) is a cultural and civic cornerstone of New York City. We believe the arts play an important role in our lives: they nourish our hearts and minds, teach us valuable lessons and critical skills, and help us create community. The manager of the 16\-acre Lincoln Center campus * We are one of eleven amazing resident arts organizations 2\. A leading Arts Presenter. * We curate numerous programs and performances, showcasing music, dance, and more 3\. An Education Hub. * We have reached 20 million students, educators, principals, and community members **Who are our people?** LCPA is a team of dreamers, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who use unique platforms in the heart of New York City and beyond to advocate for the transformative impact of artistic experiences. Lincoln Center People imagine and create in concert with this mission by founding President John D. Rockefeller III \- "The arts are not for the privileged few, but for the many. Their place is not on the periphery of daily life, but at its center." We welcome applicants from all sectors who agilely solve problems, show up as they are, and can't stop innovating. **What’s the news?** *Recent and Upcoming Programming* * **Lincoln Center Reveals 25/26 Season Featuring Jeanine Tesori as Visionary Artist** * **Kyle Abraham's 20 Years of Urgency at Lincoln Center Rose Theatre** *Campus Happenings* * **Lincoln Center Gets $50 Million Gift to Promote Contemporary Dance** * **The new JFK terminal will show iconic artworks from MoMA, the Met and Lincoln Center** *Legacies of San Juan Hill* * **WNYC: Lincoln Center Celebrates 'Legacies of San Juan Hill** * **Lincoln Center Launches San Juan Hill Project Digital Hub To Remember the Lost Urban Neighborhood** **Who is our President and CEO?** Dr. Mariko Silver **Join us!** It is the policy of Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc., to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, marital or civil partnership/union status, familial or caregiver status, alienage or citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, military or veteran status, genetic information, predisposition, or carrier status, unemployment status, domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking victim status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. LCPA is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. *If you require reasonable accommodation in locating open positions, completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to Abigail Worsnip at (212\) 875–5324\.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI Evaluation
jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. We've raised $5M from Pear, BoxGroup, Workbench, and Emergence, alongside the CEO of Box, the co\-founder of Dropbox, and senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. **The role** ------------ **Figure out what "good" means for AI agents doing real work, and prove it.** You'll design how we measure agents in domains where there's no answer key, and make sure the numbers can be trusted. It's research\-leaning, hands\-on work that ships to customers. You'll work on: * Verifiers and graders for knowledge work with no ground truth * Making simulated environments and tasks faithful to the real world * Knowing when you've tested enough, and when a score means something * Turning what works for one customer into something the product does automatically Why it's exciting: * Nobody has written the playbook for measuring agents in real work yet. You'll write it. * Real agents in high\-stakes domains, not academic benchmarks. * Measurement, not capability: whether agents are actually useful, and how anyone would know. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You've built evals, benchmarks, verifiers, reward models, RL environments, or synthetic data pipelines for LLMs or agents * You think like a researcher about whether a number means anything, and you write production code to find out * You've chosen risk before: founder, founding engineer, early employee, or a small, high\-output team * You typically have 2–6 years of experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in non\-code domains like legal, finance, healthcare, or enterprise work * Post\-training experience (SFT, RLHF, RLVR) * Statistics for evaluation, benchmark design, or published eval research **Probably not a fit** ---------------------- * Eval dashboards or observability tooling with no hands\-on eval design * Model training with little interest in evaluation **What we offer** ----------------- * Founding equity and competitive cash * One of the first hires, working directly with the founder and customers from day one * A say in how agent quality gets measured across the industry * A beautiful office in FiDi * Breakfast, lunch, and dinner * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equinox membership or a fitness stipend * Essentially unlimited budget for AI tools and tokens * Relocation support if you're moving to San Francisco

jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. Thousands of agents run against those worlds in parallel, each run isolated and replayable, often inside a customer's own cloud. Nothing off the shelf does this. You'll design it and own the architecture from day one. You'll work on: * Simulated environments that spin up, reset, and replay on demand * Running large fleets of agents quickly and cheaply * Deploying securely into the most demanding enterprise environments * The core architecture, and turning it into a product teams adopt on their own Why it's exciting: * Infrastructure here is the moat, not a dashboard on top of a database. * What you build decides which customers we can say yes to. * The runtime for agent simulation is still being invented. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You're a strong backend or infrastructure engineer who has been early before * You've built and run production systems, and you're excited to own the parts you haven't done yet * You're AI\-pilled: you build with LLMs, work alongside coding agents every day, and have opinions about where agents break * You make strong architectural calls with incomplete information * You typically have 3–10 years of experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure * Containers, sandboxing, and isolation * Distributed systems and data pipelines * Enterprise security and compliance **Probably not a fit** ---------------------- * Front\-end only * Roles where you never made the architectural calls * Careers spent entirely inside very large companies **What we offer** ----------------- * Founding equity and competitive cash * One of the first hires, working directly with the founder and customers from day one * Ownership of the platform architecture from the start * A beautiful office in FiDi * Breakfast, lunch, and dinner * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equinox membership or a fitness stipend * Essentially unlimited budget for AI tools and tokens * Relocation support if you're moving to San Francisco

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: About Luxer One --------------- Luxer One designs and deploys smart locker and access systems across multifamily properties, commercial enterprises, retail chains, and food delivery networks across North America. An Assa Abloy company, our products span cloud, mobile, and physical hardware — connected through firmware that runs in the field, at scale, around the clock. We manufacture control boards, IoT gateways, access hubs, and connected locker systems, and the firmware powering those devices is what makes all of it reliable. Why This Role Matters --------------------- When firmware works, nobody notices. When it doesn't, a deployed device goes dark, a locker doesn't open, or a fleet of devices stops reporting health to the cloud. At Luxer One, firmware is not a support function — it is the reliability foundation of everything we ship. We are actively scaling our embedded portfolio: next\-generation control boards, IoT\-connected gateways, BLE and WiFi\-enabled locker hardware, mesh access systems, and temperature\-managed storage devices. Each program is a real production deployment with real uptime expectations and real customers on the other end. We need a Senior Firmware Engineer who can own programs end to end — from hardware bring\-up and architecture through production firmware, OTA update pipelines, and field reliability — and who brings genuine seniority to the embedded systems decisions that define product quality at scale. Who You Are ----------- You are a firmware engineer who is equally comfortable writing embedded C at the register level and presenting a hardware architecture decision to a cross\-functional team. You do not wait for specs to be perfect before you start, and you do not consider a program done when code ships — you own it through field deployment and into production operations. You are: * A low\-level builder — you write production C/C\+\+ on microcontrollers, understand memory models, peripheral drivers, and timing constraints, and can debug a device in the field with an oscilloscope and a logic analyzer as readily as in a simulator * Reliable in production — you treat uptime as a personal accountability; you build telemetry in, design OTA update paths that fail safely, and watch the fleet after launch * A cross\-discipline collaborator — you work directly with electrical engineers on schematic review and hardware bring\-up, and with manufacturing partners on NPI readiness and production tooling * A technical decision\-maker — you author architecture docs and hardware specifications that others build from, not just code that implements what someone else decided * AI\-fluent — you actively use AI tools in your engineering workflow: for documentation, code review, debugging analysis, status reporting, and technical communication. You move faster and produce higher\-quality artifacts because of it, and you are interested in the broader frontier of AI\-assisted embedded development * Operationally minded — you understand that embedded systems in a commercial IoT product live in the real world, subject to network outages, power interruptions, hostile environments, and user error. You design for that reality, not the happy path And you bring: * A track record of shipping embedded firmware for IoT or connected hardware products into production at meaningful scale * Experience with the full embedded development lifecycle: architecture, bring\-up, driver development, application firmware, manufacturing tooling, OTA, and field maintenance * Hands\-on experience with BLE, WiFi, or cellular connectivity in embedded products * Comfort owning multiple concurrent hardware programs with limited supervision What You'll Do -------------- * Own firmware architecture and delivery for Luxer One's embedded hardware portfolio — including locker control boards, IoT gateways, BLE/WiFi\-connected access hardware, and next\-generation platform programs * Design and implement firmware from the ground up on new hardware programs: architecture decisions, peripheral bring\-up, RTOS integration, application layer, and production readiness * Build and maintain OTA update pipelines and device management integration — including MDM enrollment, provisioning workflows, and fleet telemetry * Partner with electrical engineers and manufacturing partners (including Ansync) on hardware design review, design for manufacturability, NPI readiness, and production validation * Write and maintain hardware specifications, architecture decision records, and technical documentation that inform roadmap decisions and manufacturing commitments * Maintain and improve the reliability of devices in the field — monitoring telemetry, identifying failure patterns, shipping patches, and owning uptime metrics on deployed fleets * Contribute to firmware quality standards: code review, CI pipeline health, automated test coverage, and escape defect rates from QA * Actively use AI tools in your workflow — for documentation generation, debugging analysis, status reporting, and code review — and help the team develop best practices for AI\-assisted embedded development * Represent embedded systems in cross\-functional planning — product roadmap, NPI programs, commercial partner engagements — as the authoritative technical voice on firmware capabilities and constraints ### **Requirements** What We're Looking For ---------------------- * Five or more years of firmware or embedded software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production IoT or connected hardware programs * Strong C/C\+\+ in an embedded context — microcontrollers, peripheral drivers, RTOS (FreeRTOS or similar), memory management * Experience with wireless connectivity in embedded products — BLE, WiFi, or cellular — including protocol handling, reliability design, and power management * OTA update design and implementation experience — including safe rollback, version management, and fleet\-scale deployment * Experience with hardware bring\-up: schematic review, debugger and logic analyzer usage, boot sequence troubleshooting * Experience producing technical specifications and architecture documents — not just code * Demonstrated AI fluency in your engineering workflow — you use AI tools actively and can articulate how they make you more effective * Strong communication — written and verbal — across technical and non\-technical audiences Strongly Preferred ------------------ * Experience working with contract manufacturers on NPI programs — design reviews, manufacturing test tooling, production validation * Familiarity with device management platforms (MDM) for IoT fleets — enrollment, provisioning, remote management * Linux\-based embedded systems experience (Yocto, Buildroot, or similar) * Experience with secure boot, secure element integration, or key management in an embedded context * Background in access control, smart lock, or connected physical security systems * Experience with fleet telemetry design and uptime instrumentation for connected hardware at scale ### **Benefits** Location \& Work Model ---------------------- This is a Sacramento, CA\-based role. We work in\-office and value in\-person collaboration with the hardware team, manufacturing partners, and cross\-functional engineering. Relocation support available for the right candidate. Compensation \& Benefits ------------------------ * $140,000 – $175,000 base salary, commensurate with experience * Annual performance bonus * 401(k) with employer match * Competitive health, dental, and vision benefits * Accrued Paid Time Off, Sick Leave, Floating Holiday What We're Looking For Five or more years of firmware or embedded software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production IoT or connected hardware programs Strong C/C\+\+ in an embedded context — microcontrollers, peripheral drivers, RTOS (FreeRTOS or similar), memory management Experience with wireless connectivity in embedded products — BLE, WiFi, or cellular — including protocol handling, reliability design, and power management OTA update design and implementation experienc

knowledge of Oracle, MongoDB, or SQL‑based databases is a plus. * This role includes participation in an on‑call rotation approximately every five weeks to support critical application reliability. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Operator Tools
jobs.description: MarginEdge is seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our new Operator Tools team — the group responsible for helping restaurants understand and control their costs, and ultimately manage their restaurants better. The team organizes around problems that define a restaurant's costs and operating workflows. We worry about things like what restaurants spend to bring goods in the door and the ordering workflow behind it; what it costs for the restaurant to make a dish and the recipe and prep workflows that produce it. We take the data a restaurant already has and turn it into insights and automations that drive savings, while giving operators hours back in their week. We believe that a number sitting in a report has limited value; helping operators turn those numbers into action is our job. MarginEdge’s Operator Tools are part of a broader SaaS solution built for restaurant operators by restaurant operators. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a problem area end\-to\-end. That means you are accountable for an outcome, not a feature list: you determine what is worth solving, work with the team to define the best solution, get it built and launched, and then evaluate the impact. You will work closely with external stakeholders — restaurant owners, GMs, head chefs, managers, accountants and bartenders — and translate their pain points to the MarginEdge engineering, design, operations, sales, and marketing teams. The ideal candidate has a “buck stops here” mentality, where you take responsibility for ensuring that all the stakeholders are put in a position to succeed, and you proactively anticipate the concerns of both customers and your team. **MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology** As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real\-time data. Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture\-backed and serve 12,000\+ restaurants across the US and Canada. We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them. We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees. **What type of responsibilities will I have?** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for your problem area. Partner with leadership to define success, make prioritization decisions, and communicate the strategy and trade\-offs. * Build a deep understanding of restaurant operators and their workflows through regular customer interaction, qualitative research, and product data, and represent that understanding in product decisions. * Validate problems and solutions before making significant investments. Use lightweight tests, prototypes, and pilots to reduce uncertainty, and be willing to change direction when the evidence warrants it. * Use data throughout the product lifecycle. Be able to investigate usage and workflow patterns yourself, partner with Data on what needs to be collected, and measure whether launches actually drove the intended outcome. * Lead product development in close partnership with Design and Engineering, from exploration and prototyping through delivery, balancing customer value, usability, feasibility, and quality. * Understand the competitive and market landscape well enough to know where we are differentiated, where we are exposed, and where there are unmet operator needs. * Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Operations on positioning, enablement, rollout, and post\-launch feedback. * Take on ambiguous, early\-stage opportunities and bring them to a point where the company can make an informed decision about whether and how to invest. * Be the product expert and accountable owner for your area, providing context and direction when customer issues, product questions, feature requests, and new opportunities arise. * Communicate strategy, decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. * Raise the bar for product practice across the team through mentoring and by improving how we approach discovery, writing, decision\-making, and measurement. **What qualifications or skills are required?** * 3\-6 years in product management or a related business or technical role (business analyst, product owner, software engineer). * A willingness to roll up your sleeves and spend t erience taking a product from zero to one, not only iterating on an established one. * Experience with hardware products and mobile applications. * Restaurant experience. * Experience building, designing, or otherwise working with software for restaurant owners and operators. **Compensation:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$135,000–$150,000** annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package. **What’s it like to work for MarginEdge?** Imagine the fun of a great restaurant \- surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other \- then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge! We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered \- so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. jobs.description: We are looking for a **Software Development Manager** to help scale our payments platform and expand the financial products we offer to our restaurant clients. You will be responsible for the delivery, quality, and growth of your team while acting as a key partner to product and design. You will balance hands\-on technical leadership with people management, helping engineers grow and ensuring your team ships secure, reliable software that thousands of restaurants rely on to pay their vendors and manage their spend across the US and Canada. MarginEdge is a SaaS platform that serves independent restaurants with a focus on simplifying complex operations and delivering actionable insights. Our system is cloud\-hosted on AWS, with services developed using Java/Spring Boot and front\-end technologies like React and React Native. Our data architecture leverages both NoSQL (DynamoDB) and relational (Postgres) databases. We also have a growing portfolio of financial products, including bill pay, integrations with third\-party payment partners, virtual credit cards, and our own payments card, that move money on behalf of our clients and simplify how restaurants pay vendors and manage spend, built on integrations with our banking and card\-issuing partners. **MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology** As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. jobs.title: Sr./Staff Process Engineer - Detailed Engineering and Plant Design
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **The Role** We are hiring a Senior / Staff Process Engineer to execute detailed engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, line and instrument and valve lists, control narratives, hydraulic models, equipment and bulk specifications, and the procurement packages behind them. Mariana executes process engineering in\-house, you will produce these deliverables yourself, own their technical content and revision history, and carry them through procurement, construction, and commissioning. **What You’ll Do** * Own the process design basis for your assigned areas. Design cases and margins, turndown, utility and reagent demands, and the first principles and assumptions basis behind them * Develop PFDs, heat and material balances, and P\&IDs. Manage the metadata behind smart drafting and modeling software such as Plant 3D * Develop P\&IDs from concept through IFC. Including, but not limited to, equipment, instrumentation and control loops, isolation and relief philosophy, drains and vents, sample and utility stations, sloping and tracing notes, and tie\-ins * Manage and develop automated workflows for the process data behind the line, instrument, and valve lists. E.g. line numbers and sizes, service conditions, design and test pressures and temperatures, pipe class selection, insulation and heat tracing, and instrument process data * Build and maintain the hydraulic models. Line sizing and pressure drop, pump and blower curves and duty points, NPSH margin, control valve and orifice sizing, slurry and two\-phase lines, and gravity, launder, and vent flow. Evaluate automation opportunities to link this to heat and material balances and Plant 3D datamanger * Size and specify process equipment such as pumps, control valves, relief devices, heat exchangers, tanks and agitators, filters, thickeners, mixer\-settlers, crystallizers, and solid–liquid separation * Write the control narratives and functional descriptions with support from the controls engineering team * Represent process in PHAs and HAZOP. * Coordinate across detailed engineering disciplines. Such as equipment lists and loads to mechanical, motor and instrument lists to electrical and controls, and layout, access, and maintenance clearances with piping and civil\-structural * Support construction and commissioning. RFI and field change resolution, P\&ID walkdowns and field verification, loop checks and functional testing, water and first\-feed startup, and as\-built closeout **Desired Qualifications** * 8\+ years of process engineering delivering detailed design for industrial process facilities — in an EPC/EPCM, owner’s engineer, or in\-house capital projects environment * Detailed\-engineering cycle on at least one greenfield or major brownfield project * BS in Chemical, Metallurgical, or Process Engineering. PE preferred **Preferred, but not required** * Lithium — direct lithium extraction, spodumene leaching, crystallization, and battery\-grade product specifications * Copper — heap and tank leaching, solvent extraction and electrowinning, tankhouse and electrolyte circuits * Slurry and solids handling — thickeners, filters, pulp and tailings piping, and settling and erosion design * Data\-centric P\&ID platforms — SmartPlant P\&ID, AVEVA P\&ID, or Plant 3D P\&ID — where the drawing is a database, not a picture **Our culture is built on four principles:** -------------------------------------------- **Everyone Gets Home Safe.** We never put speed or cost ahead of people. **Extreme Ownership.** We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. **Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.** We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. **Share Your Legos.** We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. **Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!**

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - Data Nexus
jobs.description: **Location**: This is a hybrid remote/in\-office role. ***Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in\-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.*** **About our Company**: Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground\-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry\-leading expertise, analytics\-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end\-to\-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata. **Our Team** ------------ The Data Nexus team within Medidata Study Experience builds the modern data foundation that connects clinical applications, customer data, analytics, and enterprise integrations. Our mission is to make clinical operational data easier to ingest, migrate, transform, govern, and consume at scale. We build capabilities spanning large\-scale customer and third\-party study migrations, near\-real\-time CDC and streaming pipelines, reusable data products, analytics and reporting, and cross\-product data integrations. We are modernizing our platform around cloud\-native and lakehouse architectures using technologies including AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Apache Flink, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Apache Iceberg. We treat data as a product and build trusted, reusable capabilities that power Medidata applications, customer integrations, analytics, and emerging AI/ML experiences. **Who you are:** As a Staff Data Engineer, you will be a hands\-on technical leader responsible for solving complex data engineering problems, influencing architecture and technical direction, driving strategic initiatives across teams, and raising engineering standards across Data Nexus. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable data ingestion, migration, CDC, streaming, and ETL/ELT solutions. * Provide technical leadership for large\-scale customer and third\-party clinical study data migrations. * Design and build reusable data products and services supporting Medidata applications, analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and customer integrations. * Drive modernization across cloud data warehousing, workflow orchestration, streaming, and lakehouse architectures. * Design scalable data models, transformation frameworks, APIs, and integration patterns for complex operational and analytical workloads. * Improve data quality, observability, performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency across the platform. * Lead technical design and architecture discussions and collaborate across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and other teams to deliver complex initiatives. * Mentor engineers, review designs and code, and establish engineering patterns and best practices across the team. * Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar technologies to accelerate development, refactoring, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation. * Identify opportunities to apply Generative AI and intelligent data experiences to improve how users discover, understand, and interact with clinical data. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, including experience designing and operating large\-scale production data systems. * Strong understanding of modern data engineering patterns including ETL/ELT, Change Data Capture, streaming, data modeling, data migration, and distributed data processing. * Strong software engineering fundamentals with proficiency in SQL and experience with languages such as Python, Java, Scala, or equivalent. * Experience with modern cloud data platforms, transformation frameworks, and workflow orchestration technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or comparable platforms. * Experience designing and operating cloud\-native data solutions on AWS or another major cloud platform. * Hands\-on experience with streaming and lakehouse technologies such as Apache Flink, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Amazon S3, and enterprise data catalog technologies such as AWS Glue or comparable platforms. * Strong understanding of scalability, performance, security, data quality,   such as model gateways, MCP, prompt and context management, evaluation, observability, security, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with large\-scale enterprise or clinical data migrations, analytics platforms, APIs, or reusable data products. * Experience with infrastructure automation and modern engineering practices using technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or equivalent. * Experience in life sciences, healthcare, clinical trials, or another regulated environment. jobs.title: Quality Engineer II
jobs.description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. We’re purposeful. We’re committed. And we’re driven by our Mission to alleviate pain, restore health and extend life for millions of people worldwide. The Quality function partners across manufacturing, operations, engineering, and quality systems to ensure products and processes meet regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. This team provides quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle, supporting risk management, process improvements, product disposition, change management, validation activities, and continuous compliance initiatives. This position is based in Juncos, Puerto Rico and follows an onsite work arrangement, requiring regular presence at the manufacturing facility to support daily operations and cross\-functional collaboration. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. * Develop, implement, and maintain quality standards, procedures, and inspection protocols for materials, components, and finished products. * Partner with engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are integrated into products and production processes. * Design and implement inspection, testing, and evaluation methods to verify product quality and process performance. * Perform quality assurance activities, including data analysis and statistical evaluations, to identify trends and drive improvements. * Investigate nonconformances and quality issues, determine root cause, and support implementation of corrective and preventive actions. * Ensure quality records, investigations, and supporting documentation comply with applicable regulatory and quality system requirements. * Provide oversight and support for production equipment qualification and process validation activities. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve product reliability, process capability, and overall quality performance. **Required Knowledge and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering and 2\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Manufacturing, Engineering, or a regulated industry environment OR Master's degree. * Experience supporting quality systems within a manufacturing or regulated environment. * Experience conducting investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action activities. * Experience with quality data analysis and statistical evaluation methods. Knowledge of process validation, equipment qualification, or product quality control activities. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), FDA regulations, ISO 13485, and Quality System Regulations (QSR). * Experience supporting Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Nonconformance Material Report (NCMR), and root cause investigation activities. * Experience using statistical analysis and quality improvement tools such as Minitab, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and trend analysis. * Knowledge of manufacturing process controls, inspection methods, process capability, and product quality monitoring. * Experience with electronic quality management systems (eQMS), quality data analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or experience applying Lean and Six Sigma principles in a manufacturing environment. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Our business technology team is enhancing its data engineering capabilities with focus in financial services data including accounting, finance, and broader Enterprise Data initiatives. We are seeking a skilled **Data Engineer**, along with at least three years of experience, who will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and Lakehouse architectures utilizing Python, Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps, Jira and more. **Our Data Engineer will be able to do the following confidently and independently...** * Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines utilizing Microsoft Fabric Notebooks (Python) and Fabric Pipelines. * Utilize CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git\-based workflows, Fabric deployment pipelines, etc.) to automate code deployments, testing, and release processes. * Maintain version control across code, pipeline definitions, SQL models, and integration scripts. * Build and maintain integrations (initially Salesforce) for syncing data between source systems and the enterprise data warehouse in Microsoft Fabric. * Architect and manage Lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold) structures aligning with enterprise medallion best practices. * Develop scalable data models for investment reporting, portfolio analytics, and capital markets insights. * Ensure schema alignment, consistency, and auditability across all inbound data flows. * Implement ongoing monitoring, validation, and reconciliation to support trusted investment and risk reporting. * Maintain metadata, data dictionaries, and technical documentation in alignment with Enterprise data governance. Requirements: **What we are looking for...** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data analytics, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering or cloud ETL development. * Proficient in Python for data engineering, automation, and integration tasks. * Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar). * Experience with version control (preferably Git\-based) from managing code, pipelines, and deployment artifacts. * Hands\-on experience integrating systems (Bulk API, REST API, or connector\-based ingestion). * Experience with data quality frameworks and data governance concepts. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience working with investment, capital markets, or financial services data. * Familiarity with Git\-based workflows, DevOps pipelines, or Fabric deployment processes. * Power BI and semantic model support experience. * Experience with cloud\-based orchestration or event\-driven patterns. **Our Benefits** At Merchants, we believe in investing in our people. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation, generous paid time off, wellness resources, and a standout Tuition Assistance Program that covers 100% of eligible tuition expenses, as well as required books and materials. Whether you're advancing your education, growing your career, or planning for the future, we're committed to supporting your success every step of the way. **About Merchants** Ranked as a top performing U.S. public bank by S\&P Global Market Intelligence, Merchants Bancorp is a diversified bank holding company headquartered in Carmel, Indiana operating multiple segments, including Multi\-family Mortgage Banking that offers multi\-family housing and healthcare facility financing and servicing; Mortgage Warehousing that offers mortgage warehouse financing; and Banking that offers retail and correspondent residential mortgage banking, agricultural lending, and traditional community banking. Merchants Bancorp, with $18\.8 billion in assets and $11\.9 billion in deposits as of December 31, 2024, conducts its business primarily through its direct and indirect subsidiaries, Merchants Bank of Indiana, Merchants Capital Corp., Merchants Capital Investments, LLC, Merchants Capital Servicing, LLC, Merchants Asset Management, LLC, and Merchants Mortgage, a division of Merchants Bank of Indiana. Merchants Bank and Merchants Capital have recently been honored with the 2025 USA Today Top Workplaces recognition, ranking 22nd nationally within the 500\-999 employee category. This is the second year that Merchants has been recognized with this award. These accolades build on our strong history of workplace recognition, including being named a Best Place to Work in Indiana for seven consecutive years (2016–2022\). For more information read the entire article here.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud, including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI\-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and services that are transforming Azure customer support from reactive, human\-dependent workflows toward AI\-first systems capable of resolving customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to help build the next generation of production agentic AI services that resolve customer issues faster, reduce avoidable support demand, and improve the reliability and scalability of AI\-first support experiences. You will take product specifications and turn them into production\-ready, scalable AI services — working with LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, and RAG\-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact Azure customers. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help our team provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** Key Responsibilities * Translate product specifications into AI service architectures — decompose business intent into agent workflows, data source integrations, and scalable service designs. * Build agentic AI workflows using Azure AI Foundry Agent Service and Microsoft Agent Framework, including multi\-agent coordination, tool integrations, and agent lifecycle management. * Develop and iterate on LLM\-based solutions including prompt engineering, model selection, cost/token optimization, and RAG pipeline design. * Build evaluation systems including rubrics, golden datasets, and judge agents to validate agent correctness and safety before production deployment. * Write production\-quality C\# and Python with test\-driven development, ensuring services meet reliability, performance, and security standards. * Deploy services using CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and staged rollouts with full production observability (tracing, logging, metrics). * Implement secure service patterns including RBAC, Managed Identities, and secrets management. * Integrate agents with Azure data sources and cloud\-native services to ground agent responses in real\-time signals. * Apply Responsible AI practices across all agent development, ensuring outputs are safe, fair, and compliant. * Execute reliably within sprint and co\-development commitments across ACES and partner engineering teams. * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI service components, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications :** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. **Other:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.**Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, or related field. * 4\+ years of software engineering experience in C\# and/or Python, with production deployment experience. * Experience building or integrating with LLM\-based systems (prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks). * Familiarity with Azure services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, or similar cloud\-native technologies). * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production observability. * Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration and agent\-to\-agent communication protocols. * Experience with evaluation frameworks for AI systems (rubrics, golden datasets, judge agents). * Familiarity with RAG pipelines and vector retrieval systems. * Experience with container orchestration, microservices architecture, and cloud\-native deployment patterns. * Experience with security best practices (RBAC, Managed Identities, secrets management). * Experience working in Agile/sprint\-based delivery with cross\-org dependencies. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. * \#EngOps \#EngOpsACES Software Engineering IC3 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 \- $202,200 per year. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Start with the data pipeline, range across the full stack, and help take a mature, revenue\-earning platform to the next level, with AI at the center of how you build.*** About Northern Light Northern Light provides the world's most sophisticated machine learning\-powered competitive intelligence platform for market research. For over 25 years, we've been helping Fortune 1000 enterprises make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions through our award\-winning SinglePoint knowledge management platform. Our clients include global leaders across technology, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and life sciences who depend on us to transform fragmented data into strategic clarity. We're a company that takes pride in our compulsive drive to provide exceptional client support. We wake up each day ready to tackle the challenges of knowledge management and we never stand still. Our recent innovations include generative AI capabilities, machine learning insights, and advanced competitive intelligence automation. The Product: Search Over Content Nobody Else Has Assembled SinglePoint is an enterprise search and market\-intelligence platform. We license content from a large number of publishers and research vendors, combine it with each customer's own internal documents, normalize all of it, enrich it, index it into per\-customer search databases, and serve it through a customer\-specific portal with search, analytics, NLP enrichment, and AI summarization and Q\&A. Our customers are research and strategy teams at large enterprises. When they can't find something, it costs them a decision. The Opportunity Northern Light is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to start in our content pipeline and grow into ownership across the full platform. The pipeline brings in content from well over a hundred vendor feeds, makes it consistent, and makes it searchable for every customer. From there, the whole platform is open to you: services, search, AI features, and the customer portals. It all works, it earns real revenue, and it's ready for its next chapter. We're looking for someone who sees a 25\-year\-old platform as an opportunity, reaches for AI tools by default, and gets genuinely excited about making something proven dramatically better. What You'll Do * Build and maintain ingestion for new vendor feeds and new customers, from the vendor's delivery quirks through to documents appearing in a customer's search results. * Shape how vendor content is transformed into a consistent, reliable format customers can trust. * Migrate legacy pipelines onto the current stack, including an ongoing Perl\-to\-Python effort and a newer move toward containerized, contract\-bound services. * Help replace convention\-driven job scheduling with explicit, durable workflows. * Track down production content problems and fix them at the root. * Bring AI into the pipeline itself, using ML, NLP, LLMs, and AI tooling to classify, enrich, and validate content, and to speed up how we build and migrate. * Work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the customer portals (PHP and React/TypeScript), following problems and ideas all the way from the vendor to what the customer sees. Who We Hire: AI\-First Builders Who Finish What They Start You can take a task that isn't fully specified, go find the missing context yourself, and drive it until it is running in production, verified against the behavior it replaced, and the thing it replaced is switched off. Not “my part is done.” Done. Transforming a mature system takes creativity and energy as much as rigor. We want someone who brings fresh ideas, shares them freely, and makes the people around them better. What We're Looking For * **A track record of delivering production software.** Things you built that real users depend on, and that you kept running. * **Comfort in code you didn't write.** Much of this estate is older than the people working on it. You can read an unfamiliar system, form an accurate model of it, and change it safely. * **Strong data pipeline instincts.** You build pipelines that are reliable and repeatable, and you can prove a new one matches the old one before you cut over. * **Operational comfort.** Containers, CI/CD, and enough production instinct to know whether your change is actually live. * **An AI\-first way of working.** You use AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agents every day, and you have ideas about where they can make a pipeline smarter. * **Collaborative energy.** Small team, big ambitions. You share ideas freely, write down what you learn, and make the people around you better. * **Judgment about scope.** You know when to fix the root cause and when to ship the narrow thing and record the debt. Languages: No Language Requirement What runs here today is mostly Python, Rust, PHP, and React, plus some long\-lived Perl. New backend work is mostly Python and Rust; the portals are PHP and React. We don't require any of these on your résumé. We hire for judgment, for the ability to pick up whatever the problem happens to be written in, and for finishing. If you have been strong in two or three languages, you'll be fine in ours. One honest note: you will read Perl in this job. You don't have to love it. You do have to be willing. Helps, But Not Required * Building with LLMs, embeddings, or AI agents in production * Web crawling and scraping at scale (Scrapy or equivalent) * Search and information retrieval: indexing, relevance, faceting * Durable workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow * Rust * Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform * PHP * Working with licensed third\-party data feeds Job Details **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Location:** Hybrid in the Boston, MA area, with regular time at our Somerville office, Eastern Time working hours. **Work authorization requirements:** Must be authorized to work in the United States (unfortunately, we cannot sponsor visas). Why Join Northern Light * Join a company shaping the future of competitive and market intelligence. * Work with a collaborative, high\-performing team that values creativity, experimentation, and measurable results. * Put AI at the center of how you build, with the room to bring new ideas into a platform customers already rely on. * Range across the full stack, from vendor feeds to the customer\-facing portals. * Competitive salary, benefits, and professional growth opportunities. * Regular team offsites and opportunities for cross\-functional collaboration. Working at Northern Light Northern Light is based in the Boston, MA area. Northern Light is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Northern Light SinglePoint, LLC participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I\-9 information to confirm employment eligibility for all new hires. For more information, visit www.e\-verify.gov. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

"Forward Deployment Engineer Role Summary The Forward Deployed Engineer — AI FDE deploys, configures, extends, and operationalizes NTT DATA's industry\-specific AI platforms — AI for Insurance and AI for Manufacturing — within customer environments. These platforms, powered by the AI Vista Platform, are designed for Service as Software (SaS) — replacing manual, labor\-intensive back\-office operations with AI\-driven agentic workflows that deliver outcomes autonomously, with human oversight where it matters. The platforms provide pre\-built specialized agents, domain ontologies, governed workflows, and composable building blocks. The FDE takes these capabilities into production for specific customers — configuring extraction schemas, authoring business rules, registering connectors, assembling workflows, deploying containerized services, and ensuring governed, observable operation. The FDE combines agentic AI engineering expertise with domain understanding, DevOps capability, and customer engagement skills. platform improvements that benefit all future deployments. * Contribute to reusable implementation assets: deployment playbooks, configuration templates, and integration patterns. services, managed databases, blob storage, and identity providers. * Experience with containerized deployments: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, container registries, and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment. * Familiarity with LLM concepts: prompt engineering, model selection and routing, confidence scoring, token economics, and the dis  in customer\-facing, consultative environments. * production context — building APIs, scripting automation, integrating with cloud services, or developing data processing pipelines. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in a hands\-on engineering capacity. * Experience implementing, configuring, or extending enterprise platforms or products within customer environments. * Experience delivering technology solutions in one or more of the following domains: insurance (underwriting, claims, policy administration, TPA operations), manufacturing (quality, supply chain, compliance, production operations), or adjacent regulated industries. * Experience translating domain\-specific workflows, business rules, and operational constraints into technology solution configurations. * Experience working with AI/ML systems in production — model integration, confidence\-based routing, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, or document processing pipelines. * Experience providing structured field feedback to product or engineering teams, distinguishing between customer\-specific needs and reusable platform improvements. * Experience operating independently and solving complex business and technical challenges within ambiguous or evolving environments."
