jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** Natera is seeking a **Principal AI Engineer** to set technical direction for, and hands\-on build of, the Vector Store GenAI Platform that powers document intelligence and retrieval across our Real\-World Data (RWD) organization. The platform ingests clinical documents from multiple sources, indexes them for high\-quality search, and makes that content available to downstream AI workflows and business use cases across oncology and other clinical domains. This is a principal\-level individual contributor role with architecture\-plus\-build ownership of retrieval, document processing, and ingestion systems. You will define platform strategy and sequencing, ship production code in a cloud environment, raise the reliability and quality of search and retrieval, and prove new approaches through POCs and benchmarks. You will partner with clinical, engineering, and product leaders to turn ambiguous priorities into a clear technical roadmap, establish standards for how retrieval serves agents and re\-extraction workflows, and deliver measurable improvements in platform quality and operability—with high autonomy and limited day\-to\-day direction. The ideal candidate combines deep hands\-on engineering with a track record of owning complex AI platforms end to end. You set direction, implement critical path yourself, and elevate the technical bar across the teams that consume and extend the platform. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own platform architecture and hands\-on delivery for the Vector Store GenAI Platform, including search and retrieval, document processing and chunking, ingestion pipelines, and APIs that serve downstream AI workflows. * Set technical direction for hybrid search and retrieval quality; evaluate embedding models and retrieval approaches through working implementations, POCs, and benchmarks, and drive adoption of what works in production. * Advance document parsing and chunking so clinical content is indexed in a way that supports accurate, structured, and faceted retrieval across common document types. * Define and build stable, reproducible retrieval for agent and re\-extraction workloads, including durable content identifiers, flexible context assembly, versioned indices, and quality or confidence signals. * Strengthen document classification and ingestion visibility so source material is discoverable, operable, and measurable at scale across historical and ongoing data flows. * Continuously improve retrieval quality through better deduplication, clinical concept normalization, and exploration of promising retrieval methods where they add clear value. * Integrate LLM capabilities into existing production systems with attention to performance, scalability, cost, observability, and safe operation in a regulated environment. * Partner with clinical AI, engineering, product, and SME stakeholders to prioritize workstreams, define success metrics, and sequence roadmap investments without disrupting the live platform. * Provide principal\-level technical leadership through architecture decisions, design reviews, clear documentation, mentoring influence, and pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, latency, cost, and delivery timelines. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree or background in a clinical or life sciences discipline is a plus. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale. * 5\+ years building and shipping AI/ML\-powered applications in production, with deep hands\-on experience in retrieval\-augmented systems, vector search, and document\-centric AI pipelines—including indexing, retrieval quality, evaluation, and integration with downstream LLM or agent systems. * Demonstrated track record as a principal or equivalent IC: setting technical direction for a platform or multi\-team capability, making architecture decisions that stick, and personally delivering critical path production code. * Strong hands\-on expertise in Python and modern software engineering practices, including testing, code review, workflow orchestration, and agile delivery in large existing codebases. * Experience designing and operating AI systems in cloud environments, with AWS strongly preferred; experience with CI/CD, observability, and production support is expected. * Proven ability to work independently as an architecture\-plus\-build IC—influencing without direct authority, aligning stakeholders, and delivering end\-to\-end from strategy through integration and rollout—with strong communication across technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience with clinical or structured healthcare documents and document\-centric search or RAG systems is strongly preferred. * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. * Experience designing retrieval interfaces used by agents or multi\-step LLM workflows is a plus. **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer, Charging
jobs.description: Join Nayax, a global fintech leader (NASDAQ; TASE: NYAX) in cashless payments, consumer engagement and business management solutions, with more than 1,200 employees across 12 offices worldwide. Nayax Energy (formerly Lynkwell, acquired by Nayax in 2025\) is building an integrated energy ecosystem for fleet electrification and public EV charging networks. It is the entry point to mobility and energy management for businesses, fleets, partners, utilities and drivers. We're hiring a full\-time Senior Mobile Engineer, Charging to join our global hardware team on\-site in Schenectady, NY. You'll build the native Android extensions that let our React Native apps talk to our next\-generation EV charging hardware. The role is focused on the native layer, not on building full native apps. You'll write the Kotlin modules that give React Native apps access to the charger hardware, which they talk to locally over a 40\-pin connector. **This role requires working onsite from our Schenectady, NY office five days per week.﻿** **Your key responsibilities will include:** * Build and maintain native Android modules in Kotlin that extend our React Native apps, exposing charger hardware to JavaScript/TypeScript through Turbo Modules, Fabric components or legacy native modules. * Implement local charger communication over the 40\-pin connector between the Android device and the charger hardware, including connection handling, message parsing and error recovery. * Work with the Android hardware and platform APIs that reach the connector (for example serial/UART and GPIO), plus foreground services and permissions, so communication stays reliable in the field. * Design clear, typed JS/TS interfaces for native modules (for example Codegen specs), with predictable events, error handling and lifecycle behavior. * Define the app\-to\-hardware protocols and data contracts with the embedded and hardware engineering team. * Package, version and document native modules, and keep them current through React Native and Android SDK upgrades. * Build test harnesses, simulators and automated tests (unit, instrumentation and on\-device) for native\-to\-hardware flows, supporting hardware and firmware validation. * Mentor less experienced engineers, and explain problems and solutions at every level, from deep technical dives to architecture and design discussions. * Work across teams inside and outside engineering, including customer support, product management, marketing and sales. Requirements: **What Makes You a Great Fit** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 6\+ years of professional software development, including 4\+ years of Android development in Kotlin (Java a plus). * Experience writing native modules or extensions for React Native (Turbo Modules, Fabric or legacy native modules), or for similar frameworks such as Flutter platform channels or Capacitor plugins. * Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, and of how React Native's native layer (JSI, Codegen, the bridge) passes data, events and work between threads. * Hands\-on experience integrating Android with physical hardware over wired interfaces, such as serial/UART, GPIO or USB, on phones, tablets or embedded Android devices. * A strong grasp of Android threading, coroutines, background execution limits and runtime permissions. * Comfort debugging across the app and hardware boundary, using tools like serial monitors, logic analyzers and logcat. * Familiarity with Scrum or Kanban, the full SDLC and testing practices. * Clear communication with engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders, and good task management. * Willingness to work in person at our hardware manufacturing facility in Schenectady, NY. **﻿Nice\-to\-Have Skills** * Familiarity with hardware interfaces and protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, CAN and GPIO. * AOSP or custom Android hardware (kiosks, embedded displays, payment terminals). * Experience in EV charging, energy, IoT, connected devices or smart hardware, including OCPP or UL 1998\. * Building test apparatus for hardware or firmware validation. • General electrical safety knowledge. **Compensation and Benefits** * **The base salary range for this position is $ 95,000\-$145,000 per year** * Eligibility for an annual performance bonus and additional benefits. * Final compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications. **Why Join Nayax** * Make a tangible impact by building tools that are used across a global support organization. * Take ownership from day one and see your work drive measurable business outcomes. * Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and support experts across the company. * Work in a high\-growth environment where your ideas can quickly become reality. * Be part of a global fintech leader transforming how people pay, engage, and do business. Learn More about Nayax: Founded in 2005, Nayax is a global fintech leader providing end‑to‑end payment, consumer engagement, and business management solutions. We help businesses grow revenue, reduce operational complexity, and deliver seamless commerce experiences across unattended, self‑service, and retail environments. With support for 80\+ payment methods across 50\+ currencies, a European payment institution license, and strategic partnerships with leading global financial institutions, Nayax enables secure, scalable, and future‑ready commerce worldwide. Operating across 120\+ countries with 1,200\+ employees in 13 global offices, Nayax combines innovative technology with real‑world impact. At Nayax, we build long‑term value through smart automation, loyalty solutions, and an agile ecosystem designed to scale with our customers \- and our people.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to take ownership of our core card **authorization platform.** This high\-throughput, low\-latency platform processes real\-time debit and prepaid transactions over **ISO 8583** for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts—and every failure carries direct financial impact. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production\-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Technical Leadership \& Team Management** ------------------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 software engineers. * Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. * Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. **Core Architecture \& Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput, low\-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand\-in processing. * Manage long\-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign\-on/sign\-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. * Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. * Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row\-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. * Build fault\-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). **Platform Modernization \& Security** -------------------------------------- * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2\.7 3\.5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. * Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. * Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). **Operations \& Stakeholder Engagement** ---------------------------------------- * Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. * Lead incident response efforts, drive root\-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. * Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. **Requirements \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------- **Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** ----------------------------------- * **Experience \& Leadership:** 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. * **Core Java Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in Java (11/17\+), deep understanding of java.util.concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. * **Spring Framework:** Extensively hands\-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). * **Distributed Transactions \& Systems:** Proven expertise in transaction management trade\-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). * **Database \& RDBMS:** Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. * **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Real\-world experience with event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). * **System Resilience:** Hands\-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high\-availability systems running thousands of TPS. * **DevOps \& Quality:** Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). * **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade\-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** ------------------------- * **jPOS Framework:** Experience with **ISOMsg,** custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), **ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer,** and Q2 configuration. * **ISO 8583 Specifications:** Hands\-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). * **Observability Tools:** Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). * **Advanced Concurrency:** In\-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. * **Card Payments Domain:** Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand\-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). * **Infrastructure \& Rules:** Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). * Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. * **10–15 years** of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high\-throughput, enterprise\-grade Java/J2EE applications. * **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity—driving system design, leading 5–8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. * **Proven track record** of architecting low\-latency, mission\-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.

jobs.description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. escalation, and domain performance tracking * Plan and execute office network builds, moves, and refreshes with Facilities and Security * Design, deploy, and operate Zero Trust and network security architecture diagrams, IP plans, runbooks, and SOPs *AI enablement* * Deploy and administer enterprise AI platforms (Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and related tools), including configuration, scripts and APIs to eliminate manual toil * Act as an escalation point for IT Support on complex network and infrastructure issues * Participate in a global on\-call rotation **This role requires** * 2 years of experience in network, infrastructure, or IT engineering * Strong networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, TLS, VPN, proxy, firewall) and proven troubleshooting skills * problem\-solving skills * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and teach others * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams **Bonus points if you have** * Cisco Meraki certification (CMNA) or CCNA/Network\+ * Experience with SD\-WAN design and multi\-site network management * Experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust, DLP, or CASB tooling * Experience building agents or workflows with MCP, prompt engineering, or LLM APIs * Experience with infrastructure as code or workflow automation (Terraform, Ansible, n8n, or similar) * Experience supporting SOX or similar compliance controls * Experience administering SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, or Atlassian * Experience running AI adoption programs, training, or internal enablement **Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.** **Qualified applicants may inquire about visa sponsorship (including transfer of a current H\-1B visa), but the company does not support or sponsor O\-1, F\-1, or J\-1 visas, or candidates who require commencement of an H\-1B "cap case" petition for future work authorization. This position is to be filled as soon as possible.** \#LI\-MM4 \#LI\-Remote The pay range below represents a reasonable estimate of the salary for the listed position. This role is eligible for a corporate bonus plan. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job\-related factors such as an applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience. New Relic provides a variety of benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental, vision, parental leave and planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, flex time\-off, 11 paid holidays, volunteer time\-off, and other competitive benefits designed to improve the lives of our employees. Estimated Base Pay Range $95,000 \- $119,000 USD Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com. We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid. **Our hiring process** In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic. jobs.description: **Normal Computing \| Build with Us** ------------------------------------- Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), London, Copenhagen, and Seoul. **The Role** ------------ As an early\-career Product Manager, you'll work with the Product Lead and the engineering teams to help build the AI systems and autoresearch platform our ASIC team needs to tapeout unconventional, physics\-based architecture. We are rethinking the chip design system from the ground up, automating the process of research: exploring the full design space, generating candidate architectures, evaluating them at appropriate levels of fidelity, and feeding learnings from experiments run in hardware labs and deployed silicon into the next generation chip. Domains of exploration include RTL optimization, design verification, and continual learning from experiment results. You'll help decide what we build, then be accountable for delivering on the incremental milestones to tapeout. On any given day, you might sit with a chip architect benchmarking novel architectures, shadow a verification debug session and come back with a proposal for what to automate, scope out the requirements and success criteria for a custom EDA tool, or prototype an experiment dashboard. This is a building role. You'll write specs, run experiments, and use coding agents to prototype and land fixes yourself. When you have an idea, we would rather you spend an afternoon prototyping a rough version than a week describing it. No semiconductor background is required to start. In your first few months the bar is understanding how the team works, asking the questions that move a design discussion forward, and earning trust by following through on deliverables. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **AI tooling scope:** Investigate where the ASIC team's time actually goes, decide what we build, then be accountable for whether it gets used. * **Specs and prototypes:** Write the requirements docs and user journeys that engineering builds from. Where a working prototype communicates faster than a document, build the prototype instead. * **Prototype to production:** Work with engineers to turn a promising prototype into something the ASIC team can rely on. * **Shipping small changes:** Work in the codebase with coding agents, open PRs for bug fixes or UI changes, learn from code reviews from engineers, and develop judgment about which changes are yours to make. **What Makes You a Great Fit** ------------------------------ * A degree in CS, EE, physics, math, or similar, or the equivalent taught to yourself. * 1\-3 years of experience in product management, engineering, research, technical program management, or a related technical role. * You can point to something that was your idea and that you made real. * Fluency with coding agents. You already use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or something similar as a normal part of how you work. * Experience building or evaluating LLM\-powered products. * Clarity of communication in both speaking and writing. * Comfort with ambiguity. Much of what you work on will be underspecified. You should be able to take a vague problem, frame it, and come back with a proposal. * Interest in how chips are designed. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Coursework, research, or internship experience in chip architectures, digital design, verification, or hardware performance modeling. * Exposure to SystemVerilog. * Familiarity with the mechanisms underlying LLM inference ***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement*** *Normal Computing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.* ***Accessibility Accommodations*** *Normal Computing is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@normalcomputing.com.* ***Privacy Notice*** *By submitting your application, you agree that Normal Computing may collect, use, and store your personal information for employment\-related purposes in accordance with our* *Applicant Privacy Notice**.* Compensation Range: $205\.5K \- $225K

jobs.title: Director of Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Director of Applied AI Engineering** -------------------------------------- **North \- Remote (US)** ------------------------ *Let’s go North, together.* Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back\-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions. **Job Summary:** ---------------- The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands\-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. This is a delivery role, not a research role, measured by systems that are live, adopted, and safe to run in a regulated financial services environment. This will require an individual with strong software engineering fundamentals, judgment about where large language models and machine learning outperform conventional automation, attention to detail, and the capacity to rapidly develop and act upon in\-depth knowledge of our business, products, customers, and regulatory obligations. This position will partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Risk to improve current business processes, and will work with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security to ensure AI systems are explainable, auditable, and safely governed. This role is responsible for providing updates to leadership on the team's impact through clear reporting and KPIs, and for establishing the long\-term strategy, technical architecture, and responsible\-AI guardrails as well as the short\-term scope and sequencing that gets value into production quickly. **What You’ll Be Doing:** ------------------------- * Build and lead a high\-performing Applied AI engineering team, defining the practice's operating model, engagement strategy, and technical standards from the ground up. * Partner with Product, customers, and business stakeholders to observe workflows and turn operational challenges into effective AI solutions. * Drive rapid discovery, prototyping, and seamless transition of AI capabilities to production across concurrent enterprise projects. * Architect, deploy, and maintain production AI solutions, including agentic workflows, chatbots, copilots, agent\-assist tools, and traditional ML models. * Establish modular, reusable integrations for AI agents to securely access internal systems and enterprise data with least\-privilege controls. * Own the AI evaluation lifecycle, incorporating offline/online evals, benchmark datasets, human\-in\-the\-loop validation, and production readiness criteria. * Manage production operations alongside Cloud and Data engineering, overseeing CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, latency, and inference cost optimization. **What We Need From You:** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, or a related domain, including time in a customer\-facing or business\-embedded engineering capacity (ex. forward deployed, solutions, or professional services engineering) * 2\+ years building and shipping production systems on top of large language models (LLMs), including at least one agentic or conversational system live with real users * 4\+ years of hands\-on management experience with a track record of hiring and growing teams as well as providing coaching and mentoring * Exceptional leadership skills, and proven ability to operate in a fast\-moving environment * Hands\-on approach to closing gaps in technical execution, able to personally debug a misbehaving agent in production **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** ----------------------------------- * Demonstrated problem\-solving and executive\-level communication skills, bridging technical teams and leadership seamlessly. * Hands\-on expertise in code\-level AI SDKs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Strands Agents), selecting optimal tools rather than relying on no\-code builders. * Knowledge of core building blocks of production AI applications: tool/function calling, RAG, vector search, structured outputs, conversation and state management, and the judgment to favor deterministic workflows when appropriate. * Cloud engineering skills (preferably AWS), including deploying agents on managed services (e.g., Bedrock AgentCore), containers, IAM, networking, and cost optimization. * Track record deploying and maintaining production AI systems, driving robust CI/CD, tracing, incident response, and latency/cost controls. * Experience making evaluation part of the build cycle, including test sets, regression testing, human review, and measuring quality once systems are live * Grasp of AI security and guardrails (prompt injection defense, least\-privilege access, audit trails, and human\-in\-the\-loop design) aligned with financial regulations (Model Risk Management, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA). **What we offer:** ------------------ We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a *life well lived,* both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include: * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Coverage * Flexible Paid Time Off * 401(k) \+ Match * Mental Health Support \& Well\-Being Program * Paid Maternity \& Paternity Leave * Education Assistance * Company\-funded Lifestyle Spending Account **Salary Range:** **$207,000\-290,000 USD** ------------------------------------------- *Pay within this range varies by work location and on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.* *Please note: North is a US\-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.* **Who we are:** --------------- North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end\-to\-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise\-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award\-winning, hands\-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else. **Let’s go North, together!** Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do\-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well\-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling. **At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.** *To learn more about North, and our family of companies, visit our website:* *north.com*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — .NET & React
jobs.description: **About Northern Trust** As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. **Role \- Senior Software Engineer — .NET \& React** We are looking for an accomplished **Senior Software Engineer** to design, develop, and modernize scalable enterprise applications. The role centers on API\-first, cloud\-native solutions built with **.NET (C\#)** for backend services and **React** for frontend experiences, with a strong focus on security, performance, maintainability, and sound engineering practices. with tools such as **GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps** * Champion test\-driven development and automated testing * Contribute to code reviews, mentoring, and knowledge sharing * Work with DevOps, QA, and platform teams to enable reliable deployments * Support production systems and assist with incident resolution when required **Required Qualifications:** **Essential Technical Skills** * At least **4 years** of professional software engineering experience * Strong proficiency in **C\# and .NET / ASP.NET Core** * Proven experience building micro\-frontends (MFEs) with **React** and **TypeScript** * Strong knowledge of **REST APIs**, HTTP fundamentals, and API security * Experience with relational databases such as **SQL Server** * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably design**, clean code, and refactoring * Hands\-on experience with **unit testing**, **integration testing**, and mocking frameworks * Familiarity with event\-driven and microservices architectures; Kafka or other messaging technologies are a plus * Experience working in agile delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in **financial services** or another highly regulated industry * Knowledge of **performance tuning**, high\-volume transaction processing, and distributed systems **Professional Capabilities** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities * Clear, structured communication * Ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams * A proactive approach with strong ownership and accountability **Technical Leadership:** The successful candidate will demonstrate strong **technology leadership**, shaping solution design and improving engineering practices across teams: * Advance **modern engineering practices**, including API\-first design, cloud\-native patterns, automation, and technical debt reduction * Guide and mentor engineers to strengthen capabilities and promote consistent practices across teams * Identify **technology risks, scalability issues, and non\-functional gaps** early, then drive practical solutions * Balance immediate delivery needs with long\-term platform health, maintainability, and operational resilience **Alignment with Northern Trust Principles:** Successful candidates are expected to reflect **Northern Trust’s core principles and values** in everyday engineering decisions and practices: * **Service \& Integrity First** – Develop software responsibly, with security, accountability, client trust, and data protection at the forefront. * **Strength in Collaboration** – Partner across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and risk to deliver sustainable, well\-designed solutions. * **Expertise \& Continuous Improvement** – requirements through appropriate controls, logging, and documentation. * **Client\-Focused Engineering** – Make technology choices that support scalability, resilience, and lasting client outcomes rather than only short\-term delivery. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Salary Range: $114,500 \- 194,700 USD*Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life \& accident insurance, and other voluntary and well\-being benefits. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

jobs.title: Laravel Developer
jobs.description: About Nu Image Medical Nu Image Medical is an established telemedicine company dedicated to making healthcare more accessible, convenient, and personalized. Since 2008, we’ve helped patients access medical consultations and innovative treatments through our online healthcare platform. We’re looking for a talented Laravel Developer with strong AI expertise to join our engineering team and help us continue building, optimizing, and expanding the technology powering our services. About the Role As a Laravel Developer, you’ll work directly with our technology leadership and development team to build, maintain, and optimize our telemedicine platform. You’ll be responsible for developing scalable backend systems, integrating third\-party services, implementing AI\-powered solutions, and delivering features that directly improve operational efficiency and the patient experience. The ideal candidate combines deep practical experience with Laravel, Laravel Nova, and Vue.js with advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, including AI integrations, large language models (LLMs), APIs, intelligent automation, and AI\-driven application development. We’re looking for someone who can identify opportunities to apply AI to real\-world business challenges, design reliable AI\-powered workflows, and integrate emerging technologies into secure, production\-ready applications. The candidate should take ownership of their work, write clean and maintainable code, and confidently solve complex technical challenges independently. Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and optimize applications using PHP and Laravel. * Build and maintain RESTful APIs and third\-party integrations. * Design, develop, and integrate AI\-powered features, tools, and workflows into existing applications. * Integrate large language models (LLMs) and AI services through APIs to support intelligent automation, data processing, and operational efficiency. * Evaluate AI tools, frameworks, and technologies to identify opportunities for practical implementation across the business. * Develop AI\-driven automations that reduce manual work, streamline internal processes, and improve platform functionality. * Understand prompt engineering, structured AI outputs, context management, and methods for improving the reliability of AI\-generated results. * Develop and maintain internal administration tools using Laravel Nova and Filament. * Build and maintain frontend interfaces using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS. * Design and optimize MySQL databases and queries. * Integrate external healthcare platforms, payment processors, communication services, and AI\-based services. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues across application and AI\-integrated systems. * Write clean, efficient, secure, and well\-documented code. * Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. * Implement automated tests and follow software development best practices. * Maintain security and privacy standards when working with sensitive healthcare information and AI systems. * Collaborate with product, operations, and engineering teams to deliver new features and technical improvements. Required Qualifications * 3\+ years of professional PHP development experience. * Strong, hands\-on experience with Laravel and its ecosystem. * Practical experience with Laravel Nova, including building and customizing resources, fields, actions, and administrative interfaces. * Proficiency in Vue.js, including developing and maintaining reusable components and interactive user interfaces. * Strong practical knowledge of AI technologies, LLMs, and AI\-powered application development. * Experience integrating AI models or services into applications using APIs and building functional AI\-driven features. * Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, model limitations, and strategies for improving AI response quality and consistency. * Ability to identify business processes that can benefit from AI, automation, and intelligent workflows. * Solid understanding of object\-oriented programming and MVC architecture. * Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency with MySQL, including database design and query optimization. * Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. * Familiarity with JavaScript and modern frontend development practices. * Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security. * Ability to troubleshoot complex applications independently. * Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Laravel Filament. * Experience with Tailwind CSS. * Experience building AI agents, multi\-step AI workflows, or tool\-calling integrations. * Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and semantic search. * Experience connecting AI services to internal databases, APIs, and business applications. * Familiarity with AI evaluation, output validation, error handling, and safeguards against unreliable model responses. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve coding efficiency, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Understanding of AI data privacy, security, and responsible handling of sensitive information. * Familiarity with Laravel queues, jobs, events, and scheduled tasks. * Experience with Redis and caching strategies. * Familiarity with AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar cloud infrastructure. * Experience integrating payment gateways such as Stripe. * Experience with automated testing using PHPUnit or Pest. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. * Experience developing healthcare, telemedicine, or other regulated applications. * Knowledge of HIPAA\-related technical safeguards and secure handling of sensitive data. What We’re Looking For Beyond technical expertise, we value developers who: * Take initiative and ownership of projects. * Can work independently without constant supervision. * Have a strong interest in AI and stay informed about evolving AI technologies and practical applications. * Can confidently evaluate, implement, and optimize AI solutions rather than relying solely on prebuilt tools. * Understand how to translate business needs into reliable AI\-powered technical solutions. * Communicate clearly and proactively. * Understand the importance of delivering reliable, secure, production\-ready software. * Are comfortable working with existing codebases and modernizing legacy systems. * Can balance development speed with code quality, security, and maintainability. * Enjoy learning new technologies and continuously improving existing systems. Why Join Nu Image Medical? * Work on a real\-world healthcare platform serving patients nationwide. * Join an established company with a growing technology ecosystem. * Work directly with experienced technical leadership. * Help implement practical AI solutions that improve workflows and operational efficiency. * Contribute to meaningful projects with measurable business impact. * Help shape the future of internal systems, AI integrations, and patient\-facing applications. * Be part of a collaborative engineering team where your contributions matter. How to Apply Please submit your resume, GitHub profile or portfolio (if available), and a brief description of your experience working with Laravel and AI technologies. We’d especially like to hear about applications you’ve built, AI integrations you’ve implemented, challenging technical problems you’ve solved, and projects where you’ve taken significant ownership. **Applicants must have practical experience with Laravel, Laravel Nova, and Vue.js. Strong hands\-on knowledge of AI integration and AI\-powered application development is highly valued.** Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Data Center Operations Section. Req. 227096 The Office of Technology Services aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. This is a high level technical support position requiring the ability to provide technical leadership in the implementation and management of complex database systems. The incumbent will possess advanced, specialized skills in database platforms and software. The nature of the work is highly complex and requires a deep understanding of people, processes and technology within the context of a large enterprise and government environment. The incumbent is required to have in\-depth database planning, design, and analysis skills. The incumbent may be required to coordinate and serve as liaison with multiple vendors for in\-house and outsourced database related initiatives. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Two years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field; OR An associate's degree in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any area. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any area. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. NOTE: Any college hours or degree must be from an accredited college or university. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: * Performs day\-to\-day administration, maintenance, and support of database systems serving multiple state agencies and critical business applications. I * nstalls, configures, upgrades, patches, monitors, and maintains database platforms in on\-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments. * Performs database backup and recovery, performance monitoring and tuning, capacity management, security configuration, and high availability and disaster recovery support. * Coordinates database maintenance activities, including after\-hours work when required to meet business availability requirements. * Works with vendors and internal technical teams to troubleshoot database software and configuration issues and implement appropriate solutions. * Provides technical support and guidance to application developers, system administrators, technical support personnel, and end users regarding database configuration, performance, connectivity, availability, and functionality. * Develops and maintains technical documentation, procedures, configuration standards, and operational runbooks. * Performs problem determination and resolution for database\-related incidents and service requests reported by application users and technical staff. * Provides Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support based on the complexity of the issue and established support procedures. * Investigates database availability, performance, connectivity, backup and recovery, security, and application\-related issues using database monitoring, diagnostic, logging, and performance analysis tools. * Coordinates with application, infrastructure, network, security, cloud, and vendor teams to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes. Documents resolutions and follows up with users and technical teams as necessary. * Provides database administration and technical support for assigned projects and initiatives. * Participates in the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of database solutions, including new database installations, upgrades, migrations, high availability configurations, disaster recovery solutions, and cloud database implementations. * Assists with evaluating and implementing database tools and technologies. * Uses scripting and automation to improve routine database administration tasks and operational efficiency. * Works with senior database administrators and other technical teams on complex projects and technical issues. * Participates in knowledge\-sharing and training activities and develops familiarity with database technologies, cloud services, automation, security practices, and enterprise database standards. * Provides technical advice and assistance to management, application teams, system administrators, and other technical personnel regarding database administration, capacity planning, performance, availability, security, backup and recovery, and emerging database technologies. * Assists with technology evaluations, product research, and technical planning activities. * Keeps current with database technology, cloud services, automation tools, security practices, vendor recommendations, technical documentation, and industry trends relevant to the State's database environment. * Performs other duties as assigned to provide reliable, secure, and effective database services. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer** **Why Join Oilgear** At Oilgear, we design and manufacture high\-performance hydraulic systems that power some of the world’s most demanding industrial applications. Our employees play a critical role in our success, and we are committed to providing a safe, collaborative, and growth\-oriented environment. At Oilgear, you’ll work with advanced technology, contribute to meaningful products, and be part of a team that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. **Summary** The Manufacturing Engineer is primarily responsible for improving and supporting manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, work methods, and production performance for Oilgear hydraulic products. Approximately 80% of the role is focused on manufacturing engineering, including process improvement, production support, tooling and fixture development, manufacturing documentation, cost reduction, quality improvement, and new product or process implementation. Approximately 20% of the role supports product design and engineering activities, including CAD updates, design\-for\-manufacturability reviews, engineering changes, and product improvement. The position works closely with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and shop\-floor personnel to develop practical, safe, repeatable, and cost\-effective manufacturing solutions. **Essential Responsibilities and Duties** **Manufacturing Engineering \& Production Support \- Primary Focus** * Provide hands\-on engineering support to production personnel to resolve manufacturing and assembly issues involving processes, drawings, tolerances, materials, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and product performance. * Develop, improve, and standardize manufacturing methods, work sequences, routings, bills of operations, work instructions, and process documentation within applicable ERP/MRP systems. * Evaluate manufacturing processes and identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, productivity, repeatability, lead time, material flow, labor utilization, and cost. * Design, develop, specify, and implement tooling, fixtures, gauges, workholding, and other manufacturing aids that improve production efficiency and product quality. * Support machining and assembly operations by evaluating equipment capabilities, cutting tools, workholding, process parameters, CNC\-related manufacturing needs, and production methods. * Analyze production problems and lead structured root cause and corrective action activities using methods such as 5 Why and 8D. * Partner with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and production employees to implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence of manufacturing issues. * Support plant layout, equipment placement, work\-cell design, material flow, and utilization of manufacturing space. * Evaluate and recommend new equipment, manufacturing technology, tooling, and process changes; assist with technical justification, implementation, validation, and training. * Develop manufacturing estimates, process requirements, and production methods for new or revised components using existing Fremont capabilities whenever practical. * Support supplier and process qualification activities related to manufactured components, tooling, equipment, and production processes. * Maintain accurate manufacturing documentation and ensure process changes are effectively communicated and implemented on the shop floor. **Continuous Improvement, Cost \& Quality** * Lead or support continuous improvement and cost\-reduction projects focused on manufacturing efficiency, scrap, rework, cycle time, throughput, tooling, material usage, and labor utilization. * Use production data, quality information, observations, and employee feedback to identify manufacturing constraints and improvement opportunities. * Support quality and safety requirements by ensuring manufacturing methods, jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Oakwood.** Oakwood Systems Group is a Microsoft Solutions Partner helping organizations modernize applications, data platforms, cloud environments, and business workflows. Our AI work focuses on moving clients beyond experimentation by designing and delivering secure, production\-ready AI applications, agents, copilots, and automation that create measurable business value. **The Role.** We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on AI Engineer who can turn ambiguous business problems into reliable AI solutions. This role is for an engineer with a strong software, data, or machine\-learning foundation who has already shipped production systems and is comfortable owning work from discovery and technical design through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operational handoff. You will work directly with clients and Oakwood delivery teams to build practical AI capabilities on the Microsoft cloud, with particular emphasis on generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, enterprise integration, and responsible production operations. **What You Will Do:** ===================== * Design, build, and deploy production of AI applications, copilots, and agents using Microsoft Azure and modern AI frameworks. * Build RAG and enterprise knowledge solutions using embeddings, vector search, document processing, metadata, and retrieval strategies that produce grounded, source\-aware answers. * Design agentic workflows that use tools, APIs, structured outputs, memory/state, human approval, and multi\-step orchestration to automate real business processes safely. * Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications and data sources through REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, databases, SaaS platforms, and custom services. * Develop maintainable backend services and APIs, primarily in Python, with appropriate testing, error handling, logging, security, and performance considerations. * Establish evaluation approaches for AI quality, groundedness, reliability, safety, latency, and cost; use those results to improve prompts, retrieval, orchestration, and model selection. * Implement production engineering practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, secrets management, observability, and environment promotion. * Apply enterprise security and governance practices, including identity, role\-based access, data boundaries, auditability, responsible AI controls, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns where appropriate. * Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to understand workflows, clarify requirements, prototype solutions, explain tradeoffs, and translate AI possibilities into deployable designs. * Contribute architecture reviews, code reviews, estimation, technical discovery, and solution design for new client opportunities. * Create reusable patterns, accelerators, reference implementations, and delivery of assets that improve the speed and consistency of future Oakwood AI engagements. * Document solutions clearly and support knowledge transfer so client teams can understand, operate, and extend what we deliver. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help establish pragmatic engineering standards for production of AI delivery. **Required Qualifications:** ============================ * 5\+ years of professional engineering experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, applied AI, backend development, or a closely related discipline, with meaningful ownership of production systems. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building generative AI / LLM\-powered applications or AI\-enabled software, with at least one solution taken beyond prototype into a production or production\-like environment. * Strong Python programming skills and experience building production services, APIs, integrations, or data/AI pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with LLM application patterns such as prompt design, RAG, embeddings, vector search, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent orchestration. * Experience evaluating AI systems using measurable criteria rather than subjective demos alone, including quality, reliability, safety, latency, and/or cost. * Experience with cloud\-based applications and AI services; strong Azure experience is preferred, and candidates should be able to work effectively in a Microsoft\-centric environment. * Working knowledge of SQL and enterprise data integration, including the ability to reason about data quality, access, lineage, and how data architecture affects AI outcomes. * Experience with modern software engineering practices: Git, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, APIs, logging/monitoring, and secure configuration/secrets management. * Ability to troubleshoot production of AI behavior, including retrieval failures, hallucinations, tool\-calling errors, prompt regressions, latency, cost, and unexpected edge cases. * Strong client\-facing communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to both engineers and business stakeholders. * Ability to work independently in a consulting environment, manage competing priorities, and move from incomplete requirements to a well\-structured implementation plan. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or related Microsoft AI services. * Experience with one or more orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI, or custom agent frameworks. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent\-to\-tool integration patterns, or reusable enterprise tool registries. * Experience with Azure application services such as Functions, Container Apps, App Service, AKS, API Management, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Entra ID. * Experience with MLOps / LLMOps practices including evaluation pipelines, model or prompt versioning, tracing, monitoring, feedback loops, and production incident response. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or other modern data platforms used to prepare governed enterprise data for AI. * Experience with classical machine learning, NLP, deep learning, fine\-tuning, multimodal models, or model serving where the use case requires more than foundation\-model APIs. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor while applying disciplined engineering review for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Prior consulting, professional services, systems integration, or Microsoft partner experience. * Relevant Microsoft or cloud certifications, such as Azure AI Engineer, Azure Developer, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent. **What Success Looks Like:** ============================ * AI solutions move from discovery and prototype to secure, supportable production deployments with clear acceptance criteria. * Clients can see and articulate the business value of the systems delivered, not just the technical novelty. * AI quality is measured and improved through repeatable evaluation, observability, and feedback rather than one\-time demonstrations. * Solutions integrate cleanly with client applications, data, identity, and operating processes and can be maintained after handoff. * Reusable engineering patterns and delivery assets reduce effort and risk across future engagements. * You are viewed by clients and teammates as a trusted engineer who can combine technical depth, sound judgment, and practical delivery. **Why Oakwood** =============== Oakwood combines deep Microsoft expertise with hands\-on application, data, cloud, and AI engineering. We hold Microsoft Solutions Partner designations across key solution areas and an Advanced Specialization for AI Applications on Microsoft Azure. AI Engineers at Oakwood have the opportunity to work directly with clients, build real production solutions, shape reusable delivery patterns, and help organizations turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into durable business outcomes.

jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. **The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity** The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust. **About You** *Production builder*: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it. *Careful evaluator*: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality. *Strong owner:* You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use. **What you will be doing** * Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long\-running work. * Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling. * Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state. * Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete. * Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding. * Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests. * Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory. * Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine\-tuning or other post\-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved. **What you will bring to the role** * Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools. * Hands\-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool\-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation. * Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant. * Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain. * Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action. **Scope by level** Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster. **Our stack** Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan. We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts. **And extra credit for** * Open\-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data. * Fine\-tuning, preference data, post\-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets. * Identity and security workflows. Foundation\-model research experience is optional.
