jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Detection & Discovery
jobs.description: ### **Strength in Trust** OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. ### **The Challenge** Enterprises need dependable visibility into both the data they hold and the AI they use. OneTrust's Detection \& Discovery team owns and actively maintains Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities while expanding discovery of AI models, agents, and related cloud resources. Customers rely on these systems to find, understand, and govern assets across complex environments. This role is intentionally balanced between strengthening the Data Discovery and Data Catalog pipeline and advancing AI Detection \& Discovery. You will provide hands\-on technical leadership across both: sustaining and improving mature production capabilities while building the next generation of AI discovery. ### **Your Mission** ### **Data Discovery \& Data Catalog** * Own the technical evolution and ongoing maintenance of Data Discovery and Data Catalog services and modules, including production support for capabilities customers depend on. * Lead a major engineering\-quality initiative to reduce technical debt, address critical issues, and modernize the code and architecture without compromising customer stability. * Improve the stability, reliability, performance, and operability of the end\-to\-end discovery and catalog pipeline, from scanning and ingestion through cataloging and downstream use. * Identify and deliver practical opportunities to apply AI across discovery and catalog workflows, improving automation and customer value where it makes sense. ### **AI Detection \& Cloud Discovery** * Design and build Java services, APIs, and reusable connectors that discover AI models, agents, and related resources across cloud and AI platforms. * Translate provider APIs, identity models, and resource structures into secure, consistent discovery contracts and normalized inventory data. * Advance continuous, scheduled, and incremental discovery so changes to discovered assets are reflected accurately and promptly. * Enable secure discovery across customer accounts, projects, subscriptions, and regions, and partner with AI Governance teams on asset and lifecycle integrations. ### **Production Support \& Reliability** * Participate in customer\-facing production\-support calls for Data Discovery and AI Governance, including issues involving customer\-managed or on\-premises components. * Troubleshoot complex issues across Java services, Linux environments, Kubernetes deployments, cloud integrations, and network connectivity; partner with Support, Operations, and engineering teams to mitigate customer impact. * Drive incidents from investigation through root cause and durable corrective action, using findings to improve product stability, supportability, and documentation. ### **Technical Leadership** * Set architecture and lead multi\-quarter initiatives from design through production adoption; make pragmatic build\-versus\-reuse decisions. * Establish a high bar for code quality, design reviews, automated testing, and production readiness. * Improve observability and operational maturity; use incident patterns and operational metrics to drive systemic improvements. * Collaborate with Product, UX, Security, Platform, and customer\-facing teams; mentor engineers and influence practices beyond your immediate projects. ### **You Are** A hands\-on technical leader who can balance investment in new capabilities with stewardship of mature, business\-critical software. You bring sound judgment to complex systems, work comfortably across architecture and implementation, and help teams deliver improvements without losing sight of reliability and customer impact. ### **Your Experience Includes** * 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on development in Java and the Spring ecosystem. * A track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud\-native services and APIs used in production at enterprise scale. * Experience owning and evolving production software, including technical\-debt reduction, critical issue resolution, and improvements to stability and reliability. * Hands\-on experience debugging production services in Linux   AI Foundry, or Vertex AI. * Experience with Java workflow orchestration frameworks such as Temporal, connector frameworks, or developer automation. * Experience with Kafka or other messaging technologies, CI/CD, and production operations for cloud\-native services. * Familiarity with AI governance, security, privacy, compliance, or other regulated enterprise domains. ### **Where we Work** We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. ### **Benefits** As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. ### **Resources** Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: * OneTrust Careers on YouTube * @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram ### **Your Data** You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com. ### **Our Commitment to You** When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

You should have deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets at scale, with strong software engineering skills to automate security controls and fleet operations across environments with different compliance requirements. Your problem\-solving mindset and attention to detail will be key to success in this role. **In this role, you will:** Build the platforms that help employees do their best work on devices they can experiences by building agentic workflows with OpenAI products and models that use fleet telemetry to anticipate issues, guide remediation, and design friction out of everyday work. * Make new hires changes, traceable actions, and tested recovery. * Partner with IT, Security, Research, and Engineering to deliver consistent Linux provisioning, updates, and support alongside macOS and Windows. * version control, peer review, and automated validation. * Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for fleet infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with staged deployments and tested rollback. * Use fleet telemetry to proactively improve performance and reliability, detect configuration drift, and verify deployment outcomes. * Participate in engineering on\-call, own incident resolution, and turn operational lessons into lasting improvements that reduce recurring failures and manual work. **You may be a fit for this role if you have:** ----------------------------------------------- * cloud identity integration. * Demonstrated success with open\-source endpoint tools for configuration, device and application management, and telemetry. * Experience delivering secure, reliable, jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **About the Role** ------------------ Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next\-generation physical\-world sensing and AI\-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add\-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products. As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third\-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi\-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI\-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * Design and build the sensing\-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR\- and imagery\-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products * Architect the automated detection\-to\-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score. * Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer\-vision and LiDAR\-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd\-capture). * Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to. * Own the technical design for a tiered sensing\-ingestion model (satellite, fleet\-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points. * Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements. * Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Establish testing, monitoring, and data\-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety\-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation. **Qualifications \& Preferred Experience** ------------------------------------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross\-system integrations end\-to\-end in a production SaaS environment. * Experience building or integrating computer\-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data\-processing pipelines; comfort with point\-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus. * Strong data\-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one\-off custom logic. * Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred. * Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build\-vs\-integrate calls. * Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan. * A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public\-sector systems) is a strong plus. * Proficient in AI\-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness. * Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **How This Level Is Differentiated** ------------------------------------ The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones: * Owns a technical domain end\-to\-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation. * Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information. * Sets technical direction and milestones for the sensing\-integration roadmap; influences cross\-functional partners without formal authority. * Establishes patterns, like the connector/adapter approach, that other engineers and products reuse, elevating the work of the broader team. * Expected to embed AI\-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $205K \- $227K

problem\-solving skills. At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **AI Solutions Developer** ========================== Full\-time · Remote (US) P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure. We're hiring a software engineer to build AI applications across client engagements, our own products, and reusable tools for our consultants. In this role, you'll partner with clients and the consultants who know their data, work through the problem together, and build the software that solves it, whether that's an agent that answers questions about company data or an app that takes a repetitive task off someone's plate. **Why this job is different** ============================= **You'll know why you're building it.** Every project starts with a client problem we think we can solve or a tool our own team needs. Each solution is built for that client's situation. If it stops making sense, we change course. **We're honest with clients.** We don't sell anyone the wrong thing. Ever. When something isn't a good fit, we say so. **Direct client contact.** You'll be on the call with clients from the first conversation through go\-live. Nobody in between translating requirements. Real conversations with real people about real problems. **AI is how we work.** You'll use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex every day. They'll write a lot of the code. You pick the right tool for the job, decide what gets built, check that it works, and own what ships. **Remote, with a life.** We're fully remote in the US and overlap for a few core hours on weekdays. Working faster doesn't mean working more. We mean it about having a life outside work. **What you'll actually do** --------------------------- **The consulting work:** * Leading client conversations to understand the business problem behind the request, then translating it into what to build. * Keeping projects on track: raising risks early, keeping each milestone demonstrable, and flagging scope changes the moment you see them. * Training client teams so they can own and run what you build. * Spotting the next problem worth solving for a client and bringing it to your account team. * Demonstrating solutions to colleagues and clients. You'll explain how they work, answer questions about their limitations, and discuss what's needed to put them into use. **The engineering work:** * Building and maintaining AI applications and agents, taking features from a prototype through testing and deployment. * Connecting applications to Power BI semantic models, Fabric data, and other business systems through APIs, with appropriate sign\-in and access permissions. * Investigating bugs and performance problems, checking AI responses against the underlying data, and improving application reliability. * Creating examples, templates, and documentation so other people can use and maintain what you build. * Trying new AI tools on practical problems and sharing what's worth using and why. We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out and brings ideas of their own. You'll have support and code review from the team, with responsibility for the work you take on. Independent experimentation matters here, and so does knowing when to ask a question or work through a problem with someone else. **What you need** ----------------- **Consulting Skills** * You care as much about business impact as technical polish. * You can translate a client's frustration into a technical and human solve. * You're comfortable presenting to a C\-suite or a front\-line manager, with the professional presence clients trust with their business. * Clear communication. You can explain a technical decision to another developer and describe what an application does to someone who doesn't write code. **Engineering Skills** * Three or more years of software development experience, including maintaining applications after launch. * Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, including connecting interfaces to APIs and working with application data. * Hands\-on experience developing software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can provide useful context, guide the work, review changes, and verify the results. * Solid programming fundamentals. You're comfortable using Git, reading unfamiliar code, and tracing problems through an application. * An understanding of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric concepts, including how data is organized and modeled for reporting and analysis. Hands\-on experience with these products is welcome but isn't required. * Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem and the basics of cloud services, authentication, and permissions. **Nice to have** Experience with Next.js, Python, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, or MCP would be useful. Previous consulting work or experience building tools for other developers would also help. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Base salary:** $125\-150k * **Full benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, life, 401k * **Remote work:** US\-based team. Your home office wherever makes you happiest * **Professional growth:** Time built in to try new tools on real problems and share what you find. People here want to see you grow, and they'll jump in when you're stuck **Our values** -------------- We hire for the same five values in every role at P3: * **Reliable.** You do what you said you'd do, and what you ship keeps working. * **Adaptable.** The tools change every month. You change with them, and you change course when a project stops making sense. * **Proactive.** You flag a problem the moment you see it, and you fix the small things before anyone has to ask. * **Invested.** You care whether the client's business actually gets better. * **Direct.** You say plainly what works, what doesn't, and what you don't know yet. **About P3 Adaptive** --------------------- We've been modernizing organizations' relationship with data since 2010\. We pair deep technical skill with business sense, and we skip the deck theater and the jargon. Our teams are small, senior, and hands\-on, and work doesn't pass through a chain of handoffs. We're building on top of the AI wave. If you want to build the AI that changes how companies use their data, we're ready to meet you. *P3 Adaptive is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Period.* *This position is open to people authorized to work in the United States. We don't sponsor work visas.*

jobs.description: As a Fortune 500 company, Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is an ideas and solutions company. Our white paper business delivers Paper With Purpose by providing the highest level of customer service and operational excellence. We have approximately 15,000 team members in more than 100 locations in the United States that strive to meet the local needs of our customers. People • Customers • Trust PCA is currently recruiting for a Plant Optimization Engineer based at the Columbus, IN corrugated box plant facility. **Description of role:** The Plant Optimization Engineer Position (POE) is a developmental program which focuses on hiring recent college graduates with degrees in engineering (0\-2 years experience) into a rotational training experience with the goal of developing them into well\-rounded employees and future leaders at PCA. In addition, POEs will complete engineering process optimization projects throughout the box plant, typically in areas of scrap reduction, throughput improvements, downtime reduction, etc., and will provide engineering support to all plant functions as needed. Upon successful completion of the program, the Plant Optimization Engineer will transition into a new full\-time role in the chosen career path either at their current plant, or another plant or paper mill that has an opening that aligns with their skills and interests. Typical career paths for those who have completed the POE Program include box plant leadership/management positions in Production or Maintenance. **Principle Accountabilities:** * Rotate through all departments at a corrugated plant, completing assigned learning objectives and technical training in each area. * Organize and implement moderate to large process improvements, problem elimination and and car. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of one Internship or Co\-op is preferred, especially in a manufacturing environment. * Obtaining a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry \- from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI\-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park \& Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com. As a remote\-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day. **The Role** ------------ We work on several systems: our ACME operations management suite, embeddable scheduling and booking widgets, B2B and B2C sales and support tooling, and custom solutions for enterprise operators. The work is technically varied and the stakes are real: operators depend on this software to run their businesses. We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with strong technical depth who is also highly effective with AI\-assisted development. You reason independently about complex systems, find the problems that aren't obvious from the requirements, and use AI as a tool to build faster while owning every decision it informs. That means you know how to break down ambiguous problems, delegate to agents, review their work critically, and course\-correct when things go sideways. You'll join the platform team, working deep in our existing systems, including ACME Core, to make other teams faster and safer, using AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier for your engineering judgment, not a replacement for it. The platform team works closely with DevOps, who own our infrastructure, so this is a backend\-focused role rather than an infrastructure one. Over the past few months, we've seen a step\-function improvement in the reliability and capabilities of long\-running AI agents. We're adapting our engineering practice to match, and we want strong backend engineers who are already building this way and excited to push it further. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work as part of the platform team, improving the backend systems, tooling, and practices that other teams build on. Feature development is still part of the role where it fits. * Identify automation opportunities across the engineering workflow (repetitive manual work, slow or fragile processes, recurring operational toil) and build the solutions, using AI agents where they help. * Enable other teams: build and maintain shared services, libraries, and APIs, make the right way the easy way, and unblock engineers who depend on the platform through guidance, documentation, and code review. * Own security fixes and dependency updates across our backend systems: triage vulnerabilities, plan and ship upgrades safely in an existing codebase, and make sure they don't break the teams and services that depend on them. * Identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks, and recognize scalability limits before they become production problems. * Reason about concurrency, failure modes, and reliability across APIs and integrations. * Own your services in production: monitoring, debugging, performance, and reliability. When something breaks, you get to root cause and fix it properly. * Contribute to our AI\-first engineering culture, share patterns, document what works, and help the team level up on how we build with AI. * Use AI tools fluently \- Claude Code, Augment or equivalent, to compress implementation time, then critically review everything that comes out of them. AI makes a strong engineer faster; it does not replace technical judgment. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * 5\+ years of professional backend development using Java, with a meaningful track record of shipping and operating production systems. * Strong system design: you make sound architectural decisions, think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail, and you know when a simple solution is enough. * Strong backend fundamentals: API design, integrations, concurrency, failure modes, and service reliability. * Deep understanding of database behavior: data modeling, query design, indexing, and the performance implications of your choices. * Proven ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and debug complex production issues to root cause, including problems that aren't obvious from the requirements. * Comfortable working in an existing, evolving codebase: you can get up to speed quickly, make safe incremental changes, and leave things better than you found them, without defaulting to rewrites. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow, as a force multiplier on top of strong fundamentals. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code: catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written. * Clear communicator: you can articulate why you made a technical choice, flag when a spec has holes, and disagree constructively. * Interest in Elixir or functional programming languages as we expand our stack **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience building B2B SaaS products, ideally with complex multi\-tenant data models or transactional workflows. * Experience on small, high\-output teams where you've had to make architectural calls without a committee. * Familiarity with frontend development and JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular or modern JS frameworks), enough to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers and understand how your APIs are consumed. * Experience on a platform, internal tooling, or developer\-enablement team, including security patching and dependency upgrades in a large existing codebase. * Background in the travel, hospitality, or experiences industry. **What We Value** ----------------- A few things that define how we build: * Depth first. We value engineers who understand how systems actually behave: databases, concurrency, failure modes, and performance. AI amplifies that understanding; it doesn't replace it. * Judgment over speed. AI compresses implementation time. What differentiates engineers now isn't typing speed or memorized syntax, it's the ability to make the right calls on what to build, how to build it, and when it's not ready to ship. * Ownership. You built it? You own it. That includes AI\-generated code. You know when to use agents and when to do it yourself. * Directness. We want people who ask hard questions, surface problems early, and are willing to push back on a bad spec rather than build it and hope for the best. * Quality as a habit. Peer code reviews, test coverage, and clean APIs are not optional. We move fast, but not by cutting corners on the things that compound. Peek Travel Inc. is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If you are unable to apply due to incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at talent@peek.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. #### **What you'll do** As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll help strategic partners understand, position, and demonstrate Pindrop's value within their own platforms and customer conversations. You'll work with partner solutions engineering (SE) teams to build clear value narratives and credible demos that show Pindrop in the context of each partner's solution. You'll also provide the technical guidance that makes those demos real. Your focus is building repeatable partner motions so partners lead stronger early customer conversations and bring Pindrop into active opportunities with the right context. * Ask the right questions, recommend best practices, and help partner SE teams connect customer problems, stakeholders, use cases, and outcomes to a clear Pindrop value story. * Teach partners how to position Pindrop within their own platform and customer motion. Explain product functionality, cloud concepts, and integration choices in plain language. * Build and coach tailored demo flows that connect the customer's situation to Pindrop capabilities and expected outcomes, not a standard feature tour. * Lead enablement and practice sessions on value messaging, use\-case positioning, technical integration overviews, demo delivery, and common customer questions. * Prepare partners for early customer meetings, platform demos, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), prospecting conversations, and active opportunities by adapting the story to each audience. * Advise partner technical teams on where and how to place Pindrop application programming interfaces (APIs) within contact center as a service (CCaaS) platforms and adjacent workflows. Help them connect systems for a usable first\-pass demo integration. * Create and configure partner demo tenants, sandboxes, and supporting CCaaS environments for repeatable authentication and bot detection scenarios. * Develop reusable demo scripts, use\-case plays, talk tracks, setup guidance, and integration documentation that improve partner consistency and self\-service. * Identify risks that could derail a partner\-led demo or integration. Bring in the right internal teams and define a practical path forward without taking on production ownership. * Partner with Product and Engineering to turn recurring partner questions, product gaps, and integration needs into actionable field feedback. #### **Who you are** * A translator. You turn customer problems and technical capabilities into value stories, tailored demos, and practical next steps. * A natural coach and facilitator. You're comfortable in front of partner SEs, developers, business stakeholders, and internal teams, and you make each of them better at telling the story. * A pragmatic builder. You keep technical support practical and repeatable, and you know when "ready to demo" is the right bar. * Clear about boundaries. You know when to use a repeatable approach, when to involve a specialist, and when production ownership belongs with Product, Engineering, or implementation teams. * Trusted. Partners and internal teams rely on you to communicate value, technical options, limitations, risks, and handoff points honestly. #### **Your skill\-set** Must\-haves * 3\+ years in sales engineering, partner engineering, solutions consulting, technical consulting, or a comparable customer\-facing technical role in enterprise software. You can show you've turned technical capabilities into clear value narratives and tailored demos. * Experience enabling or coaching technical sellers, partner SEs, or customer\-facing technical teams on positioning and demo delivery, with strong facilitation and presentation skills. * Strong experience with CCaaS platforms such as Five9, Genesys, NICE, Amazon C ons you'll never personally join. * Represent differentiated, category\-defining technology. You'll position solutions backed by deep expertise, proprietary technology, and 300\+ patents, not a commodity product. * Stay hands\-on across the CCaaS ecosystem. You'll work across Five9, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, and more, building working integrations rather than slideware. * Operate inside an AI\-first organization. With Innovation as our first core value, you'll be encouraged to use AI to build demos, enablement content, and integration guidance faster. * Influence what we build. Your field feedback goes directly to Product and Engineering and shapes how Pindrop works within partner platforms. * Grow as Pindrop grows. You'll help define a partner motion that's still being built, and grow your career as we scale it. #### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * Remote\-first environment \- giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. It handles one\-click modpack and plugin installs, a template shop, Minecraft version switching, Steam Workshop collections, DDoS protection management, subdomains and AI\-assisted log analysis. Around it sit our Astro website, our WHMCS billing platform, Discord bots and a set of internal tools. **The role** We're hiring an intermediate software developer whose main focus is the frontend. You'll own the user interfaces our customers touch every day. That means features in the React panel, pages on the Astro website, and the PHP and HTML templates behind our billing and other systems. This isn't a junior role. You should be able to take a feature from an issue to a reviewed pull request with little hand\-holding. You should also be able to read code you didn't write and know when to ask a question. Backend experience is a real plus but not required. If you're strong on the frontend and want to grow into full\-stack work, we'll train you on our PHP/Laravel backend and the systems around it. **What you'll work on** Most of your time goes to the first two areas. The rest grows as you do. * **Pine Game Panel** (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, styled\-components, easy\-peasy, React Router; Laravel API): build and polish customer features such as the file manager, console, backups, schedules, mod and plugin installers, template shop and game\-specific settings screens * **Website** (Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4\): product and game pages, pricing, tools and blog; keep it fast, accessible and SEO\-friendly * **Billing and client area** (WHMCS: PHP, Smarty templates, HTML/CSS/JS): customize the client area, order flow and email templates; write hooks * **Internal tools** (React \+ Vite; ASP.NET Core): admin dashboards for staff, such as product data, sponsorships and hardware planning * **Panel backend, as you grow** (PHP 8\.2\+, Laravel 12, MySQL, Redis, queues): API endpoints, services, background jobs, tests On the panel, there is also modernization work ahead. Planned items include moving off twin.macro to plain Tailwind, upgrading React and Tailwind, and reworking layouts to be truly responsive. If you enjoy leaving a codebase better than you found it, there's plenty to do. **What we're looking for** * Around 2–4 years of professional or equivalent real\-world frontend experience, with shipped work you can show us * Strong React and TypeScript: hooks, component design, state management, and talking to REST APIs * Solid HTML and CSS fundamentals, with Tailwind CSS experience; responsive layouts, accessibility and cross\-browser quirks shouldn't scare you * Comfort with plain PHP and server\-rendered HTML templates, since not everything we run is a single\-page app * Day\-to\-day Git: branches, pull requests, rebasing, and taking code review well * Debugging skills: browser dev tools, network inspection, and reading a stack trace in a language you're less familiar with * Clear written communication in English; much of our work is async through issues and PR reviews **Bonus points** None of these are required. Each one helps, and backend experience helps most. * Backend / full\-stack: Laravel or another PHP framework, MySQL, Redis, queues and background jobs, writing tests (PHPUnit, Jest, Playwright) * Astro or other static and hybrid site frameworks, plus web performance and SEO work * WHMCS or other billing and client\-area customization * Real\-time UIs: WebSockets and streaming data, such as live consoles and resource graphs * Other languages in our stack: Go (our Wings daemon), C\#/.NET (internal tools), Node.js (Discord bots) * Infrastructure basics: Linux, Docker, nginx, CI pipelines * Game servers: you've run or modded Minecraft, Rust or similar, so you know what our customers are trying to do **How we work** * Work starts from an issue, goes onto a feature branch, and lands through a pull request that a senior developer reviews * Merged changes deploy automatically to a staging environment, so you test against the real thing before a versioned production release * Small team, real ownership: what you build is in front of customers within days, not quarters * Mentoring toward full\-stack work, with code review that explains the why **Details** * Type: Full\-time * Location: Remote **How to apply** When you apply, send links to work you've built, such as a portfolio, GitHub, live sites or a project write\-up. Tell us about a frontend problem you solved that you're proud of. Shipped work matters more to us than a list of buzzwords. Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent Pay: Up to $4,000\.00 per month Application Question(s): * Share your Steam profile. What games have you put the most hours into, and have you ever run a server or developed plugins/mods? * Do you have experience using AI coding agents like Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex inside Cursor or Zed? Tell us how you use them in your development workflow. * Tell us about a project you're most proud of, whether personal, open\-source, or professional. What did you build, what was your role, and what challenges did you overcome? Please share links to your GitHub profile and any portfolio or live projects. Experience: * Developer: 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director, Data & Information Architecture
jobs.description: **About Pivot Bio** Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of the soil microbiome, Pivot Bio is pioneering game\-changing advances in agriculture. Our products harness naturally occurring microbes to provide nutrients to crops, helping farmers improve yields while reducing environmental impact. Pivot Bio is seeking a Director, Data \& Information Architecture to define and steward the enterprise information backbone connecting Product Innovation, Agronomy, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Digital products. This role is responsible for establishing canonical data models, domain boundaries, data contracts, lineage standards, and governance patterns that enable trustworthy, decision\-grade data across the enterprise. Unlike traditional platform\-focused data architecture roles, this position is centered on information architecture: designing durable semantic models, traceability frameworks, and evidence systems that support product performance analysis, scientific discovery, operational execution, and AI\-enabled decision making. **What Success Looks Like** * Define canonical enterprise data models spanning R\&D, Agronomy, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Digital domains. * Establish domain ownership, data contracts, lineage, and reconciliation standards. * Design logical and physical Lakehouse models supporting Silver and Gold layers. * Create traceable, reproducible evidence systems capable of supporting scientific and commercial decision making. * Provide a phased architecture roadmap for modernization and migration of existing data assets. * Enable trustworthy AI and analytics through strong semantic foundations. **Key Responsibilities** * Own enterprise information architecture strategy and standards. * Design canonical models, master data relationships, and cross\-domain integration patterns. * Define semantic standards for observations, results, recommendations, outcomes, and evidence. * Lead logical and physical data modeling efforts within Databricks Lakehouse. * Establish metadata, lineage, versioning, and traceability frameworks. * Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Manufacturing, and Commercial teams to translate business requirements into durable data models. * Review architecture designs and validate implementations through hands\-on modeling, SQL analysis, and proof\-of\-concept work. * Drive data governance practices focused on quality, stewardship, reproducibility, and trust. **Preferred Experience** * 10\+ years in Data Architecture, Information Architecture, or Enterprise Data Modeling. * Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling. * Experience with canonical modeling, Data Vault, metadata management, MDM, and lineage. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or modern Lakehouse platforms. * Strong SQL skills and ability to validate models directly against data. * Experience in regulated, scientific, manufacturing, healthcare, life sciences, or evidence\-sensitive environments preferred. * Demonstrated ability to balance governance rigor with pragmatic execution. **What We Are Not Looking For** This role is not primarily a cloud infrastructure architect, integration engineer, or BI/reporting architect position. Success requires deep information architecture capability, including semantic modeling, domain design, lineage, traceability, and enterprise data stewardship. Must be authorized to work in the United States. **What We Offer:** * Incentive Bonus Plan * Competitive package in a disruptive startup * Stock options * Health/Dental/Vision insurance with employer\-paid premiums * Life, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability policies * Employee Assistance Program with free referrals and discounts * 401(k) plan, 3% Match * Commuter benefits * Annual Training \& Development support * Flexible vacation policy with a generous holiday schedule * Exciting opportunity to work with a talented and fun team \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.title: GTM Engineer- AI B2B Lead Generation & Automation
jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a hands\-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI\-powered lead generation engine. You build the core AI agents first, then run the campaigns on them every day, turning enterprise buying signals into qualified sales conversations. You might have started in outbound, SDR leadership, demand gen, or growth, then taught yourself to build the agents and automations that do the work. Or you're an engineer who learned B2B prospecting the hard way. Either way, you've personally built systems that booked real meetings, and you can show us how you have been successful. If that's you, we would like to meet you! **About PlanITROI** For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has turned retired technology into financial value for enterprise organizations. Our services cover IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). We operate on reuse\-as\-intended\-use: reuse before recycling, and recycling only when reuse isn't viable. PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide and is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor. Our mission is to maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients and gets a second life as affordable technology. **Your mission** Build and run the AI\-powered outbound engine that finds enterprise buying opportunities and turns them into qualified meetings and signed MSAs. Your agents will research 5,000\+ enterprise accounts and reach 250,000\+ contacts. You own it end\-to\-end: signal detection, account intelligence, contact discovery, personalization, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. **Build first, then run.** You start by building a few core agents. Then you run the campaigns on them: launching and monitoring sequences, working reply queues, tuning messaging and targeting every week, protecting deliverability, and handing warm conversations to sales at the right moment. Expect most of your time to shift from building to running once the agents are live. **Who we sell to.** Enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 11,000,000\+ employees, mostly knowledge workers (80%\+), complex buying committees, and an existing technology provider. Your challenge: find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and give them a compelling reason to talk to PlanITROI. **Who you work with.** You report to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer, and work closely with the VP of Marketing. No layers in between other than support. **What you'll build and own** * **Signal detection.** Ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals such as tech refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, and social activity. Trigger the right next action while the signal is fresh. * **Buying committee intelligence.** Identify high\-fit ICP accounts, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts per entry point, validate contact data, and track changes. * **Personalization and challenger messaging.** Combine account intelligence, signals, persona pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context into relevant outreach at scale. * **Multichannel orchestration.** Run email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR follow\-up as one system, with sequencing, timing, routing, and next\-best actions. * **Objection handling and follow\-up.** Respond intelligently to objections like "We already have a provider," keep conversational context, and escalate to humans at the right moment. * **Performance and optimization.** Measure results by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. Find what's winning, kill what isn't, and run the next experiment. These are capabilities, not six separate agents. You design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together. **What you bring** **This role requires a hands\-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself.** You'll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay, but using them isn't the role. Building the agents that run on top of them is. You understand both sides: the engineering, and the B2B prospecting strategy that turns agents into a working revenue system. **Must\-haves** * **AI agents that booked meetings.** You've personally built and run AI agents or automated outbound systems that produced measurable B2B meetings, and you have the performance data to prove it. * **Agent engineering.** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, memory and state, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n, or comparable frameworks. * **Coding and integration.** Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. * **Enterprise prospecting.** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying committee mapping, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. Bonus if you've displaced incumbent providers. * **GTM stack.** Hands\-on with tools like Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense or Bombora, and AI calling or voicemail platforms. * **Production operations at scale.** Monitoring, debugging, CRM sync, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, and error handling for systems reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail without burning domains or accounts. **Nice\-to\-haves** * A background in outbound, SDR/BDR leadership, demand gen, growth, or RevOps before moving into AI and automation. * Experience in IT services, ITAD, or computer hardware, hardware as a service **What success looks like** Your primary outcome is **qualified enterprise meetings** that meet defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. We also track: * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion.** How well your agents turn buying signals into conversations and meetings. * **Contact precision.** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Deployment velocity.** How fast a campaign idea becomes a working agent and a live test. * **Multichannel conversion.** Replies, conversations, meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability.** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, and compliance. * **Learning rate.** How quickly you find what isn't working, fix the root cause, and scale what is. **How we hire: show us, don't tell us** We hire on proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished slides about what agents might do. If you qualify, we'll give you a real project to show us how you build. * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show your architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, and integrations; how your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human handoff; and real performance data such as meetings, pipeline, or conversion gains. You won't need access to any PlanITROI system or need to buy software. Free tiers and trials are fine. Your work stays yours unless we hire you. If you show work from a past employer, please redact anything confidential. **Ready to build?** If you love hard technical problems and want to build something ambitious, bring your working agents, your results, and your drive. Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow. **Explore more about us:** PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| BuyRefurbished.com *PlanITROI is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: ASIC Architect, Principal (AI Inference)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** --------------------- Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are deploying in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ----------------- We're looking for an exceptional Principal ASIC Architect to help define the future of AI inference hardware. You will collaborate across architecture, software, machine learning, systems, and silicon implementation to design next\-generation AI accelerators capable of serving rapidly evolving frontier models. This role requires exceptional technical breadth, balancing mathematical understanding, ML trends, systems architecture, and practical silicon implementation. This may be the single most important technical hire after the Chief Architect. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Architectural Exploration*** Own architectural exploration across the evolving landscape of transformer models, MoE, sparse models, and long\-context inference. * Evaluate emerging techniques including speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV\-cache evolution, sub\-quadratic and linear attention, and state\-space models. * Assess memory architectures, communication architectures, and interconnects for next\-generation accelerators. **Performance Modeling*** Develop analytical models and build simulation frameworks to evaluate architectural tradeoffs. * Estimate latency, throughput, bandwidth, memory and compute utilization, scaling efficiency, power, area, and cost. **Hardware/Software Co\-Design*** Partner closely with compiler, runtime, system software, firmware, ASIC engineering, and ML research teams to align hardware direction with real workload needs. **ASIC Specification \& Roadmap*** Develop architecture documents and define subsystem interfaces. * Evaluate tradeoffs across competing architectural directions and guide the future product roadmap. **Industry Awareness*** Track new LLMs, reasoning models, research papers, hardware competitors, academic research, and emerging algorithms to keep Positron's architecture ahead of the field. **AI\-Enabled Engineering*** Use AI to accelerate research, performance analysis, architecture exploration, simulation generation, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 15\+ years of experience in ASIC architecture. * Deep expertise in AI accelerator design and high\-performance SoCs. * Hands\-on experience building performance models for memory systems and interconnects. * Strong hardware/software co\-design ability. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with GPU architecture. * A solid grasp of ML systems, distributed inference, and large\-scale serving. * Deep knowledge of transformer internals. * Compiler experience. * A track record of research publications. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success in this role looks like helping define future Positron architectures and creating a scalable architectural direction that bridges software and hardware, influencing products that remain competitive for years despite rapidly evolving AI models. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Shape the core architecture of Positron's AI inference accelerators at a foundational level, with outsized influence over the company's technical direction for years to come. * Work at the intersection of frontier AI research and silicon implementation, tackling problems few architects in the industry get to own end to end. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $300,000 – $350,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off, so you can truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: AI Agent Developer
jobs.description: Description: **About Us** ============ Preferred Business Systems (PBS) has been making technology simple for small and midsize businesses since 1997\. From our headquarters in Whippany, New Jersey, we deliver managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, business communications, and office technology to organizations across New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, and the rest of the U.S. Our clients span healthcare, law, logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, construction, hospitality, and financial services. Our growing AI and Automation team builds AI\-powered agents that take repetitive and complex work off their plates, from executive assistance and recruiting to warehouse dispatching and customer communications. **The Role** ============ As an AI Agent Developer, you'll design, build, integrate, and maintain AI agents that streamline real business operations. You'll work within the architecture and standards set by technical leadership, owning the implementation details that turn an approved design into a working solution. You'll partner with Business Strategists, who lead customer relationships and define requirements. Your job is to turn those requirements into automations that are functional, reliable, and secure. Prior AI agent experience is a plus but not required. If you have a strong foundation in software development, APIs, and automation, we'll help you grow into the AI side. **What You'll Do** ================== **Build and integrate AI agents** --------------------------------- * Develop AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure services, and custom code. * Build custom applications and integrations in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages. * Connect agents to Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, third\-party APIs, databases, and customer business applications. * Implement LLM\-powered workflows, tool calling, conditional logic, and human approval steps. * Manage LLM usage costs and performance as part of every build. * Create reusable components that speed up future implementations. **Work with customers** ----------------------- * Join Business Strategists in technical discovery to identify integration needs and system limitations. * Support customer demos, solution testing, and troubleshooting. * Keep internal stakeholders informed on progress, challenges, and risks. **Test, deploy, and improve** ----------------------------- * Write and run functional, integration, and error\-handling tests. * Evaluate LLM output quality, including consistency, hallucinations, and edge cases. * Validate accuracy, permissions, and reliability before deployment. * Deploy approved solutions into customer environments. * Resolve escalated defects and improve agents based on performance data and customer feedback. **Build securely and responsibly** ---------------------------------- * Implement secure authentication, authorization, and least\-privilege access. * Protect customer data and credentials using approved practices. * Identify risks such as sensitive data exposure, prompt injection, and unauthorized actions. * Build in human approval checkpoints and audit logging. * Participate in security reviews and remediate findings. **Document and hand off** ------------------------- * Maintain documentation for agents, integrations, configurations, and deployments. * Write troubleshooting guides and support runbooks. * Define monitoring, alerting, and logging requirements. * Train our support team so every deployed agent is supportable long\-term. Requirements: **What You Bring** ================== * 2\+ years of professional software or automation development experience. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language, using Git and standard development practices. * Experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrating with third\-party systems. * Solid understanding of OAuth 2\.0, authorization, and secure credential handling. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Power Automate (or a comparable workflow platform). * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. * Clear communication with both technical and nontechnical people. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience building AI agents or LLM\-powered applications. * Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Graph API, and Azure services. * Understanding of LLM APIs, function calling, and agent orchestration. * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases. * Experience with AI evaluation, monitoring, and observability. * SQL and data integration experience. * Experience in an MSP or multi\-customer environment. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
