jobs.title: Implementations Manager-Data Centers
jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership. **About the role** As an Implementation Manager, you will work cross\-functionally with Prime’s Data Center Operations, Solutions Engineering and Sales teams, and the Customer’s operation teams to coordinate installation of equipment and infrastructure within a data center environment for customer use. It will be your mission to ensure these installations are completed on time, on budget and error\-free. The position’s primary responsibility is project management of client installations in a data center environment. This typically includes the installation of IT equipment racks, electrical distribution, aisle containment systems, and data cable infrastructure. The Implementation Manager will manage multiple projects across several data centers in their region using standard project and construction management best practices to ensure all installations are completed on time, with accuracy, and within budget. **What you'll do** Implementing customer\-specified equipment and material to support their data center deployment plans. * Review and validate customer provided design and scope of work (SOW) documents for completeness. * Create distribute RFP for SOW, manage and evaluate responses, make recommendation on preferred contractor. * Manage contract approvals with customer, Prime accounting team, and contractor accounting team. * Manage the customer installations at all facilities to be completed on or before deadlines. * Work with contractors and suppliers to obtain the best quality execution and the best pricing. * Qualify vendors and implement the company's procurement procedures including tendering projects, using RFPs, purchase orders, and cost tracking templates. * Hold contractors and suppliers to set delivery dates. * Identify and rectify any steps in the process that are delaying installations. * Attend weekly meetings with all site installation managers as assigned. * Work closely with the Sales Engineers and Sales to ensure understand order requirements. Support the various departments in Prime with material sourcing, pricing, and technical specifications. * Assist the Solutions Engineers in ensuring the Sales Orders/SOW’s accurately reflect the client fit out requirements. * Work closely with Facility Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Construction, Operations Procurement, Provisioning and Finance. * Manage, direct, and coordinate the activities of internal or contracted personnel or third parties who are providing services or performing on\-site installations. Provide implementation updates. * Keep clients and internal Prime stakeholders informed of the installation progress. * Update project tracking log regularly as required. * Attend conference calls and meetings with clients as required. 4\. Project cost reporting. * Keep accurate records for all expenditures (PO/contract with vendors). * Document actual installation costs vs budget for each completed installation. **Qualifications** * Strong project management skills, ideally a PMP or similar certification. * 3\-5 years of experience in the data center industry in design, construction and/or fit out. * Intermediate level knowledge of rack, cage, electrical distribution, and data cable infrastructure. * Intermediate level knowledge in reading/interpreting construction plans, one\-line drawings, and construction specifications. * Advanced level proficiency in the use of MS Productivity tools, including Teams, Word, Access, Excel, Visio \& Project. * Strong written and verbal customer service skills. * Ability to track costs for all projects, using purchase orders and other tracking methods. * Demonstrate ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical facilities environment. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range of $135\-150k along with an annual performance bonus and an additional capital project bonus program * 401k up to a 4% employer match that is fully vested upon enrollment * 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability * Paid Time Off \+ Sick time *Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.* Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, protected veteran or military status, disability status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. \#LI\-On\- Site

jobs.title: Applied Research - Evals & Data
jobs.description: **Own Your Intelligence** ------------------------- Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team. Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high\-performance training, and deployment into one full\-stack system for post\-training at frontier scale \- from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open\-source models trained end to end for long\-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full\-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Role Impact** This is a customer facing role at the intersection of cutting\-edge RL/post\-training methods, applied data, and agent systems. You’ll have a direct impact on shaping how advanced models are aligned, evaluated, deployed, and used in the real world by: * **Advancing Agent Capabilities:** Designing and iterating on next\-generation AI agents that tackle real workloads—workflow automation, reasoning\-intensive tasks, and decision\-making at scale. Working with applied data from real deployments to continuously refine policies, improve reasoning, and enhance reliability and safety. * **Building Robust Infrastructure:** Developing the distributed systems, evaluation pipelines, and coordination frameworks that enable these agents to operate reliably, efficiently, and at massive scale. Building data capture, processing, and versioning workflows for feedback, model traces, and reward signals. * **Bridge Between Customers \& Research:** Translating customer needs and insights from applied data into clear technical requirements that guide product and research priorities. Collaborating closely with RL and eval teams to ensure real\-world signals inform model alignment and reward shaping. * **Prototype in the Field:** Rapidly designing and deploying agents, evals, and harnesses alongside customers to validate solutions. Using applied evaluation data to iterate on model performance and discover new capabilities. **Customer\-Facing Engineering** * Work side\-by\-side with customers to deeply understand workflows, data sources, and bottlenecks. * Prototype agents, data pipelines, and eval harnesses tailored to real use cases, then hand off hardened systems to core teams. * Translate customer insights and evaluation results into roadmap and research direction. **Post\-training \& Reinforcement Learning** * Design and implement novel RL and post\-training methods (RLHF, RLVR, GRPO, etc.) to align large models with domain\-specific tasks. * Build evaluation harnesses and verifiers to measure reasoning, robustness, and agentic behavior in real\-world workflows. * Integrate applied data collection and analytics into the post\-training process to surface regressions, emergent skills, and alignment opportunities. * Prototype multi\-agent and memory\-augmented systems to expand capabilities for customer\-facing solutions. **Agent Development \& Infrastructure** * Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI agents for automation, workflow orchestration, and decision\-making. * Extend and integrate with agent frameworks to support evolving feature requests and performance requirements. * Architect and maintain distributed training and inference pipelines, ensuring scalability and cost efficiency. * Develop observability and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) to ensure reliability and performance in production deployments. **Requirements** * Strong background in machine learning engineering, with experience in post\-training, RL, or large\-scale model alignment. * Experience with applied data workflows and evaluation frameworks for large models or agents (e.g., SWE\-Bench, HELM, EvalFlow, internal eval pipelines). * Deep expertise in distributed training/inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, sglang, Ray, Accelerate). * Experience deploying containerized systems at scale (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). * Track record of research contributions (publications, open\-source contributions, benchmarks) in ML/RL. * Passion for advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in reasoning, measurement, and building practical, agentic AI systems. **What We Offer** * Cash Compensation Range of $150\-300k \+ equity incentives * Flexible Work (remote or San Francisco) * Visa Sponsorship \& relocation support * Professional Development budget * Team Off\-sites \& conference attendance **Growth Opportunity** You’ll join a mission\-driven team working at the frontier of open, superintelligence infra. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to: * Shape the evolution of agent\-driven, data\-informed solutions—from research breakthroughs to production systems used by real customers. * Collaborate with leading researchers, engineers, and partners pushing the boundaries of RL, evaluation, and post\-training. * Grow with a fast\-moving organization where your contributions directly influence both the technical direction and the broader AI ecosystem. If you’re excited to move fast, build boldly, and help define how agentic AI is developed and deployed, we’d love to hear from you. Ready to build the open superintelligence infrastructure of tomorrow? Apply now to help us make powerful, open AGI accessible to everyone.

We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Forward\-Deployed Research Engineer (FDRE) to serve as the primary technical interface between Prime Intellect and our most important customers: AI companies, research labs, and enterprises running post\-training and agentic RL on our platform. This is not a traditional research role. You'll spend most of your time embedded with customers, understanding their models, workflows, and goals. Then, you'll translate those objectives into concrete training runs, environment designs, evaluation harnesses, and deployment recipes using the Lab stack. You are the person who makes the platform work in practice for real workloads. You'll work closely with our research, product, and infrastructure teams to feed field insights back into the platform, shaping what we build next based on what customers actually need. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Customer Engagement \& Technical Delivery** * Embed directly with strategic customers to understand their agent architectures, failure modes, and product goals * Design and build custom RL environments, evaluation harnesses, and verifiers that capture what "good" looks like for each customer's domain * Architect agent scaffolding — tool use, multi\-step reasoning, memory, sandbox execution — tailored to customer workflows * Configure and launch training runs on Lab, iterating on reward functions, rollout strategies, and evaluation criteria * Serve as the technical lead for engagements end\-to\-end: from discovery through deployed, improved models ### **Platform Feedback \& Ecosystem** * Identify repeatable patterns from customer engagements and codify them into reference implementations, templates, and documentation * Serve as the voice of the customer internally, shaping the roadmap for Lab, verifiers, the Environments Hub, and training infrastructure * Build high\-quality examples and "recipes" that make it easy for new customers and open\-source contributors to extend the stack * Contribute to technical content (blog posts, tutorials, case studies) that demonstrates real\-world platform usage ### **Applied Research \& Experimentation** * Develop novel evaluation methodologies for agentic behavior — multi\-step reasoning, tool use correctness, recovery from failure, long\-horizon task completion * Prototype and iterate on agent harnesses for real\-world tasks: code generation, workflow automation, document processing, and more * Experiment with reward design, rubric construction, and environment shaping to improve training signal quality * Stay current on the frontier of agentic AI, evals, and post\-training methods, and bring that knowledge directly into customer work **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Deep hands\-on experience building, evaluating, or deploying LLM\-based agents in the past 1–2 years — you've seen what breaks in production and know what good evals look like * Strong intuition for evaluation design: you can look at a customer's agent and quickly identify what to measure, how to construct a rubric, and where the reward signal is weak * Working understanding of RL and post\-training concepts (GRPO, RLHF, reward modeling, SFT) — you don't need to have written a trainer from scratch, but you should understand what the knobs do and why they matter * Strong Python skills and comfort with the modern AI stack (Hugging Face, inference engines, agent frameworks) * Experience in a customer\-facing or consulting\-adjacent technical role, or as a technical founder — you're comfortable in a room with a customer's engineering team figuring out what to build * Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a clear environment spec, a compelling case study, and a useful Slack message to a frustrated customer * High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You don't wait for specs; you scope the problem, ship a solution, and iterate **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience with agent frameworks and tooling (DSPy, LangGraph, MCP, Stagehand, browser automation) * Experience building or running LLM evaluation pipelines at scale (benchmarks, synthetic data generation, model grading) * Research experience — publications, open\-source contributions, or benchmarks in ML/RL/agents * Familiarity with sandbox/code execution environments for agent evaluation * Web programming experience (React, TypeScript, Next.js) for building demos and customer\-facing tooling **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Cash Compensation Range of $150\-300k** \+ equity incentives * **Flexible Work** (San Francisco or hybrid\-remote) * **Visa Sponsorship** \& relocation support * **Professional Development** budget * **Team Off\-sites** \& conference attendance **Growth Opportunity** ---------------------- You’ll join a mission\-driven team working at the frontier of open, superintelligence infra. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to: * Shape the evolution of agent\-driven solutions—from research breakthroughs to production systems used by real customers. * Collaborate with leading researchers, engineers, and partners pushing the boundaries of RL and post\-training. * Grow with a fast\-moving organization where your contributions directly influence both the technical direction and the broader AI ecosystem. If you’re excited to move fast, build boldly, and help define how agentic AI is developed and deployed, we’d love to hear from you. **Ready to build the open superintelligence infrastructure of tomorrow?** Apply now to help us make powerful, open AGI accessible to everyone.

jobs.description: **Description** **POSITION DESCRIPTION:** Qcells is seeking a Senior Manager, DevOps to lead the DevOps function within our Operations and Platform Management organization and own the strategy, architecture, and operational execution of the DevOps foundation supporting our critical infrastructure energy management platform. using Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Ensure infrastructure environments are reproducible, scalable, secure, and consistently managed across cloud and edge deployments. * Partner with policy\-as\-code, and governance controls supporting NERC CIP, SOC 2, NIST, IEC 62443, and other applicable critical infrastructure standards. * Implement and govern secure practices for secrets and operational risks effectively to both technical teams and senior leadership. * Travel may be required up to 15%, depending on business needs. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience in the frameworks including NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and NIST. * Azure certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Azure Security Engineer Associate. * Knowledge of industrial control systems, SCADA environments, and industrial deployment requirements. * Experience with edge computing platforms and offline\-capable or intermittently connected deployment environments. * Familiarity with industrial communication technologies and protocols including OPC\-UA, MQTT, and industrial IoT architectures. * Experience with observability platforms including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable technologies. * Understanding of data sovereignty, multi\-tenant architectures, and geographically distributed infrastructure. * Experience implementing chaos engineering, resilience testing, and reliability engineering practices for mission\-critical systems. * Knowledge of FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or other government security and compliance frameworks. **COMPENSATION:** In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, the anticipated annual base salary for this position is: * Zone 1 (Bay Area, NYC): $209,800 – $262,200 * Zone 2 (CA, jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Every moment of every day, people around the world rely on the energy they access through infrastructure built by Quanta. Comprising the largest skilled\-labor force in North America, our employees are highly skilled and innovative, continually working to connect people and power. We’re building the infrastructure that supports the energy transition, and there are more opportunities than ever to be part of our team. Join us and build your career building a brighter future. Imagine what you could do here. We encourage, inspire, and support our people to seize opportunities in our corporate office and with hundreds of our operating companies worldwide that provide solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, and communications industries. Quanta actively promotes and maintains a culture of belonging where all employees can be themselves, live their values, and find opportunities to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic organization in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is prized. Come find out how our people power modern life. **About this Role** ------------------- The Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (Lead FDE) is a hands\-on technical team lead who guides a small pod of Forward Deployed Engineers through the delivery of high\-impact solutions — from discovery to production — for Quanta’s operating companies. You will own day\-to\-day execution on a single active project at a time, setting technical direction, coordinating the work of 2–4 engineers, and personally contributing to the codebase alongside them. Unlike the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, who shapes architecture across multiple initiatives, the Lead FDE is embedded in the details of one engagement: translating ambiguous business needs into shipped software, unblocking the team, and serving as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders. Unlike an individual Forward Deployed Engineer, you are accountable not only for your own output but for the quality, velocity, and coherence of the whole pod’s work. This is a working lead role. You are expected to spend the majority of your time building — writing production code, prototyping with AI\-assisted tooling, and pairing with engineers — while also planning, reviewing, mentoring, and communicating outcomes to business partners. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead a pod of Forward Deployed Engineers through end\-to\-end delivery of a single project, from problem framing to production hand\-off. * Partner directly with business leaders, domain experts, and operating\-unit stakeholders to understand needs and shape scope. * Translate ambiguous requirements into a concrete delivery plan with clear, testable milestones. * Write production\-ready code as a hands\-on contributor on the project, not just as a reviewer. * Make day\-to\-day technical decisions (frameworks, integrations, data models, deployment targets) and escalate architectural calls to the FDEM when needed. * Run code reviews, pairing sessions, and working sessions that raise the team’s technical bar. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and similar) to accelerate delivery and bring best practices back to the broader FDE team. * Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early — and drive the team through them. * Deploy applications to production and coordinate post\-deployment support, monitoring, and iteration with SMEs. * Mentor Forward Deployed Engineers through pairing, feedback, and targeted coaching on craft and consulting skills. * Document design decisions, reusable components, and lessons learned to support scale and knowledge\-sharing across the FDE practice. * Represent the pod in status reviews, demos, and retrospectives with stakeholders and Data \& AI leadership. * Stay current with emerging AI tools and development practices and pilot their adoption within your project. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 8–12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or technical consulting, with recent hands\-on delivery experience. * At least 2 years in a technical lead, tech lead, or senior engineer capacity guiding the work of other engineers on a shared project. * Advanced proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java). * Solid grounding in software architecture patterns, API design, data modeling, and full\-stack or backend delivery. * Fluency in at least one major cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern development practices (CI/CD, containers, version control workflows, testing). * Demonstrated experience applying AI tooling (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, vector search, prompt engineering, RAG patterns) in real delivery workflows. * Track record of shipping production software on tight timelines in a consultative or embedded setting. * Experience mentoring engineers and running effective code reviews. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between business stakeholders and engineers and to represent technical tradeoffs clearly. Preferred Education and Experience * Experience delivering AI, automation, or data\-intensive applications in enterprise environments. * Experience working within large, decentralized organizations or multi\-site enterprise environments. * Background in utility, energy, renewables, construction, or specialty contracting industries. * Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, solutions engineer, or delivery consultant role. Licenses / Certifications Required N/A Preferred Cloud architecture or AI/ML certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent). Supervisory Responsibilities * **Supervises others:** No (technical leadership; no direct reports) * **Has hiring and terminating responsibilities:** No (contributes to interviews and hiring recommendations) * **Number of employees reporting to this job:** 0 Subordinate Supervisory Employees, 0 Non\-Supervisory Employees **What You'll Get** ------------------- * Competitive compensation and benefits package * Flexible work options * Educational assistance * Wellness and Mental Health programs * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Referral Program * Volunteer Time Off * Learning and Development Programs * Office Amenities and Perks **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

Build multi\-agentic prototypes, design core frameworks, and step in to write production code or debug complex system issues when the team faces blockers. * Generative AI \& Agentic Platform Design: Architect enterprise\-grade agentic systems, multi\-agent platforms, autonomous workflow orchestrations, and advanced memory/context management systems leveraging the Model Context Protocol (Server, Client, Gateway). * Standards \& Practice Governance: Establish comprehensive LLMOps and MLOps standards (including prompt versioning, automated evaluation, CI/CD, drift detection, and production monitoring). Define reference architectures and reusable frameworks to accelerate project delivery. * AI Security \& Compliance: Design AI security architectures for regulated industries, ensuring strict compliance with HIPAA, HITRUST, GDPR, SOC 2, and OWASP LLM Top 10 security requirements. * Mentorship \& Practice Growth: Mentor Associate Technical Architects, senior engineers, and delivery teams. Conduct architectural reviews and manage technical debt across engagements. **Required Skills:** **Must Have:** * Experience: 8\+ years of progressive experience in AI/ML engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a technical leadership or architectural role. * Enterprise Architecture \& System Design: + Deep expertise in system integration, legacy modernization, cloud\-native design, and API gateway architectures. + Proven ability to visually represent complex, multi\-system architectures and explain technical trade\-offs with deep, structured reasoning. * Advanced ML \& Deep Learning Foundations: + Mastery of statistical ML, deep learning base architectures (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs), and Computer Vision platforms. + Proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Generative AI \& Agentic Platform Architecture: + Deep understanding of the entire agent development lifecycle, multi\-agent system design, and A2A (Agent\-to\-Agent) communication protocols. + Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, LangChain). + Proven experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt engineering strategies (Chain of Thought, Tree of Thoughts), and LLM optimization (PEFT, SFT, QLoRA, DPO). + Practical implementation of Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, OpenSearch). * Robust MLOps \& LLMOps: + Experience designing end\-to\-end ML lifecycles (data ingestion, feature store, registry, deployment, monitoring, drift detection). + Strong SQL and data transformation experience using BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark. * AI Security \& Regulatory Compliance: + Proven experience designing secure, compliant architectures aligned with major enterprise regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001\). **Good to Have:** * Cloud Expertise: Professional Cloud Architect and Machine Learning Engineer certifications on AWS or GCP. * Thought Leadership: Publications, technical blogs, or conference presentations in Agentic/Generative AI or Enterprise Architecture. **Behavioural Skills:** * Technical Reasoning \& Probing: Exceptional ability to justify architectural choices, explain complex technical decisions under deep probing, and evaluate alternative tooling stacks. * Stakeholder Presence: Exceptional presentation and communication skills. Proven ability to pitch proposals, influence decision\-makers, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders. * Willingness to Walk the Talk: A hands\-on leader who leads by example, stepping in to write code, build prototypes, and guide engineers through technical uncertainty. * Strategic Mentorship: Passion for coaching Associate Architects and senior engineers, establishing standards, and fostering a culture of technical excellence. **What is in it for you:** * Be part of the fastest\-growing AI\-first digital transformation and engineering company in the world * Be a leader of an energetic team of highly dynamic and talented individuals * Exposure to working with fortune 500 companies and innovative market disruptors * Exposure to the latest technologies related to artificial intelligence and machine learning, data and cloud *If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, Relativity aiR, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change. What We Do At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code; they harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster and shape the future of legal technology. They shape how industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice and continuously evolve our platform using the latest technologies, including cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling. Our AI powers privacy programs, identifies confidential information, and detects language indicating misconduct. We’re reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. If you’re passionate about solving hard problems, designing for scale, and building tools that matter, while working in a culture that values transparency, innovation, and shared success, Relativity offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **About the Role** Relativity's design system is moving to UX, and we are building its next generation. You will take it from early build to production and keep it running: making the technical calls inside the library, from module format to how it behaves under micro frontends, and building most of them yourself. The framework is chosen, the first components exist, and it ships through our micro frontend. Your work is the packaging, publishing, CI, testing, and hardest component behavior that turn it into a library teams can depend on. You will also maintain the libraries it replaces while teams move off them. **Job Description and Requirements** * Build and maintain how the library is packaged and published: module format, peer dependencies, the publish path to Artifactory and CDN. * Apply versioning and deprecation practice on every release, and write the migration guides for consuming teams. * Stand up CI, execute visual regression testing, and wire the token pipeline from design token files through to CSS variables. * Test and review components built by designers and coding agents before they merge, and maintain the machine\-readable guidance that agents leverage. * Fix accessibility defects in the code and support the accessibility conformance reporting. * Respond to breaking changes caused by releases and apply fixes through timely patch releases. * Keep legacy libraries in maintenance mode, only addressing major security issues and critical fixes. * Author the component behavior that our React framework library doesn’t provide. Raise the engineering bar of the design system team through code review and pairing with designers who use coding agents. * **Preferred Qualifications** * You have helped maintain a design system that multiple teams depend upon. * You are fluent with AI coding tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. * You have worked across platform teams. * You have guided a design system migration that included patching what broke for consuming teams. * You can explain packaging decisions to a designer and a design decision to a platform engineer. * You have a strong accessibility practice of creating accessible, keyboard\-navigable, responsive experiences and testing them with screen readers and tools like Axe or equivalent. You have experience working in legacy codebases. * **Minimum Qualifications** * 7\+ years in front\-end or UX engineering. * Deep React and TypeScript experience. * Experience keeping a published package reliable across releases. * Technical leadership on a library or product area. * Ability to turn a technical direction into a working plan and execute on it. * Experience owning build and release tooling for a published package. * Deep experience with semantic HTML, CSS, and accessible component patterns. * Clear technical communication, including in code review. Based in the United States. * **Why We Could Be a Great Fit** * Impactful Mission: *Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It* \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * Engineering Culture: Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * Inclusive Environment: Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * Community Impact: Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * Compensation \& Benefits: Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $126,000 and $190,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R's primary structures. This isn't about turning the same bolt every day; it's about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real\-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it's up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch. **About the Role:** * Own Forming operations within the work center, being responsible for delivery of all formed products and improving both roll forming and press brake process * Bring online a press brake work center and lead the development effort for the company to be capable of forming up to 20' sheets of material for our rocket primary structure * Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high\-fidelity processes * Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team * Support the shop floor through live issue resolution and provide upstream feedback as we innovate the next generation of manufacturing technology * Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight builds **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline with 2\+ years progressive and related experience required * A history of improving manufacturing processes and the ability to independently identify and lead development projects needed to meet processing requirements * Strong engineering fundamentals in process improvement, forming, metallic processing, mechanics of materials * Deep knowledge of common metallic manufacturing processes, tools, inspection methods and GD\&T * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability * Strong 3D \& 2D design/drafting skills per ASME Y14\.5M (NX preferred) **Nice to have, but not required:** * Direct experience with roll forming and press brake forming aluminum alloys * New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success * Experience in managing projects in a improve the internal tools our sales team runs on — dashboards, workflows, reporting, integrations \- Deploy and monitor your own work on Vercel and Supabase, and fix what breaks \- Sit down with the sales team, figure out what they actually need, then build it What we're looking for \- Extremely proficient with AI coding tools: you use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agents every day and can show jobs.title: AI Product Engineer, Technology, Facilities
jobs.description: We're looking for an AI Product Engineer to build and ship enterprise tools, systems and automations that drive measurable operational savings or improvements across Rivian's Facilities organization. You'll use AI\-native development tools like Cursor, Gemini, and Claude to turn real Facilities problems into working solutions that save time, reduce cost, and eliminate manual overhead. You'll embed directly into Facilities workflows — construction project reporting, capital program tracking, real estate operations, building management — and build automations that have a tangible dollar\-and\-cents impact. **Build \& Deploy** * Build internal applications, AI agents, and workflow automations using LLM\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Gemini, Claude, Glean, etc.) targeting specific Facilities pain points — manual reporting, data entry, schedule tracking, cost reconciliation — with a focus on quantifiable time and cost savings * Stand up no\-code and low\-code solutions, maintainable by non\-technical team members where speed and simplicity are prioritized over engineering complexity * Connect Facilities data sources (ACC, Procore, Kahua, FOS, Databricks) via APIs to support intelligent workflows that unify siloed information * Own the Full SDLC by applying traditional product development rigor to AI\-generated code. You will manage sprint cycles, define technical requirements in Jira, and oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the tools you build. * Conduct code reviews on peer\-built AI tools and own enhancement of deployed solutions based on user feedback and evolving business needs **Learn the Business** * Rapidly build working knowledge of Facilities operations — how capital projects are planned, budgeted, tracked, and delivered — by shadowing project managers, construction teams, and operations staff to find automation opportunities that aren't on anyone's roadmap yet * Understand the Facilities tech stack well enough to identify where AI can eliminate friction and reduce costs * Document solutions, create reusable templates, and contribute to internal playbooks and how\-to guides **Collaborate \& Deliver Value** * Partner with Facilities stakeholders to understand workflows, quantify inefficiencies, and prioritize automations with the highest operational ROI * Translate operational needs into working prototypes and iterate based on user feedback until adoption sticks * Help track and report the impact of deployed solutions — hours saved, errors reduced, costs avoided, scaling without new headcount **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * 4\+ years in a technical role — software development, product ownership, technical program management, or similar * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; OR equivalent practical, hands\-on experience in lieu of a degree * Demonstrated experience building with AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, or equivalent) * Working knowledge of prompt engineering, AI agent design, and LLM application development * Strong foundational knowledge of Agile methodologies, version control (Git), code reviews, and secure deployment pipelines. * Strong UI/UX instincts — can produce functional, clean interfaces without a design team * Strong communication skills; equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with leadership or a working session with project teams * Self\-directed; thrives in ambiguous environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Familiarity with large\-scale construction, real estate, or capital programs * Experience with enterprise AI tools like Glean or similar knowledge management platforms * Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) frameworks and multi\-agent architectures * Prior experience shipping internal tools in a non\-engineering business unit * Track record of upskilling peers or running internal training on new technologies \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Sr. Audio Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: The Audio Group at Rivian is responsible for in\-vehicle acoustics, media and infotainment playback, Chimes, voice UI, and custom audio hardware. We have a deep passion for sound quality and technical excellence. Rivian is seeking an **Audio Software QA Engineer** to design, build, and maintain our automated software test framework. In this role, you will take full ownership of software\-based audio validation, ensuring that our Audio Weaver DSP signal chains, Linux/Android audio HALs, chime systems, and media routing perform flawlessly across software releases. You will bridge the gap between software development, DSP engineering, and vehicle release management, acting as the ultimate gatekeeper for Rivian’s audio software quality. **Test Automation Framework Development:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks (using Python, C/C\+\+, or Robot Framework) for vehicle audio software regression testing. * Integrate automated audio test scripts into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab) for automated build verification and regression testing. * Develop automated audio signal analysis tools (e.g., automated THD, SNR, frequency response, and latency measurements using Audio Precision or SoundCheck APIs). * Execute functional, regression, integration, smoke, and exploratory testing * Design, author, maintain, and structure detailed test cases, test scenarios, and run lists within TestRail **Infotainment \& Audio Software Validation:** * Validate end\-to\-end audio software stacks across Android Automotive, Linux, and RTOS environments, including * Audio HAL, Audio Weaver DSP binaries, and media routing. * Perform functional and regression testing for critical vehicle audio features, including chime prioritization, voice assistant capture (Alexa/Rivian Voice UI), telephony, and media playback. * Collaborate with the System Software team to debug audio driver, HAL, and platform bring\-up issues on hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test rigs. **Bug Triage, Root\-Cause Analysis, \& Reporting:** * Analyze automated test execution reports, triage failures, and isolate root causes between software algorithms, OS audio routing, and physical hardware. * Provide detailed bug reports with captured audio traces, logs, and reproduction steps; work directly with DSP and Software Engineers to resolve issues. * Define and execute software release criteria for audio software packages prior to vehicle Over\-The\-Air (OTA) updates. **Cross\-Functional Quality Collaboration:** * Partner with the Audio Systems Test Integration Engineer to execute software test suites on physical lab benches and rigs. * Work alongside DSP and Hardware Engineers during new feature bring\-up to establish test strategies and acceptance criteria early in the software development lifecycle. * Familiarity with product life cycles in a fast\-paced automotive environment * **Experience:** a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Audio Engineering, or related discipline and 3\+ years of professional experience in software QA, audio test automation, or embedded software validation. * **Programming \& Scripting:** High proficiency in Python and C/C\+\+; familiarity with MATLAB or bash scripting. * OS \& Platform Depth: Demonstrated experience testing audio on Linux, Android (Android Audio HAL / ALSA), or QNX/RTOS platforms. * **Audio Tooling:** Experience with Audio Weaver, Audio Precision (APx API), SoundCheck, or similar acoustic analysis software. * **Education:** Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Audio Engineering, or a related field. * **Nice to Have:** Critical listening skills; experience with CI/CD automation tools; knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, A2B, Ethernet).

jobs.title: AI Controls & Engineering Lead
jobs.description: About Rockefeller Capital Management: Rockefeller Capital Management was established in 2018 as a leading independent financial advisory services firm. Originally founded in 1882 as the family office of John D. Rockefeller, the Firm has evolved to offer strategic advice to ultra\- and high\-net\-worth individuals and families, institutions, and corporations from offices in 35 markets throughout the United States, as well as an office in London. The Firm oversees $237 billion in client assets as of August 31, 2026\. Position: The primary purpose of this role is to enable the safe, deliberate, and accelerated adoption of AI across Rockefeller Capital Management. Partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity (CISO), and AI Risk Governance teams, the individual translates governance requirements into scalable technical controls that govern the firm's AI ecosystem, including agents, copilots, skills, plugins, connectors, and the large language models that power them. AI platforms evolve rapidly, with new models, capabilities, and features released on a near\-weekly basis. This role is responsible for staying ahead of that pace by continuously evaluating emerging technologies from providers such as Microsoft, Anthropic, and other vendors. The individual will assess new capabilities through both a business value and risk lens, providing clear recommendations on whether they should be adopted, piloted, restricted, or deferred. This is a highly hands\-on technical role focused on operationalizing AI governance. Rather than creating policy, the individual interprets existing requirements and implements them directly through platform configuration, policy enforcement, APIs, automation, and administrative tooling across Microsoft and Anthropic environments. The goal is to ensure AI controls are embedded, measurable, and enforceable while supporting the firm's continued innovation and growth. Responsibilities: * Interpret and implement enterprise control requirements. Translate policies, standards, and risk decisions issued by Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, and AI Risk Governance into concrete technical controls, review gates, and deployment standards for AI capabilities. * Configure and script the controls. Implement guardrails directly across Microsoft and Anthropic services — tenant and admin center settings, Copilot and Copilot Studio policies, Azure AI Foundry configuration, Anthropic enterprise administration, Entra access policies, and Purview data protection controls. * Automate governance at scale. Build scripts and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Python, KQL) to inventory agents and skills, enforce policy, detect drift, monitor usage, and produce audit and compliance evidence. * Own agents and skills end to end. Maintain the inventory, ownership model, and lifecycle — from intake and review through deployment, monitoring, recertification, and retirement. * Run capability review assessments. Evaluate new AI features and use cases against firm\-defined risk, security, and compliance criteria — covering business value, security exposure, data access and entitlement impact, supervisory obligations, operational readiness, and fit with enterprise * architecture standards — and escalate to the appropriate governance body where a policy decision is required. * Assess LLMs and model changes. Test and compare models across providers, track model and version updates, evaluate capability shifts and failure modes, and provide the technical evidence governance bodies need to decide where each model may be used. * Stay ahead of AI evolution. Systematically track roadmaps, release notes, and previews across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Anthropic, and emerging platforms, and translate each change into a clear enable, pilot, restrict, or defer recommendation. * Implement controls for safe sharing and reuse. Configure how agents and skills are scoped, shared, and permissioned in line with approved requirements, including departmental boundaries, intent review, and guardrails against unintended data exposure. * Partner across the firm. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, AI Risk Governance, platform engineering, product, and business teams to confirm intent, close gaps, and ensure capabilities launch with the required controls already in place. * Report clearly to leadership and governance forums. Produce decision records, review summaries, control evidence, and executive\-ready briefings on AI capability posture, risks, and adoption Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 2 years working directly with generative AI, LLMs, copilots, or agent platforms. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring tenants, platform, or security controls — not just specifying them. * Proficiency in scripting and automation wit pts, grounding, connectors, and retrieval behave — including where they can leak data or produce unreliable results. * Strong grasp of identity, access, and data protection fundamentals, ideally in an Entra and Purview environment. * Proven ability to read a policy or control standard and determine what it means in practice for a platform configuration. * Clear, concise writing and the confidence to present recommendations to senior stakeholders. Skills: * Familiarity with AI cost and consumption management — token metering, prompt\-caching economics, spending limits, and chargeback or show back models. * Exposure to responsible AI or AI risk frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Familiarity with AI supply\-chain risk — untrusted skills, plugins, and MCP servers as an attack vector — and with registry, scanning, and gating approaches to control them. * Practical experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, red\-teaming, or prompt\-injection and jailbreak testing. * Experience ingesting AI platform telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel or Defender XDR and extending incident\-response playbooks to AI\-specific alerts. * Experience with network\- and proxy\-layer enforcement of AI traffic, including application\-identity or URL\-category policy, TLS inspection, and egress control for cloud\-resident agents that bypass the corporate firewall. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, Entra External ID, and data entitlement enforcement. * Hands\-on experience deploying client and endpoint policy through Intune or Group Policy — for example, pinning an AI desktop application to the enterprise tenant and forcing SSO. * Familiarity with agent and non\-human identity models, including on\-behalf\-of execution, admin\-assigned agent permissions, and central agent registration in Entra, Agent 365, or Azure AI Foundry. * Experience administering the agent and skill lifecycle in Copilot Studio, Agent 365, or Anthropic enterprise administration — inventory, ownership, sharing controls, and inactivity review. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code or configuration management (Terraform, Bicep, ARM) applied to platform governance. * Experience supporting technology intake, control testing, or audit and evidence process. * Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with supervisory and recordkeeping obligations. * Experience validating audit, e\-discovery, and records\-retention coverage for a new platform, including provider compliance or audit APIs and OpenTelemetry\-based log export. Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000\. Base salary for the role will depend on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Rockefeller Capital Management offers a comprehensive benefit package including health coverage, vacation time, paid leave, retirement plan, and more. representing  Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national other non\-merit factor **Additional Information** About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. jobs.title: Platform / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Do you love solving hard cloud networking and automation problems, and want to own the infrastructure foundation of an innovative global company with the feel of a startup and an amazing culture? SRAM is seeking a Platform / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own our cloud network architecture and our infrastructure\-as\-code foundation. This role sits at the center of everything the platform team runs. You will operate a large multi\-account AWS Control Tower organization (40\+ accounts), design and evolve the network topology that connects it, and author the Terraform that defines all of it. Everything else the team does, from CI/CD to identity to observability, is built on top of those two pillars. You will join a team of 4, reporting to the IT Director, and help carry forward an active 2026 roadmap centered on network egress centralization and continued IaC maturity, alongside observability and app modernization work. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Cloud Networking: * Own cloud networking end to end: design and evolve multi\-account VPC architecture, transit gateway / centralized egress, Route 53, and cross\-account connectivity across a 40\+ account AWS Control Tower organization * Lead the network egress centralization initiative on the 2026 roadmap * Infrastructure as Code: * Own infrastructure as code end to end: author and maintain Terraform modules from scratch, including module design, state management, and reusable patterns other engineers build on, not just consuming existing modules * Continue raising the bar on IaC coverage and module quality across the organization * Platform Governance: * Extend AWS multi\-account governance (Control Tower, Organizations, IAM) across EC2, RDS, ECS, EKS, and Bedrock * Support the observability buildout and the migration of workloads from EC2 to ECS * CI/CD and Identity: * Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including OIDC federation * Administer Microsoft Entra SSO * Internal Tooling and Partnership: * Build, extend, and support internal tooling and services, leveraging AWS Bedrock for inference where applicable * Partner closely with engineers across teams to turn infrastructure and networking needs into self\-service, well\-documented tooling * Who Thrives Here: * Communicates clearly and generously; writes good docs, explains tradeoffs, and makes teammates' jobs easier * Gives opinionated, direct guidance but stays genuinely open to pushback * Shares context proactively and treats knowledge as something to spread, not hoard * Is patient, reliable, and easy to build trust with over the long haul **Qualifications** ------------------ * 4\+ years in cloud infrastructure / platform engineering, with hands\-on ownership of production cloud networking (VPC design, routing, egress, cross\-account or cross\-VPC connectivity) at scale * Proven experience authoring and designing Terraform modules from scratch, including module structure, state management, and reuse patterns, not just consuming existing ones * Production AWS experience, ideally within a multi\-account / Control Tower organization * Hands\-on experience with GitLab CI/CD (including OIDC federation) and Microsoft Entra SSO integration * Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: * Proficiency in Python and Bash, with a bias toward automation over manual toil * Solid grounding in identity and access management, secrets management, and observability tooling * A code\-first, no\-lock\-in mindset * Experience with AWS Bedrock or similar managed inference services preferred * Experience building with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow preferred * Prior EC2\-to\-ECS migration experience preferred * Preferred Certifications: * AWS Certified * HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate * Compensation and Benefits: * Starting salary range: $90,000 up to $125,000, based on skills and experience * Annual corporate bonus eligibility based on company and individual performance * Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; life and long\-term disability insurance; generous paid time off ### **About SRAM** SRAM LLC is one of the world's largest suppliers of components to the bike industry. Established in Chicago in 1987, SRAM continues to promote cycling through its products, its advocacy, and its employees who are dedicated to improving the cycling experience. Today, SRAM employs more than 5,000\+ employees, in 20\+ locations, across 10\+ countries. SRAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description: **Senior Technical Success Manager** ==================================== **Location:** Remote, Travel as Needed **Reporting to:** Technical Operations Manager At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting\-edge solutions, and a security\-first mindset. We provide end\-to\-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future\-ready transformation. As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long\-term impact. Our approach is innovation\-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real\-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology. **Overview** ============ The Technical Success Manager is responsible for the operational, technical, and lifecycle success of assigned managed\-services customers. The position serves as a primary relationship and coordination point between the customer and STN’s Service Desk and Managed Services Operations, Engineering, Project Management Office, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership teams. The Technical Success Manager develops and maintains an informed understanding of each customer’s business, stakeholders, technology environment, managed\-services agreement, support history, active initiatives, asset lifecycle, and upcoming contractual obligations. The role facilitates recurring customer meetings, monitors service performance and escalations, tracks commitments, coordinates ongoing initiatives, supports asset and technology lifecycle planning, and ensures that contract, licensing, warranty, and service renewals are identified and addressed in advance. This is a non\-commissioned role. The Technical Success Manager identifies customer needs and qualified improvement opportunities but transfers solution design, pricing, negotiation, forecasting, and closing responsibilities to the appropriate Sales, Solutions, or contract\-management resources. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Customer relationship and account knowledge** ----------------------------------------------- * Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned managed\-services customers. * Build relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technical contacts, department managers, and escalation stakeholders. * Understand each customer’s business operations, critical technology dependencies, supported locations, key vendors, communication preferences, and service expectations. * Maintain an accurate stakeholder map identifying decision\-makers, technical contacts, executive sponsors, renewal owners, and escalation contacts. * Maintain awareness of customer sentiment, organizational change, operational risks, business priorities, and upcoming initiatives. * Represent the customer’s interests internally while maintaining contractual, technical, and operational boundaries. **Customer meeting management** ------------------------------- * Coordinate and attend weekly, monthly, quarterly, and other scheduled customer meetings based on account requirements. * Prepare agendas using ticket activity, service performance, project status, lifecycle items, renewals, open decisions, risks, and upcoming initiatives. * Facilitate meetings or support the designated meeting owner. * Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, dependencies, and follow\-up actions. * Distribute meeting notes and action summaries within the established service standard. * Track customer commitments through completion and escalate overdue or blocked actions. * Assist with monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews, executive reviews, and technology\-planning discussions. **Support ticket and service oversight** ---------------------------------------- * Review open tickets, aging tickets, escalations, recurring incidents, reopened tickets, and customer\-impacting trends for assigned accounts. * Monitor high\-priority and customer\-sensitive issues to confirm ownership, communication cadence, and appropriate escalation. * Follow up on tickets and initiate with Managed Services Operations, who remain responsible for completing the work; keep informed and help move stalled tickets forward. * Help ensure customer\-facing updates are timely, accurate, understandable, and aligned with confirmed technical information. * Identify patterns that may require root\-cause analysis, problem management, technical remediation, training, lifecycle replacement, or project work. * Review relevant SLA performance, ticket volume, response trends, resolution trends, and backlog information. * Avoid b ative, risk, and escalation records current. * Conduct recurring internal account reviews with Service Delivery, Managed Services Operations, Engineering, PMO, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership as appropriate. * Provide leadership with visibility into account health, upcoming renewals, lifecycle exposure, open commitments, escalations, and commercial handoffs. * Use the STN One portal, Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence), the ticketing system, Salesforce, NetSuite, monitoring tools, and other approved platforms according to defined processes. * Support customer onboarding, transitions, offboarding, and material environment changes, and validate that onboarding (G.9\) and offboarding (G.11\) duties are complete. * Identify possible service\-scope misunderstandings or recurring out\-of\-scope requests and route them for review. **Experience \& Qualifications** ================================ **Required** ------------ * Four or more years of experience in an MSP, IT service\-delivery, technical account\-management, customer success, or comparable customer\-facing technical role. * At least two years managing customer relationships, escalations, recurring reviews, or an assigned account portfolio. * Operational working knowledge of networks, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. * Experience reviewing support tickets, service metrics, customer escalations, and recurring issue trends. * Experience coordinating technical projects, upgrades, remediation activities, or customer initiatives. * Experience using a PSA, CRM, ticketing system, documentation platform, project system, asset platform, or monitoring portal. * Ability to interpret service descriptions, contract dates, licensing quantities, warranties, and renewal requirements. * Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills. * Ability to communicate credibly with customer executives, business contacts, and technical teams. * Sound judgment regarding when to involve Service Delivery, Engineering, Security, PMO, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, or leadership. **Preferred** ------------- * Direct Managed Service Provider employment experience. * Experience leading monthly service reviews, QBRs, executive reviews, or technology\-planning meetings. * Experience with contract renewals, software licensing, hardware warranties, leases, or vendor services. * Experience developing asset or technology lifecycle plans. * Experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, a customer portal, PSA, CRM, RMM or monitoring tools, and IT documentation platforms. * ITIL 4 Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA, CAPM, Project\+, or similar relevant certification. * Experience working with regulated or compliance\-sensitive customers. **Physical and work requirements** ---------------------------------- * Regular use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and customer portals. * Ability to participate in meetings across supported customer time zones. * Periodic customer, company, or vendor travel as required by account needs. * Occasional participation in urgent customer escalations outside the normal meeting schedule. * Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law and company policy. **Compensation** ================ * Full\-Time, Exempt * $100,000\-$110,000/year, DOE **Benefits** ============ * Health Coverage – Medical, Dental \& Vision * FSA Health and Dependent Care available • 401(k) Plan * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Observed Holidays Paid * Cell Phone Allowance * Collaborative, growth\-driven culture Candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents. We are unable to provide sponsorship at this time. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.

jobs.description: **Job Description** Sage is looking for an experienced Principal AI Engineer to build AI\-powered solutions that accelerate and automate complex data migration into Sage products. This is a senior, hands\-on technical role for someone who can independently own substantial engineering initiatives, translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions, and take those solutions from concept through production. This is a hybrid role, three days per week onsite in the San Jose office. **Key Responsibilities** - Design and build AI/ML\-powered solutions for migrating data from a variety of source systems into Sage products. - Apply machine learning, data science, and modern AI techniques to problems including data transformation, mapping, classification, reconciliation, and validation. - Own substantial technical projects end\-to\-end, from problem definition and architecture through implementation and production deployment. - Independently drive solutions to complex and ambiguous technical problems. - Build scalable, reliable production systems rather than prototypes alone. - Contribute to the infrastructure and operational practices required to deploy, monitor, and maintain AI systems in production. - Work closely with engineering, product, and domain experts to translate customer and implementation challenges into technical solutions. - Help establish engineering patterns and best practices for applying AI across Sage's migration capabilities. - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers. Qualifications - 10\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI, or closely related engineering disciplines. - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field from a top\-tier university. - Graduate study or an advanced degree in AI, machine learning, data science, or a related technical field is desirable. - Significant hands\-on experience building and deploying applied data science and/or machine learning solutions. - Strong software engineering skills and experience developing production\-grade systems. - Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, or related AI Ops / MLOps practices is desirable. - Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver large, technically complex projects. - Strong understanding of data pipelines, data transformation, and working with large or complex datasets. - Experience applying modern AI technologies, including LLMs, to real\-world business problems. - Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment with significant technical ambiguity. Collaborate with cybersecurity and technical teams to implement container and cluster security, workload isolation, access controls, and network segmentation. * Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and adversarial testing of AI applications, model endpoints, and integrations.
