jobs.title: Citrix Engineer
jobs.description: **Citrix Engineer** ------------------- Citrix \& Client Experience \| Full Time \| Remote **ABOUT SAPPHIRE HEALTH** At Sapphire Health, we are at the forefront of operating the technology infrastructure that keeps healthcare running. Our Citrix \& Client Experience team delivers the virtual desktops, published applications, and endpoint experience that clinicians and staff rely on every shift to access Epic and other critical systems. We combine enterprise\-grade application and desktop delivery technologies with proven expertise to keep the clinical workspace fast, available, and secure. If you are passionate about end user computing and client experience and motivated to make a meaningful impact in healthcare, we invite you to join our dynamic team. **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Citrix Engineer is a mid\-level technical role on the Sapphire Health Citrix \& Client Experience team, responsible for designing, building, operating, and optimizing the virtual application and desktop platforms that clinicians and staff use to deliver patient care. This role operates across the full Citrix delivery stack: Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops on premises and in Citrix Cloud (DaaS), image management through Machine Creation Services and Provisioning Services, user profile management, and the endpoints and authentication in front of them, supporting 6,000 virtual desktops across our healthcare clients. The Citrix Engineer is expected to operate with increasing independence, taking ownership of platform administration, image and release management, login and session performance, and tier 2 and tier 3 incident response. Our primary platforms include Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and Citrix Cloud, XenServer and VMware vSphere, FSLogix and Citrix Profile Management, Imprivata single sign\-on, IGEL thin clients, Amazon WorkSpaces Core, and Microsoft Azure; equivalent product experience is valued, and platform\-specific training is provided. Working closely with the Technical Architect and supporting the development of Technical Specialists, this position is central to delivering a reliable, responsive clinical workspace across our managed healthcare environments. **CORE QUALIFICATIONS** * 4\+ years of progressive end user computing or infrastructure engineering experience, including at least 3 years hands\-on with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, ideally supporting clinical applications in a healthcare environment * Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD), both on premises and in Citrix Cloud (DaaS) * Deep knowledge of Citrix components, including StoreFront, Delivery Controllers, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and Citrix Director * Hands\-on experience with image management using Machine Creation Services (MCS) and Provisioning Services (PVS) * Proficiency with user profile management, including FSLogix and Citrix Profile Management (UPM) * Experience integrating Imprivata single sign\-on with Citrix * Experience with server virtualization supporting VDI workloads, including XenServer or VMware vSphere * Working knowledge of Windows infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and endpoint security agents * PowerShell scripting for automation and administration * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team * Experience supporting Epic client delivery through Citrix a plus * NetScaler (ADC and Gateway) experience a plus * IGEL or other thin client management experience a plus * Azure Virtual Desktop or Amazon WorkSpaces Core experience a plus * Understanding of switching, firewall, and wireless fundamentals as they affect virtual desktop performance a plus * Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare compliance standards a plus **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Citrix Platform \& Delivery** * Design, build, configure, and maintain Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops environments, both on premises and in Citrix Cloud (DaaS) * Administer StoreFront, Delivery Controllers, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and Citrix policies * Publish and maintain clinical and business applications, including Epic client delivery * Support XenServer and VMware vSphere hosts that underpin virtual desktop delivery, in partnership with the infrastructure team **Image, Profile \& Endpoint Management** * Build, patch, and release gold images using Machine Creation Services and Provisioning Services, validating changes before production rollout * Manage user profiles with FSLogix and Citrix Profile Management to keep login times and session behavior consistent * Integrate and support Imprivata single sign\-on for badge tap clinical workflows * Support IGEL and other thin client endpoints, including configuration and firmware management **Performance, Monitoring \& Capacity** * Monitor login, session, and application performance through Citrix Director and related tooling, and drive improvements in login time and session responsiveness * Monitor Epic application performance as delivered through Citrix, partnering with Epic teams to resolve client issues * Right\-size virtual desktops and contribute to capacity planning for compute, memory, and storage across virtual desktop pools * Support the planned expansion of Amazon WorkSpaces Core for cloud\-based desktop delivery **Service Operations \& Security** * Provide tier 2 and tier 3 technical support for Citrix and virtual desktop incidents, performing triage and remediation and contributing to root cause analysis * Apply regular Citrix platform and VDA updates and remediate vulnerabilities to protect sensitive healthcare data * Prepare and execute changes within the change management process, ensuring production\-impacting work is vetted and run within approved windows * Create and maintain runbooks and platform documentation for the systems under management **Collaboration \& Development** * Provide consultative support, education, and documentation to clients and end users to ensure a positive experience * Provide guidance and peer support to Technical Specialists, helping to elevate the technical capabilities of the broader team * Collaborate with the Technical Architect on design decisions and contribute technical input to architecture discussions * Research and evaluate end user computing technology trends to identify ways to improve our desktop and application offerings * Pursue continuous professional development through platform\-specific training and industry certifications **TRAINING \& CERTIFICATION EXPECTATIONS** The Citrix Engineer is expected to maintain and pursue certifications that align with the platforms and responsibilities of the role. Equivalent certifications from prior platform experience are recognized, and platform\-specific training for our environment is provided. The following represents the target certification profile: * Preferred: Citrix Certified Associate (CCA\-V) or Citrix Certified Professional (CCP\-V); CCA\-V expected within first year if not held at hire * Preferred: Epic Client Systems Administrator (ECSA) * Plus: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate * Plus: Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty (AZ\-140\) for candidates with cloud desktop experience * Growth: Citrix Certified Expert (CCE\-V) **GROWTH OPPORTUNITY** The Citrix Engineer role offers a clear path toward senior technical leadership within the Sapphire Health practice. Team members gain deep exposure to enterprise end user computing architecture, complex clinical workflows, and large\-scale project work while building the platform expertise and design thinking needed to advance into a Technical Architect role. This position provides increasing autonomy and ownership as proficiency grows, with direct mentorship from senior technical leadership. **WHY SAPPHIRE HEALTH?** * Make a meaningful impact on the clinical workspace care teams rely on to deliver patient care * Comprehensive benefits, including competitive compensation and health insurance * Professional development with a clear technical career progression from Specialist to Engineer to Architect * Collaborative, inclusive culture that values innovation and growing autonomy * Opportunity to work with enterprise\-grade application and desktop delivery technologies across diverse healthcare environments *This role is ideal for Citrix professionals ready to take ownership of complex end user computing challenges while growing toward senior leadership in keeping the clinical workspace fast, available, and secure.*

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineering (Agent OS Platform)
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan is building the Agent OS for the trades: a shared platform that powers role\-specific AI experiences across Atlas, field, office, voice, mobile, and future product surfaces. This is not a collection of chatbots. Agent OS is the runtime, context, memory, action, trust, and evaluation layer that lets AI agents help contractors run their businesses safely, observably, and at enterprise scale. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a small, hands\-on AI platform team building the core Agent OS. This is a builder\-manager role. The right person can lead engineers, shape architecture, make high\-quality technical decisions, and stay close enough to the work to unblock design, implementation, debugging, evaluation, and production delivery. This is not a pure people\-management, AI strategy, or research leadership role. We need someone who can earn credibility with senior engineers by improving the technical work, not just coordinating it. We do not expect one person to have built every part of an agent platform before. We do expect strong engineering judgment, production scars, hands\-on curiosity, and the ability to learn fast while making high\-quality technical decisions. **What You’ll Build** You will lead a compact AI platform engineering team responsible for foundational Agent OS capabilities, including: * Agent runtime and workflow execution: role\-specific agents, planning, tool use, delegation, pause/resume, long\-running workflows, durable checkpoints, and failure recovery. * Context and memory systems: retrieval, tenant\-aware memory, transcripts, artifacts, tool results, provenance, freshness, and replayable evidence. * Capability platform: reusable domain capabilities that combine prompts, tools, context requirements, policies, evals, rollout controls, ownership, and rollback expectations. * Action and trust layer: typed action contracts, scoped permissions, business precondition checks, approval flows, reversibility, idempotency, audit trails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Evaluation and observability harness: offline and online evals, scenario libraries, simulation, trajectory review, regression detection, quality metrics, cost/latency telemetry, and autonomy promotion gates. * ServiceTitan integration: secure access to systems of record, governed data sources, domain context, Atlas integration, and role\-specific agent experiences for owners, CSRs, dispatchers, technicians, managers, accountants, and back\-office teams. **What You’ll Do** * Lead the team through architecture, implementation, production launch, and fast iteration. * Stay hands\-on: review designs and code, inspect traces, debug production behavior, evaluate prototypes, and help engineers make pragmatic tradeoffs. * Translate Agent OS strategy into concrete platform slices that ship quickly without creating one\-off agent implementations. * Define platform contracts for role shells, capabilities, tools, actions, approvals, context, memory, evidence, and evaluation. * Build the distinction between what an agent can do and what it is authorized to do in a given tenant, role, workflow state, and risk context. * Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, Atlas, and domain engineering teams to create useful, safe, and measurable agent capabilities. * Drive evaluation as part of everyday engineering: scenario design, regression suites, trace review, simulation, production monitoring, quality gates, and rollout criteria. * Help the team make model and inference tradeoffs across latency, cost, quality, structured outputs, caching, fallback behavior, and provider choices. * Ensure live ServiceTitan systems of record remain authoritative while memory, retrieval, transcripts, and agent\-generated artifacts are governed as contextual evidence. * Work through real agent failures with the team: wrong tool calls, stale context, missing permissions, unsafe actions, poor retrieval, bad recommendations, latency spikes, and cost regressions. * Hire, coach, and retain strong engineers who can build fast, reason deeply, and operate responsibly in a fast\-moving AI environment. **What You’ll Bring** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years leading engineering teams or major technical initiatives in a product or platform organization. * Strong technical background as a builder. You may not write production code every day, but you can read code, review implementation plans, reason through distributed systems, and debug real behavior. * Recent hands\-on technical leadership: you have personally reviewed design docs, read implementation details, inspected production traces/logs, or debugged system behavior in the last 6–12 months. * Experience shipping AI, ML, data, platform, infrastructure, workflow, automation, or developer\-platform systems in production. * Practical understanding of modern LLM application architecture: model gateways, prompt ion, and evaluation foundations. Domain teams can publish governed capabilities without rebuilding infrastructure. Customers can see why an agent made a recommendation, what evidence it used, what it is allowed to do, and when a human approved it. The best candidate will not only manage the team building this system. They will help build the system. **Remote Location:** US and Canada remote candidates will be considered. Candidates based in Pacific Time or able to work significant Pacific Time overlap are highly preferred. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $239,300 USD \- $358,900 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $223,600 USD \- $335,400 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Cloud Services & API Platform (C#/Azure Track) - Hybrid
jobs.description: Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees. Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures. Learn about our company culture directly from our team. **YOU** As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in modernizing and evolving our software platform. You will design and develop cloud\-based APIs and services that support next\-generation engineering and design applications for the building industry. We are actively investing in the transformation of our software platform from traditional desktop applications toward modern cloud\-based services and APIs hosted in Microsoft Azure. This role offers the opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor team members, and grow into a Technical Lead position as our platform modernization efforts expand. **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** (% of Time) Design, develop, and support scalable cloud\-native services and APIs using C\# and ASP.NET Core. (30%) Collaborate with architects and engineers to modernize existing desktop application functionality into service\-oriented and cloud\-hosted solutions. (20%) Design and implement secure, observable, and resilient distributed systems leveraging Azure cloud technologies. (15%) Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and architecture reviews while promoting engineering best practices. (10%) Develop automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes to improve software quality and delivery velocity. (10%) Participate in Agile planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. (10%) Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and development practices. (5%) **DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience * 7\+ years of professional software development experience * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET (ASP.NET Core) * Experience building RESTful APIs and distributed services * Experience designing scalable client\-server or cloud\-native applications * Experience with relational databases and data modeling (T\-SQL / Azure SQL) * Experience implementing automated testing strategies (unit, integration) * Experience with Git\-based source control workflows * Experience working in Agile / Scrum software development environments * Strong system design, debugging, and communication skills * Demonstrated ability to mentor or guide other engineers * Microsoft Azure services: App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Storage, Application Insights, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Managed Identity * Microservice and service\-oriented architecture design patterns * Event\-driven systems and messaging patterns (Azure Service Bus / Event Grid) * CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions * Containerization technologies: Docker and Kubernetes (AKS) * Observability and monitoring practices (Application Insights / OpenTelemetry / structured logging) * OpenAPI / Swagger API documentation * Authentication and authorization using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID * Experience modernizing legacy desktop or monolithic applications * WPF or desktop application development (C\+\+/C\#) * Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM) * Building industry software experience is a plus **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, and hear, and sometimes walk and stand. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally push or lift up to 25 lbs. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This job operates in a professional office environment where standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers/scanners, etc. are frequently used. **TRAVEL** This position requires domestic travel up to 5%\-10% of the time. **WORK STATUS \& LOCATION** This full\-time, exempt position is located in Plano, TX and operates under a hybrid work model, requiring employees to work in the office three days per week. **RELOCATION** Relocation is not available for this position. **PAY** $107,500 \- $182,800 / year \#LI\-Hybrid **REWARDS AT SIMPSON STRONG\-TIE** We recognize and reward employees with a carefully designed and comprehensive rewards package, including competitive compensation, quarterly bonuses or commission and first\-rate benefits. May exclude some positions, such as seasonal jobs. * **Quarterly Bonuses/Commission:** You will be eligible for either a bonus or commission, paid on a quarterly basis. We believe *all* employees affect customers, sales and revenue — directly or indirectly – and should be rewarded by sharing the company profits. * **Benefits:** We provide a wide range of benefits for eligible full\-time employees including: medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, employee stock purchase and bonus plans, pay for holidays, vacation, sick days, funerals and jury duty, years of service awards, employee discounts, employee referral bonuses, charitable contribution matching, education reimbursement and more. View benefit plan details here: https://benefits.strongtie.com/. In keeping with our values and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in our communities, we are an equal opportunity employer. This means that our employment decisions are based on your qualifications and merit, and our business needs. Please note all job offers are contingent upon a successful drug screen and criminal background check, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. \#NowHiring \#GetHired \#Hiring \#HiringNow Company: Simpson Strong\-Tie Company Inc.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description: Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like! Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. We utilize our employees’ personal strengths to help grow our company and ensure our team is living their best, authentic life. We share our appreciation for our team members regularly during all\-hands, a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutouts in our Teams channels, social media, amongst more. Our remote\-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist. Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well\-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle! The **Manager, Data Engineering,** is responsible for turning data architecture vision into reliable, repeatable, and scalable data pipelines and data products as part of Skillable’s enterprise data platform. Manage a team of at least five employees and be hands\-on in technical ownership of the data engineering function. Lead day\-to\-day engineering execution while setting strong data engineering practices across ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and operational support. **What You Will Do:** * Manage a team by hiring and onboarding talent, setting clear expectations, conducting formal performance reviews, and coaching accountability. * Lead the team to deliver on the enterprise data platform roadmap by translating architecture direction into sequenced execution plans, team backlogs, and measurable outcomes. * Create a strong engineering culture across the team by setting standards for maintainability, organization, and repeatability; growing engineers via regular 1:1s, timely feedback, development plans, and formal review cycles; and being responsible for overall team performance and cohesion. * Own day\-to\-day execution for the Data Engineering team by breaking work into tasks, driving sprint\-level planning, delegating effectively to grow ownership, unblocking delivery, and ensuring high\-quality outcomes through engineering reviews and feedback. * Drive implementation of the Medallion architecture (Bronze Silver Gold) with strong enforcement of layer responsibilities, ensuring repeatable and auditable pipeline behavior leveraging Boomi, Dbt, Azure Data Bricks, Boomi/Rivery, Delta tables, and Sql Server. * Partner closely with the Data Architect to bring the architecture to life through concrete implementation patterns, reference pipelines, and guardrails—ensuring the team can consistently execute the intended approach. * Reduce friction by driving crisp decisions and forward motion—using lightweight decision records, seeking the right input, and then executing accountability (while avoiding overly heavy process). * Establish DataOps practices aligned with modern software development lifecycle (SDLC): CI/CD for data assets, consistent branching/release patterns, code review standards, and runbooks/operational readiness for pipelines. * Improve pipeline observability and operational reliability by implementing monitoring for freshness/staleness, failure modes, and quality signals, and ensuring the team responds predictably to incidents and support requests. * Drive stakeholder partnership and intake stream: collaborate with business partners to clarify requirements, reduce ad\-hoc thrash, and shape requests into deliverable, well\-scoped work that fits the platform strategy. * Develop future leaders and succession plans for key roles through assigning regularly occurring responsibilities, mentoring, and strategic delegation. * Support and promote the company values through positive interactions with both internal and external stakeholders on a regular basis. * Other strategic business initiatives or special cross\-functional project involvement as required. **What You Bring to the Role:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or relevant professional experience. * 10\+ years of relevant professional experience in software / data engineering, including building production data pipelines and data platforms. * 2\+ years of experience in lead capacity (formal or informal) including team leadership, task breakdown, reviews, delivery ownership, and cross\-functional coordination. * Experience directly managing a team, including hiring/interviewing and conducting formal performance reviews. * Deep hands\-on experience with Databricks (Spark), Boomi/Rivery, and Delta Lake patterns for scalable lakehouse processing. * Strong experience with ETL/ELT design and implementation, including orchestration/ingestion into transformation workflows  ire to learn, solve problems, and dig into detailed analysis. * Experience working in a fully remote team is preferred but not required. * Thorough understanding (or willingness to learn expeditiously) of business operations and processes. **Salary Range** The base salary for this position is $140,000 \- $185,000 annually. Consistent with applicable laws, compensation will be determined based on the candidate's level, relevant skills, qualifications, and experience along with requirements for the position and annual financial plans. Skillable is a distributed first team with employees working across the U.S., and we do not consider geography when determining compensation ranges. Pay range and current benefit offerings are effective for 90 days from posting date. Standard employment offerings are subject to potential change upon periodic review and analysis, at the discretion of Skillable. **What We Offer** We believe in providing a suite of benefits that ensure our employees know we appreciate them as people first. Skillable wants to be a company that promotes physical, emotional and all around well\-being through our benefit offerings! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including: * Fully remote with a monthly stipend to pay for office services and supplies * Medical (2 plan options), dental (2 plan options), vision, health savings account with generous employer contributions, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group paid life insurance, group paid STD and LTD and voluntary life/AD\&D insurance, accident and critical illness options. * 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, healthy lifestyle reimbursements. * Unlimited PTO, Paid holidays, bereavement leave, parental leave, caregiver leave and paid FMLA leave. * Privilege of logging off at 2:00 pm local time, every Friday for team members who are caught up on work and meeting deliverables. Full company closure during the 4th of July holiday week. * Reimbursement for up to $750 annually to use towards lifestyle choices that impact their wellness such as gym memberships, fitness classes or healthy meal plans, * Stipend of $200 a month for office expenses. * Access to pet insurance; access for employees and dependents to Skillable learning opportunities through our product and more! **Working Conditions:** The job conditions for this position are in a remote home office setting, requiring a space that supports privacy and focus to attend to regular and frequent video and voice calls. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on\-going basis throughout the day. Periodic travel may be required equaling up to approximately 10% of the time. Skillable participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work int he U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. **Fraud Prevention:** To protect candidates from recruiting scams, please note that our Talent Acquisition Manager will only contact applicants using the personal contact information provided when applying through our official careers page. If you did not apply but are being pursued about a position, our initial outreach will only occur through LinkedIn \- not via Indeed. If you receive an unexpected message directing you to apply through another website or from anyone other than our Talent Acquisition Manager, please treat it with caution. ***Skillable can only hire potential candidates with a primary residence in the following States: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IN, KY, MA, ME, MI, MO, NC, ND, NE, NH, NV, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI.***

jobs.title: Staff Photolithography Process Engineer
jobs.description: Bold Thinking. World Changing. At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. Automotive safety enhancements, life\-saving medical devices, consumer electronics and American security require semiconductors. Working in our Minnesota headquarters, Florida, or Texas location — employees join together to improve the world. Explore what’s possible. Joining our U.S. \- based team means contributing to and learning about the commercialization of some of the most exciting technologies the world has ever seen. We are turning “science fiction” into everyday reality through technologies such as superconducting, 3D integrated circuits or computer chips, carbon nanotubes, photonic logic devices, micro electro\-mechanical systems and other emerging device topologies. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Our customers include emerging leaders who rely on our intellectual property security and quality manufacturing services. Step into the future. SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds. Are you bold thinking? Find your place on our team and help us change the world! **Position Summary:** SkyWater Technology is seeking a Staff Photolithography Process Engineer with 4 plus years of experience in development and sustaining high volume manufacturing environments, leading process characterization and development initiatives, and driving collaboration across cross functional fab teams. **Major Areas of Accountability:** * Develop, optimize, characterize, and sustain photolithography processes for high volume manufacturing environment. * Own and sustain production lithography processes, driving continuous improvements in yield, defectivity, critical dimension (CD), overlay, throughput, and cost. * Develop process control strategies and recommend appropriate metrology and monitoring plans to maintain process stability and capability. * Monitor inline and end\-of\-line statistical process control (SPC) charts to identify trends, excursions, and abnormal process behavior, and implement corrective and preventive actions. * Analyze process data to identify sources of variation, process marginalities, and opportunities for continuous improvement. * Investigate lithography\-related defects, patterning failures, CD variation, overlay errors, and yield losses using structured problem\-solving, statistical analysis, and design of experiments (DOE). * Collaborate with equipment, integration, and cross\-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot process and equipment issues and improve manufacturing capability. * Develop new lithography processes and execute qualification plans for new chemicals, materials, and process changes. * Lead engineering projects to close process performance gaps, achieve milestones, and deliver measurable improvements in yield, productivity, and cost. * Apply data mining, programming, scripting, and statistical analysis techniques to improve process understanding and engineering efficiency. * Communicate technical findings and present data\-driven recommendations effectively while building strong working relationships across engineering, manufacturing, and support organizations. * Manage multiple projects independently, demonstrate strong technical ownership, and consistently deliver commitments in a high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical field. * 4 plus years of experience in photolithography process engineering experience in a high volume mass production environment. * Applied knowledge of photolithography processes, process optimization, overlay and alignment improvement, and critical dimension (CD) variation reduction. * Tools: Experience optimizing process on TEL tracks and ASML Steppers \& Scanners (I Line, KrF, \& dry ArF). * Chemicals: Experience setting up and optimizing Resist process with \& without TARCs or BARCs on existing fab tool. * Metrology: Experience with Overlay on ARCHER tools and CD job writing on NANOSEM \& HITACHI SEMs **Preferred Qualifications:** * Strong understanding of semiconductor photolithography processes, equipment, and manufacturing operations. * Hands\-on experience developing and characterizing lithography processes, including process windows and overlay margins. * Demonstrated proficiency in statistical process control (SPC), design of experiments (DOE), data mining, and process data analysis. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a meticulous, data\-driven approach to process improvement. * Experience identifying process variation, reducing defectivity, improving yield, and addressing process marginalities in a production environment. * Strong communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. The annual salary range for this role is $94,320 \- $141,480\. Pay offered is based on many factors, including, but not limited to, the job\-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate. SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including 401k match, and life insurance. Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short\- and long\-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on\-site fitness facility, and an on\-site self\-serve market. SkyWater complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities unless doing so would cause an undue hardship. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. To request reasonable accommodations, to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 952\-851\-5200 or Recruiting@SkyWatertechnology.com. EOE, including disability/vets We will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment or gift cards, or provide financial information before a formal offer of employment has been accepted. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to represent our company, please verify its authenticity by contacting our recruitment team at recruiting@skywatertechnology.com before responding.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Research
jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services. Snap Research serves as an innovation engine for the company. Our projects range from solutions to hard technical problems that significantly enhance Snap’s existing products, to riskier explorations that can lead to fundamental paradigm shifts in the way people communicate and express themselves. The team consists of scientists and engineers who experiment with and invent new technology that has a lasting impact on Snap’s products. We also frequently publish our work at top conferences and journals in computer science and related fields. We are looking for a Research Scientist to join our User Modeling and Personalization Research Team! Our team’s mission is to invent new ways to model user behavior, and empower our business partners to build world\-class user\-centric ML systems which shape personalized experiences across Snap. Our work spans the domains of generative and language models for information retrieval, efficient large\-scale recommender systems, and representation learning for structured graph data. Together with you, we seek to redefine the state\-of\-the\-art in technology to deliver our users customized experiences which delight them. What you'll do: * Lead research projects in the user modeling and personalization domains, including generative modeling, recommendation systems, information retrieval, and efficiency * Build scalable research prototypes and evaluate them in large\-scale machine learning scenarios * Share your expertise with teammates and interns * Publish your findings at top conferences * Partner with engineering teams to deliver your technology to millions of Snapchatters Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities: * Strong technical knowledge of machine learning, information retrieval, personalization, and state\-of\-the\-art deep learning literature * Demonstrated ability in defining, leading and executing challenging research projects * Strong computer science fundamentals, problem\-solving and engineering skills (Python, PyTorch) * Pragmatic, hands\-on approach to research with a drive to build working prototypes rather than solely rely on theoretical exploration * Proven ability to mentor interns, students and junior researchers Minimum Qualifications: * PhD in a related technical field such as computer science, machine learning, or mathematics or equivalent years of practical work experience * Strong familiarity with PyTorch, and hands\-on experience with distributed (multi\-node and multi\-GPU) machine learning model training, inference and experimentation * Experience applying language models in the context of generative search, ranking and/or personalization * Track record of publications (first\-author preferred) in top machine learning, information retrieval or language venues (e.g. ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, RecSys, SIGIR, WSDM, ACL, COLM, etc.) Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with large\-scale machine learning problems in an academic or industrial research lab, or equivalent open\-source experience * Experience with large\-scale data processing, collection or synthesis using machine learning frameworks on Enterprise Cloud solutions like Google Cloud, AWS, and/or Azure * Familiarity with post\-training, preference optimization, working with large\-scale search or recommendation interaction data, and recommender systems * Demonstrated ability to transform cutting\-edge research into tangible product improvements "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week. At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable). Our Benefits : Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success! jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Customer & Vendor Management
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer **Company:** Snapsheet **Job Location:** USA,Remote **Job Type:** Full\-time, direct hire **About Snapsheet**: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them into our core systems and processes across cloud\-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170\+ P\&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around. **Role Overview:** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Snapsheet’s Customer Vendor Management (CVM) team who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and ready to create impactful solutions. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the evolution of our industry\-leading claims engine. CVM owns how claims connect with customers, vendors, and external partners across the full claim lifecycle. You'll contribute to and learn about workflow automation, including source control management, automated test frameworks, continuous integration and test execution, quality metrics and reporting, artifact and release systems, and delivery through cloud services. If any of this sounds like fun, read on and let's connect soon. **What You'll Do** CI/CD Engineers work directly with software engineers to create solutions that let them do their best work. jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Agent Platform
jobs.description: **REQ ID** JR114899 **Date posted** 10/14/2026 **We're looking for an exceptional technology leader and hands\-on builder who wants to help redefine how a global entertainment company operates through AI.** This is an opportunity to **build, lead, and scale** Sony Pictures Entertainment's enterprise AI agent ecosystem, creating the platforms, capabilities, and engineering practices that will transform how work gets done across the business. As **Executive Director, Enterprise Agent Platform** reporting to the SVP, Enterprise Intelligence Platform, you'll own one of the company's most exciting emerging technology capabilities. You'll define our enterprise agent platform strategy, make critical technology decisions, and build and lead a high\-performing team who turn ambitious ideas into production\-ready solutions. **This is a leadership role for someone who wants to build, not just oversee.** You'll remain deeply hands\-on with the technology, actively shaping architecture, solving complex engineering challenges, and working alongside your team to deliver results. You'll be expected to stay at the forefront of a rapidly evolving AI landscape, continuously evaluating emerging technologies, challenging conventional approaches, and translating new possibilities into practical business solutions. You'll work alongside leaders who value technical depth, intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a bias for action. Success requires someone who can move seamlessly between strategy and execution, stay closely connected to the work happening across their own and partner teams, and bring the technical credibility to influence decisions at every level. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN, BUILD \& SHAPE** **Define and Evolve Our Enterprise AI Agent Strategy** * Own the strategy, selection, architecture, and evolution of SPE's enterprise agent platforms. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, make critical platform decisions, and establish the engineering standards that enable AI agents to scale securely and effectively across the organization. * You'll stay ahead of developments in agentic AI, continuously assessing new platforms, capabilities, and approaches while ensuring our technology decisions position SPE for both immediate impact and long\-term success. **Build, Lead \& Engineer Alongside a Team** * This is not a traditional leadership role where you set direction and delegate the technical work. You'll remain actively engaged in architecture, engineering, prototyping, technical problem\-solving, and critical design decisions. * You'll set a high engineering bar, develop exceptional technical talent, and create a culture of curiosity, experimentation, ownership, and continuous improvement. **Turn Big Ideas Into Production Solutions, Fast** * You’ll take high\-priority business opportunities from concept to production in weeks, not quarters. * You'll champion a builder\-oriented approach that prioritizes speed, simplicity, and measurable results. By leveraging native platform capabilities, connectors, and reusable components rather than unnecessarily developing custom applications, you'll help the team deliver solutions faster and more efficiently. * You'll know when to experiment, when to make decisions, and when to scale and balance urgency with the engineering discipline needed to build reliable, enterprise\-ready solutions. **Build the Foundation for Enterprise\-Wide Scale** * You'll establish reusable architectures, engineering patterns, and a shared pattern library that make every new solution faster to deliver, easier to maintain, and more effective than the last. * You'll also own the agent registry, control plane, and AgentOps capabilities, including monitoring, incident management, lifecycle management, and cost optimization. This will be to ensure a growing portfolio of enterprise AI agents remains secure, observable, reliable, and accountable. **Stay Ahead of Technology and Connected to the Business** * This role will require you to operate at the forefront of a rapidly changing AI landscape, bringing fresh thinking, technical insights, and emerging capabilities into SPE. * You'll maintain a deep understanding of what's happening across your own engineering teams, adjacent technology organizations, and the broader AI ecosystem. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on campus reliability, you will design what the campus watches and trusts, technically command cross\-discipline SEVs, and build the guardrails that make the next incident smaller. You are the connective tissue across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling on one of the largest AI training campuses in the world. This role demands calm incident leadership, fleet\-scale observability judgment, and the ability to drive reliability work across software and facility boundaries. We are looking for candidates from power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or people who currently work or have worked in facilities like SpaceXSI with power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems. RESPONSIBILITIES: * Own monitoring architecture and signal quality across GPU and host telemetry (DCGM, Prometheus/Grafana) and facility telemetry (BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, CDU / direct liquid cooling): what we alert on, suppress, and trust. Consume NOC noise\-disposition feedback to drive suppression and redesign. Treat alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Provide SEV command support: technical incident leadership, bridge coordination with the NOC, paging and escalation (e.g., PagerDuty), and timeline and severity hygiene. * Run blameless postmortems and drive corrective actions to closed, not filed. * Gate high\-risk change: fleet\-scale firmware/BIOS/BMC rollouts (Redfish, canaries, rollback) and SOP/MOP/EOP\-governed work on power and cooling systems through a disciplined change management process. * Lead cross\-functional reliability projects spanning compute, network (InfiniBand/RoCE), storage, and facility signal boundaries, including grey failures that cross those boundaries (e.g., NVLink flapping, thermal throttling, power sequencing). * Partner with Hardware Failure Analysis on systemic failure classes: turn fleet data (MTBF/AFR, repeat\-RMA trends) into monitoring, stop\-rules, and vendor RCA inputs. * Build and maintain playbooks, run game days, and keep cross\-discipline dependency maps current. Own runbook quality jointly with the NOC (SRE designs; NOC operates and corrects). * Define error budgets and availability objectives at campus and service boundaries as adopted by the business. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response for SEV\-class events in the Memphis / Southaven data center campus. PROFILE SIGNALS: * Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or facilities like SpaceXSI — current or prior — spanning power, compute, cooling, or related plant systems. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge. Nuclear control\-room, shift supervisor / Senior Reactor Operator (SRO), Shift Technical Advisor, or Navy nuclear experience counts as incident command. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. Treats alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Cross\-team facilitation and systems engineering depth across software and facility boundaries. SUCCESS MEASURED BY: * MTTD / MTTR trend for SEV\-class events * % of SEVs with a blameless postmortem and closed action items * Alert actionable ratio * Recurrence rate of incident classes * Monitoring coverage of critical dependencies across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling * GPU fleet availability lost to infrastructure events BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, plant operations, or large\-scale production operations, preferably in power plants, nuclear power plants, high\-performance computing, or data center environments. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge, whether from an SRE/NOC bridge or a plant control room. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. * Hands\-on experience with at least one of: Prometheus/Grafana, NVIDIA DCGM, or industrial telemetry and controls (SCADA, BMS/BAS, EPMS, DCIM, PLCs, Modbus/BACnet). * Experience working across at least two of: compute, network, storage, power, and cooling / facilities telemetry. * Experience writing and operating playbooks, runbooks, or SOP/MOP/EOPs with a 24/7 operations, control room, or NOC partner. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Java, Go, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to reliability engineering. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including NOC, data center operations, hardware failure analysis, and infrastructure engineering. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Spectral Labs is building foundation models for engineering physical systems. We're looking for an AI engineer to build the systems that put those models to work: agents that read, edit, and generate CAD, the tool interfaces that connect LLMs to our geometry models, and the task\-level evals that decide what's ready to ship. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform (Mid-Senior Level)
jobs.description: ### **About Sprinter Health** **At Sprinter Health, our mission is reimagining how people access care by bringing it directly to their homes.** Nearly 30% of patients in the U.S. skip preventive or chronic care simply because they can’t get to a doctor’s office. For many, the ER becomes their first touchpoint with the healthcare system, driving over **$300B in avoidable costs every year.** By using the same technologies that power leading marketplace and last\-mile platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most. So far, we’ve supported more than **2 million patients across 22 states, completed 130,000\+ in\-home visits, and maintained a 92 NPS**. Our team of clinicians, technologists, and operators have raised over $125M to date from investors like **a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel** and enjoy multi\-year runway. ### **About the Role** We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (5\+ years experience) who is passionate about platform engineering and wants to build the foundational systems that enable our engineering organization to scale. At Sprinter, you'll build the infrastructure, internal tooling, and shared services that help engineers develop, deploy, and operate software more efficiently. From improving CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure to building developer tools, automation, and observability systems, you'll own the platforms that make our engineering teams faster, more reliable, and more effective. This is a hands\-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code but is most motivated by improving how other engineers build software. You'll work across application code, infrastructure, and operational systems, solving complex technical challenges that have an outsized impact across the organization. ### **Hybrid \& Office Experience** We operate on a hybrid schedule, working from the office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays designated as work\-from\-anywhere days. We care deeply about work\-life balance and are happy to provide flexibility when life happens. We ask that employees be in the office Monday through Thursday to collaborate with their teams while maintaining flexibility where it matters most. Lunch is provided every day, and the entire team takes an hour to eat together. It's one of the ways we stay connected outside of meetings. You'll usually find us playing a board game before getting back to work. ### **What you will do:** * Design and build internal tools, shared services, and automation that improve developer productivity across engineering teams * Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and infrastructure that enable engineers to ship software quickly and reliably * Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure, developer environments, and foundational services that support our growing platform * Improve observability, monitoring, and operational tooling to make our systems easier to debug, maintain, and operate * Develop reusable frameworks, infrastructure components, and self\-service tooling that reduce manual work and accelerate development * Partner closely with engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, improve development workflows, and drive adoption of platform capabilities * Own foundational engineering projects end to end, making pragmatic architectural decisions that balance reliability, scalability, and developer experience ### **What you have done:** * Spent 5\+ years building and scaling backend software, infrastructure, or platform systems in production * Built internal developer tools, automation, shared services, or infrastructure that support multiple engineering teams * Worked hands\-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment systems, and production environments * Designed and implemented reliable, maintainable software that improves how other engineers build, test, deploy, or operate applications * Led technical projects end to end, from architecture and implementation through rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance * Collaborated across engineering teams to understand developer pain points and translate them into scalable technical solutions * Made technical decisions that balance developer productivity, operational reliability, and long\-term maintainability ### **What gives you an edge:** * You've deliberately built your career around platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, or developer productivity * You've built internal platforms, CLIs, frameworks, or self\-service tooling adopted by multiple engineering teams * You've improved engineering velocity through faster deployments, more reliable CI/CD pipelines, or reduced operational overhead * You've worked extensively with AWS, serverless architectures, infrastructure as code, or cloud\-native systems * You've implemented observability, monitoring, or incident management tooling that improved production reliability * You've worked in mid\- or growth\-stage startups (Series A–C) where infrastructure and developer tooling needed to evolve alongside rapid product development * You've measured the success of your work through developer adoption, deployment frequency, system reliability, or improvements in engineering efficiency ### **The Interview Process** **We aim to complete the interview process between 2–3 weeks. It will usually consist of:** * Recruiter Screen (30 Minutes) * Technical Assessment (45 Minutes) * Hiring Manager Introduction (30 Minutes) * Onsite Interview: Systems Design \+ Behavioral Interview \+ Lunch with the Team (3 Hours) * References ### **What we offer** * Meaningful pre\-IPO equity * Medical, dental, and vision plans 100% paid for you and your dependents * Flexible PTO \+ 10 paid holidays per year * 401(k) with match * 16\-week parental leave policy for birthing parent, 8 weeks for all other parents * HSA \+ FSA contributions * Life insurance, plus short and long\-term disability coverage * Free daily lunch in\-office * Annual learning stipend ### **Our Technology Stack** * Serverless AWS (AppSync, DynamoDB, Lambda, Amplify, CloudFormation, Node) * React Native, React Native for Web * GraphQL * TypeScript * JavaScript * Node.js Sprinter Health is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other protected classes. *Beware of recruitment fraud and scams that involve fictitious job descriptions followed by false job offers.* *If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles on our official**Sprinter Health Careers website**. All legitimate job postings will require an application to be made directly through our official careers website. Job\-related communications will only be sent from email addresses ending in @**sprinterhealth.com**. Please ensure that you're only replying to emails that end in @**sprinterhealth.com**.* Compensation Range: $175K \- $225K

This is your chance to make a monumental impact by leading the charge in streamlining and innovating our data platform and services across the enterprise, from corporate and supply chain to our customer, partner and in\-store experience. * Become the leader of a centralized enterprise data management team, ensuring real\-time data access and unparalleled accuracy across all our channels. * Lead the foundation for enterprise data management – your work will pave the way for future innovation at Starbucks. * Champion seamless API integration across our vast digital ecosystem such as commerce, mobile and in\-store order, digital drive through, in\-store digital menu board, corporate and supply chain, fostering a truly connected enterprise experience. As a principal engineer of the Data Platform and Services engineering team, you’ll collaborate with solution architects and engineering managers, tackle toughest technical problems in the team to lead our data initiatives and drive technical excellence. You’ll lead a group of passionate engineers in building, sustaining, and enhancing critical data platforms used by Starbucks to help drive customer, store, and partner connections and to gain business efficiencies. You’ll play a key role in architecting, designing and developing advanced data platforms, fostering composable design and architecture, and ensuring our solutions are secure, performant, resilient, scalable, flexible, and extensible. The Principal Engineer of Data Platform and Services will be responsible for: * Communicates highly complex technical ideas, architectural strategies, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Establishes strong cross\-functional, collaborative relationships with business, product, architecture, security, and technology partners to drive alignment and execution. * Provides technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, proactively removing technical barriers and resolving complex development and production issues. * Champions AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic capabilities to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. * Identifies and drives opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows and platform capabilities, reducing manual effort and accelerating reliable jobs.title: AI Systems Analyst Builder
jobs.description: **AI Systems Analyst \& Builder** *Sticker Pack, Inc. \| Sparks, Nevada \| Onsite, full time \| $70,000 starting salary \| Read the whole post for application directions* **Brief Summary** We make custom stickers and magnets for national parks, gift shops, resort towns, and the tourist shops you wander into on every road trip. There is a decent chance something we printed is on a fridge near you right now. We run two production facilities in the Reno area, our people are genuinely great, and we have decided to build our own software instead of renting someone else's. We are looking for one person who is half analyst, half builder, and fully dangerous with AI. You will figure out how our business actually works, map it, find what the data is telling us, and then build the tools that fix it, with Claude as your daily driver. Some weeks you will be deep in SQL figuring out why reorders dropped. Some weeks you will be shipping a feature the sales team uses the same afternoon. Most weeks, both. Let's be honest about the filter. This is not a job for someone who is "interested in AI." It is for someone who already builds with it every day, knows exactly where it lies to you, and gets a little irritated when a process takes three clicks that should take zero. You do not need ten years of experience. You do need to be very, very good, and hungry to get better. *The good news*: you won't be figuring it out alone. You will work closely with an experienced senior engineer who reviews your work and helps you level up fast. If you read this and thought "finally," keep going. **What Success Looks Like** * First 30 days: you know our stack, our data, and our people, and you have shipped at least one real fix or report that someone on the floor noticed. * First 90 days: our core workflows (quote to order to production to invoice) are mapped with clear entrance and exit criteria, and you own at least one internal tool end to end. * Leadership answers key business questions from a dashboard instead of waiting on a spreadsheet. * Sales and production staff spend measurably less time on admin work because something you built does it for them. * Our SOPs are current, clear, and actually used, by people and by our AI assistant. * Every system you touch is documented well enough that someone else could pick it up tomorrow. **Duties \& Responsibilities** Roughly half analysis and process, half building. The mix will shift week to week. **Process Mapping \& SOPs** * Sit with Sales, Production, and the warehouse to learn how work actually happens, then map it: swimlanes, handoffs, entrance and exit criteria. * Write and maintain our SOPs as clean markdown files. These are not shelf documents. They feed our internal Slack AI assistant, so a good SOP literally makes the whole company smarter. * Keep our data definitions consistent, so "active account" means the same thing in every report and every system. * Turn "that's just how we've always done it" into a system, and explain the why to the people who use it. **Data \& Analysis** * Query, clean, and analyze sales, customer, and production data (SQL, Python, pandas) to answer real questions: churn risk, reorder behavior, rep performance, margin by product line. * Build dashboards and reports that leadership actually opens. * Spot the problem before anyone asks. Bring the owners the number that changes the conversation. **Build** * Design, build, and ship internal tools and features using AI assisted development, on Supabase (Postgres), Vercel, Shopify, GitHub, and Slack. * Improve our internal Slack AI assistant: what it knows, what it can look up, and how well it answers. * Connect systems through APIs and webhooks so data gets entered once and flows everywhere it needs to go. * Review and test what AI writes before it ships. You own the output, not the model. * Follow our review rules: changes to the database, money, customer data, or permissions get a senior review before they merge. **Who You Work With** * *Our systems lead:* your manager and day to day partner. Owns priorities and the big picture on our operations systems. * *An outside senior engineer*: your mentor and reviewer. Weekly sessions for your first 90 days, then regular check ins. Reviews your work on critical systems and teaches you how to make bigger technical calls. * *The owners:* direct access, fast decisions, no committees. * *An outside security firm:* audits our systems on a regular schedule. * *Sales, production, and warehouse teams:* your users. They will tell you when something is wrong. Listen to them. **Desired Qualifications \& Traits** * AI Fluent, Not AI Dependent: builds with Claude (or similar) every day and knows its failure modes cold. Can tell when the model is confidently wrong. * Analytical: validates assumptions with data, not vibes. Comfortable telling the owners the numbers say otherwise. * Process Brain: can walk into a messy workflow, ask the right questions, and walk out with a clear map and an SOP people actually follow. * Systems Thinker: sees how a change to the sales form shows up on the production floor three steps later. * Builder: would rather ship a working v1 on Tuesday than a perfect diagram next month. * Translator: explains technical things to non technical people in plain English, without making anyone feel dumb. * Coachable: takes a hard code review well, asks good questions, and comes back better. **Experience \& Requirements** **Must Have** * Proof you can do the work: projects, analyses, tools, or systems you built and shipped. We care about this far more than your resume. * Strong SQL, plus working Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. * Data analysis experience: cleaning messy data and turning it into a clear answer. * Daily, hands on use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build real things. * You know why orders and line items live in separate tables. * Able to work onsite in Sparks, Nevada. **Nice to Have** * Process mapping (swimlanes, BPMN) and writing SOPs or documentation. * BI tools and dashboard design. * Understands database architecture and is comfortable using that structure to serve production deployments. * Building LLM agents or retrieval (RAG) systems. * QuickBooks data, Monday.com, or manufacturing and wholesale operations. **Education** A degree is welcome, and not required. Self taught, bootcamp, career changer from ops or finance: all welcome if you can show us the work. **The Fine Print** **What You** ***Won't*** **Get** * A big engineering team. It's you, our systems lead, a senior mentor, and a lot of AI. * A product manager writing your tickets. You will talk to the people who need the thing. * Clean data. You will meet our QuickBooks exports. You will have opinions. * A remote job. We move fast, and fast happens in the same room. * Boredom. **What You** ***Will*** **Get** * Real ownership of systems a whole company runs on, early in your career. * Weekly mentorship from an experienced senior engineer. That's rare. Use it. * $70,000 starting salary, with pay reviews at 90 days and six months tied to the success milestones above, plus health, vision, and dental insurance options. * Nevada: no state income tax, and Lake Tahoe less than an hour away. * Bragging rights: the systems you build put stickers in national park gift shops. **How to Apply** We read every application that follows these instructions, and none that don't. Send the following to *hr@stickerpack.com* : * Your resume. (Short is fine.) * A link to something you built or analyzed: a repo, a git\-hub project, a live app, a dashboard, a write up. In a few sentences, tell us what you did and what the AI did. * Short answers to these three questions: * Tell us about a time an AI tool gave you confidently wrong code or analysis. How did you catch it? * Describe a messy process you turned into a system. What was broken, and what did you build? * Tell us about a time the data said something nobody expected. What did you find, and what happened next? * Don't click the apply button. Follow the directions. **Write those answers yourself.** Use AI for everything else in this job, just not this part. **We can tell.** **What to Expect** A 30 minute intro call. Then a live session with our senior engineer: you work through a real build and a real data question, using your usual AI tools, while we watch how you think. Then a visit to meet the team and see the floor. Fast process, fast answer. Pay: $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Parental leave Work Location: In person

The primary job activity provides automated test set software, instrumentation, and test methods to support certification testing of SubCom’s novel undersea electro\-optic network elements. The role reports to the Director of Certification Test Engineering**Responsibilities*** Develop software architectures, automated test systems, procedures, and executable code to support certification testing of advanced electro\-optic products and new product introduction initiatives. * Design and implement data acquisition, instrumentation control, and test automation solutions to improve test efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability. * Partner with R\&D engineers throughout the product development lifecycle to define, develop, and validate product test strategies and certification methods. * Lead the transfer of new products, test software, and qualification processes from development into manufacturing, ensuring production readiness and scalability. * Collaborate with Production Engineers and Equipment Designers to integrate, deploy, and optimize manufacturing test platforms and processes. * Provide ongoing support for production testing operations, including software maintenance, troubleshooting, and resolution of product and test equipment issues. * Drive continuous improvement of test software development processes, including requirements management, software architecture reviews, coding standards, and formal design/code review practices. * Analyze complex technical problems, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to maintain product quality, reliability, and manufacturing throughput. * Serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert for automated test systems, influencing engineering best practices across multiple programs and product lines. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers and technicians, supporting skill development, knowledge sharing, and successful project execution. **Qualifications*** BS in Electrical, Computer science or Software engineering required, with 10\+ years of experience * Expert C programmer experienced with developing C code in both Windows and UNIX/Linux environments using development environments like Visual Studio, LabWindows/CVI, and test executive environments (NI\-TestStand). * Experienced in developing test and measurement solutions for electrical and optical components or subsystems including developing software which interfaces directly with test equipment and/or product hardware (as opposed to pure GUI/ web interface software) * Experienced with knowledge of GPIB, Ethernet, RS\-485, I2C command/control interfaces including developing and troubleshooting test equipment drivers * Experienced in qualifying new products or test systems for manufacture, supporting new product introduction to manufacturing, and debugging complex test systems * Familiarity with quality processes for developing, manufacturing, and testing high reliability products including characterization and calibration processes, and error of measurement studies for test equipment * Ability to understand written test methods and translate them into modular test executables, to include robust exception handling * Ability to multitask, good organizational skills, and a demonstrated ability to thrive in a team environment with other test software and hardware
