jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: At Sure Steel, Inc., we are more than just a construction company. We are builders of success, integrity, and innovation. Our leadership in steel fabrication and construction stems from our commitment to excellence, safety, and customer satisfaction. Our AI Strategy Department plays a crucial role in delivering next\-generation solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and performance across our projects. We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to lead Sure Steel's work in building, training, and deploying our own AI models. This is a new role for the company. The Machine Learning Engineer will fine\-tune and run open\-weight models on Sure Steel's own documents, data, and workflows, creating AI trained not just on steel erection, but on Sure Steel specifically. The work focuses on high\-volume, company\-specific tasks such as forecasting, scheduling, document reading and classification, data extraction, and help desk support. These models will lower AI operating costs, keep sensitive data on infrastructure we control, and reduce dependence on any single AI provider. This role works closely with the Wayne development team and provides technical leadership in machine learning, but does not include formal supervisory responsibilities. * Identify, scope, and prioritize machine learning use cases with the Senior AI Strategist, starting small and proving value before scaling. * Select, evaluate, and fine\-tune open\-weight language and vision models on Sure Steel documents, drawings, and operational data. * Build and maintain training datasets, including data collection, cleaning, labeling, and versioning, in partnership with the data owners in each department. * Develop models for forecasting, scheduling, document classification, data extraction, and drawing interpretation. * Deploy models into production on cloud or company\-controlled infrastructure, and integrate them with Wayne and other internal systems through APIs. * Design routing so high\-volume, repetitive work runs on cost\-efficient in\-house models. * Track and report model accuracy, cost per task, and savings against frontier model usage, so each use case shows it pays for itself. * Monitor model performance in production, retrain as data and processes change, and maintain clear documentation for every model. * Protect sensitive data, including HR, payroll, and time tracking information, through secure handling, access controls, and alignment with company cybersecurity standards. * Manage cloud compute for training and inference, keeping spend efficient and predictable. * Stay current on open\-weight models, tooling, and research, and recommend new approaches as the field moves. * Share knowledge with the Wayne development team and help build the company's internal machine learning capability. * Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating machine learning models, including large language models. * Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar). * Experience with fine\-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, or other parameter\-efficient methods. * Experience preparing datasets: collection, cleaning, labeling, and evaluation set design. * Experience deploying models to production, including serving, APIs, and monitoring. * Solid foundation in statistics and model evaluation. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to business leaders. Preferred Skills * Experience running open\-weight models with tools such as vLLM, Ollama, or llama.cpp, including quantization for cost\-efficient inference. * Computer vision or document AI experience, especially reading drawings, scanned documents, or forms. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector databases. * Familiarity with MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, and CI/CD for models. * Experience with time\-series forecasting. * Experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) as part of a daily workflow. * Experience with construction tech or ERP systems (e.g., Tekla, Spectrum, Procore). * Industry experience in construction, manufacturing, or industrial operations.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives. The role Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to own AI features end to end: Learn the work from the people who do it, build the system, measure it, ship it, and run it in production. The systems you will work on read and file documents, pull facts from medical records and police reports, answer questions across a case's full history, and run agents that chase records and draft routine work for staff to approve. You will report to the Lead AI Engineer, who sets the architecture and build plan; you own delivery within it. This is an individual\-contributor seat for someone who drives work forward with urgency and high quality without waiting to be told how, and whose work reaches case teams within weeks, not quarters. Responsibilities * Build: Ship production AI features, including structured extraction, classification and routing, case search, and agents that act with a person approving the result. * Integrate: Connect those features to the firm's systems (e.g., Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft Graph for Outlook and SharePoint, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, DocuSign). * Measure: Build the evaluation sets and tests for your features so every model or prompt change is measured on facts captured, facts missed, wrong answers, cost, and speed before it ships. * Run: Deploy your services as containers on Azure, monitor them, and fix them when they break. * Learn and train: Sit with intake, case management, records, and litigation staff before automating their work, and train them on what you ship. * Document: Write each system down so anyone on the team can run it. Qualifications Required: * Experience: 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-powered features to real users. * Ownership: A record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped outcomes with little supervision, and of finishing what you start. * LLM craft: Hands\-on work with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) spanning prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluation. * Stack: Strong Python or TypeScript/Node (both preferred), SQL and Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Git, Docker, and cloud deployment (Azure preferred). * Communication: Care with sensitive data and the ability to explain technical work in plain language. Preferred: * Models and tooling: Vector search (e.g., pgvector), evaluation frameworks, and agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol. * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: APIs and SOQL; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI or telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Documents and industry: OCR and document processing; legal, insurance, or healthcare data Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. What will you be doing? * Partner as a member of an empowered product team (Product Manager, Product Designer, Team Lead and engineers), sharing accountability for the outcomes your team commits to. * Contribute to continuous product discovery, helping the team assess feasibility early and building quick technical prototypes to test ideas before we commit to building. * Design, build and own Python backend services for our AI platform, from media upload through asynchronous ML processing to insight delivery. * Work API\-first and spec\-driven, defining clean REST contracts that serve headless frontends, internal teams and customer integrations. * Build MCP servers that make System1’s data and capabilities available to AI agents and tools, for customers and colleagues alike. * Engineer through Claude Code day to day, building and sharing skills, subagents and workflows that raise the speed and quality of the whole team. * Take code into production at scale with confidence, bringing the testing, observability and reliability our enterprise customers expect. * Contribute to our infrastructure as code and cloud environment, understanding how your services are deployed, run and scaled. * Work alongside our data scientists to bring models into production, learning the machine learning side of the platform as you go. * Build with enterprise security and compliance in mind, so the world’s largest advertisers can trust the platform with their data. You need to be this kind of person: * A missionary, not a mercenary. You care deeply about the customer problem and the outcome, not just the code. * Outcome\-driven. You measure your success by the change you create for customers and the business, not by tickets closed. * An engineer first, with AI as a force multiplier. You use AI tools to move faster with rigour, not to skip the thinking. * Comfortable with ambiguity and ownership. You don’t wait for a perfectly specified ticket, you frame the problem with your team and go. * A clear communicator, able to explain technical trade\-offs to product, design, data science and commercial colleagues as well as to fellow engineers. * Curious and a lifelong learner, with the integrity to back your point of view with evidence in front of colleagues, customers and stakeholders. * Able to see the bigger picture without losing attention to detail, your code quality is as strong as your product thinking. * A natural collaborator, comfortable working with all departments at all seniorities, and equally able to drive work forward independently. * Passionate about (good!) advertising, how it works and how it can be improved or excited to become so. You need to have the following experience: To be successful in this role, you will have approximately 3–5 years of real\-world software engineering experience and be ready to operate as a first\-class member of an empowered product team, where you’ll have outsized influence on the outcomes we deliver. * Strong commercial experience building backend services in Python. * Experience designing and building REST APIs, ideally spec\-driven, with a clear understanding of what frontends need from a headless architecture. * Experience building SaaS software and taking code into production at scale, whether as part of a team or with personal responsibility for it. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). * A working understanding of infrastructure as code and the ability to contribute to it. * Solid experience working with databases and data modelling. * Daily use of Claude Code as an engineering tool, including building your own skills and subagents, with an engineering\-led approach rather than vibe coding. * Experience building MCP servers, or a strong understanding of MCP and a drive to build with it. * Experience working in a product operating model, as part of an empowered, cross\-functional product team. * Familiarity with the security and compliance requirements of enterprise customers. * Familiarity with machine learning systems, or a genuine desire to learn, is a plus. This role will require you to operate across multiple discovery and delivery threads in parallel, balancing speed with the rigour and reliability our customers expect. Benefits We offer a competitive salary and bonus scheme, including health insurance, and pension. Our people are important to us, and we understand that each person has a life outside of work and we therefore offer flexible, remote working within the UK, with occasional travel to get together for company and team meet\-ups. We also offer several wellbeing resources such as “de\-clutter” afternoons for your personal and professional needs. We encourage learning and offer education reimbursement opportunities. We have recognition schemes, and regular socials, including summer and winter parties! We welcome applicants from all diverse communities and encourage our candidates to ask us about reasonable adjustments that we may be able to make to support through our recruitment process and while in post.

jobs.title: Civil Engineering Lead Professional
jobs.description: Job Description: **Civil Lead Professional** **T. Baker Smith \| Civil Engineering Leadership Opportunity** **Your Opportunity** T. Baker Smith is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Civil Lead Professional** to lead and develop our civil engineering team, oversee successful project delivery, and help drive the continued growth of our civil engineering services. This is more than a technical leadership role. We're looking for a proven leader who is passionate about developing people, building strong client relationships, and delivering innovative engineering solutions. As a Civil Lead Professional, you'll have the opportunity to influence the direction of our civil engineering operations while making a meaningful impact on our associates, clients, and communities. **What You'll Do** **Lead \& Develop Your Team** * Provide leadership, mentorship, and accountability for a team of Civil Engineers, Project Managers, Designers, and technical professionals. * Foster a collaborative, high\-performing environment focused on professional development, engagement, and accountability. * Coach and develop team members while identifying opportunities for career advancement and technical growth. * Ensure teams have the resources, training, and support necessary to deliver exceptional results. * Promote a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, and continuous improvement. **Oversee Civil Engineering Projects** * Provide leadership and oversight for a diverse portfolio of civil engineering projects, including site development, drainage, utilities, grading, and infrastructure improvements. * Guide Project Managers and technical teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations. * Oversee project planning, design development, technical execution, and overall project performance. * Support the development of proposals, project scopes, budgets, and fee negotiations. * Monitor project profitability, resource utilization, and operational performance. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver comprehensive engineering solutions. **Drive Quality \& Technical Excellence** * Champion quality assurance and quality control across all civil engineering projects. * Ensure engineering designs, plans, specifications, and deliverables meet applicable codes, regulations, and professional standards. * Provide technical guidance and support to project teams in resolving complex engineering challenges. * Promote consistent application of engineering best practices and quality standards. * Ensure compliance with firm policies, procedures, and safety expectations. **Build Relationships \& Support Growth** * Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, industry partners, and stakeholders. * Support business development efforts by identifying new opportunities and expanding existing client relationships. * Partner with discipline leadership to execute strategic initiatives and support long\-term growth. * Represent T. Baker Smith at client meetings, industry events, and professional organizations. * Help position the civil engineering team for continued success through exceptional service and project delivery. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field. * **Professional Engineer (P.E.) license required**, preferably in the state where the position is based. * Minimum of 5 years of progressive civil engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership and project management responsibilities. * Experience managing civil engineering projects involving land development, site design, drainage, utilities, municipal infrastructure, or related civil engineering services. * Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineering professionals and project teams. * Strong understanding of civil engineering design principles, project delivery, quality control, and regulatory requirements. * Experience managing project budgets, schedules, resource allocation, and financial performance. * Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. * Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Commitment to professional development, industry involvement, and continuous improvement. * Ability to travel to client meetings, project sites, and other office locations as needed. **Why T. Baker Smith?** At T. Baker Smith, we're more than an engineering firm — we're a team of professionals committed to delivering exceptional solutions while investing in the people who make our success possible. We believe great leadership is about more than managing projects. It's about empowering people, building relationships, and creating opportunities for growth. As part of our team, you'll enjoy: * A collaborative, people\-focused culture built on the **TBS COMPASS**. * Opportunities to lead meaningful projects and influence the growth of our civil engineering services. * Professional development, leadership training an office location or within a practice. Accountability Chart Responsibilities * Lead, Manage \& Hold Accountable (LMA) * Project delivery that builds client intimacy * QA/QC \& Standard of Care * Enforce firm Policies \& Procedures * Resource Utilization * Group Project Profitability, Engagement targets, Group Utilization Goals Essential Functions Lead, Manage \& Hold Accountable (LMA) * Provide clear direction using the TBS COMPASS. * Cultivate associates using Associate Development Plan (ADP) Process. * Consider promotions and salary adjustments. * Provide the necessary tools: Resources, Training, Technology, People, \& Time and Attention. * Delegate and communicate effectively. * Conduct regular and effective team meetings. * Conducts quarterly conversations. * Reward and recognize direct reports. * Provide strong HSE leadership. Project Delivery That Builds Client Intimacy * Ensure Project Managers deliver profitable projects in accordance with TBS Project Management Best Practices and Guidelines and TBS 5\-Step Proven Process. * Ensure Project Managers understand their part within the TBS Strategic Client Development Process. * Assist in fee development and negotiation to result in a profitable project. * Review and approve contracts; ensure solid contracts are executed on all projects within the group. * Provide thorough review and approval of TBS Project Management Plans (PMPs). * Ensure Project Managers are reviewing and updating their projects reports weekly. * Ensure Project Managers deliver projects in accordance with scope, schedule, and budget. * Ensure Project Managers are collecting fees in a timely manner from their clients. Updated 07\.21\.2023 Page 2 of 2 QA/QC \& Standard of Care * Ensure quality assurance/quality control and professional standard of care on all project work. Enforce Firm Policies \& Procedures * Ensure the firm’s Policies \& Procedures are implemented within the group. Resource Utilization * Allocate people and equipment effectively within and between groups. Key Performance Measures * Engagement score as per GallupQ12 * Group project profitability * Group utilization Firmwide Functions * Must be 100% on the same page with the TBS COMPASS. * Meet or exceed the bar on the TBS People Analyzer. * Adhere to the TBS Policies and Practices and TBS Safety Best Practices and Guidelines. * Perform duties, as assigned or as apparent, to add value to projects and exceed client expectations. * Meet or exceed personal target utilization rate. Supervisory/Coaching Responsibilities Directly supervises and mentors project managers, project professionals, project technicians, project assistants and field associates. Physical Requirements The associate is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to operate and maneuver, objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; use manual dexterity to operate keyboard, calculator, and telephone; talk and hear; climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel and lift up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision; depth perception; ability to adjust focus. Minimum Requirements * College course work or technical training plus five years related technical work experience, or any equivalent combination of education and experience. * Professional certification or licensing in work specialization. * Actively involved in career\-geared professional organizations. * Actively participate in leadership training (i.e., ACEC Leadership Pipeline). * Actively use effective communications skills (Written, Verbal, and Non\-verbal). Work Environment The associate works in an office and outside, potentially exposed to a variety of environmental conditions. Hours of Work and Travel Position requires 40\+ hours per week. Travel to visit clients, tour project sites, and other office locations on a regular basis is required. Nights away from home, and weekend commitments to the firm, its associates and clients are required.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Job Description: Solutions Developer Build Solutions That Make a Real Impact T. Baker Smith (TBS) is looking for a Solutions Developer to join our Innovative Solutions Group and help turn complex business and technology challenges into practical, scalable solutions. This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys more than simply writing code. You’ll have the opportunity to work across full\-stack application development, systems integration, automation, data architecture, and AI\-enabled solutions while collaborating with teams across the firm and supporting innovative solutions for our clients. If you enjoy solving problems, exploring emerging technologies, and taking solutions from concept through deployment, this could be a great opportunity to make an impact. What You’ll Do As a Solutions Developer, you will: * Design, build, test, deploy, and support secure, scalable software applications for internal teams and external clients. * Develop modern frontend and backend solutions using current frameworks, programming languages, APIs, and reusable components. * Design and maintain relational databases, data models, queries, and application data\-access solutions. * Integrate enterprise systems, GIS platforms, cloud services, databases, and third\-party applications through APIs, webhooks, and other integration methods. * Build automation workflows and data pipelines that reduce manual processes, improve data quality, and increase operational efficiency. * Develop and integrate AI\-enabled solutions, including LLM services, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and intelligent document processing when appropriate. * Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, define requirements, evaluate options, prototype ideas, and develop effective technical solutions. * Own assigned solutions throughout the full software development life cycle, from architecture and development through testing, deployment, documentation, support, and continuous improvement. * Use Git\-based version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to improve software quality and deployment reliability. * Apply secure development practices involving authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization. * Research emerging technologies and contribute to development standards and best practices. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Work collaboratively within an Agile development environment. What We’re Looking For * 4\+ years of professional experience in software development, solutions development, application development, systems integration, or a related technology discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Demonstrated full\-stack development experience using modern technologies such as: + TypeScript/JavaScript + Angular or React + Node.js + .NET + Python + Or comparable technologies * Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including data modeling, SQL development, and application data access. * Experience developing and consuming REST APIs, webhooks, and system integrations. * Familiarity with cloud\-based or hybrid application environments. * Working knowledge of Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, application deployment, and modern DevOps practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, planning, and communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Ability and enthusiasm to quickly learn new technologies. Even Better If You Have * Experience with containerized applications or development environments. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development and AI\-enabled application technologies. * Experience working with LLM APIs, RAG, vector search, or intelligent document processing. * Experience integrating GIS or other enterprise platforms. * A track record of identifying opportunities where technology and automation can improve business processes. Why T. Baker Smith? At TBS, technology is more than a support function—it’s an opportunity to rethink how work gets done. As part of our Innovative Solutions Group, you’ll work on meaningful technology initiatives that can improve processes across the firm while also helping solve complex challenges for our clients. You’ll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, explore emerging capabilities, collaborate with professionals across multiple disciplines, and help shape solutions from the ground up. We’re looking for someone who is curious, collaborative, solutions\-focused, and excited about using technology to create measurable value. If you’re ready to build, automate, integrate, innovate, and help us develop what’s next, we’d like to hear from you. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable – and passion goes a long way. Here at TBS, we are in the business of cultivating people, and you are set up to succeed if you identify strongly with these values / behaviors; ***Growth oriented, Trustworthy, Responsive, Works hard, smart, \& safe, Builds a positive team \& family spirit, and are Enthusiastic \& energetic.*** We also know that diversity of background and thought can enhance problem\-solving and encourage more creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. *Our purpose is investing in people to enhance communities and that commitment has endured for over 100 years. We pride ourselves in doing this by recruiting, hiring, and retaining diverse, passionate, and forward\-thinking talent. T. Baker Smith is an equal opportunity employer, and we are dedicated to providing an inclusive and diverse environment for all associates.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly technical and customer\-focused Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to lead the implementation and deployment of enterprise Voice AI solutions. This individual will work directly with enterprise customers to design, build, integrate, and launch production\-ready AI solutions within complex customer environments. The ideal candidate combines strong full\-stack engineering expertise with exceptional communication and client\-facing skills. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Live events are fun. Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact. Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization. Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences. TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR. We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers. **Why Work at TicketManager** At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real\-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast\-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun. If you’re excited about live events, cutting\-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here. **The Role** TicketManager is building its AI and automation infrastructure from the ground up, and we are looking for a partner to build it with. As an AI Automation Engineer, you will work directly with the VP of Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy to turn AI strategy into working systems: n8n workflows, MCP servers, LLM integrations, chat and voice agents, and AI\-driven engineering automation that makes the whole team faster. This is not a role with a fully written roadmap. Requirements are fluid, projects range from a one\-afternoon automation to a multi\-month platform build, and the technology changes monthly. You will break things and fix them faster, stay endlessly curious, and set your own priorities. When the first three approaches fail, you find the fourth, because we believe there is always a way. Your work will directly shape how TicketManager operates, serves customers, and scales. **Responsibilities:*** Build, maintain, and measure workflow automations in n8n across CRM, ERP, support, and fulfillment systems, from first prototype through stable production * Build, maintain, and measure custom MCP servers that connect Claude and other models to internal systems and data * Build and manage integrations with Claude, Gemini, and other model APIs, including prompt engineering and structured outputs * Design agentic workflows where AI takes multi\-step actions autonomously, and instrument them so we know when they work and when they don't * Build and maintain voice and chat agents for sales and support, and own the development of a full in\-app chatbot * Use AI CLI tools such as Claude Code and Codex daily, and automate code review, testing, QA, and release pipelines * Work with data lakes on AWS and Azure to keep AI systems fed with clean, current data, with security (credential handling, access scoping, audit logging) as a default * Define success metrics before every pilot, track cost, performance, and adoption, and kill what doesn't work fast * Evaluate new models and tools as they appear, and recommend when to adopt, switch, or skip * Present your work to leadership and cross\-functional teams, make the case for the technologies you believe in, and help non\-technical colleagues put them to use **Desired Skills and Experience:*** Bachelor's Degree required; MS in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a relevant field is preferred * 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in automation engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical role * Hands\-on experience with AI CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar, and with code automation and AI\-assisted code review and QA * Real experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable orchestration tools, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON * Familiarity with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and prompt engineering fundamentals * A track record of solving problems nobody handed you a clean answer for; comfortable with fluid requirements and setting your own priorities * Strong communication skills: you can present an idea and persuade others to adopt a technology or approach * Visible evidence of constant learning, such as side projects and experiments you built to teach yourself * Nice to have: experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), or building chat and voice agents (VAPI, Deep Chat, assistant\-ui, or similar) * Nice to have: Python or JavaScript, CI/CD and release automation (GitHub Actions or similar), AWS or Azure data lakes, RAG and vector databases **TicketManager Highlights:*** **Location:** Calabasas, CA (HQ) * **Compensation:** $95,000 \- $125,000 base salary \+ Variable Compensation * **Reports to:** VP, Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy * **Work** **Expectations**: Role is In\-Office, Monday\-Friday * **Retirement:** 401(k) \& Company Match * **Health Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision \& Chiropractic * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO * **Interview Process:** Multistage interview process with senior leaders across TicketManager to ensure strong alignment on role scope and expectations. * **Events:** Quarterly live event credits (we practice what we preach!), monthly happy hours, and volunteering * **Perks:** Fun, collaborative, in\-office culture at our HQ with catered lunches and big company perks with the autonomy of a high\-growth startup * **Recognition:** Inc. 5000 fastest\-growing private company by Inc. Magazine six years in a row. Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work by Inc. Magazine, The LA Business Journal, and Sports Business Journal * 4\.5 out of 5 Glassdoor rating * Used by over 4,000 globally known companies including \~15% of the Fortune 500 BeVi1QHdDC

jobs.title: Head of Validation - Security & Privacy
jobs.description: Washington D.C. Regular R\&D \- Security Job ID: A215299B to this job Responsibilities About the Team The Validation organization independently tests whether our security and privacy controls work and meet our extreamly high security and compliance standards. Security \& Privacy (S\&P) sets the standards and builds the solutions. Validation checks that they hold up against real attackers, at scale, and keep working over time. Validation owns the whole cycle from finding issues to fixing them: discovering weaknesses through red teaming, penetration testing and attack simulation across our social, games, education, productivity, and generative AI applications and models; deciding which ones matter based on how they could actually be exploited; driving fixes to completion across the company; confirming that fixes hold; and measuring how well our controls work overall. This covers product security, cyber defense, data protection, identity and access management (IAM), incident response, cloud and corporate infrastructure, privacy, and generative AI and content. About the Role The Head of Validation leads the following teams: Vulnerability Management, Validation Engineeringm Cyber \& Privacy Validation (Penetration Testing and Red Team) and Generative AI \& Content Assurance Validation. Responsibilities \- Build and lead a global Validation organization that gives leadership independent, objective evidence on whether the controls and software we approved work in practice. \- Own the full cycle from finding issues to fixing them: discovery (red teaming, penetration testing, attack simulation, adversarial AI testing, privacy testing), prioritization, remediation, verification after fixes, and measurement. \- Set the strategy and rules of engagement for offensive testing. Balance broad, whole\-company red team exercises with focused tests of single systems or targets, based on risk, threat intelligence, and business priorities. \- Run Vulnerability Management at scale. Prioritize based on how issues could actually be exploited, hold owners accountable for fixes, and push for fixes that remove whole classes of attack rather than single issues. Use automation to recommend fixes and close gaps faster. \- Make sure fixes hold. After any fix or incident, confirm from both inside and outside the network that the control works and that systems are back to their expected state. \- Through Validation Engineering, measure how well our security tools and processes work and how much they cover. Turn the results into an ongoing view of security posture that executives can track, with clear metrics, trends, and gap analysis. \- Independently challenge cyber defense, data protection, IAM, and privacy controls against realistic threats and declared requirements, including detection, prevention, containment, data handling, retention, and deletion. \- Independently test generative AI, recommendation, and content assurance controls, including jailbreaks, data leakage, model safety, ranking behavior, content provenance, and drift, working alongside first\-line content assurance owners. \- Keep validation independent from the teams that own controls. Control owners design, run, monitor, and fix their controls; Validation tests them. Build close working relationships while preserving objectivity. \- Report validation results, residual risk, and posture trends to the CSO, senior leadership, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), audit, and regulatory stakeholders where needed. \- Hire, develop, and keep strong leaders and engineers. Build a high\-performing, inclusive culture across regions and time zones. \- Define team charters, operating model, roadmap, headcount, and budget. Grow the validation scope as the program matures. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- 15\+ years in information security, including 8\+ years leading multi\-team organizations in offensive security, red teaming, penetration testing, vulnerability management, or security assurance. \- Proven record of building or scaling an offensive security or validation function at a large, complex technology company. \- Deep understanding of attacker tradecraft across cloud, corporate infrastructure, applications, identity, and data, and of how to translate it into meaningful control testing. \- Experience running vulnerability management at enterprise scale, including exploitability\-based prioritization, accountability for fixes, and success metrics. \- Strong executive presence. Able to turn technical findings into clear, objective risk statements for senior leadership. \- Experience working across security engineering, product, infrastructure, privacy, and legal teams while staying independent. Preferred Qualifications \- Experience validating privacy controls (data handling, retention, deletion, access) against regulatory or contractual requirements. \- Experience with adversarial testing of AI/ML systems, such as large language model (LLM) jailbreaks, prompt inj blic security research. jobs.description: **About Tin Can** ================= Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world. We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on two engineers to help make it happen. **The Role** ------------ A Tin Can earns its spot on the kitchen counter when a kid keeps picking it up. Because we build both ends of the call, we get to make things no other phone can, and the next ones are the kind families ask us for: an easier way to fill the contact book, even more speed dials, more a kid can do without waiting on a grown\-up. We’re hiring two Software Engineers to own the core product — the features that give a kid someone to call, a reason to call, and an easy way to do it. You’ll build across the whole product: the app parents live in (Flutter), the TypeScript services on AWS Lambda behind contacts, plans, call logs, and voicemail, and the call\-routing service that gates every call. You’ll sit with the Head of Product and the core experience’s PM and designer, alongside the engineers who own our voice platform, firmware, and account portal. When a feature reaches into the call path — a new hotline number, the voicemail menu — you’ll go there, with our voice engineers reviewing anything on the SIP and media plane. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Make it easier to hear who called and call them back — on the phone itself, in our services, and in the parents’ app * Give kids more of the phone: even more speed dials, and more a kid can set up alone, with a parent’s say\-so * Make the first week count — improved contact syncing, faster contact approvals, and a first run that has a family calling on day one * Build the fun, weird features no other landline can, the kind a kid tells their friends about * Own the call\-routing rules a feature needs — what a speed dial or a hotline number does, who a kid can reach — in the service every call goes through * Build the tooling behind hotlines — scheduling, uploading, playback — with the engineers who own our voice platform * Spec and build the service side of features whose other half is firmware — what the phone plays, how it rings — with the firmware engineer * Instrument what you ship — event schema, dashboard, alarm — so we can see kids calling more, week by week * Take a turn in our on\-call rotation, because nobody knows a feature like the person who built it **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years building user\-facing software, including a feature you took from idea to production and kept running * Strong TypeScript; you’ve built and run an API in production (ours run on AWS Lambda with Postgres) and can model contacts, permissions, and call history * You’ve shipped a mobile or web client people use every day; our app is Flutter, and we’ll teach you Dart * You think about the kid and the parent at once — what a kid can do alone, what needs a grown\-up, and how fast “no” takes effect * Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have * Hands\-on and scrappy; you’d rather prototype the flow on a real Tin Can than wait for a perfect spec * A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor * Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office Monday through Thursday; this isn’t a remote role * **Bonus:** Flutter or Dart; curiosity about telephony (dial plans, IVRs, text\-to\-speech); a product for kids or families; or Stripe, Shopify, or IoT integrations **Why Join Tin Can** ==================== * **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters. * **You’ll own the reason a kid picks up the phone:** Reliability makes a call connect; you’ll build what makes a kid want to make one — easier ways to call back, more speed dials, more to do when no one’s around — and see it in how often families call. * **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one. * **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care. If you’re excited by making a Tin Can the thing a kid reaches for when they’ve got something to tell someone — and building what makes that call easy to make and return — we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $145K \- $175K

For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. **Where is the work:** Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires. **What’s in it for you:** A sustainable future demands ongoing digital advancement. Our digital solutions team leads the way in developing next\-generation climate technology focused on reducing demand\-side energy consumption and emissions. Our team—including BrainBox AI, Nuvolo, and more—combines technical expertise with advanced analytics to create data\-driven solutions that add real value for customers, communities, and the planet. Whether you're advancing AI in HVAC or driving analytics for greater efficiency, your ideas will help engineer solutions for stronger communities and a sustainable world. Trane Technologies is seeking to hire a Unit Controls Embedded Software Engineer who will be working on a motivated global team to develop real\-time embedded machine controls for both HVAC Equipment and Equipment Integration into Building, Campus, and Enterprise\-Wide Automation Systems. Primary responsibilities include assisting in design, implementation and testing of complex control strategies that operate Trane Technologies’ flagship products. Additionally, the Unit Controls Embedded Software Developer will work in parallel with many engineering disciplines to ensure the delivery of robust control systems, verified through real world laboratory testing and virtual simulations. This opportunity offers growth, leadership, and career building challenges on a variety of next generation controls and can lead to other expanding opportunities in this broad global organization. **What you will do:** * Analyze, design, implement, test real\-time embedded software for electronic industrial HVAC controls. * Integrate software \& hardware \- test \& verify system functionality. * Help advance software development tools, technology and processes. * Estimate tasks and generate schedules for reporting to leadership and end customers. * Manage field reported defects. * Follow established Trane product development procedures and guidelines. * Estimated 5% travel. **What you will bring:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or Computer Science required. * 1\-3 years of C\+\+ or similar object\-oriented software design experience required. * Experience in analysis, design, implementation, test, and debugging of software required. * Experience in hands on development and troubleshooting on embedded targets a plus. * Experience in the UML and Object\-Oriented Design a plus. * Knowledge of XML, TCP/IP, MODBUS, BACnet, LonTalk a plus. * Familiarity with database applications a plus. * Familiarity with embedded operating systems (Linux OS) and networking a plus. * Familiarity with software configuration management and defect tracking tools a plus. * HVAC equipment/systems knowledge a plus. * Systems integration/engineering knowledge a plus. * Must have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. **Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:** $52,300\.00 \- $74,199\.99 **Compensation Type:** Salary **Incentive Eligible:** No **Sales Commission Eligible:** No **Disclaimer:** We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. **Thrive at work and at home:** * Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! * Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. * Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. * 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. **Disclaimer:** Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations **Safety Sensitive Role:** NoThe company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Technology Behind Medical Imaging \- This role is not hybrid or remote, must be able to work in office in Bloomingdale, IL location. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control? Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real\-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production. We are particularly interested in engineers who understand what happens below the application layer—people who can write efficient firmware, debug hardware\-software interactions, and develop dependable embedded solutions rather than relying exclusively on high\-level software frameworks. What You'll Do * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using C and/or C\+\+. * Develop bare\-metal firmware for microcontroller\-based systems and real\-time applications. * Design and improve motion\-control functionality involving motors, encoders, sensors, and actuators. * Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including CAN/CANopen, RS\-232, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet. * Collaborate with electrical engineers on PCB bring\-up, electronic interfaces, and hardware\-software integration. * Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve complex technical problems. * Develop software verification tests, investigate failures, and improve system reliability. * Document software architecture, interfaces, requirements, testing, and engineering changes. * Support prototype development, production troubleshooting, and ongoing product improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and product engineering teams. What We're Looking For Required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 7\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience. * Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C\+\+. * Demonstrated experience with bare\-metal programming and microcontroller\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues. * Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software. Highly desirable experience: * Motor control, motion\-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real\-time control. * Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability\-critical products. * Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation. * RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics. * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements. What Makes This Opportunity Different? * Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment. * Hands\-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems. * Cross\-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals. * Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability. * Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise. Benefits: * Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * STD, LTD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off, including holidays and vacation. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Who Will Succeed Here? You are a hands\-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines. You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion. Candidates whose experience is limited to application\-level software development without hands\-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit. Apply Today If you have embedded firmware, electronics, and motion\-control experience to make a difference, we want to hear from you. Please submit your résumé highlighting your embedded development experience, microcontroller platforms, communication protocols, and a few examples of challenging technical problems you have solved. Del Medical is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and applicable law. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you require sponsorship at all now or in the future to work in the United States? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: At Tesco Controls (a UFT company), our culture is grounded in the idea that the how we achieve results is just as important as the results themselves. Our winning behaviors guide the way we work, collaborate, and grow—both as individual employees and as a team. Our core winning behaviors are to Build Relationships, have a Relentless Drive for Results, to Communicate with Integrity and Focus, and to Be a Mentor, Teacher, Learner. These behaviors are more than words—they are the foundation of our success and continued growth. Here, you’ll join a stable, growing company where your work directly supports cleaner water, stronger communities, and critical infrastructure across the country. If you want meaningful work, real growth opportunities, and a team that takes pride in doing the right thing—you’ll find it here. Apply today and help power the systems that keep our world running. The Electrical Engineer is the core technical role in Tesco’s product\-focused Engineering organization. The role designs and applies manufactured electrical equipment around Tesco standard products and approved OEM equipment, adapting those products to project\-specific requirements while preserving manufacturability, listing constraints, repeatability, and commercial discipline. Electrical Engineers are expected to become proficient in complete equipment\-package design rather than one narrow drafting function. The role combines electrical calculations and schematics with physical layout, component application, material/BOM definition, manufacturing coordination, testing, and project execution. Controls, PLC/I/O, instrumentation, and communications are treated as interfaces that must be understood as part of the complete electrical product. This role will require travel up to 10% of the time. ### **What you'll do:** * Design complete electrical equipment and control packages using SolidWorks\-based model workflows, approved components, controlled product standards, reusable assemblies, and project\-specific configuration rules. * Develop one\-lines, three\-lines, elementary/control schematics, physical layouts, wiring/interface information, Bills of Materials, submittals, and production engineering data for switchboards, MCCs, VFD lineups, pump\-control panels, UL 508A panels, service equipment, and related products. * Apply Tesco standard products to customer specifications, determine required options and modifications, and coordinate approved deviations without unnecessarily creating one\-off designs. * Engineer power distribution, breakers/protection, bus/conductors, disconnects, control power, motor starters, VFDs, PLC/I/O interfaces, instrumentation interfaces, environmental controls, grounding/bonding, SCCR, and related electrical functions. Engineer or support UL 845 MCC modifications under applicable OEM file\-extension arrangements, maintaining OEM/listing requirements and coordinating modifications with qualified Manufacturing and Quality personnel. * Coordinate model and design validation with Manufacturing Engineering before customer submittal/release; resolve constructability, access, listing, thermal, material, bus/wiring, and production issues before they become shop NCRs. * Develop electrical material takeoffs and engineering inputs for estimates, procurement, and project execution; use standard assemblies and validated product data wherever available. * Participate in factory testing, customer witness testing, troubleshooting, field application/startup support, and closeout as assigned. * Work directly with Project Management on assigned priorities, deliverables, and schedule; promptly elevate technical risk, missing information, product deviations, or resource constraints. * Participate in regular morning shop walks and maintain in\-person communication with Manufacturing Engineering and production personnel when assigned equipment is in fabrication, assembly, wiring, or test. Engineers based outside Sacramento are expected to visit the manufacturing facility regularly while their equipment is in active production, as directed by project need. ### **What you bring:** * Typically 3\-8 years of industrial electrical design, power distribution, motor control, controls equipment, OEM product engineering, panel/switchgear design, or related experience. * Demonstrated experience using SolidWorks for electrical design or strong directly transferable 3D CAD/model\-based equipment\-design experience. Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, 3D panel/equipment layout, component libraries, reusable assemblies, BOM generation, and drawing/submittal production is strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of industrial electrical design including 120/208/240/480 VAC systems, 24 VDC controls, breakers/fuses, conductors, bus, starters, VFDs, transformers/control power, PLC/I/O interfaces, instrumentation, grounding/bonding, enclosure selection, and environmental/thermal considerations. * Familiarity with UL 508A; exposure to UL 891 switchboards, MCC equipment and UL 845 modification constraints, NFPA 70/NEC, NEMA, SCCR, and utility/service requirements is strongly valued. * Ability to read and create one\-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, panel/equipment layouts, equipment schedules, Bills of Materials, customer specifications, and manufacturer technical data. * Working knowledge of PLC, OIT/HMI, instrumentation, and industrial communications sufficient to coordinate electrical interfaces and produce complete equipment packages. * Ability and willingness to work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment, engage directly with the shop during production, participate in FAT, and travel to customer sites when project needs require. * Strong written/verbal communication, disciplined documentation, attention to detail, and a demonstrated bias toward ownership, standardization, and early problem resolution. Pay offered will be based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and geographic location. We may pay more or less than the range based on the person’s qualifications. In good faith we believe the range is what we will pay for this role at the time of the posting and may change in the future Join our team to innovate the future of water and wastewater. You’ll collaborate with coworkers who are the best and the brightest, challenge yourself on exciting work, and help build the best water and wastewater platform company in the U.S. Tesco Controls is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. TESCO provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information. (Compliant with the new VEVRAA and Section 503 rules) .

jobs.description: **The opportunity** Unity is building a robust, near real\-time reporting platform that powers critical analytics and decision\-making across our ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help architect and implement the distributed data systems that drive this platform at scale. In this role, you'll design and build high\-throughput, low\-latency data processing pipelines that power reporting used by internal teams and external customers. You'll operate at the intersection of distributed systems, stream processing, and cloud\-native infrastructure — ensuring correctness, reliability, and scalability in a high\-volume production environment. This is a high\-impact role where engineering rigor, architectural clarity, and production ownership matter. **What you'll be doing** * Own the end\-to\-end attribution pipeline. You will be a core engineer on the team responsible for getting attribution data right — from the moment a user interacts with an ad to the signal landing accurately in our data warehouse and in the hands of our ML and Reporting teams. This means owning a portfolio of high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive services and streaming pipelines that operate at the center of Unity's mobile advertising infrastructure. * Build and operate real\-time ad event processing. You will design, build, and operate the online services that receive ad interaction events from mobile SDKs and other partners, process terabytes of data at scale — including enrichments, transformations, and privacy operations — and deliver signals to external and internal partners in real time. * Lead our architectural modernization. A significant part of your work will be an active migration, replacing a legacy event\-handling layer with a modern gRPC\-based service. This is greenfield development within a production system, requiring careful design with backfill and failover behavior while preserving data accuracy throughout the cutover. * Improve low\-latency data services. You will improve the caching layer that serves data on every ad request within strict latency budgets, and own the persistence layer that links auction, fill, placement, and gamer identities together across the ad lifecycle. * Build and maintain critical ad serving infrastructure. You will build and own multiple services that support ad serving — including negative targeting and block listing — across the team's service portfolio. Responsibilities include logging, tracing, and authentication; a Kafka\-backed caching framework; health check and readiness probe infrastructure; and Docker\-based integrations. * Drive data health monitoring and quality. You will own real\-time monitoring of data health, detecting anomalies, event delivery rates, and data quality signals as they happen. You will also build and maintain the batch data pipeline jobs that produce daily datasets in BigQuery. * Collaborate across ML, Reporting, and external partners. You will be the team that ML modeling, Reporting, and external partners rely on for timely and accurate signal reporting. When something goes wrong, you will lead the investigation and recovery. **What we're looking for** * Strong foundation in distributed systems and systems design * Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data processing systems * Deep understanding of streaming concepts: exactly\-once semantics, watermarking and event\-time processing, stateful stream processing, checkpointing and recovery, and backpressure handling * Production experience with frameworks such as Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, or similar technologies * Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala * Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow for stream and batch coordination * Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures and distributed infrastructure including Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud platforms **You might also have** * Experience migrating legacy systems to modern architectures in production environments **Additional information** Zone A: $210,300 \- $273,400 USD Zone B: $187,200 \- $243,300 USD Zone C: $165,600 \- $215,200 USD *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Pricing
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Upstart’s Core Pricing team drives key initiatives that directly influence our revenue streams, unit economics, and product strategy. The team builds and evolves the common systems used to translate underwriting insights into accurate risk and profitability decisions for every loan we originate, while enabling a seamless borrower experience across products. As a **Senior Software Engineer on Core Pricing**, you will design and build scalable, reliable systems that power pricing decisions across Upstart’s products. In close partnership with engineering, data science, product, and business teams, you will own meaningful technical projects, improve the architecture and reliability of our pricing services, and help translate complex modeling and business requirements into durable software capabilities. **How you’ll make an impact** * Design, build, and evolve high\-performance, real\-time pricing systems that support critical lending decisions across Upstart products. * Own complex engineering projects from technical design through delivery, balancing scalability, reliability, correctness, and speed of iteration. * Partner with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate modeling and business requirements into reliable software solutions. * Identify and implement architectural improvements that increase the flexibility, maintainability, observability, and resilience of pricing services. * Contribute to technical standards for system design, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence within the Core Pricing team. * Support other engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing while contributing to sound technical decisions across the team. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or its equivalent, plus **4 years of software engineering experience**. * Experience writing production software in Python and working with Java, Kotlin, or another strongly typed programming language. * Experience designing, building, and operating scalable APIs, distributed systems, or microservices in a cloud environment such as AWS or GCP. * Experience owning the technical design and delivery of complex software projects from development through production. * Experience building production systems with requirements related to scalability, latency, reliability, or correctness. **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of fintech, financial systems, financial mathematics, statistics, machine learning platforms, or decisioning systems. * Experience working on business\-critical systems that affect revenue, profitability, risk, or core product outcomes. * Experience with distributed systems, cloud\-native architecture, platform engineering, continuous integration and deployment, or infrastructure as code. * Experience partnering with data science and product teams to productionize models, decisioning logic, or experimentation capabilities. * Ability to work effectively across engineering and non\-engineering teams on technically complex initiatives. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and  Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $166,900—$230,900 USD At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). Canada \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $153,000—$190,000 CAD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy
